title: Hello, My Name Is…
story_description: Two students meet for the first time outside a classroom. They ask names, say hello, and introduce themselves politely.
story_intro: This is a new semester.
Two students meet outside the classroom.
They meet for the first time and want to know each other.
They greet each other very politely.
They ask each other's names.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 你好！
dialogue.py: nǐ hǎo!
dialogue.en: Hello!

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 你好！
dialogue.py: nǐ hǎo!
dialogue.en: Hello!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 請問，你叫什麼名字？
dialogue.py: qǐng wèn, nǐ jiào shén me míng zi?
dialogue.en: Excuse me, what is your name?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 我叫王小明。你呢？
dialogue.py: wǒ jiào wáng xiǎo míng. nǐ ne?
dialogue.en: My name is Wang Xiaoming. How about you?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 我叫李華。
dialogue.py: wǒ jiào lǐ huá.
dialogue.en: My name is Li Hua.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 很高興認識你！
dialogue.py: hěn gāo xìng rèn shi nǐ!
dialogue.en: Nice to meet you!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 我也很高興認識你。
dialogue.py: wǒ yě hěn gāo xìng rèn shi nǐ.
dialogue.en: Nice to meet you too.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 你是學生嗎？
dialogue.py: nǐ shì xué sheng ma?
dialogue.en: Are you a student?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 是的，我是學生。你也是學生嗎？
dialogue.py: shì de, wǒ shì xué sheng. nǐ yě shì xué sheng ma?
dialogue.en: Yes, I am a student. Are you also a student?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 對，我們都是學生。
dialogue.py: duì, wǒ men dōu shì xué sheng.
dialogue.en: Right, we are both students.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 太好了。
dialogue.py: tài hǎo le.
dialogue.en: Great.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 再見！
dialogue.py: zài jiàn!
dialogue.en: Goodbye!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 再見！
dialogue.py: zài jiàn!
dialogue.en: Goodbye!

speaking.part_b: Role-play: You meet a classmate. Greet them and ask their name. Answer when they ask yours.
part_c: 你叫什麼名字？
你是學生嗎？

comprehension.q: What is the second speaker's name?
Are they both students?
Where are they?
How does A feel about meeting B?
What is the first speaker's name?

true_false.q: A and B have met before.
B is a teacher.
A is a student.
They are saying goodbye at the end.
Wang Xiaoming is a student.

passage.title: Hello, My Name Is… Listening Passage
passage.zh: 你好！請問，你叫什麼名字？我叫王小明。你呢？我叫李華。很高興認識你！
passage.en: This is a new semester. Two students meet outside the classroom. They meet for the first time and want to know each other. They greet each other very politely. They ask each other's names.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Introduce yourself in 3 sentences: say hello, your name, and your identity (student).

grammar.explanation: Simple 'Subject + Verb + Object' structure and the question particle '嗎'. To ask a yes/no question, add '嗎' at the end of a statement.
examples: 我是學生。 (I am a student.)
你是學生嗎？ (Are you a student?)
我叫李華。 (My name is Li Hua.)
他叫什麼名字？ (What is his name?)
我也很高興。 (I am also very happy.)

practice.q: Complete: 我___王小明。 (My name is...)
Complete: 他___是學生嗎？ (Is he also...)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你好，我是老師。
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ hǎo, wǒ shì lǎo shī.
expansion_dialogue.en: Hello, I am the teacher.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 老師好！我叫大衛。
expansion_dialogue.py: lǎo shī hǎo! wǒ jiào dà wèi.
expansion_dialogue.en: Hello teacher! My name is David.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 大衛，你是美國人嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: dà wèi, nǐ shì měi guó rén ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: David, are you American?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 是的，我是美國人。
expansion_dialogue.py: shì de, wǒ shì měi guó rén.
expansion_dialogue.en: Yes, I am American.

review.speaking: Introduce yourself to a friend: '你好，我叫[Name]，我是學生。'
review.writing: Write your name, your country, and one greeting in Chinese.
review.self_check: Can you say hello and tell someone your name?

title: Nice to Meet You
story_description: A new student joins the class. The teacher introduces the student to two classmates.
story_intro: A new student is here today.
The teacher is in the classroom.
The teacher introduces the new student to others.
Everyone says 'Nice to meet you'.
They are all friendly.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 各位同學，大家好！
dialogue.py: gè wèi tóng xué, dà jiā hǎo!
dialogue.en: Hello class, everyone!

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 這是一位新學生。
dialogue.py: zhè shì yī wèi xīn xué sheng.
dialogue.en: This is a new student.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 他叫馬克。
dialogue.py: tā jiào mǎ kè.
dialogue.en: His name is Mark.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 大家好，我叫馬克。
dialogue.py: dà jiā hǎo, wǒ jiào mǎ kè.
dialogue.en: Hello everyone, my name is Mark.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 很高興認識大家。
dialogue.py: hěn gāo xìng rèn shi dà jiā.
dialogue.en: Nice to meet you all.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 馬克，你好！我叫小麗。
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, nǐ hǎo! wǒ jiào xiǎo lì.
dialogue.en: Mark, hello! My name is Xiaoli.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 我叫大明。歡迎你！
dialogue.py: wǒ jiào dà míng. huān yíng nǐ!
dialogue.en: My name is Daming. Welcome!

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你們。
dialogue.py: xiè xie nǐ men.
dialogue.en: Thank you (all).

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 馬克，這是你的課本。
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, zhè shì nǐ de kè běn.
dialogue.en: Mark, this is your textbook.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝老師。
dialogue.py: xiè xie lǎo shī.
dialogue.en: Thank you, teacher.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 請坐吧。
dialogue.py: qǐng zuò ba.
dialogue.en: Please take a seat.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的。
dialogue.py: hǎo de.
dialogue.en: Okay.

speaking.part_b: Role-play: You are a teacher. Introduce a new friend to your classmates. Use 'This is...' and their name.
part_c: 他是誰？
這是什麼？

comprehension.q: Who is the new student?
Who is the new student?
What did the teacher give to Mark?
What is the name of the girl classmate?
What did Mark say to his classmates?
comprehension.a: Nice to meet you all / Thank you

comprehension.q: Did the teacher ask Mark to stand up or sit down?

true_false.q: Mark is a teacher.
Xiaoli and Daming are Mark's classmates.
The teacher gave Mark a pen.
Mark is a new student.
Everyone is in a classroom.

passage.title: Nice to Meet You Listening Passage
passage.zh: 各位同學，大家好！這是一位新學生。他叫馬克。大家好，我叫馬克。很高興認識大家。
passage.en: A new student is here today. The teacher is in the classroom. The teacher introduces the new student to others. Everyone says 'Nice to meet you'. They are all friendly.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Write 3 sentences about a classmate: their name, if they are a student, and 'Nice to meet you'.

grammar.explanation: Using '這 (zhè)' for 'this' and measure words like '位 (wèi)'. Measure words are required between a number/demonstrative and a noun.
examples: 這是我。 (This is me.)
這是一位老師。 (This is a teacher.)
那是你的課本。 (That is your textbook.)
兩位學生 (Two students)
請坐吧。 (Please sit down - 'ba' makes it a suggestion.)

practice.q: Complete: 這___一___學生。 (This is a student.)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 這是誰？
expansion_dialogue.py: zhè shì shuí?
expansion_dialogue.en: Who is this?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 這是我弟弟。
expansion_dialogue.py: zhè shì wǒ dì di.
expansion_dialogue.en: This is my younger brother.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 他也是學生嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: tā yě shì xué sheng ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: Is he also a student?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 不，他是老師。
expansion_dialogue.py: bù, tā shì lǎo shī.
expansion_dialogue.en: No, he is a teacher.

review.speaking: Introduce a friend: '這是我的朋友，他叫[Name]。'
review.writing: Write 3 sentences about a classmate.
review.self_check: Can you use 'This is...' to introduce someone?

title: Where Are You From?
story_description: Two learners talk after class and ask about countries and cities.
story_intro: Class is over.
Two students are talking.
They want to know about their countries.
They ask 'Where are you from?'.
They talk about cities too.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 你好，馬克！
dialogue.py: nǐ hǎo, mǎ kè!
dialogue.en: Hello, Mark!

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你好！
dialogue.py: nǐ hǎo!
dialogue.en: Hello!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 你是哪國人？
dialogue.py: nǐ shì nǎ guó rén?
dialogue.en: Which country are you from?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我是美國人。你呢？
dialogue.py: wǒ shì měi guó rén. nǐ ne?
dialogue.en: I am American. How about you?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 我是台灣人。
dialogue.py: wǒ shì tái wān rén.
dialogue.en: I am Taiwanese.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你是台灣哪裡人？
dialogue.py: nǐ shì tái wān nǎ lǐ rén?
dialogue.en: Where in Taiwan are you from?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 我是台北人。你呢？
dialogue.py: wǒ shì tái běi rén. nǐ ne?
dialogue.en: I am from Taipei. How about you?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我是紐約人。
dialogue.py: wǒ shì niǔ yuē rén.
dialogue.en: I am from New York.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 紐約很大，對嗎？
dialogue.py: niǔ yuē hěn dà, duì ma?
dialogue.en: New York is very big, right?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 對，紐約很大，也很漂亮。
dialogue.py: duì, niǔ yuē hěn dà, yě hěn piào liang.
dialogue.en: Yes, New York is big and also beautiful.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 我希望能去紐約。
dialogue.py: wǒ xī wàng néng qù niǔ yuē.
dialogue.en: I hope I can go to New York.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 歡迎你來紐約！
dialogue.py: huān yíng nǐ lái niǔ yuē!
dialogue.en: Welcome to New York!

key_sentences.en: Where in Taiwan are you from?
I hope to go to New York.

speaking.part_b: Role-play: Ask a friend where they are from (country and city). Tell them where you are from.
part_c: 你是哪國人？
你住在哪個城市？

comprehension.q: What nationality is Mark?
Where is the other student from?
Which city is described as big and beautiful?
What does the Taiwanese student hope to do?
Is Taipei in Taiwan?

true_false.q: Mark is from Taiwan.
A is from New York.
New York is a small city.
A hopes to visit New York.
Mark welcomes A to New York.

passage.title: Where Are You From? Listening Passage
passage.zh: 你好，馬克！你好！你是哪國人？我是美國人。你呢？我是台灣人。
passage.en: Class is over. Two students are talking. They want to know about their countries. They ask 'Where are you from?'. They talk about cities too.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Write where you are from and where you live (country and city). Use 3 sentences.

grammar.explanation: Asking 'Which country' with '哪國 (nǎ guó)' and nationality by adding '人 (rén)' after a country name.
examples: 國 + 人 = Nationality (e.g., 美國人)
哪 + 國 + 人 = Which country's person?
哪裡 + 人 = Person from where? (usually for cities)
很 + Adjective (e.g., 很大, 很漂亮)
也 + 很 + Adjective (e.g., 也很漂亮)

practice.q: Translate: Where in America are you from?
Complete: 倫敦很____。 (London is very beautiful.)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你是英國人嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ shì yīng guó rén ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: Are you British?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 不，我是澳洲人。
expansion_dialogue.py: bù, wǒ shì ào zhōu rén.
expansion_dialogue.en: No, I am Australian.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 澳洲漂亮嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: ào zhōu piào liang ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: Is Australia beautiful?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 澳洲非常漂亮。
expansion_dialogue.py: ào zhōu fēi cháng piào liang.
expansion_dialogue.en: Australia is extremely beautiful.

review.speaking: Ask someone: '你是哪國人？' and answer.
review.writing: Write: '我是[Country]人，我是[City]人。'
review.self_check: Can you say your country and city in Chinese?

title: How Are You Today?
story_description: A student arrives late and looks tired. A friend asks how they feel.
story_intro: The class is starting.
One student arrives late.
He looks very tired.
His friend asks about his feelings.
They talk about why he is tired.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 大衛，你來了！
dialogue.py: dà wèi, nǐ lái le!
dialogue.en: David, you're here!

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，我遲到了。
dialogue.py: bào qiàn, wǒ chí dào le.
dialogue.en: Sorry, I'm late.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 沒關係。你今天怎麼樣？
dialogue.py: méi guān xi. nǐ jīn tiān zěn me yàng?
dialogue.en: No problem. How are you today?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 我今天很累。
dialogue.py: wǒ jīn tiān hěn lèi.
dialogue.en: I am very tired today.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 為什麼？你昨天沒睡好嗎？
dialogue.py: wèi shén me? nǐ zuó tiān méi shuì hǎo ma?
dialogue.en: Why? Did you not sleep well yesterday?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 對，我昨晚功課很多。
dialogue.py: duì, wǒ zuó wǎn gōng kè hěn duō.
dialogue.en: Right, I had a lot of homework last night.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 太辛苦了。
dialogue.py: tài xīn kǔ le.
dialogue.en: That's too hard.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 我現在想喝咖啡。
dialogue.py: wǒ xiàn zài xiǎng hē kā fēi.
dialogue.en: I want to drink coffee now.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 我也想喝。我們課後去買吧。
dialogue.py: wǒ yě xiǎng hē. wǒ men kè hòu qù mǎi ba.
dialogue.en: I also want to drink some. Let's go buy some after class.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 好主意，謝謝你。
dialogue.py: hǎo zhǔ yì, xiè xie nǐ.
dialogue.en: Good idea, thank you.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 不客氣。現在我們開始上課吧。
dialogue.py: bù kè qì. xiàn zài wǒ men kāi shǐ shàng kè ba.
dialogue.en: You're welcome. Now let's start class.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 好。
dialogue.py: hǎo.
dialogue.en: Okay.

key_sentences.en: I want to drink coffee now.

speaking.part_b: Role-play: Your friend looks tired. Ask them how they are and why. Suggest a drink.
part_c: 你今天累嗎？
你喜歡喝咖啡嗎？

comprehension.q: Why is David late?
comprehension.a: He is not explicitly told why, but he arrived late.

comprehension.q: How does David feel?
Why is David tired?
comprehension.a: He had a lot of homework last night.

comprehension.q: What does David want to drink?
When will they buy coffee?

true_false.q: David slept well last night.
A is angry that David is late.
David has a lot of homework.
They will go buy coffee now.
A also wants to drink coffee.

passage.title: How Are You Today? Listening Passage
passage.zh: 大衛，你來了！抱歉，我遲到了。沒關係。你今天怎麼樣？我今天很累。為什麼？你昨天沒睡好嗎？
passage.en: The class is starting. One student arrives late. He looks very tired. His friend asks about his feelings. They talk about why he is tired.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Write 4 sentences about how you feel today and why (e.g., happy because it's sunny, or tired because of work).

grammar.explanation: Asking 'How' with '怎麼樣 (zěn me yàng)' and 'Why' with '為什麼 (wèi shén me)'. Using '想 (xiǎng)' for 'want to do something'.
examples: 你今天怎麼樣？ (How are you today?)
他為什麼不來？ (Why is he not coming?)
我想喝茶。 (I want to drink tea.)
我不想去。 (I don't want to go.)
開始上課吧。 (Let's start class - 'ba' for suggestion.)

practice.q: Complete: 他為什麼___高興？ (Why is he happy?)
Translate: I want to go home.
Complete: 我們___喝咖啡吧。 (Let's drink coffee.)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你今天高興嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ jīn tiān gāo xìng ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: Are you happy today?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 我很開心，因為今天是我的生日。
expansion_dialogue.py: wǒ hěn kāi xīn, yīn wèi jīn tiān shì wǒ de shēng rì.
expansion_dialogue.en: I am very happy because today is my birthday.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？祝你生日快樂！
expansion_dialogue.py: zhēn de ma? zhù nǐ shēng rì kuài lè!
expansion_dialogue.en: Really? Happy birthday!

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 謝謝你！
expansion_dialogue.py: xiè xie nǐ!
expansion_dialogue.en: Thank you!

review.speaking: Say how you feel: '我今天很[Feeling]。
review.writing: Write 4 sentences about your feelings.
review.self_check: Can you say how you feel and ask why?

title: In the Classroom
story_description: The teacher gives simple classroom instructions. Students ask for help.
story_intro: The teacher is talking.
The students are listening.
The teacher gives some commands.
Students follow the instructions.
If they don't understand, they ask questions.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 各位學生，請聽我說。
dialogue.py: gè wèi xué sheng, qǐng tīng wǒ shuō.
dialogue.en: Students, please listen to me.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 請打開課本，翻到第十頁。
dialogue.py: qǐng dǎ kāi kè běn, fān dào dì shí yè.
dialogue.en: Please open your textbook to page ten.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 請跟我讀。
dialogue.py: qǐng gēn wǒ dú.
dialogue.en: Please read after me.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 你好。
dialogue.py: nǐ hǎo.
dialogue.en: Hello.

dialogue.speaker: Students
dialogue.zh: 你好。
dialogue.py: nǐ hǎo.
dialogue.en: Hello.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 現在，請大家寫這兩個字。
dialogue.py: xiàn zài, qǐng dà jiā xiě zhè liǎng gè zì.
dialogue.en: Now, please everyone write these two characters.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 老師，請等一下。
dialogue.py: lǎo shī, qǐng děng yī xià.
dialogue.en: Teacher, please wait a moment.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 什麼事？
dialogue.py: shén me shì?
dialogue.en: What's the matter?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 我不明白這句話。
dialogue.py: wǒ bù míng bai zhè jù huà.
dialogue.en: I don't understand this sentence.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，我再說一遍。
dialogue.py: méi guān xi, wǒ zài shuō yī biàn.
dialogue.en: No problem, I'll say it again.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 謝謝老師。
dialogue.py: xiè xie lǎo shī.
dialogue.en: Thank you, teacher.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 大家明白了也？
dialogue.py: dà jiā míng bai le ma?
dialogue.en: Does everyone understand?

dialogue.speaker: Students
dialogue.zh: 明白了。
dialogue.py: míng bai le.
dialogue.en: Understood.

speaking.part_b: Role-play: You are a student. Tell the teacher you don't understand and ask them to say it again.
part_c: 你明白嗎？
請寫你的名字。

comprehension.q: What should the students open?
What page should they turn to?
What does the teacher want the students to do after her?
How many characters should they write?
What did the teacher do when the student didn't understand?

true_false.q: The students are listening to music.
They should open their bags.
A student asks the teacher to wait.
One student doesn't understand a sentence.
The teacher refused to say it again.

passage.title: In the Classroom Listening Passage
passage.zh: 各位學生，請聽我說。請打開課本，翻到第十頁。請跟我讀。你好。現在，請大家寫這兩個字。
passage.en: The teacher is talking. The students are listening. The teacher gives some commands. Students follow the instructions. If they don't understand, they ask questions.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Write 5 classroom commands (e.g., 'Listen to me', 'Open the book').

grammar.explanation: Giving polite commands using '請 (qǐng)' + Verb. Using '第 (dì)' for ordinal numbers (1st, 2nd, etc.) and '兩 (liǎng)' for the quantity 'two'.
examples: 請坐。 (Please sit.)
第一頁 (The first page)
兩個學生 (Two students - use 'liǎng' instead of 'èr' with measure words)
請再說一遍。 (Please say it one more time.)
我明白了。 (I understand now - 'le' indicates a change of state.)

practice.q: Complete: 請再讀___。 (Please read one more time.)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 老師，這個字怎麼讀？
expansion_dialogue.py: lǎo shī, zhè ge zì zěn me dú?
expansion_dialogue.en: Teacher, how do you read this character?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: Teacher
expansion_dialogue.zh: 這個字讀'書'。
expansion_dialogue.py: zhè ge zì dú 'shū'.
expansion_dialogue.en: This character is read as 'shū'.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 是什麼意思？
expansion_dialogue.py: shì shén me yì si?
expansion_dialogue.en: What does it mean?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: Teacher
expansion_dialogue.zh: 是'book'的意思。
expansion_dialogue.py: shì 'book' de yì si.
expansion_dialogue.en: It means 'book'.

review.speaking: Give a command: '請打開課本。'
review.writing: Write 5 classroom commands.
review.self_check: Can you understand and give simple classroom commands?

title: What Is This?
story_description: A student finds objects on a desk and asks what they are.
story_intro: The classroom is quiet.
A student is looking at a desk.
There are many things on the desk.
She asks her friend about the objects.
They use 'this' and 'that' to identify things.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 小明，這是什麼？
dialogue.py: xiǎo míng, zhè shì shén me?
dialogue.en: Xiaoming, what is this?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 這是一支筆。
dialogue.py: zhè shì yī zhī bǐ.
dialogue.en: This is a pen.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 那是什麼？
dialogue.py: nà shì shén me?
dialogue.en: What is that?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 那是我的筆記本。
dialogue.py: nà shì wǒ de bǐ jì běn.
dialogue.en: That is my notebook.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 這個也是你的嗎？
dialogue.py: zhè ge yě shì nǐ de ma?
dialogue.en: Is this also yours?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 不是，那是小華的書。
dialogue.py: bù shì, nà shì xiǎo huá de shū.
dialogue.en: No, that is Xiaohua's book.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 這本書很大。
dialogue.py: zhè běn shū hěn dà.
dialogue.en: This book is very big.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 對，那是字典。
dialogue.py: duì, nà shì zì diǎn.
dialogue.en: Right, that is a dictionary.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 桌子上還有什麼？
dialogue.py: zhuō zi shàng hái yǒu shén me?
dialogue.en: What else is on the table?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 還有一張地圖和一個書包。
dialogue.py: hái yǒu yī zhāng dì tú hé yī gè shū bāo.
dialogue.en: There is also a map and a schoolbag.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 地圖在那裡嗎？
dialogue.py: dì tú zài nà lǐ ma?
dialogue.en: Is the map over there?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 對，就在那裡。
dialogue.py: duì, jiù zài nà lǐ.
dialogue.en: Yes, right over there.

key_sentences.en: What else is on the table?

vocabulary.meaning: measure word for flat objects (paper, maps, tables)

speaking.part_b: Role-play: Point at objects in your room and ask '這是什麼？'. Have your partner answer using '這是...' and a noun.
part_c: 這是你的筆嗎？
桌子上有什麼？

comprehension.q: What is the first object identified?
Who does the book belong to?
What is described as very big?
Where is the map?
How many objects are mentioned at the end?

true_false.q: The pen is Xiaoming's.
The notebook is Xiaoming's.
The book is Xiaoming's.
There is a map on the desk.
The schoolbag is under the desk.

passage.title: What Is This? Listening Passage
passage.zh: 小明，這是什麼？這是一支筆。那是什麼？那是我的筆記本。這個也是你的嗎？
passage.en: The classroom is quiet. A student is looking at a desk. There are many things on the desk. She asks her friend about the objects. They use 'this' and 'that' to identify things.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Label 8 objects you might find on a desk in Chinese (e.g., pen, book, notebook, computer, map, etc.).

grammar.explanation: Using '這 (zhè)' and '那 (nà)' with measure words. Each noun has a specific measure word (e.g., '支' for pens, '本' for books, '張' for flat surfaces).
examples: 這一支筆 (This pen)
那三本書 (Those three books)
這兩張地圖 (These two maps)
那個書包 (That schoolbag)
桌子上 (On the table - 'shàng' comes after the noun)

practice.q: Complete: 桌子___有書。 (There are books on the table.)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 這是你的電腦嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: zhè shì nǐ de diàn nǎo ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: Is this your computer?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 對，這是我的電腦。
expansion_dialogue.py: duì, zhè shì wǒ de diàn nǎo.
expansion_dialogue.en: Yes, this is my computer.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你的電腦很新。
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ de diàn nǎo hěn xīn.
expansion_dialogue.en: Your computer is very new.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 謝謝。
expansion_dialogue.py: xiè xie.
expansion_dialogue.en: Thank you.

review.speaking: Ask '這是什麼？' and answer with '這是一支筆。'
review.writing: Write: '桌子上有書和筆。'
review.self_check: Can you use 'this' and 'that' with correct measure words?

title: My Bag Is Missing
story_description: A student cannot find their bag. A friend helps search in the classroom.
story_intro: The class is over.
A student is looking for something.
She cannot find her bag.
Her friend helps her search.
They check the desks and chairs.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 糟糕，我的書包在哪裡？
dialogue.py: zāo gāo, wǒ de shū bāo zài nǎ lǐ?
dialogue.en: Oh no, where is my schoolbag?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 你找不到書包了嗎？
dialogue.py: nǐ zhǎo bù dào shū bāo le ma?
dialogue.en: Can't you find your schoolbag?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 對，我剛才還在這裡。
dialogue.py: duì, wǒ gāng cái hái zài zhè lǐ.
dialogue.en: Right, I was just here a moment ago.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 別擔心，我們一起找吧。
dialogue.py: bié dān xīn, wǒ men yī qǐ zhǎo ba.
dialogue.en: Don't worry, let's look together.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 這是你的嗎？
dialogue.py: zhè shì nǐ de ma?
dialogue.en: Is this yours?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 不是，那是小華的。
dialogue.py: bù shì, nà shì xiǎo huá de.
dialogue.en: No, that's Xiaohua's.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 你的書包是什麼顏色的？
dialogue.py: nǐ de shū bāo shì shén me yán sè de?
dialogue.en: What color is your schoolbag?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 是藍色的，很大。
dialogue.py: shì lán sè de, hěn dà.
dialogue.en: It's blue and very big.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 看！那是你的嗎？在桌子下面。
dialogue.py: kàn! nà shì nǐ de ma? zài zhuō zi xià mian.
dialogue.en: Look! Is that yours? Under the table.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 對！那是我的書包。太謝謝你了！
dialogue.py: duì! nà shì wǒ de shū bāo. tài xiè xie nǐ le!
dialogue.en: Yes! That is my schoolbag. Thank you so much!

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，找到了就好。
dialogue.py: méi guān xi, zhǎo dào le jiù hǎo.
dialogue.en: No problem, it's good that it's found.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 我的書和筆都在裡面。
dialogue.py: wǒ de shū hé bǐ dōu zài lǐ miàn.
dialogue.en: My books and pens are all inside.

key_sentences.zh: 你的書包是什麼顏色的？
key_sentences.example: 他的衣服是什麼顏色的？

speaking.part_b: Role-play: You lost your phone. Describe its color to your friend and look for it together. Use '藍色的' or '紅色的'.
part_c: 你的書包是什麼顏色的？
書包裡面有什麼？

comprehension.q: What did the student lose?
Where was the student just a moment ago?
What color is the schoolbag?
Where was the schoolbag found?
What is inside the schoolbag?

true_false.q: The student is not worried about the bag.
The first bag they found was blue.
The student's bag is big.
They found the bag on top of the desk.
A helped B find the bag.

passage.title: My Bag Is Missing Listening Passage
passage.zh: 糟糕，我的書包在哪裡？你找不到書包了嗎？對，我剛才還在這裡。別擔心，我們一起找吧。這是你的嗎？
passage.en: The class is over. A student is looking for something. She cannot find her bag. Her friend helps her search. They check the desks and chairs.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Write a short note about a lost item: what it is, its color, and where you last saw it.

grammar.explanation: Possessive marker '的 (de)' and location words like '裡面 (lǐ miàn)', '下面 (xià miàn)'. Adjectives with '的' (e.g., '藍色的').
examples: 我的書 (My book)
老師的筆 (Teacher's pen)
藍色的書包 (Blue schoolbag)
桌子下面 (Under the table)
書包裡面 (Inside the schoolbag)

practice.q: Complete: 書包___有什麼？ (What is inside the schoolbag?)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 那是你的錢包嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: nà shì nǐ de qián bāo ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: Is that your wallet?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 在哪裡？
expansion_dialogue.py: zài nǎ lǐ?
expansion_dialogue.en: Where?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 就在椅子下面。
expansion_dialogue.py: jiù zài yǐ zi xià mian.
expansion_dialogue.en: Right under the chair.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 喔，對！那是我的。謝謝！
expansion_dialogue.py: ō, duì! nà shì wǒ de. xiè xie!
expansion_dialogue.en: Oh, right! That's mine. Thanks!

review.speaking: Ask '這是你的[Item]嗎？' and answer.
review.writing: Write a short lost-item note.
review.self_check: Can you describe a lost item and its location?

title: Numbers Around Us
story_description: Two students compare phone numbers, room numbers, and page numbers.
story_intro: Two students are talking after class.
They want to stay in touch.
They exchange phone numbers.
They also talk about their room numbers.
They use numbers from 1 to 100.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 馬克，你的電話號碼是多少？
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, nǐ de diàn huà hào mǎ shì duō shǎo?
dialogue.en: Mark, what is your phone number?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.py: wǒ de hào mǎ shì líng jiǔ yī èr, sān sì wǔ, liù qī bā.
dialogue.en: My number is 0912-345-678.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 好的，我記下來了。
dialogue.py: hǎo de, wǒ jì xià lái le.
dialogue.en: Okay, I've written it down.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 你住在哪個房間？
dialogue.py: nǐ zhù zài nǎ gè fáng jiān?
dialogue.en: Which room do you live in?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我住在 305 號房間。你呢？
dialogue.py: wǒ zhù zài sān líng wǔ hào fáng jiān. nǐ ne?
dialogue.en: I live in room 305. How about you?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 我住在 218 號。我們很近。
dialogue.py: wǒ zhù zài èr yī bā hào. wǒ men hěn jìn.
dialogue.en: I live in room 218. We are very close.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 對了，今天的作業在第幾頁？
dialogue.py: duì le, jīn tiān de zuò yè zài dì jǐ yè?
dialogue.en: By the way, what page is today's homework on?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 在第五十二頁。
dialogue.py: zài dì wǔ shí èr yè.
dialogue.en: It's on page fifty-two.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 五十二頁？這麼多！
dialogue.py: wǔ shí èr yè? zhè me duō!
dialogue.en: Page fifty-two? So many!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 不，是從第四十頁到五十二頁。
dialogue.py: bù, shì cóng dì sì shí yè dào wǔ shí èr yè.
dialogue.en: No, it's from page forty to fifty-two.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 喔，一共十二頁。
dialogue.py: ō, yī gòng shí èr yè.
dialogue.en: Oh, twelve pages in total.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 對，一共十二頁。
dialogue.py: duì, yī gòng shí èr yè.
dialogue.en: Correct, twelve pages in total.

key_sentences.en: What page is the homework on?

key_sentences.zh: 從第四十頁到五十二頁。

speaking.part_b: Role-play: Exchange phone numbers and room numbers with a new friend. Use numbers 0-10 and room numbers like 101, 202.
part_c: 你的電話號碼是什麼？
你住在哪裡？

comprehension.q: What is Mark's phone number?
Which room does Mark live in?
Are the two students living close or far from each other?
What page is the homework on?
How many pages of homework are there in total?

true_false.q: Mark gave his address to A.
A lives in room 218.
The homework starts from page 52.
There are 40 pages of homework.
Mark thinks there is a lot of homework.

passage.title: Numbers Around Us Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克，你的電話號碼是多少？我的號碼是0912-345-678。好的，我記下來了。你住在哪個房間？我住在305號房間。你呢？
passage.en: Two students are talking after class. They want to stay in touch. They exchange phone numbers. They also talk about their room numbers. They use numbers from 1 to 100.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Write your own (imaginary) phone number, your room number, and a page range (e.g., 'from page 10 to page 20').

grammar.explanation: Asking for numbers with '多少 (duō shǎo)' (for phone numbers) or '幾 (jǐ)' (for small counts or series). Using '從 (cóng)...到 (dào)...' for ranges.
examples: 電話號碼是多少？ (What is the phone number?)
你有幾個朋友？ (How many friends do you have?)
第三頁 (The third page)
從週一到週五 (From Monday to Friday)
一共一百塊 (One hundred dollars in total)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 老師，作業是一百頁嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: lǎo shī, zuò yè shì yī bǎi yè ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: Teacher, is the homework page one hundred?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: Teacher
expansion_dialogue.zh: 不是，作業是一百個字。
expansion_dialogue.py: bù shì, zuò yè shì yī bǎi gè zì.
expansion_dialogue.en: No, the homework is one hundred characters.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 一百個字？沒問題。
expansion_dialogue.py: yī bǎi gè zì? méi wèn tí.
expansion_dialogue.en: One hundred characters? No problem.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: Teacher
expansion_dialogue.zh: 很好。
expansion_dialogue.py: hěn hǎo.
expansion_dialogue.en: Good.

review.speaking: Say your phone number in Chinese.
review.self_check: Can you say and understand numbers up to 100?

title: What Time Is It?
story_description: A student asks the time before class starts. Another student checks the clock.
story_intro: The sun is high.
A student is running to class.
He asks another student about the time.
They check the clock.
They talk about being early or late.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 請問，現在幾點？
dialogue.py: qǐng wèn, xiàn zài jǐ diǎn?
dialogue.en: Excuse me, what time is it now?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 現在是早上八點五十分。
dialogue.py: xiàn zài shì zǎo shang bā diǎn wǔ shí fēn.
dialogue.en: It is 8:50 AM now.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 糟糕，九點上課嗎？
dialogue.py: zāo gāo, jiǔ diǎn shàng kè ma?
dialogue.en: Oh no, does class start at 9:00?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 對，九點整開始。
dialogue.py: duì, jiǔ diǎn zhěng kāi shǐ.
dialogue.en: Yes, it starts at 9:00 sharp.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 我快要遲到了！
dialogue.py: wǒ kuài yào chí dào le!
dialogue.en: I'm about to be late!

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，還有十分鐘。
dialogue.py: méi guān xi, hái yǒu shí fēn zhōng.
dialogue.en: It's okay, there are still ten minutes left.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 老師到了嗎？
dialogue.py: lǎo shī dào le ma?
dialogue.en: Has the teacher arrived?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 老師已經在教室裡了。
dialogue.py: lǎo shī yǐ jīng zài jiào shì lǐ le.
dialogue.en: The teacher is already in the classroom.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 你為什麼不進去？
dialogue.py: nǐ wèi shén me bù jìn qù?
dialogue.en: Why aren't you going in?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 我現在在等朋友。
dialogue.py: wǒ xiàn zài zài děng péng you.
dialogue.en: I'm waiting for a friend right now.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 喔，好吧。我先进去了。再見！
dialogue.py: ō, hǎo ba. wǒ xiān jìn qù le. zài jiàn!
dialogue.en: Oh, okay. I'm going in first. Goodbye!

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 好，再見！
dialogue.py: hǎo, zài jiàn!
dialogue.en: Okay, goodbye!

key_sentences.en: There are still ten minutes left.

speaking.part_b: Role-play: Ask a passerby for the time. They tell you it's almost 10:00. React if you are early or late for a meeting.
part_c: 你早上幾點起床？
現在幾點？

comprehension.q: What is the exact time mentioned?
When does the class start?
How many minutes until class starts?
Where is the teacher?
Why is the second person staying outside?

true_false.q: The first student is early.
Class starts at 8:50.
The teacher is late.
There are 10 minutes left before class.
Student B is going inside now.

passage.title: What Time Is It? Listening Passage
passage.zh: 請問，現在幾點？現在是早上八點五十分。糟糕，九點上課嗎？對，九點整開始。我快要遲到了！
passage.en: The sun is high. A student is running to class. He asks another student about the time. They check the clock. They talk about being early or late.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Write 5 times of day in Chinese (e.g., 7:30 AM, 12:00 PM, 6:15 PM, 10:45 PM, 1:00 AM).

grammar.explanation: Telling time with '點 (diǎn)' and '分 (fēn)'. Using '快要...了' for future events and '已經...了' for past actions.
examples: 三點十分 (3:10)
快要十點了 (Almost 10:00)
已經十點了 (Already 10:00)

practice.a: 四點一刻 / 四點十五分

practice.q: Complete: 他____來了。 (He has already arrived.)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 現在幾點？
expansion_dialogue.py: xiàn zài jǐ diǎn?
expansion_dialogue.en: What time is it?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 差五分十點。
expansion_dialogue.py: chā wǔ fēn shí diǎn.
expansion_dialogue.en: Five minutes to ten.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 喔，九點五十五分。
expansion_dialogue.py: ō, jiǔ diǎn wǔ shí wǔ fēn.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 對，很晚了。
expansion_dialogue.py: duì, hěn wǎn le.
expansion_dialogue.en: Yes, it's very late.

review.speaking: Ask '現在幾點？' and tell the time.
review.writing: Write 5 times of day.
review.self_check: Can you tell and understand time in Chinese?

title: Days of the Week
story_description: Two classmates check their weekly class schedule.
story_intro: The new week is starting.
Two friends are talking about classes.
They check which days they have Chinese class.
They talk about today and tomorrow.
They plan to meet later this week.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 馬克，今天星期幾？
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, jīn tiān xīng qī jǐ?
dialogue.en: Mark, what day of the week is it today?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 今天星期一。
dialogue.py: jīn tian xīng qī yī.
dialogue.en: Today is Monday.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 我們今天有中文課嗎？
dialogue.py: wǒ men jīn tiān yǒu zhōng wén kè ma?
dialogue.en: Do we have Chinese class today?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 有，星期一、三、五都有中文課。
dialogue.py: yǒu, xīng qī yī, sān, wǔ dōu yǒu zhōng wén kè.
dialogue.en: Yes, we have Chinese class every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 那明天星期二沒有中文課？
dialogue.py: nà míng tiān xīng qī èr méi yǒu zhōng wén kè?
dialogue.en: So there is no Chinese class tomorrow, Tuesday?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 對，明天沒有。但是有體育課。
dialogue.py: duì, míng tiān méi yǒu. dàn shì yǒu tǐ yù kè.
dialogue.en: Right, none tomorrow. But we have PE class.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我喜歡體育課。
dialogue.py: tài hǎo le, wǒ xǐ huan tǐ yù kè.
dialogue.en: Great, I like PE class.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 星期六和星期日你做什麼？
dialogue.py: xīng qī liù hé xīng qī rì nǐ zuò shén me?
dialogue.en: What do you do on Saturday and Sunday?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 我週末通常休息，或者看電影。
dialogue.py: wǒ zhōu mò tōng cháng xiū xi, huò zhě kàn diàn yǐng.
dialogue.en: I usually rest on weekends, or watch movies.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 這個星期六我們一起看電影吧。
dialogue.py: zhè ge xīng qī liù wǒ men yī qǐ kàn diàn yǐng ba.
dialogue.en: Let's watch a movie together this Saturday.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 好啊，沒問題！
dialogue.py: hǎo a, méi wèn tí!
dialogue.en: Sure, no problem!

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 那我們星期六見。
dialogue.py: nà wǒ men xīng qī liù jiàn.
dialogue.en: Then I'll see you on Saturday.

key_sentences.en: There are classes on Mon, Wed, Fri.
What do you do on weekends?

speaking.part_b: Role-play: Plan a meeting with your friend. Check their availability on different days of the week and agree on a day.
part_c: 你今天有課嗎？
你週末喜歡做什麼？

comprehension.q: What day is it today?
Which days do they have Chinese class?
Does Student A like PE class?
What does Student A usually do on weekends?
What are they planning to do on Saturday?

true_false.q: Tomorrow is Wednesday.
They have Chinese class on Tuesdays.
Mark likes PE class.
A and Mark will meet on Saturday.
Student A is busy on weekends.

passage.title: Days of the Week Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克，今天星期幾？今天星期一。我們今天有中文課嗎？有，星期一、三、五都有中文課。那明天星期二沒有中文課？
passage.en: The new week is starting. Two friends are talking about classes. They check which days they have Chinese class. They talk about today and tomorrow. They plan to meet later this week.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Write 5 sentences about your weekly schedule (e.g., 'Monday I have class', 'Sunday I rest').

grammar.explanation: Days of the week are formed with '星期 (xīng qī)' + Number (1-6). Sunday is '星期日 (rì)' or '星期天 (tiān)'. Use '或者' for 'or' in statements.
examples: 星期一 (Monday)
星期六 (Saturday)
星期日 (Sunday)
今天有課。 (Today has class.)
看書或者聽音樂。 (Read books or listen to music.)

practice.q: Complete: 我休息___看書。 (I rest or read books.)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 後天是星期幾？
expansion_dialogue.py: hòu tiān shì xīng qī jǐ?
expansion_dialogue.en: What day is the day after tomorrow?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 今天是星期三，後天是星期五。
expansion_dialogue.py: jīn tiān shì xīng qī sān, hòu tiān shì xīng qī wǔ.
expansion_dialogue.en: Today is Wednesday, the day after tomorrow is Friday.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 星期五你有空嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: xīng qī wǔ nǐ yǒu kòng ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: Are you free on Friday?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 有空，怎麼了？
expansion_dialogue.py: yǒu kòng, zěn me le?
expansion_dialogue.en: Yes, I am. What's up?

review.speaking: Say your weekly schedule.
review.writing: Write 5 sentences about your week.
review.self_check: Can you say all the days of the week in Chinese?

title: My Family
story_description: A student shows a family photo to a friend.
story_intro: Two friends are sitting together.
One student has a photo in her hand.
It is a photo of her family.
She introduces each person in the photo.
They talk about how many people are in their families.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 馬克，你看！這是我家的照片。
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, nǐ kàn! zhè shì wǒ jiā de zhào piàn.
dialogue.en: Mark, look! This is a photo of my family.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 哇，這張照片很漂亮。這是你爸爸和媽媽嗎？
dialogue.py: wa, zhè zhāng zhào piàn hěn piào liang. zhè shì nǐ bà ba hé mā ma ma?
dialogue.en: Wow, this photo is beautiful. Are these your father and mother?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 對，這是我爸爸，這是我媽媽。
dialogue.py: duì, zhè shì wǒ bà ba, zhè shì wǒ mā ma.
dialogue.en: Yes, this is my father, and this is my mother.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 他們看起來很年輕。
dialogue.py: tā men kàn qǐ lái hěn nián qīng.
dialogue.en: They look very young.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。這是我哥哥，這是我妹妹。
dialogue.py: xiè xie. zhè shì wǒ gē ge, zhè shì wǒ mèi mei.
dialogue.en: Thanks. This is my older brother, and this is my younger sister.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你有兄弟姐妹嗎？
dialogue.py: nǐ yǒu xiōng dì jiě mèi ma?
dialogue.en: Do you have siblings?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 有，一個哥哥和一個妹妹。你呢？
dialogue.py: yǒu, yī gè gē ge hé yī gè mèi mei. nǐ ne?
dialogue.en: Yes, one older brother and one younger sister. How about you?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我沒有兄弟姐妹，我是獨生子。
dialogue.py: wǒ méi yǒu xiōng dì jiě mèi, wǒ shì dú shēng zǐ.
dialogue.en: I don't have siblings, I am an only child.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 喔，那你家有幾口人？
dialogue.py: ō, nà nǐ jiā yǒu jǐ kǒu rén?
dialogue.en: Oh, then how many people are in your family?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我家有三口人：爸爸、媽媽和我。
dialogue.py: wǒ jiā yǒu sān kǒu rén: bà ba, mā ma hé wǒ.
dialogue.en: There are three people in my family: father, mother, and me.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 我家有五口人。我們家很大。
dialogue.py: wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ kǒu rén. wǒ men jiā hěn dà.
dialogue.en: There are five people in my family. Our family is big.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 真好！
dialogue.py: zhēn hǎo!
dialogue.en: That's great!

key_sentences.en: Are these your father and mother?
How many people in your family?

speaking.part_b: Role-play: Show an imaginary photo to your friend. Introduce your family members and ask about their family size.
part_c: 你家有幾口人？
你有兄弟姐妹嗎？

comprehension.q: What is A showing to Mark?
How many siblings does A have?
Is Mark an only child?
How many people are in A's family?
How many people are in Mark's family?

true_false.q: A has an older sister.
Mark's parents look old.
There are five people in A's family.
Mark has one brother.
A and Mark are talking about a photo.

passage.title: My Family Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克，你看！這是我家的照片。哇，這張照片很漂亮。這是你爸爸和媽媽嗎？對，這是我爸爸，這是我媽媽。他們看起來很年輕。謝謝。這是我哥哥，這是我妹妹。
passage.en: Two friends are sitting together. One student has a photo in her hand. It is a photo of her family. She introduces each person in the photo. They talk about how many people are in their families.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Write 5 sentences about your family (e.g., 'My family has 4 people', 'I have a brother').

grammar.explanation: Using '口 (kǒu)' as a measure word for family members. Using '有 (yǒu)' for possession ('have') and '沒有 (méi yǒu)' for 'don't have'.
examples: 我有哥哥。 (I have an older brother.)
我沒有弟弟。 (I don't have a younger brother.)
你家有幾口人？ (How many people are in your family?)
我家有三口人。 (My family has three people.)
這是我爸爸。 (This is my father.)

practice.q: Translate: I don't have a brother.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 這是你姐姐嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: zhè shì nǐ jiě jie ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: Is this your older sister?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 不，這是我好朋友。
expansion_dialogue.py: bù, zhè shì wǒ hǎo péng you.
expansion_dialogue.en: No, this is my good friend.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 她真漂亮。
expansion_dialogue.py: tā zhēn piào liang.
expansion_dialogue.en: She is really beautiful.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 謝謝，她也是我們班的學生。
expansion_dialogue.py: xiè xie, tā yě shì wǒ men bān de xué sheng.
expansion_dialogue.en: Thanks, she is also a student in our class.

review.speaking: Introduce your family size and members.
review.writing: Write 5 sentences about your family.
review.self_check: Can you name your family members and say how many people are in your family?

title: My Friend
story_description: A student describes their best friend to another classmate.
story_intro: Two students are talking during a break.
One student asks about the other's friends.
A student describes his best friend.
He talks about his friend's name, nationality, and personality.
They talk about what they do together.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 馬克，你有很多朋友嗎？
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, nǐ yǒu hěn duō péng you ma?
dialogue.en: Mark, do you have many friends?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 有，我在這裡認識了很多新朋友。
dialogue.py: yǒu, wǒ zài zhè lǐ rèn shi le hěn duō xīn péng you.
dialogue.en: Yes, I've met many new friends here.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 誰是你最好的朋友？
dialogue.py: shéi shì nǐ zuì hǎo de péng you?
dialogue.en: Who is your best friend?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我最好的朋友叫大衛。
dialogue.py: wǒ zuì hǎo de péng you jiào dà wèi.
dialogue.en: My best friend is called David.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 大衛是哪國人？
dialogue.py: dà wèi shì nǎ guó rén?
dialogue.en: What nationality is David?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 他是加拿大人。我們一起學中文。
dialogue.py: tā shì jiā ná dà rén. wǒ men yī qǐ xué zhōng wén.
dialogue.en: He is Canadian. We study Chinese together.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 他是一個怎麼樣的人？
dialogue.py: tā shì yī gè zěn me yàng de rén?
dialogue.en: What kind of person is he?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 他非常聰明，也很幽默。
dialogue.py: tā fēi cháng cōng ming, yě hěn yōu mò.
dialogue.en: He is very smart and also very humorous.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 你們常在一起做什麼？
dialogue.py: nǐ men cháng zài yī qǐ zuò shén me?
dialogue.en: What do you usually do together?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我們常一起打籃球，或者去圖書館看書。
dialogue.py: wǒ men cháng yī qǐ dǎ lán qiú, huò zhě qù tú shū guǎn kàn shū.
dialogue.en: We often play basketball together, or go to the library to read.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 聽起來很不錯。
dialogue.py: tīng qǐ lái hěn bù cuò.
dialogue.en: Sounds good.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 下次我介紹你們認識。
dialogue.py: xià cì wǒ jiè shào nǐ men rèn shi.
dialogue.en: I'll introduce you to each other next time.

key_sentences.en: My best friend is named David.

speaking.part_b: Role-play: Describe your best friend to a new classmate. Tell their name, where they are from, and one thing you do together.
part_c: 你最好的朋友是誰？
他/她是哪國人？

comprehension.q: How many friends has Mark met here?
What is the name of Mark's best friend?
What nationality is David?
What two adjectives describe David's personality?
Where do they sometimes go to read books?

true_false.q: Mark doesn't have many friends.
David and Mark study Chinese together.
David is from America.
Mark thinks David is smart.
They never play basketball.

passage.title: My Friend Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克，你有很多朋友嗎？有，我在這裡認識了很多新朋友。誰是你最好的朋友？我最好的朋友叫大衛。大衛是哪國人？
passage.en: Two students are talking during a break. One student asks about the other's friends. A student describes his best friend. He talks about his friend's name, nationality, and personality. They talk about what they do together.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Write a short profile of your best friend: name, age, nationality, and what they are like (personality).

grammar.explanation: Using '最 (zuì)' for superlative ('the most'). Adverb '非常 (fēi cháng)' for emphasis. Using '常 (cháng)' for frequency.
examples: 最好 (The best)
最高 (The tallest)
非常有錢 (Extremely rich)
他常看電影。 (He often watches movies.)
我不常喝咖啡。 (I don't often drink coffee.)

practice.q: Complete: 他___聰明。 (He is extremely smart.)
Translate: I often go to the library.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你認識大衛嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ rèn shi dà wèi ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: Do you know David?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 認識，他是我最好的朋友。
expansion_dialogue.py: rèn shi, tā shì wǒ zuì hǎo de péng you.
expansion_dialogue.en: Yes, he is my best friend.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 他也認識我妹妹。
expansion_dialogue.py: tā yě rèn shi wǒ mèi mei.
expansion_dialogue.en: He also knows my younger sister.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？太巧了！
expansion_dialogue.py: zhēn de ma? tài qiǎo le!
expansion_dialogue.en: Really? What a coincidence!

review.speaking: Describe one friend's name and personality.
review.writing: Write a 5-sentence profile of a friend.
review.self_check: Can you describe a friend's name, nationality, and personality?

title: How Old Are You?
story_description: Students fill out a class profile form and ask each other ages.
story_intro: It is the first day of class.
The teacher gives the students a form.
They need to write their personal information.
They ask each other about their ages and birthdays.
They practice numbers and age-related questions.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 各位同學，請填寫這張表格。
dialogue.py: gè wèi tóng xué, qǐng tián xiě zhè zhāng biǎo gé.
dialogue.en: Class, please fill out this form.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 寫下你的姓名、國籍和年齡。
dialogue.py: xiě xià nǐ de xìng míng, guó jí hé nián líng.
dialogue.en: Write down your name, nationality, and age.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 馬克，你今年幾歲？
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, nǐ jīn nián jǐ suì?
dialogue.en: Mark, how old are you this year?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我今年二十歲。你呢？
dialogue.py: wǒ jīn nián èr shí suì. nǐ ne?
dialogue.en: I am twenty years old this year. How about you?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 我二十一歲。
dialogue.py: wǒ èr shí yī suì.
dialogue.en: I am twenty-one years old.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 那你比我大一歲。
dialogue.py: nà nǐ bǐ wǒ dà yī suì.
dialogue.en: Then you are one year older than me.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 對。你的生日是幾月幾號？
dialogue.py: duì. nǐ de shēng rì shì jǐ yuè jǐ hào?
dialogue.en: Right. When is your birthday (month and day)?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我的生日是十月五號。你呢？
dialogue.py: wǒ de shēng rì shì shí yuè wǔ hào. nǐ ne?
dialogue.en: My birthday is October 5th. How about you?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 我的生日是三月十二號。
dialogue.py: wǒ de shēng rì shì sān yuè shí èr hào.
dialogue.en: My birthday is March 12th.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我們班誰年齡最大？
dialogue.py: wǒ men bān shéi nián líng zuì dà?
dialogue.en: Who is the oldest in our class?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 我覺得是大明，他二十五歲了。
dialogue.py: wǒ jué de shì dà míng, tā èr shí wǔ suì le.
dialogue.en: I think it's Daming, he is twenty-five years old.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 二十五歲？那他比我們都大。
dialogue.py: èr shí wǔ suì? nà tā bǐ wǒ men dōu dà.
dialogue.en: Twenty-five? Then he is older than all of us.

key_sentences.en: How old are you this year?
You are one year older than me.

speaking.part_b: Role-play: You are filling out a profile. Ask your partner their age and birthday. Compare your ages (who is older?).
part_c: 你今年多大？
你的生日是什麼時候？

comprehension.q: What are the students doing?
How old is Mark?
How old is the other student?
When is Mark's birthday?
Who is the oldest in the class according to A?

true_false.q: Mark is 21 years old.
A is older than Mark.
Mark's birthday is in March.
Daming is 25 years old.
They are writing their names on a form.

passage.title: How Old Are You? Listening Passage
passage.zh: 各位同學，請填寫這張表格。寫下你的姓名、國籍和年齡。馬克，你今年幾歲？我今年二十歲。你呢？我二十一歲。
passage.en: It is the first day of class. The teacher gives the students a form. They need to write their personal information. They ask each other about their ages and birthdays. They practice numbers and age-related questions.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Complete a simple personal profile: Name, Country, Age, Birthday.

grammar.explanation: Asking age with '幾歲 (jǐ suì)' (for children/peers) or '多大 (duō dà)' (general). Comparison with 'A 比 B + Adjective'. Dates: 'Month + 月 + Day + 號'.
examples: 你幾歲？ (How old are you?)
哥哥比我大。 (Older brother is older than me.)
我比他小。 (I am younger than him.)
十月五號 (October 5th)
我二十歲了。 (I am 20 years old now - 'le' for new status.)

practice.q: Complete: 他比我___。 (He is older than me.)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你弟弟幾歲？
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ dì di jǐ suì?
expansion_dialogue.en: How old is your younger brother?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 他今年十歲了。
expansion_dialogue.py: tā jīn nián shí suì le.
expansion_dialogue.en: He is ten years old this year.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 他的生日快到了吧？
expansion_dialogue.py: tā de shēng rì kuài dào le ba?
expansion_dialogue.en: His birthday is coming soon, right?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 對，是下個星期六。
expansion_dialogue.py: duì, shì xià gè xīng qī liù.
expansion_dialogue.en: Yes, it's next Saturday.

review.speaking: Ask '你幾歲？' and answer.
review.writing: Complete your personal profile.
review.self_check: Can you say your age and birthday in Chinese?

title: My Birthday
story_description: A classmate invites another student to a small birthday party.
story_intro: A student's birthday is coming.
She wants to have a small party.
She invites her friend to her home.
They talk about the time and place.
They also talk about cake and gifts.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 馬克，下個星期六是我的生日。
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, xià gè xīng qī liù shì wǒ de shēng rì.
dialogue.en: Mark, next Saturday is my birthday.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？祝你生日快樂！
dialogue.py: zhēn de ma? zhù nǐ shēng rì kuài lè!
dialogue.en: Really? Happy birthday!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。我星期六晚上想請朋友來我家玩。
dialogue.py: xiè xie. wǒ xīng qī liù wǎn shang xiǎng qǐng péng you lái wǒ jiā wán.
dialogue.en: Thanks. I want to invite friends to my house on Saturday night.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 太好了！幾點開始？
dialogue.py: tài hǎo le! jǐ diǎn kāi shǐ?
dialogue.en: Great! What time does it start?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 晚上七點。你能來嗎？
dialogue.py: wǎn shang qī diǎn. nǐ néng lái ma?
dialogue.en: 7:00 PM. Can you come?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 能，我一定去。要做什麼準備嗎？
dialogue.py: néng, wǒ yī dìng qù. yào zuò shén me zhǔn bèi ma?
dialogue.en: Yes, I'll definitely go. Do I need to prepare anything?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 不用，我會準備蛋糕和飲料。
dialogue.py: bù yòng, wǒ huì zhǔn bèi dàn gāo hé yǐn liào.
dialogue.en: No need, I will prepare cake and drinks.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你喜歡什麼禮物？
dialogue.py: nǐ xǐ huan shén me lǐ wù?
dialogue.en: What kind of gift do you like?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 不用送禮物，你能來我就很高興了。
dialogue.py: bù yòng sòng lǐ wù, nǐ néng lái wǒ jiù hěn gāo xìng le.
dialogue.en: No need for gifts, I'm just happy if you can come.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，我會帶點好吃的。
dialogue.py: méi guān xi, wǒ huì dài diǎn hǎo chī de.
dialogue.en: It's okay, I'll bring something delicious.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 那謝謝你。我們星期六晚上見！
dialogue.py: nà xiè xie nǐ. wǒ men xīng qī liù wǎn shang jiàn!
dialogue.en: Then thank you. See you Saturday night!

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好，星期六見！
dialogue.py: hǎo, xīng qī liù jiàn!
dialogue.en: Okay, see you Saturday!

key_sentences.zh: 下個星期六是我的生日。

key_sentences.en: I want to invite friends to play.

vocabulary.meaning: to give (as a gift) / to deliver

speaking.part_b: Role-play: Invite your friend to your birthday party next Friday at 6:00 PM. Tell them not to bring a gift.
part_c: 你喜歡吃生日蛋糕嗎？
你的生日是哪一天？

comprehension.q: When is A's birthday?
Where will the party be?
What time does the party start?
What will A prepare for the party?
What will Mark bring to the party?

true_false.q: The party is next Friday.
Mark cannot go to the party.
A asked Mark to bring a cake.
A will be happy if Mark just comes.
Mark wants to give a gift.

passage.title: My Birthday Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克，下個星期六是我的生日。真的嗎？祝你生日快樂！謝謝。我星期六晚上想請朋友來我家玩。太好了！幾點開始？晚上七點。你能來嗎？
passage.en: A student's birthday is coming. She wants to have a small party. She invites her friend to her home. They talk about the time and place. They also talk about cake and gifts.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Write a birthday invitation: include date, time, place, and 'Please come!'.

grammar.explanation: Using '能 (néng)' for possibility/ability. Using '會 (huì)' for future intention. '請 (qǐng)' used as 'to invite someone to do something'.
examples: 你能來嗎？ (Can you come?)
我會準備好。 (I will prepare [it].)
請他吃飯。 (Invite him to eat.)
下個星期 (Next week)
不用謝。 (No need to thank [me].)

practice.q: Translate: Wish you a happy birthday!
Complete: 我___去你家。 (I will go...)
Translate: Invite a friend to play.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 這是送你的禮物。
expansion_dialogue.py: zhè shì sòng nǐ de lǐ wù.
expansion_dialogue.en: This is a gift for you.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 哇，是一本書！謝謝你。
expansion_dialogue.py: wa, shì yī běn shū! xiè xie nǐ.
expansion_dialogue.en: Wow, it's a book! Thank you.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 不客氣，希望你喜歡。
expansion_dialogue.py: bù kè qì, xī wàng nǐ xǐ huan.
expansion_dialogue.en: You're welcome, I hope you like it.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 我很喜歡這本書。
expansion_dialogue.py: wǒ hěn xǐ huan zhè běn shū.
expansion_dialogue.en: I like this book very much.

review.speaking: Invite a friend to a party.
review.writing: Write a short birthday invitation.
review.self_check: Can you invite someone to a party and wish them happy birthday?

title: Colors in the Room
story_description: Students decorate the classroom and choose colors for posters.
story_intro: The students are making posters.
They have many colored pens and papers.
They talk about which colors they like.
They decide which colors to use for the posters.
The classroom becomes very colorful.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 馬克，我們來做海報吧。
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, wǒ men lái zuò hǎi bào ba.
dialogue.en: Mark, let's make posters.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好啊。你這裡有很多顏色的筆。
dialogue.py: hǎo a. nǐ zhè lǐ yǒu hěn duō yán sè de bǐ.
dialogue.en: Sure. You have pens in many colors here.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 對。你喜歡什麼顏色？
dialogue.py: duì. nǐ xǐ huan shén me yán sè?
dialogue.en: Yes. What color do you like?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我最喜歡藍色。你呢？
dialogue.py: wǒ zuì xǐ huan lán sè. nǐ ne?
dialogue.en: I like blue the best. How about you?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 我最喜歡紅色和黃色。
dialogue.py: wǒ zuì xǐ huan hóng sè hé huáng sè.
dialogue.en: I like red and yellow the best.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 那我們用藍色的紙做海報嗎？
dialogue.py: nà wǒ men yòng lán sè de zhǐ zuò hǎi bào ma?
dialogue.en: Then shall we use blue paper for the poster?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 可以。海報的字用什麼顏色？
dialogue.py: kě yǐ. hǎi bào de zì yòng shén me yán sè?
dialogue.en: Can do. What color for the poster's characters?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我覺得用黑色或者白色比較清楚。
dialogue.py: wǒ jué de yòng hēi sè huò zhě bái sè bǐ jiào qīng chu.
dialogue.en: I think using black or white is clearer.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 好主意。海報上面畫什麼？
dialogue.py: hǎo zhǔ yì. hǎi bào shàng miàn huà shén me?
dialogue.en: Good idea. What shall we draw on the poster?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我們可以畫綠色的樹和紅色的花。
dialogue.py: wǒ men kě yǐ huà lǜ sè de shù hé hóng sè de huā.
dialogue.en: We can draw green trees and red flowers.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 太漂亮了！我們開始畫吧。
dialogue.py: tài piào liang le! wǒ men kāi shǐ huà ba.
dialogue.en: So beautiful! Let's start drawing.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好，我來畫樹。
dialogue.py: hǎo, wǒ lái huà shù.
dialogue.en: Okay, I'll draw the trees.

key_sentences.en: Use blue paper to make posters.

speaking.part_b: Role-play: You are choosing colors for a new shirt. Tell your friend your favorite color and ask their opinion on black vs. white.
part_c: 你喜歡什麼顏色？
你今天穿什麼顏色的衣服？

comprehension.q: What are the students making?
Which color does Mark like best?
What two colors does A like best?
What colors are suggested for the text to make it clear?
What will they draw on the poster?

true_false.q: A has many colored pens.
Mark likes red the best.
They will use blue paper.
Black text is not clear on posters.
A will draw the trees.

passage.title: Colors in the Room Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克，我們來做海報吧。好啊。你這裡有很多顏色的筆。對。你喜歡什麼顏色？我最喜歡藍色。你呢？我最喜歡紅色和黃色。
passage.en: The students are making posters. They have many colored pens and papers. They talk about which colors they like. They decide which colors to use for the posters. The classroom becomes very colorful.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Describe 5 colored objects you see in your room (e.g., 'The bed is white', 'The book is blue').

grammar.explanation: Using '比較 (bǐ jiào)' for relative comparison. Using '或者 (huò zhě)' for 'or' in statements. Color nouns end in '色 (sè)'.
examples: 比較好 (Better / relatively good)
比較大 (Larger / relatively big)
喝茶或者咖啡。 (Drink tea or coffee.)
紅色 (Red color)
用藍色的筆 (Use a blue pen)

practice.q: Complete: 這本書___貴。 (This book is relatively expensive.)
Translate: Use a pen to write.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 這件衣服漂亮嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: zhè jiàn yī fu piào liang ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: Is this piece of clothing beautiful?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 很漂亮，但是我不喜歡黃色。
expansion_dialogue.py: hěn piào liang, dàn shì wǒ bù xǐ huan huáng sè.
expansion_dialogue.en: Very beautiful, but I don't like yellow.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 那這件藍色的呢？
expansion_dialogue.py: nà zhè jiàn lán sè de ne?
expansion_dialogue.en: Then how about this blue one?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 藍色的比較好看。
expansion_dialogue.py: lán sè de bǐ jiào hǎo kàn.
expansion_dialogue.en: The blue one looks better.

review.speaking: Name 5 colors in Chinese.
review.writing: Describe 5 colored objects.
review.self_check: Can you say your favorite color and describe the color of objects?

title: Clothes Today
story_description: Two friends talk about what they are wearing today.
story_intro: It is a sunny day.
Two friends meet on the street.
They look at each other's clothes.
They talk about shirts, pants, and shoes.
They also talk about colors and style.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 馬克，你今天穿得很帥！
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, nǐ jīn tiān chuān de hěn shuài!
dialogue.en: Mark, you are dressed very handsomely today!

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。我穿了我的新襯衫。
dialogue.py: xiè xie. wǒ chuān le wǒ de xīn chèn shān.
dialogue.en: Thanks. I'm wearing my new shirt.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 這件襯衫的顏色很好看。
dialogue.py: zhè jiàn chèn shān de yán sè hěn hǎo kàn.
dialogue.en: The color of this shirt looks very good.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我也很喜歡。你今天的裙子也很漂亮。
dialogue.py: wǒ yě hěn xǐ huan. nǐ jīn tiān de qún zi yě hěn piào liang.
dialogue.en: I like it too. Your skirt today is also very beautiful.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 這是我的生日禮物。
dialogue.py: zhè shì wǒ de shēng rì lǐ wù.
dialogue.en: This was my birthday gift.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你的鞋子也是新的嗎？
dialogue.py: nǐ de xié zi yě shì xīn de ma?
dialogue.en: Are your shoes new too?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 不是，這雙鞋子我穿了很久了。
dialogue.py: bù shì, zhè shuāng xié zi wǒ chuān le hěn jiǔ le.
dialogue.en: No, I've worn this pair of shoes for a long time.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 但是它們看起來很乾淨。
dialogue.py: dàn shì tā men kàn qǐ lái hěn gān jìng.
dialogue.en: But they look very clean.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 天氣變冷了，你沒穿夾克嗎？
dialogue.py: tiān qì biàn lěng le, nǐ méi chuān jiá kè ma?
dialogue.en: The weather has turned cold, aren't you wearing a jacket?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 夾克在我的書包裡。等一下我會穿上。
dialogue.py: jiá kè zài wǒ de shū bāo lǐ. děng yī xià wǒ huì chuān shàng.
dialogue.en: The jacket is in my schoolbag. I'll put it on in a moment.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 好，別感冒了。
dialogue.py: hǎo, bié gǎn mào le.
dialogue.en: Okay, don't catch a cold.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，謝謝提醒。
dialogue.py: méi wèn tí, xiè xie tí xǐng.
dialogue.en: No problem, thanks for the reminder.

key_sentences.en: This pair of shoes has been worn for long.
The jacket is in the bag.

speaking.part_b: Role-play: Compliment your friend's clothes. Ask if their shoes or shirt is new. Tell them the weather is cold.
part_c: 你今天穿什麼顏色的衣服？
你喜歡穿襯衫還是夾克？

comprehension.q: What is Mark wearing that is new?
Why is A wearing a beautiful skirt?
Has A worn her shoes for a long time or a short time?
Where is Mark's jacket?
How is the weather today?

true_false.q: Mark is wearing an old shirt.
A's skirt is a gift.
A's shoes are dirty.
Mark will put on his jacket soon.
The weather is very hot.

passage.title: Clothes Today Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克，你今天穿得很帥！謝謝。我穿了我的新襯衫。這件襯衫的顏色很好看。我也很喜歡。你今天的裙子也很漂亮。這是我的生日禮物。
passage.en: It is a sunny day. Two friends meet on the street. They look at each other's clothes. They talk about shirts, pants, and shoes. They also talk about colors and style.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Describe what you are wearing today: include 3 items and their colors.

grammar.explanation: Using '得 (de)' to describe how an action is performed (e.g., '穿得帥'). Measure words for clothes: '件 (jiàn)' for tops, '雙 (shuāng)' for shoes.
examples: 穿得好 (Dress well)
一件夾克 (One jacket)
一雙鞋子 (One pair of shoes)
在...裡 (Inside ...)
變冷了 (Became cold - 'le' for change of state)

practice.q: Complete: 他穿___很漂亮。 (She dresses very beautifully.)
Complete: 夾克___書包裡。 (The jacket is in the bag.)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你要去哪裡？
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ yào qù nǎ lǐ?
expansion_dialogue.en: Where are you going?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 我去買衣服。
expansion_dialogue.py: wǒ qù mǎi yī fu.
expansion_dialogue.en: I'm going to buy clothes.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你想買什麼？
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ xiǎng mǎi shén me?
expansion_dialogue.en: What do you want to buy?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 我想買一件黑色的褲子。
expansion_dialogue.py: wǒ xiǎng mǎi yī jiàn hēi sè de kù zi.
expansion_dialogue.en: I want to buy a pair of black pants.

review.speaking: Describe your clothes today.
review.writing: Write: '我今天穿一件[Color]的[Item]。'
review.self_check: Can you use '件' and '雙' correctly for clothing?

title: Food I Like
story_description: Students talk about favorite food during lunch break.
story_intro: It is lunch time.
Students are eating together.
They talk about different kinds of food.
They ask 'What do you like to eat?'.
They talk about fruit, meat, and vegetables.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 馬克，你喜歡吃中國菜嗎？
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, nǐ xǐ huan chī zhōng guó cài ma?
dialogue.en: Mark, do you like eating Chinese food?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 非常喜歡。我覺得中國菜很好吃。
dialogue.py: fēi cháng xǐ huan. wǒ jué de zhōng guó cài hěn hǎo chī.
dialogue.en: Very much. I think Chinese food is delicious.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 你最喜歡吃什麼？
dialogue.py: nǐ zuì xǐ huan chī shén me?
dialogue.en: What do you like to eat the most?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我最喜歡吃米飯和牛肉。你呢？
dialogue.py: wǒ zuì xǐ huan chī mǐ fàn hé niú ròu. nǐ ne?
dialogue.en: I like eating rice and beef the most. How about you?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 我喜歡吃麵條，也喜歡吃很多蔬菜。
dialogue.py: wǒ xǐ huan chī miàn tiáo, yě xǐ huan chī hěn duō shū cài.
dialogue.en: I like eating noodles, and I also like eating lots of vegetables.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你不喜歡吃肉嗎？
dialogue.py: nǐ bù xǐ huan chī ròu ma?
dialogue.en: Don't you like eating meat?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 我不常吃肉。我比較喜歡吃魚。
dialogue.py: wǒ bù cháng chī ròu. wǒ bǐ jiào xǐ huan chī yú.
dialogue.en: I don't often eat meat. I prefer eating fish.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 水果呢？你喜歡什麼水果？
dialogue.py: shuǐ guǒ ne? nǐ xǐ huan shén me shuǐ guǒ?
dialogue.en: What about fruit? What fruit do you like?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 我最喜歡蘋果和香蕉。西瓜也不錯。
dialogue.py: wǒ zuì xǐ huan píng guǒ hé xiāng jiāo. xī guā yě bù cuò.
dialogue.en: I like apples and bananas the most. Watermelon is also not bad.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我每天都吃一個蘋果。
dialogue.py: wǒ měi tiān dōu chī yī gè píng guǒ.
dialogue.en: I eat an apple every day.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 那很健康！
dialogue.py: nà hěn jiàn kāng!
dialogue.en: That's healthy!

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 對，醫生也是這麼說的。
dialogue.py: duì, yī shēng yě shì zhè me shuō de.
dialogue.en: Yes, the doctor says so too.

key_sentences.en: What do you like to eat most?
I eat an apple every day.

speaking.part_b: Role-play: Talk to a friend about dinner. Ask what they like to eat and tell them your favorite fruits and vegetables.
part_c: 你喜歡吃什麼水果？
你最喜歡的菜是什麼？

comprehension.q: Does Mark like Chinese food?
What two things does Mark like to eat most?
Does Student A eat a lot of meat?
What kind of meat (animal) does Student A prefer?
How often does Mark eat an apple?

true_false.q: Mark think Chinese food is bad.
A likes vegetables.
A doesn't like fruit.
Mark eats an apple once a week.
The doctor says eating apples is healthy.

passage.title: Food I Like Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克，你喜歡吃中國菜嗎？非常喜歡。我覺得中國菜很好吃。你最喜歡吃什麼？我最喜歡吃米飯和牛肉。你呢？我喜歡吃麵條，也喜歡吃很多蔬菜。
passage.en: It is lunch time. Students are eating together. They talk about different kinds of food. They ask 'What do you like to eat?'. They talk about fruit, meat, and vegetables.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: List 3 foods you like and 3 foods you dislike in Chinese.

grammar.explanation: Using '比較 (bǐ jiào)' for preference. Using '每天都 (měi tiān dōu)' for daily habits. Adjective '好吃 (hǎo chī)' for food.
examples: 比較喜歡 (Prefer)
每天都 (Every day - 'dōu' is usually used with 'měi tiān')
牛肉 (Beef - 'cow meat')
很好吃 (Very delicious)
我不喜歡吃。 (I don't like to eat.)

practice.q: Complete: 我每天___喝茶。 (I drink tea every day.)
Complete: 你___喜歡吃什麼？ (What do you like most?)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 午飯我們吃什麼？
expansion_dialogue.py: wǔ fàn wǒ men chī shén me?
expansion_dialogue.en: What are we eating for lunch?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 我們去吃麵條吧。
expansion_dialogue.py: wǒ men qù chī miàn tiáo ba.
expansion_dialogue.en: Let's go eat noodles.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 好，我也想吃麵。再加一個青菜嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: hǎo, wǒ yě xiǎng chī miàn. zài jiā yī gè qīng cài ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: Okay, I want to eat noodles too. Shall we add a green vegetable?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 好的，多吃蔬菜很好。
expansion_dialogue.py: hǎo de, duō chī shū cài hěn hǎo.
expansion_dialogue.en: Okay, eating more vegetables is good.

review.writing: Write a list of foods you like and dislike.
review.self_check: Can you name several common foods and express your preference?

title: At the School Cafeteria
story_description: A student buys a simple lunch at the cafeteria.
story_intro: The cafeteria is busy.
A student is standing in line.
He wants to buy some food and a drink.
He asks about the items and prices.
He pays with cash.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你好，我想買這個套餐。
dialogue.py: nǐ hǎo, wǒ xiǎng mǎi zhè ge tào cān.
dialogue.en: Hello, I'd like to buy this set meal.

dialogue.speaker: Worker
dialogue.zh: 好的。你要飯還是麵？
dialogue.py: hǎo de. nǐ yào fàn hái shì miàn?
dialogue.en: Okay. Do you want rice or noodles?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我要飯，謝謝。
dialogue.py: wǒ yào fàn, xiè xie.
dialogue.en: I want rice, thanks.

dialogue.speaker: Worker
dialogue.zh: 還要別的嗎？
dialogue.py: hái yào bié de ma?
dialogue.en: Anything else?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 還要一碗湯。請問一共多少錢？
dialogue.py: hái yào yī wǎn tāng. qǐng wèn yī gòng duō shǎo qián?
dialogue.en: And a bowl of soup. How much is it in total?

dialogue.speaker: Worker
dialogue.zh: 套餐八十塊，湯十五塊，一共九十五塊。
dialogue.py: tào cān bā shí kuài, tāng shí wǔ kuài, yī gòng jiǔ shí wǔ kuài.
dialogue.en: Set meal is 80, soup is 15, total 95 dollars.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 給您一百塊。
dialogue.py: gěi nín yī bǎi kuài.
dialogue.en: Here is 100 dollars.

dialogue.speaker: Worker
dialogue.zh: 好的。找您五塊錢。
dialogue.py: hǎo de. zhǎo nín wǔ kuài qián.
dialogue.en: Okay. Here is 5 dollars change.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。請問哪裡可以拿餐具？
dialogue.py: xiè xie. qǐng wèn nǎ lǐ kě yǐ ná cān jù?
dialogue.en: Thanks. Where can I get utensils?

dialogue.speaker: Worker
dialogue.zh: 就在那邊，桌子上面。
dialogue.py: jiù zài nà biān, zhuō zi shàng miàn.
dialogue.en: Right over there, on top of the table.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的，謝謝。
dialogue.py: hǎo de, xiè xie.
dialogue.en: Okay, thanks.

dialogue.speaker: Worker
dialogue.zh: 不客氣。請慢用。
dialogue.py: bù kè qì. qǐng màn yòng.
dialogue.en: You're welcome. Enjoy your meal.

key_sentences.en: I want to buy the set meal.
Do you want rice or noodles?

speaking.part_b: Role-play: You are at the cafeteria. Order a set meal with rice and a soup. Ask for the total price and where the utensils are.
part_c: 你喜歡吃飯還是麵？
你今天午飯吃了什麼？

comprehension.q: What does Mark want to buy?
Does Mark choose rice or noodles?
What else does Mark order besides the meal?
What is the total cost of the meal and soup?
How much change does the worker give to Mark?

true_false.q: Mark wants to buy noodles.
The set meal costs 100 dollars.
Mark pays 100 dollars.
The utensils are on the floor.
The worker is polite.

passage.title: At the School Cafeteria Listening Passage
passage.zh: 你好，我想買這個套餐。好的。你要飯還是麵？我要飯，謝謝。還要別的嗎？還要一碗湯。請問一共多少錢？
passage.en: The cafeteria is busy. A student is standing in line. He wants to buy some food and a drink. He asks about the items and prices. He pays with cash.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Write a simple cafeteria order: one main dish, one side or drink, and the total (imaginary) price.

grammar.explanation: Asking choices with '還是 (hái shì)'. Asking price with '多少錢 (duō shǎo qián)'. Using '找 (zhǎo)' for giving change.
examples: 茶還是水？ (Tea or water?)
這多少錢？ (How much is this?)
找你十塊。 (Here is 10 change.)
還要一個。 (Want one more.)
在哪裡？ (Where is it?)

practice.q: Complete: 你要___別的嗎？ (Do you want anything else?)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你要喝咖啡還是果汁？
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ yào hē kā fēi hái shì guǒ zhī?
expansion_dialogue.en: Do you want to drink coffee or juice?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B

expansion_dialogue.py: wǒ yào guǒ zhī. duō shǎo qián yī píng?
expansion_dialogue.en: I want juice. How much per bottle?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 二十塊錢。
expansion_dialogue.py: èr shí kuài qián.
expansion_dialogue.en: Twenty dollars.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B

expansion_dialogue.en: Okay, I'll have one bottle.
