title: At a Convenience Store
story_description: A customer buys water, snacks, and tissues.
story_intro: It is a hot afternoon.
A customer enters a convenience store.
He needs several items.
He searches for water and snacks.
He talks to the clerk and pays.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你好，請問礦泉水在哪裡？
dialogue.py: nǐ hǎo, qǐng wèn kuàng quán shuǐ zài nǎ lǐ?
dialogue.en: Hello, excuse me, where is the mineral water?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 在後面的冰箱裡。你要哪一種？
dialogue.py: zài hòu miàn de bīng xiāng lǐ. nǐ yào nǎ yī zhǒng?
dialogue.en: In the fridge at the back. Which kind do you want?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我要一瓶大的。還有洋芋片在那裡嗎？
dialogue.py: wǒ yào yī píng dà de. hái yǒu yáng yù piàn zài nà lǐ ma?
dialogue.en: I want a large bottle. Also, are the potato chips over there?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 對，在那排架子上。有原味和辣味的。
dialogue.py: duì, zài nà pái jià zi shàng. yǒu yuán wèi hé là wèi de.
dialogue.en: Yes, on that row of shelves. There are original and spicy flavors.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我要一包辣味的。還要一包面紙。
dialogue.py: wǒ yào yī bāo là wèi de. hái yǒu yī bāo miàn zhǐ.
dialogue.en: I want a bag of spicy ones. And a pack of tissues.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 面紙在櫃檯旁邊。還要別的嗎？
dialogue.py: miàn zhǐ zài guì tái páng biān. hái yào bié de ma?
dialogue.en: Tissues are next to the counter. Anything else?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 不用了，謝謝。一共多少錢？
dialogue.py: bù yòng le, xiè xie. yī gòng duō shǎo qián?
dialogue.en: No more, thanks. How much in total?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 水三十塊，洋芋片二十五塊，面紙十塊，一共六十五塊。
dialogue.py: shuǐ sān shí kuài, yáng yù piàn èr shí wǔ kuài, miàn zhǐ shí kuài, yī gòng liù shí wǔ kuài.
dialogue.en: Water is 30, chips are 25, tissues are 10, total 65 dollars.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我可以刷卡嗎？
dialogue.py: wǒ kě yǐ shuā kǎ ma?
dialogue.en: Can I swipe my card?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 可以。請在這裡感應。
dialogue.py: kě yǐ. qǐng zài zhè lǐ gǎn yìng.
dialogue.en: Yes. Please tap here.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的。謝謝。
dialogue.py: hǎo de. xiè xie.
dialogue.en: Okay. Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。發票在裡面。再見！
dialogue.py: xiè xie. fā piào zài lǐ miàn. zài jiàn!
dialogue.en: Thank you. The receipt is inside. Goodbye!

key_sentences.en: There are original and spicy flavors.

speaking.part_b: Role-play: You are at a convenience store. Ask for the location of milk. Buy one bottle of milk and a bag of cookies. Pay by card.
part_c: 你常去便利商店買東西嗎？
你最常買什麼零食？

comprehension.q: What is the customer looking for first?
Where is the water located?
comprehension.a: In the fridge at the back

comprehension.q: What flavors of potato chips are available?
Where are the tissues?
How does Mark pay for his items?

true_false.q: Mark wants a small bottle of water.
Potato chips are on a shelf.
The total is 65 dollars.
Mark cannot pay by card.
The receipt is given to Mark.

passage.title: At a Convenience Store Listening Passage
passage.zh: 你好，請問礦泉水在哪裡？在後面的冰箱裡。你要哪一種？我要一瓶大的。還有洋芋片在那裡嗎？對，在那排架子上。有原味和辣味的。我要一包辣味的。還要一包面紙。面紙在櫃檯旁邊。還要別的嗎？
passage.en: It is a hot afternoon. A customer enters a convenience store. He needs several items. He searches for water and snacks. He talks to the clerk and pays.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Create a mini shopping receipt: list 3 items and their total price in Chinese.

grammar.explanation: Using '哪一種 (nǎ yī zhǒng)' for 'which kind'. Using '可以 (kě yǐ)' to ask for permission or possibility. Location word '裡面 (lǐ miàn)' for 'inside'.
examples: 你喜歡哪一種？ (Which kind do you like?)
我可以進去嗎？ (May I go in?)
盒子裡面有什麼？ (What is inside the box?)
在架子上 (On the shelf)
還要...嗎？ (Do you still want ...?)

practice.q: Complete: 書包___有什麼？ (Inside the bag...)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你好，我想領包裹。
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ hǎo, wǒ xiǎng lǐng bāo guǒ.
expansion_dialogue.en: Hello, I'd like to pick up a package.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 好的。請給我你的手機末三碼。
expansion_dialogue.py: hǎo de. qǐng gěi wǒ nǐ de shǒu jī mò sān mǎ.
expansion_dialogue.en: Okay. Please give me the last three digits of your phone number.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 六七八。這是在這家店領嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: liù qī bā. zhè shì zài zhè jiā diàn lǐng ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: Six, seven, eight. Is it picked up at this shop?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 對，請等一下，我幫你找。
expansion_dialogue.py: duì, qǐng děng yī xià, wǒ bāng nǐ zhǎo.
expansion_dialogue.en: Yes, please wait a moment, I'll find it for you.

review.speaking: Ask for the location of an item in a shop.
review.writing: Write a shopping list for 3 items.
review.self_check: Can you ask for item locations and pay at a convenience store?

title: Asking for a Bag
story_description: A shopper forgets to bring a bag and asks the cashier for one.
story_intro: A person is paying at a supermarket.
He has many items to carry.
He realizes he doesn't have a bag.
He asks the cashier for a plastic bag.
They talk about the small fee for the bag.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 老闆，不好意思，我忘了帶購物袋。
dialogue.py: lǎo bǎn, bù hǎo yì si, wǒ wàng le dài gòu wù dài.
dialogue.en: Boss, I'm sorry, I forgot to bring a shopping bag.

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.zh: 沒關係。你需要一個塑膠袋嗎？
dialogue.py: méi guān xi. nǐ xū yào yī gè sù jiāo dài ma?
dialogue.en: No problem. Do you need a plastic bag?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 對，我買的東西很多。請問一個袋子多少錢？
dialogue.py: duì, wǒ mǎi de dōng xi hěn duō. qǐng wèn yī gè dài zi duō shǎo qián?
dialogue.en: Yes, I bought many things. How much is one bag?

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.zh: 大的一個兩塊，小的一個一塊。
dialogue.py: dà de yī gè liǎng kuài, xiǎo de yī gè yī kuài.
dialogue.en: A large one is 2 dollars, a small one is 1 dollar.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我要一個大的。一共多少錢？
dialogue.py: wǒ yào yī gè dà de. yī gòng duō shǎo qián?
dialogue.en: I want a large one. How much in total?

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.zh: 加上袋子，一共三百五十塊。
dialogue.py: jiā shàng dài zi, yī gòng sān bǎi wǔ shí kuài.
dialogue.en: Including the bag, it's 350 dollars total.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的。給你錢。
dialogue.py: hǎo de. gěi nǐ qián.
dialogue.en: Okay. Here's the money.

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。需要幫你把東西裝進袋子嗎？
dialogue.py: xiè xie. xū yào bāng nǐ bǎ dōng xi zhuāng jìn dài zi ma?
dialogue.en: Thank you. Do you need help putting the things into the bag?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，我自己來就好。謝謝。
dialogue.py: méi guān xi, wǒ zì jǐ lái jiù hǎo. xiè xie.
dialogue.en: No problem, I can do it myself. Thanks.

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.zh: 好的。下次記得帶購物袋，可以省兩塊錢。
dialogue.py: hǎo de. xià cì jì de dài gòu wù dài, kě yǐ shěng liǎng kuài qián.
dialogue.en: Okay. Remember to bring a shopping bag next time, you can save 2 dollars.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我記住了。再見！
dialogue.py: wǒ jì zhù le. zài jiàn!
dialogue.en: I'll remember. Goodbye!

dialogue.speaker: Cashier
dialogue.zh: 再見，慢走！
dialogue.py: zài jiàn, màn zǒu!
dialogue.en: Goodbye, take care!

key_sentences.en: The things I bought are many.

vocabulary.meaning: to memorize / to keep in mind

speaking.part_b: Role-play: You are paying at a shop. Realize you forgot your shopping bag. Ask for a plastic bag and inquire about the cost. Refuse help with packing.
part_c: 你出門常帶購物袋嗎？
你知道塑膠袋對環境不好嗎？

comprehension.q: What did Mark forget to bring?
What does the cashier offer to Mark?
How much does a large plastic bag cost?
Does Mark want help putting items into the bag?
How much money can Mark save next time if he brings a bag?

true_false.q: Mark bought only one item.
A small bag costs 1 dollar.
Mark pays 350 dollars including the bag.
Mark doesn't know how to put things in a bag.
Mark will try to remember his bag next time.

fill_blank.q: 加上袋子，一____三百五十塊。

passage.title: Asking for a Bag Listening Passage
passage.zh: 老闆，不好意思，我忘了帶購物袋。沒關係。你需要一個塑膠袋嗎？對，我買的東西很多。請問一個袋子多少錢？大的一個兩塊，小的一個一塊。我要一個大的。一共多少錢？加上袋子，一共三百五十塊。
passage.en: A person is paying at a supermarket. He has many items to carry. He realizes he doesn't have a bag. He asks the cashier for a plastic bag. They talk about the small fee for the bag.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Write 5 polite request sentences using '不好意思' or '請問'.

grammar.explanation: Using '忘了 (wàng le)' for 'forgot'. Using '加上 (jiā shàng)' for addition. 'Verb + 進 (jìn)' for directional actions like 'put into'.
examples: 我忘了帶錢。 (I forgot to bring money.)
加上這一個。 (Add this one too.)
放進去 (Put [it] in)
走進來 (Walk in)
我自己買。 (I'll buy [it] myself.)

practice.q: Translate: Put the book into the bag.
Complete: 我___己去學校。 (I go to school by myself.)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你需要紙袋還是塑膠袋？
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ xū yào zhǐ dài hái shì sù jiāo dài?
expansion_dialogue.en: Do you need a paper bag or a plastic bag?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 紙袋比較環保，我要紙袋。
expansion_dialogue.py: zhǐ dài bǐ jiào huán bǎo, wǒ yào zhǐ dài.
expansion_dialogue.en: Paper bags are more environmentally friendly, I want a paper bag.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 好的。紙袋要五塊錢。
expansion_dialogue.py: hǎo de. zhǐ dài yào wǔ kuài qián.
expansion_dialogue.en: Okay. The paper bag is 5 dollars.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 沒問題。
expansion_dialogue.py: méi wèn tí.
expansion_dialogue.en: No problem.

review.speaking: Ask for a bag and its price politely.
review.writing: Write 5 polite requests.
review.self_check: Can you handle a situation where you need a shopping bag at a store?

title: At the Fruit Stand
story_description: A customer asks about apples, bananas, and oranges.
story_intro: It is morning at the market.
A customer wants to buy fresh fruit.
He talks to the fruit stand owner.
He asks about different kinds of fruit and their prices.
He buys a variety of fruits to eat at home.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 老闆，今天的蘋果新鮮嗎？
dialogue.py: lǎo bǎn, jīn tiān de píng guǒ xīn xiān ma?
dialogue.en: Boss, are the apples fresh today?

dialogue.speaker: Owner
dialogue.zh: 很新鮮！是剛從果園送來的。
dialogue.py: hěn xīn xiān! shì gāng cóng guǒ yuán sòng lái de.
dialogue.en: Very fresh! They were just sent from the orchard.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 蘋果怎麼賣？
dialogue.py: píng guǒ zěn me mài?
dialogue.en: How are the apples sold (what's the price)?

dialogue.speaker: Owner
dialogue.zh: 三個一百塊。你要幾個？
dialogue.py: sān gè yī bǎi kuài. nǐ yào jǐ gè?
dialogue.en: Three for 100 dollars. How many do you want?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我要三個。這排香蕉怎麼賣？
dialogue.py: wǒ yào sān gè. zhè pái xiāng jiāo zěn me mài?
dialogue.en: I want three. How are these bananas sold?

dialogue.speaker: Owner
dialogue.zh: 香蕉一斤四十塊。這串大約兩斤。
dialogue.py: xiāng jiāo yī jīn sì shí kuài. zhè chuàn dà yuē liǎng jīn.
dialogue.en: Bananas are 40 per jin (500g). This bunch is about two jin.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好，我要這串。還有橘子甜嗎？
dialogue.py: hǎo, wǒ yào zhè chuàn. hái yǒu jú zi tián ma?
dialogue.en: Okay, I'll take this bunch. Also, are the oranges sweet?

dialogue.speaker: Owner
dialogue.zh: 橘子很甜，水分很多。你要買幾個？
dialogue.py: jú zi hěn tián, shuǐ fèn hěn duō. nǐ yào mǎi jǐ gè?
dialogue.en: Oranges are very sweet and juicy. How many do you want to buy?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我買四個橘子。一共多少錢？
dialogue.py: wǒ mǎi sì gè jú zi. yī gòng duō shǎo qián?
dialogue.en: I'll buy four oranges. How much in total?

dialogue.speaker: Owner
dialogue.zh: 蘋果一百，香蕉八十，橘子四十，一共二百二十塊。
dialogue.py: píng guǒ yī bǎi, xiāng jiāo bā shí, jú zi sì shí, yī gòng èr bǎi èr shí kuài.
dialogue.en: Apples 100, bananas 80, oranges 40, total 220 dollars.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 老闆，算便宜一點吧，二百塊好嗎？
dialogue.py: lǎo bǎn, suàn pián yi yī diǎn ba, èr bǎi kuài hǎo ma?
dialogue.en: Boss, can you make it a bit cheaper, how about 200 dollars?

dialogue.speaker: Owner
dialogue.zh: 好吧，收你二百塊。下次再來！
dialogue.py: hǎo ba, shōu nǐ èr bǎi kuài. xià cì zài lái!
dialogue.en: Okay, I'll take 200. Come again next time!

vocabulary.meaning: how much is it sold for
jin (unit of weight, 500g/600g depending on region)

speaking.part_b: Role-play: You are at a fruit stand. Ask about the freshness and price of bananas. Buy two jin and try to bargain for a lower price.
part_c: 你喜歡吃什麼水果？
你常去傳統市場買水果嗎？

comprehension.q: Are the apples fresh according to the owner?
comprehension.a: Yes, just sent from the orchard

comprehension.q: How much for three apples?
What is the weight of the bunch of bananas Mark buys?
How does Mark describe the oranges?
How much does Mark eventually pay after bargaining?

true_false.q: The apples are not fresh.
Bananas are 40 dollars per jin.
Mark buys five oranges.
The total before bargaining was 220 dollars.
The owner didn't agree to lower the price.

passage.title: At the Fruit Stand Listening Passage
passage.zh: 老闆，今天的蘋果新鮮嗎？很新鮮！是剛從果園送來的。蘋果怎麼賣？三個一百塊。你要幾個？我要三個。這排香蕉怎麼賣？香蕉一斤四十塊。這串大約兩斤。
passage.en: It is morning at the market. A customer wants to buy fresh fruit. He talks to the fruit stand owner. He asks about different kinds of fruit and their prices. He buys a variety of fruits to eat at home.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Write a fruit shopping list with 3 fruits and their quantities (e.g., '5 apples, 1 bunch of bananas').

grammar.explanation: Asking price with '怎麼賣 (zěn me mài)'. Using '剛 (gāng)' for just-finished actions. Units of weight like '斤 (jīn)'.
examples: 這個怎麼賣？ (How is this sold?)
我剛到家。 (I just arrived home.)
兩斤肉 (Two jins of meat)
便宜一點 (A bit cheaper)
好嗎？ (Okay? - for making suggestions)

practice.q: Translate: How are these oranges sold?
Complete: 他___吃過飯。 (He just ate.)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 老闆，這西瓜甜不甜？
expansion_dialogue.py: lǎo bǎn, zhè xī guā tián bù tián?
expansion_dialogue.en: Boss, is this watermelon sweet?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 不甜不要錢！你要一整顆還是半顆？
expansion_dialogue.py: bù tián bù yào qián! nǐ yào yī zhěng kē hái shì bàn kē?
expansion_dialogue.en: If it's not sweet, I won't charge! Do you want a whole one or a half?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 半顆就好，家裡人少。
expansion_dialogue.py: bàn kē jiù hǎo, jiā lǐ rén shǎo.
expansion_dialogue.en: Half is fine, there are few people at home.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 好，我幫你切開。
expansion_dialogue.py: hǎo, wǒ bāng nǐ qiē kāi.
expansion_dialogue.en: Okay, I'll cut it open for you.

review.speaking: Inquire about fruit prices and bargain.
review.writing: Write a shopping list.
review.self_check: Can you ask about food freshness, weight, and bargain in Chinese?

title: I Need New Shoes
story_description: A student buys shoes and asks about size and color.
story_intro: A student is at a shoe store.
His old shoes are broken.
He wants to find a pair of comfortable sports shoes.
He talks to the shop assistant about size and color.
He tries on the shoes before buying them.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你好，我想看看這雙運動鞋。
dialogue.py: nǐ hǎo, wǒ xiǎng kàn kàn zhè shuāng yùn dòng xié.
dialogue.en: Hello, I'd like to take a look at this pair of sports shoes.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 好的。這款鞋子現在很流行。你要什麼顏色？
dialogue.py: hǎo de. zhè kuǎn xié zi xiàn zài hěn liú xíng. nǐ yào shén me yán sè?
dialogue.en: Okay. This style is very popular right now. What color do you want?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 有黑色的嗎？我不喜歡白色的，容易髒。
dialogue.py: yǒu hēi sè de ma? wǒ bù xǐ huan bái sè de, róng yì zāng.
dialogue.en: Do you have black ones? I don't like white ones, they get dirty easily.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 有黑色的。你穿幾號的鞋？
dialogue.py: yǒu hēi sè de. nǐ chuān jǐ hào de xié?
dialogue.en: We have black. What size shoe do you wear?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我穿四十二號。請給我一雙黑色的試穿一下。
dialogue.py: wǒ chuān sì shí èr hào. qǐng gěi wǒ yī shuāng hēi sè de shì chuān yī xià.
dialogue.en: I wear size 42. Please give me a black pair to try on.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 好的，請等一下... 給你，這雙是四十二號的。
dialogue.py: hǎo de, qǐng děng yī xià... gěi nǐ, zhè shuāng shì sì shí èr hào de.
dialogue.en: Okay, please wait a moment... Here you go, this pair is size 42.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: （試穿後）這雙鞋子有點兒小，腳趾有點兒擠。
dialogue.py: (shì chuān hòu) zhè shuāng xié zi yǒu diǎn r xiǎo, jiǎo zhǐ yǒu diǎn r jǐ.
dialogue.en: (After trying on) This pair is a bit small, the toes are a bit cramped.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 那你要不要試試四十三號的？
dialogue.py: nà nǐ yào bù yào shì shì sì shí sān hào de?
dialogue.en: Then do you want to try size 43?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好，麻煩你了。這雙大小正好，很舒服。
dialogue.py: hǎo, má fan nǐ le. zhè shuāng dà xiǎo zhèng hǎo, hěn shū fu.
dialogue.en: Okay, sorry to trouble you. This pair is the perfect size, very comfortable.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 這雙鞋子正在打折，現在只要一千五百塊。
dialogue.py: zhè shuāng xié zi zhèng zài dǎ zhé, xiàn zài zhǐ yào yī qiān wǔ bǎi kuài.
dialogue.en: These shoes are currently on sale, now only 1500 dollars.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我要這雙。請幫我包起來。
dialogue.py: tài hǎo le, wǒ yào zhè shuāng. qǐng bāng wǒ bāo qǐ lái.
dialogue.en: Great, I'll take this pair. Please wrap them up for me.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。請到櫃檯結帳。
dialogue.py: méi wèn tí. qǐng dào guì tái jié zhàng.
dialogue.en: No problem. Please go to the counter to pay.

key_sentences.en: I want to look at sports shoes.
What size shoe do you wear?
Try it on for a bit.

speaking.part_b: Role-play: You are at a shoe store. Tell the clerk you want black sneakers in size 42. Try them on and say they are too small. Ask for a larger size.
part_c: 你喜歡穿什麼樣的鞋子？
你買鞋子最看重什麼？價格還是舒服？

comprehension.q: What is the customer looking for?
Why doesn't Mark like white shoes?
What shoe size does Mark wear initially?
Why did Mark ask for a size 43?
comprehension.a: Because size 42 was a bit small and cramped his toes

comprehension.q: How much do the shoes cost on sale?

true_false.q: The style of shoes is very popular.
Mark eventually buys the white shoes.
Size 43 fits Mark perfectly.
The shoes are not on sale.
Mark pays at the counter.

passage.title: I Need New Shoes Listening Passage
passage.zh: 你好，我想看看這雙運動鞋。好的。這款鞋子現在很流行。你要什麼顏色？有黑色的嗎？我不喜歡白色的，容易髒。有黑色的。你穿幾號的鞋？我穿四十二號。請給我一雙黑色的試穿一下。好的，請等一下...給你，這雙是四十二號的。
passage.en: A student is at a shoe store. His old shoes are broken. He wants to find a pair of comfortable sports shoes. He talks to the shop assistant about size and color. He tries on the shoes before buying them.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Describe the shoes you want to buy: include color, size, and reason (e.g., 'I want black shoes size 40 because they are comfortable').

grammar.explanation: Using '正在 (zhèng zài)' for actions in progress. Using '只要 (zhǐ yào)' for 'only' with prices. Resultative complement '起來 (qǐ lái)' for 'up'.
examples: 我正在學中文。 (I am studying Chinese.)
只要一百塊。 (Only costs 100 dollars.)
站起來 (Stand up)
包起來 (Wrap up)
試穿一下 (Try it on for a bit)

practice.q: Complete: 他___想去商店。 (He only wants to go...)
Complete: 這件衣服___在打折。 (Is currently...)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 這件襯衫多少錢？
expansion_dialogue.py: zhè jiàn chèn shān duō shǎo qián?
expansion_dialogue.en: How much is this shirt?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 原價八百，現在打七折，只要五百六十塊。
expansion_dialogue.py: yuán jià bā bǎi, xiàn zài dǎ qī zhé, zhǐ yào wǔ bǎi liù shí kuài.
expansion_dialogue.en: Original price 800, now 30% off, only 560 dollars.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 打七折？很便宜！我可以試穿嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: dǎ qī zhé? hěn pián yi! wǒ kě yǐ shì chuān ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: 30% off? Very cheap! Can I try it on?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 當然可以，試衣間在那邊。
expansion_dialogue.py: dāng rán kě yǐ, shì yī jiān zài nà biān.
expansion_dialogue.en: Of course, the fitting room is over there.

review.speaking: Ask for your shoe size and if there's a discount.
review.writing: Write: '我穿四十二號的鞋子。'
review.self_check: Can you ask for sizes and understand discount terms like '正在打折'?

title: Clothes for a Party
story_description: Two friends choose clothes for a birthday party.
story_intro: There is a party tonight.
Mark is going to his friend's birthday party.
He is choosing his clothes in front of a mirror.
His friend gives him some advice.
They talk about what looks good and what is appropriate.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你覺得我今晚穿哪件衣服比較好？
dialogue.py: nǐ jué de wǒ jīn wǎn chuān nǎ jiàn yī fu bǐ jiào hǎo?
dialogue.en: Which piece of clothing do you think I should wear tonight?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 今晚是正式的舞會嗎？
dialogue.py: jīn wǎn shì zhèng shì de wǔ huì ma?
dialogue.en: Is it a formal ball tonight?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 不是，只是一個小型的生日派對。
dialogue.py: bù shì, zhǐ shì yī gè xiǎo xíng de shēng rì pài duì.
dialogue.en: No, just a small birthday party.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 那穿這件紅色的毛衣搭配牛仔褲怎麼樣？
dialogue.py: nà chuān zhè jiàn hóng sè de máo yī dā pèi niú zǎi kù zěn me yàng?
dialogue.en: Then how about wearing this red sweater with jeans?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我覺得紅色太亮了，我不習慣穿紅色的。
dialogue.py: wǒ jué de hóng sè tài liàng le, wǒ bù xí guàn chuān hóng sè de.
dialogue.en: I think red is too bright, I'm not used to wearing red.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 那這件深藍色的襯衫呢？看起來很穩重。
dialogue.py: nà zhè jiàn shēn lán sè de chèn shān ne? kàn qǐ lái hěn wěn zhòng.
dialogue.en: Then how about this dark blue shirt? It looks steady/composed.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 嗯，這件襯衫不錯。但是現在外面有點兒冷。
dialogue.py: en, zhè jiàn chèn shān bù cuò. dàn shì xiàn zài wài miàn yǒu diǎn r lěng.
dialogue.en: Hmm, this shirt is not bad. But it's a bit cold outside now.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 你可以外面再加一件黑色的外套。這樣既保暖又帥氣。
dialogue.py: nǐ kě yǐ wài miàn zài jiā yī jiàn hēi sè de wài tào. zhè yàng jì bǎo nuǎn yòu shuài qì.
dialogue.en: You can add a black jacket on the outside. This way it's both warm and handsome.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好主意！鞋子穿運動鞋可以嗎？
dialogue.py: hǎo zhǔ yì! xié zi chuān yùn dòng xié kě yǐ ma?
dialogue.en: Good idea! Are sneakers okay for shoes?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 派對的話，運動鞋沒問題，很休閒。
dialogue.py: pài duì de huà, yùn dòng xié méi wèn tí, hěn xiū xián.
dialogue.en: For a party, sneakers are no problem, very casual.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 太好了。謝謝你的建議！
dialogue.py: tài hǎo le. xiè xie nǐ de jiàn yì!
dialogue.en: Great. Thanks for your advice!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 不客氣。祝你玩得開心！
dialogue.py: bù kè qì. zhù nǐ wán de kāi xīn!
dialogue.en: You're welcome. Have a good time!

key_sentences.en: Which clothing is better to wear?
I'm not used to wearing red.

speaking.part_b: Role-play: You are preparing for a party. Ask your friend for fashion advice. Reject one suggestion because it's 'too bright' and accept another because it's 'handsome'.
part_c: 你參加派對時喜歡穿正式的衣服嗎？
你平時喜歡穿牛仔褲嗎？

comprehension.q: Where is Mark going tonight?
What color sweater did A first suggest?
Why didn't Mark want to wear the red sweater?
comprehension.a: He thinks it's too bright and he's not used to it

comprehension.q: What are the two advantages of adding a black jacket?
comprehension.a: Keeping warm and looking handsome (既保暖又帥氣)

comprehension.q: Are sneakers considered okay for this party?

true_false.q: Tonight is a formal ball.
A suggests matching a sweater with jeans.
Mark likes wearing bright colors.
The dark blue shirt looks steady.
A wishes Mark a happy time.

passage.title: Clothes for a Party Listening Passage
passage.zh: 你覺得我今晚穿哪件衣服比較好？今晚是正式的舞會嗎？不是，只是一個小型的生日派對。那穿這件紅色的毛衣搭配牛仔褲怎麼樣？我覺得紅色太亮了，我不習慣穿紅色的。那這件深藍色的襯衫呢？看起來很穩重。
passage.en: There is a party tonight. Mark is going to his friend's birthday party. He is choosing his clothes in front of a mirror. His friend gives him some advice. They talk about what looks good and what is appropriate.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Write what you will wear to a party tonight: include 2 items and why you chose them (e.g., 'I will wear jeans because they are casual').

grammar.explanation: Using '既...又...' to link two qualities. Using '比較 (bǐ jiào)' for relative preference. Adjective '亮 (liàng)' for brightness/intensity.
examples: 既快又好 (Both fast and good)
我比較喜歡藍色。 (I prefer blue.)
我不習慣。 (I'm not used to [it].)
穩重的顏色 (Steady color)
休閒衣服 (Casual clothes)

practice.q: Translate: I'm not used to cold weather.
Complete: 這件毛衣既暖和___漂亮。

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 這條領帶合適嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: zhè tiáo lǐng dài hé shì ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: Is this tie appropriate?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 如果你穿西裝的話，這條領帶很合適。
expansion_dialogue.py: rú guǒ nǐ chuān xī zhuāng de huà, zhè tiáo lǐng dài hěn hé shì.
expansion_dialogue.en: If you are wearing a suit, this tie is very appropriate.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 我不喜歡打領帶，太麻煩了。
expansion_dialogue.py: wǒ bù xǐ huan dǎ lǐng dài, tài má fan le.
expansion_dialogue.en: I don't like wearing a tie, it's too troublesome.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 那你可以只穿襯衫，不用打領帶。
expansion_dialogue.py: nà nǐ kě yǐ zhǐ chuān chèn shān, bù yòng dǎ lǐng dài.
expansion_dialogue.en: Then you can just wear a shirt, no need for a tie.

review.speaking: Give fashion advice to a friend using '既...又...'.
review.writing: Write 3 sentences about your favorite clothes.
review.self_check: Can you give and understand simple fashion advice in Chinese?

title: Making Plans
story_description: Two friends plan to meet after school.
story_intro: School is almost over.
Two friends want to spend time together.
They talk about going to the library or a café.
They decide on a time and a place to meet.
They confirm the plan before leaving.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 大衛，你放學以後有空嗎？
dialogue.py: dà wèi, nǐ fàng xué yǐ hòu yǒu kòng ma?
dialogue.en: David, are you free after school?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 有空，你有什麼事嗎？
dialogue.py: yǒu kòng, nǐ yǒu shén me shì ma?
dialogue.en: Yes, I am. Is something up?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我想去那家新開的咖啡店，你要一起去嗎？
dialogue.py: wǒ xiǎng qù nà jiā xīn kāi de kā fēi diàn, nǐ yào yī qǐ qù ma?
dialogue.en: I want to go to that newly opened café, do you want to go together?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 好啊！我聽說那裡的拿鐵很好喝。
dialogue.py: hǎo a! wǒ tīng shuō nà lǐ de ná tiě hěn hǎo hē.
dialogue.en: Sure! I heard the lattes there are very good.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 那我們幾點見面？
dialogue.py: nà wǒ men jǐ diǎn jiàn miàn?
dialogue.en: Then what time shall we meet?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 四點半可以嗎？我得先去圖書館還一本書。
dialogue.py: sì diǎn bàn kě yǐ ma? wǒ děi xiān qù tú shū guǎn huán yī běn shū.
dialogue.en: Is 4:30 okay? I have to go to the library first to return a book.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 可以。四點半在那家店門口見。
dialogue.py: kě yǐ. sì diǎn bàn zài nà jiā diàn mén kǒu jiàn.
dialogue.en: Can do. Meet at the shop's entrance at 4:30.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 在那家店門口...等一下，那家店在哪裡？
dialogue.py: zài nà jiā diàn mén kǒu... děng yī xià, nà jiā diàn zài nǎ lǐ?
dialogue.en: At the shop's entrance... wait a second, where is that shop?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 就在學校後門對面，郵局旁邊。
dialogue.py: jiù zài xué xiào hòu mén duì miàn, yóu jú páng biān.
dialogue.en: It's right opposite the school's back gate, next to the post office.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 喔，我知道了。那沒問題。
dialogue.py: ō, wǒ zhī dào le. nà méi wèn tí.
dialogue.en: Oh, I know it. Then no problem.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的，那我們四點半見。
dialogue.py: hǎo de, nà wǒ men sì diǎn bàn jiàn.
dialogue.en: Okay, see you at 4:30.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 不見不散！
dialogue.py: bù jiàn bù sàn!
dialogue.en: Be there or be square!

key_sentences.en: Do you want to go together?
I heard it's very good there.
I must first go to the library.
See you there! (lit. not see not leave)

vocabulary.meaning: to hear of / to be told
to meet up / to see each other

speaking.part_b: Role-play: Invite a friend to a new café. They need to return a book first, so negotiate a meeting time. Tell them the café is next to the post office.
part_c: 你喜歡喝咖啡嗎？
你常和朋友在校門口見面嗎？

comprehension.q: What does Mark want to do after school?
comprehension.a: Go to a new coffee shop

comprehension.q: What drink does David want to try at the café?
What time do they agree to meet?
What does David need to do before meeting Mark?
comprehension.a: Go to the library to return a book

comprehension.q: Where is the coffee shop located?
comprehension.a: Opposite the school's back gate, next to the post office

true_false.q: David is busy after school.
Mark heard the lattes are good.
They will meet at 4:30.
The coffee shop is far from the school.
David knows where the shop is at the end.

fill_blank.q: 我聽____那裡的咖啡很好喝。

passage.title: Making Plans Listening Passage
passage.zh: 大衛，你放學以後有空嗎？有空，你有什麼事嗎？我想去那家新開的咖啡店，你要一起去嗎？好啊！我聽說那裡的拿鐵很好喝。那我們幾點見面？四點半可以嗎？我得先去圖書館還一本書。
passage.en: School is almost over. Two friends want to spend time together. They talk about going to the library or a café. They decide on a time and a place to meet. They confirm the plan before leaving.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Write a short meeting message: include time, place, and 'See you there!'.

grammar.explanation: Using '得 (děi)' for obligation. Using '聽說 (tīng shuō)' for reported information. Location words '對面 (duì miàn)' and '門口 (mén kǒu)'.
examples: 我得走了。 (I must leave.)
我聽說他很忙。 (I heard he is busy.)
在門口等。 (Wait at the entrance.)
對面有一家店。 (There is a shop opposite.)
一起去。 (Go together.)

practice.q: Translate: I must return this book.
Complete: 我們六點___面吧。 (Meet at 6:00.)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你打算什麼時候搬家？
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ dǎ suàn shén me shí hou bān jiā?
expansion_dialogue.en: When do you plan to move?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 我得先找到新房子，然後才能搬家。
expansion_dialogue.py: wǒ děi xiān zhǎo dào xīn fáng zi, rán hòu cái néng bān jiā.
expansion_dialogue.en: I must find a new house first, then I can move.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 有需要的話，我可以幫你找。
expansion_dialogue.py: yǒu xū yào de huà, wǒ kě yǐ bāng nǐ zhǎo.
expansion_dialogue.en: If needed, I can help you look.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 太謝謝你了！你這週六有空嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: tài xiè xie nǐ le! nǐ zhè zhōu liù yǒu kòng ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: Thank you so much! Are you free this Saturday?

review.speaking: Make a plan to meet a friend at a specific time and place.
review.writing: Write a short message to a friend to invite them out.
review.self_check: Can you use 'have to', 'heard that', and confirm meeting details?

title: Sorry, I Am Busy
story_description: A friend invites another friend out, but they are busy.
story_intro: A student has a concert ticket.
He wants to invite his friend to go with him.
But his friend has a lot of things to do.
They talk about work and study.
They try to find another time to meet.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 大衛，我這有兩張音樂會的票。你週五晚上想去嗎？
dialogue.py: dà wèi, wǒ zhè yǒu liǎng zhāng yīn yuè huì de piào. nǐ zhōu wǔ wǎn shang xiǎng qù ma?
dialogue.en: David, I have two concert tickets here. Do you want to go on Friday night?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 真可惜，我週五晚上得加班，沒辦法去。
dialogue.py: zhēn kě xī, wǒ zhōu wǔ wǎn shang děi jiā bān, méi bàn fǎ qù.
dialogue.en: What a pity, I have to work overtime on Friday night, I can't go.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你要加班到幾點？音樂會八點才開始。
dialogue.py: nǐ yào jiā bān dào jǐ diǎn? yīn yuè huì bā diǎn cái kāi shǐ.
dialogue.en: Until what time do you have to work? The concert doesn't start until 8:00.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 我大約要忙到九點。最近公司事很多。
dialogue.py: wǒ dà yuē yào máng dào jiǔ diǎn. zuì jìn gōng sī shì hěn duō.
dialogue.en: I'll be busy until about 9:00. There's a lot of business at the company lately.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 那太遺憾了。週六呢？你週六有空嗎？
dialogue.py: nà tài yí hàn le. zhōu liù ne? nǐ zhōu liù yǒu kòng ma?
dialogue.en: That's a shame. How about Saturday? Are you free on Saturday?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 週六上午我要去補習班學日文，下午要陪家人。
dialogue.py: zhōu liù shàng wǔ wǒ yào qù bǔ xí bān xué rì wén, xià wǔ yào péi jiā rén.
dialogue.en: Saturday morning I'm going to a cram school to learn Japanese, and in the afternoon I have to accompany my family.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你真的很忙啊！那你什麼時候才有空？
dialogue.py: nǐ zhēn de hěn máng a! nà nǐ shén me shí hou cái yǒu kòng?
dialogue.en: You're really busy! Then when will you be free?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 週日吧。週日我可以整天休息。
dialogue.py: zhōu rì ba. zhōu rì wǒ kě yǐ zhěng tiān xiū xi.
dialogue.en: Sunday, probably. I can rest all day Sunday.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好，那我們週日一起吃午飯吧。
dialogue.py: hǎo, wǒ men zhōu rì yī qǐ chī wǔ fàn ba.
dialogue.en: Okay, then let's eat lunch together on Sunday.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 太好了！這次換我請客，向你道歉。
dialogue.py: tài hǎo le! zhè cì huàn wǒ qǐng kè, xiàng nǐ dào qiàn.
dialogue.en: Great! My treat this time, to apologize to you.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 不用客氣啦。那我們週日見。
dialogue.py: bù yòng kè qì la. nà wǒ men zhōu rì jiàn.
dialogue.en: No need to be polite. See you Sunday.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 好的，週日見！
dialogue.py: hǎo de, zhōu rì jiàn!
dialogue.en: Okay, see you Sunday!

vocabulary.meaning: to accompany / to spend time with
you're welcome / no need for formalities

speaking.part_b: Role-play: Your friend invites you to a movie on Saturday. Refuse politely because you have a part-time job. Suggest meeting on Sunday instead and offer to treat them.

你通常怎麼拒絕朋友的邀請？

passage.title: Sorry, I Am Busy Listening Passage
passage.zh: 大衛，我這有兩張音樂會的票。你週五晚上想去嗎？真可惜，我週五晚上得加班，沒辦法去。你要加班到幾點？音樂會八點才開始。我大約要忙到九點。最近公司事很多。那太遺憾了。週六呢？你週六有空嗎？週六上午我要去補習班學日文，下午要陪家人。
passage.en: A student has a concert ticket. He wants to invite his friend to go with him. But his friend has a lot of things to do. They talk about work and study. They try to find another time to meet.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Write a polite refusal message to a friend: include a reason and suggest a new time (40-60 words).

grammar.explanation: Using '才 (cái)' to emphasize something happened late. Using '得 (děi)' for obligation. '陪 (péi)' for spending time with someone.
examples: 他現在才來。 (He only just came now [late].)
我得走了。 (I have to go.)
我陪媽媽去市場。 (I accompany my mom to the market.)
沒辦法 (No way)
整天都在玩 (Playing all day long)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A

expansion_dialogue.py: jīn tiān wǎn shang de jù huì, nǐ lái ma?

expansion_dialogue.py: wǒ bù shū fu, xiǎng zài jiā xiū xi, méi bàn fǎ qù le.
expansion_dialogue.en: I'm not feeling well, I want to rest at home, I can't go.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A

expansion_dialogue.py: yán zhòng ma? yào bù yào kàn yī shēng?
expansion_dialogue.en: Is it serious? Do you want to see a doctor?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 不嚴重，只是有點兒感冒。謝謝你。
expansion_dialogue.py: bù yán zhòng, zhǐ shì yǒu diǎn r gǎn mào. xiè xie nǐ.
expansion_dialogue.en: Not serious, just a bit of a cold. Thank you.

title: Weekend Plans
story_description: Students talk about what they will do this weekend.
story_intro: The weekend is coming soon.
Students are excited about their free time.
They share their plans with each other.
Some will travel, some will study, and some will just rest.
They use future tense structures like 'will' and 'plan to'.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 這個週末你有什麼計劃？
dialogue.py: zhè ge zhōu mò nǐ yǒu shén me jì huà?
dialogue.en: What plans do you have for this weekend?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 我打算和朋友去台中旅行。你呢？
dialogue.py: wǒ dǎ suàn hé péng you qù tái zhōng lǚ xíng. nǐ ne?
dialogue.en: I plan to go on a trip to Taichung with friends. How about you?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 台中？那裡很有趣。你們要去哪裡玩？
dialogue.py: tái zhōng? nà lǐ hěn yǒu qù. nǐ men yào qù nǎ lǐ wán?
dialogue.en: Taichung? That place is very interesting. Where are you going to visit?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 我們打算去高美濕地看夕陽，還要去逢甲夜市吃美食。
dialogue.py: wǒ men dǎ suàn qù gāo měi shī dì kàn xī yáng, hái yào qù féng jiǎ yè shì chī měi shí.
dialogue.en: We plan to go to Gaomei Wetlands to see the sunset, and also go to Fengjia Night Market to eat delicious food.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 聽起來很棒。但我這個週末得留在家裡。
dialogue.py: tīng qǐ lái hěn bàng. dàn wǒ zhè ge zhōu mò děi liú zài jiā lǐ.
dialogue.en: Sounds great. But I have to stay home this weekend.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 為什麼？你要準備考試嗎？
dialogue.py: wèi shén me? nǐ yào zhǔn bèi kǎo shì ma?
dialogue.en: Why? Do you need to prepare for an exam?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 不是，我的父母這週末要來台北看我。
dialogue.py: bù shì, wǒ de fù mǔ zhè zhōu mò yào lái tái běi kàn wǒ.
dialogue.en: No, my parents are coming to Taipei to see me this weekend.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 喔，那也很好啊！你要帶他們去哪裡？
dialogue.py: ō, nà yě hěn hǎo a! nǐ yào dài tā men qù nǎ lǐ?
dialogue.en: Oh, that's also very good! Where are you going to take them?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我要帶他們去故宮博物院，晚上再去吃鼎泰豐。
dialogue.py: wǒ yào dài tā men qù gù gōng bó wù yuàn, wǎn shang zài qù chī dǐng tài fēng.
dialogue.en: I'm going to take them to the National Palace Museum, and then go eat at Din Tai Fung in the evening.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 鼎泰豐的小籠包世界聞名，他們一定會喜歡的。
dialogue.py: dǐng tài fēng de xiǎo lóng bāo shì jiè wén míng, tā men yī dìng huì xǐ huan de.
dialogue.en: Din Tai Fung's soup dumplings are world-famous, they will definitely like them.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 希望如此。祝你們在台中有個愉快的旅行！
dialogue.py: xī wàng rú cǐ. zhù nǐ men zài tái zhōng yǒu gè yú kuài de lǚ xíng!
dialogue.en: I hope so. Wish you all a pleasant trip in Taichung!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，你也一樣。祝你和父母過得開心！
dialogue.py: xiè xie, nǐ yě yī yàng. zhù nǐ hé fù mǔ guò de kāi xīn!
dialogue.en: Thanks, you too. Wish you and your parents a happy time!

key_sentences.en: I plan to go on a trip.

vocabulary.example: 故宮是世界聞名的建築。

speaking.part_b: Role-play: Share your weekend plans with a friend. Tell them you are going to stay home because family is visiting. Ask about their plan to visit a night market.
part_c: 你這個週末打算做什麼？
你喜歡去夜市吃東西嗎？

passage.title: Weekend Plans Listening Passage
passage.zh: 這個週末你有什麼計劃？我打算和朋友去台中旅行。你呢？台中？那裡很有趣。你們要去哪裡玩？我們打算去高美濕地看夕陽，還要去逢甲夜市吃美食。聽起來很棒。但我這個週末得留在家裡。為什麼？你要準備考試嗎？
passage.en: The weekend is coming soon. Students are excited about their free time. They share their plans with each other. Some will travel, some will study, and some will just rest. They use future tense structures like 'will' and 'plan to'.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Write 6 sentences about your weekend plans (e.g., 'Saturday I will sleep', 'Sunday I plan to meet friends').

grammar.explanation: Using '要 (yào)' or '打算 (dǎ suàn)' for future plans. Using '得 (děi)' for necessity. Using '祝 (zhù)' for wishes.
examples: 我要去北京。 (I am going to Beijing.)
我打算學日文。 (I plan to learn Japanese.)
你得快點。 (You have to be quick.)
祝你成功。 (Wish you success.)
他也一樣。 (He is the same.)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 暑假你打算做什麼？
expansion_dialogue.py: shǔ jià nǐ dǎ suàn zuò shén me?
expansion_dialogue.en: What do you plan to do for summer vacation?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 我想回國看望我的祖父母。
expansion_dialogue.py: wǒ xiǎng huí guó kàn wàng wǒ de zǔ fù mǔ.
expansion_dialogue.en: I want to go back home to visit my grandparents.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你很久沒見到他們了吧？
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ hěn jiǔ méi jiàn dào tā men le ba?
expansion_dialogue.en: You haven't seen them for a long time, right?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 對，我很想念他們。
expansion_dialogue.py: duì, wǒ hěn xiǎng niàn tā men.
expansion_dialogue.en: Yes, I miss them very much.

review.speaking: Describe your future plans for next week.
review.writing: Write 6 sentences about your weekend.
review.self_check: Can you express future intentions and plans using 'will' and 'plan to'?

title: A Simple Phone Call
story_description: A student calls a friend to ask about homework.
story_intro: Mark is at home.
He forgot to write down the homework.
He picks up his phone and calls his classmate.
They talk about the class and the teacher's instructions.
They practice basic phone greetings and closing phrases.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 喂？請問是大衛嗎？
dialogue.py: wéi? qǐng wèn shì dà wèi ma?
dialogue.en: Hello? Is this David?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 對，我是大衛。馬克，是你啊！有什麼事嗎？
dialogue.py: duì, wǒ shì dà wèi. mǎ kè, shì nǐ a! yǒu shén me shì ma?
dialogue.en: Yes, I'm David. Mark, it's you! What's up?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，這麼晚打擾你。
dialogue.py: bù hǎo yì si, zhè me wǎn dǎ rǎo nǐ.
dialogue.en: I'm sorry to bother you so late.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，我還沒睡呢。怎麼了？
dialogue.py: méi guān xi, wǒ hái méi shuì ne. zěn me le?
dialogue.en: No problem, I haven't slept yet. What's wrong?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我想問一下，今天老師留了什麼功課？
dialogue.py: wǒ xiǎng wèn yī xià, jīn tiān lǎo shī liú le shén me gōng kè?
dialogue.en: I wanted to ask, what homework did the teacher leave today?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 老師要我們讀課本第五十頁到五十五頁，還要寫三個句子。
dialogue.py: lǎo shī yào wǒ men dú kè běn dì wǔ shí yè dào wǔ shí wǔ yè, hái yào xiě sān gè jù zi.
dialogue.en: The teacher wants us to read page 50 to 55 of the textbook, and also write three sentences.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 喔，我記住了。要把句子寫在筆記本上嗎？
dialogue.py: ō, wǒ jì zhù le. yào bǎ jù zi xiě zài bǐ jì běn shàng ma?
dialogue.en: Oh, I've got it. Do we need to write the sentences in the notebook?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 對，明天上課要交給老師。
dialogue.py: duì, míng tiān shàng kè yào jiāo gěi lǎo shī.
dialogue.en: Yes, they need to be handed to the teacher in class tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的，太謝謝你了！
dialogue.py: hǎo de, tài xiè xie nǐ le!
dialogue.en: Okay, thank you so much!

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 不客氣。還有別的事嗎？
dialogue.py: bù kè qì. hái yǒu bié de shì ma?
dialogue.en: You're welcome. Anything else?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 沒有了。那我們明天學校見。晚安！
dialogue.py: méi yǒu le. nà wǒ men míng tiān xué xiào jiàn. wǎn ān!
dialogue.en: Nothing else. Then I'll see you at school tomorrow. Good night!

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 好，晚安！
dialogue.py: hǎo, wǎn ān!
dialogue.en: Okay, good night!

key_sentences.zh: 要把句子寫在筆記本上嗎？
key_sentences.en: Do [we] need to write sentences in the notebook?
Must hand in during class tomorrow.

vocabulary.meaning: a bit / for a short while

speaking.part_b: Role-play: Call a friend to ask about the location of a party. Use '喂', '請問', and apologize for the late call. End with '晚安'.
part_c: 你常給朋友打電話嗎？
你通常幾點睡覺？

passage.title: A Simple Phone Call Listening Passage
passage.zh: 喂？請問是大衛嗎？對，我是大衛。馬克，是你啊！有什麼事嗎？不好意思，這麼晚打擾你。沒關係，我還沒睡呢。怎麼了？我想問一下，今天老師留了什麼功課？老師要我們讀課本第五十頁到五十五頁，還要寫三個句子。
passage.en: Mark is at home. He forgot to write down the homework. He picks up his phone and calls his classmate. They talk about the class and the teacher's instructions. They practice basic phone greetings and closing phrases.

writing: Write a short phone dialogue (4 lines) between two friends using '喂', '有事嗎', and '再見'.

grammar.explanation: Using '喂 (wéi/wèi)' as a phone greeting. Using '還沒 (hái méi)' for 'not yet'. Using '把 (bǎ)' to indicate how an object is handled (introduction).
examples: 我還沒睡。 (I haven't slept yet.)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A

expansion_dialogue.py: wéi, nǐ zài zuò shén me?
expansion_dialogue.en: Hello, what are you doing?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B

expansion_dialogue.en: I'm currently reading. Is something up?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 明天我們去圖書館，好嗎？

expansion_dialogue.en: Let's go to the library tomorrow, okay?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B

title: Sending a Text Message
story_description: A student sends a message to ask where a friend is.
story_intro: Mark and David planned to meet.
David is late.
Mark is waiting at the coffee shop.
He sends a text message to David.
They exchange locations and arrival times via text.

dialogue.speaker: Mark (Text)
dialogue.zh: 大衛，你在哪裡？我已經到咖啡店了。
dialogue.py: dà wèi, nǐ zài nǎ lǐ? wǒ yǐ jīng dào kā fēi diàn le.
dialogue.en: David, where are you? I've already arrived at the coffee shop.

dialogue.speaker: David (Text)
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，公車剛才誤點了。我還在路上。
dialogue.py: bù hǎo yì si, gōng chē gāng cái wù diǎn le. wǒ hái zài lù shàng.
dialogue.en: Sorry, the bus was just delayed. I'm still on the way.

dialogue.speaker: Mark (Text)
dialogue.zh: 沒關係。你大概還要多久才到？
dialogue.py: méi guān xi. nǐ dà gài hái yào duō jiǔ cái dào?
dialogue.en: No problem. Roughly how much longer until you arrive?

dialogue.speaker: David (Text)
dialogue.zh: 大概還要十分鐘。我現在在郵局門口。
dialogue.py: dà gài hái yào shí fēn zhōng. wǒ xiàn zài zài yóu jú mén kǒu.
dialogue.en: Roughly ten more minutes. I'm at the post office entrance now.

dialogue.speaker: Mark (Text)
dialogue.zh: 好。我幫你點了咖啡。冰的還是熱的？
dialogue.py: hǎo. wǒ bāng nǐ diǎn le kā fēi. bīng de hái shì rè de?
dialogue.en: Okay. I ordered coffee for you. Iced or hot?

dialogue.speaker: David (Text)
dialogue.zh: 熱拿鐵，謝謝！
dialogue.py: rè ná tiě, xiè xie!
dialogue.en: Hot latte, thanks!

dialogue.speaker: Mark (Text)
dialogue.zh: OK，等你哦。
dialogue.py: OK, děng nǐ o.
dialogue.en: OK, waiting for you.

dialogue.speaker: David (Text)
dialogue.zh: 我快到了，下車了！
dialogue.py: wǒ kuài dào le, xià chē le!
dialogue.en: I'm almost there, getting off the bus!

dialogue.speaker: Mark (Text)
dialogue.zh: 看見你了。我在窗戶旁邊。
dialogue.py: kàn jiàn nǐ le. wǒ zài chuāng hu páng biān.
dialogue.en: I see you. I'm next to the window.

dialogue.speaker: David (Text)
dialogue.zh: 好，我進去了。
dialogue.py: hǎo, wǒ jìn qù le.
dialogue.en: Okay, I'm coming in.

speaking.part_b: Role-play: Send imaginary text messages to a friend. Tell them you are at the library. Ask where they are and if they want an iced drink.

title: At the Library
story_description: A student asks the librarian where to find a book.
story_intro: The library is a quiet place.
A student is looking for a specific book.
He goes to the help desk.
He talks to the librarian.
He asks about borrowing rules and locations.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 老師，你好。請問中文書在哪裡？
dialogue.py: lǎo shī, nǐ hǎo. qǐng wèn zhōng wén shū zài nǎ lǐ?
dialogue.en: Teacher (Librarian), hello. Where are the Chinese books?

dialogue.speaker: Librarian
dialogue.zh: 中文書在二樓。你找哪一類的書？
dialogue.py: zhōng wén shū zài èr lóu. nǐ zhǎo nǎ yī lèi de shū?
dialogue.en: Chinese books are on the second floor. What kind of books are you looking for?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我想找一本關於中國歷史的書。
dialogue.py: wǒ xiǎng zhǎo yī běn guān yú zhōng guó lì shǐ de shū.
dialogue.en: I'm looking for a book about Chinese history.

dialogue.speaker: Librarian
dialogue.zh: 歷史類的書在 205 架子上。那邊有電腦可以查詢。
dialogue.py: lì shǐ lèi de shū zài èr líng wǔ jià zi shàng. nà biān yǒu diàn nǎo kě yǐ chá xún.
dialogue.en: History books are on shelf 205. There's a computer over there to search.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。請問我可以借這本書回家嗎？
dialogue.py: xiè xie. qǐng wèn wǒ kě yǐ jiè zhè běn shū huí jiā ma?
dialogue.en: Thanks. May I borrow this book to take home?

dialogue.speaker: Librarian
dialogue.zh: 可以。你有借書證嗎？
dialogue.py: kě yǐ. nǐ yǒu jiè shū zhèng ma?
dialogue.en: Yes. Do you have a library card?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 有。一張借書證可以借幾本書？
dialogue.py: yǒu. yī zhāng jiè shū zhèng kě yǐ jiè jǐ běn shū?
dialogue.en: Yes. How many books can one library card borrow?

dialogue.speaker: Librarian
dialogue.zh: 最多可以借十本，借期是一次一個月。
dialogue.py: zuì duō kě yǐ jiè shí běn, jiè qī shì yī cì yī gè yuè.
dialogue.en: You can borrow up to ten books; the borrowing period is one month at a time.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 如果到期了，可以續借嗎？
dialogue.py: rú guǒ dào qī le, kě yǐ xù jiè ma?
dialogue.en: If it's due, can I renew it?

dialogue.speaker: Librarian
dialogue.zh: 只要沒有別人預約，就可以續借一次。
dialogue.py: zhǐ yào méi yǒu bié rén yù yuē, jiù kě yǐ xù jiè yī cì.
dialogue.en: As long as no one else has reserved it, you can renew it once.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的，我明白了。謝謝老師。
dialogue.py: hǎo de, wǒ míng bai le. xiè xie lǎo shī.
dialogue.en: Okay, I understand. Thank you, teacher.

dialogue.speaker: Librarian
dialogue.zh: 不客氣。圖書館內請保持安靜。
dialogue.py: bù kè qì. tú shū guǎn nèi qǐng bǎo chí ān jìng.
dialogue.en: You're welcome. Please keep quiet in the library.

key_sentences.en: What kind of books are you looking for?
Borrow for one month each time.
As long as no one reserved [it].

speaking.part_b: Role-play: You are at a library. Ask the librarian where the history books are. Ask how many books you can borrow and for how long. Ask about renewal rules.
part_c: 你常去圖書館嗎？
你喜歡在圖書館看書還是學習？

comprehension.q: Where are the Chinese books located?
What specific topic is Mark interested in?
What can Mark use to search for books?

passage.title: At the Library Listening Passage
passage.zh: 老師，你好。請問中文書在哪裡？中文書在二樓。你找哪一類的書？我想找一本關於中國歷史的書。歷史類的書在205架子上。那邊有電腦可以查詢。謝謝。請問我可以借這本書回家嗎？可以。你有借書證嗎？

writing: Write a library request: ask where to find a book about a specific topic and how long you can borrow it.

grammar.explanation: Using '關於 (guān yú)' for 'about'. Using '一次 (yī cì)' for 'once / at a time'. Using '只要...就...' (as long as... then... - logic).
examples: 關於我的家 (About my family)
我一個月去一次。 (I go once a month.)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 這本書是你的嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: zhè běn shū shì nǐ de ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: Is this book yours?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 不是，這是我從圖書館借的。
expansion_dialogue.py: bù shì, zhè shì wǒ cóng tú shū guǎn jiè de.
expansion_dialogue.en: No, I borrowed it from the library.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 什麼時候要還？
expansion_dialogue.py: shén me shí hou yào huán?
expansion_dialogue.en: When do you have to return it?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 下個星期五要還。
expansion_dialogue.py: xià gè xīng qī wǔ yào huán.
expansion_dialogue.en: I have to return it next Friday.

review.speaking: Ask for a book location in a library.
review.writing: Write a library request message.
review.self_check: Can you ask about library rules and book locations?

title: Borrowing Something
story_description: A student forgets a pen and asks to borrow one.
story_intro: The class is about to start.
Mark is checking his bag.
He realizes he doesn't have a pen.
He asks his neighbor for help.
They talk about borrowing and lending politely.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 大衛，不好意思，我今天忘記帶筆了。
dialogue.py: dà wèi, bù hǎo yì si, wǒ jīn tiān wàng jì dài bǐ le.
dialogue.en: David, I'm sorry, I forgot to bring a pen today.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，我有兩支。你要借一支嗎？
dialogue.py: méi guān xi, wǒ yǒu liǎng zhī. nǐ yào jiè yī zhī ma?
dialogue.en: No problem, I have two. Do you want to borrow one?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 可以嗎？太謝謝你了！
dialogue.py: kě yǐ ma? tài xiè xie nǐ le!
dialogue.en: Is it okay? Thank you so much!

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 當然可以。這支黑色的借給你。
dialogue.py: dāng rán kě yǐ. zhè zhī hēi sè de jiè gěi nǐ.
dialogue.en: Of course. Borrow this black one.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 喔，這支筆寫起來很順。是新買的嗎？
dialogue.py: ō, zhè zhī bǐ xiě qǐ lái hěn shùn. shì xīn mǎi de ma?
dialogue.en: Oh, this pen writes very smoothly. Is it newly bought?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 對，昨天剛買的。你要小心用喔，別弄丟了。
dialogue.py: duì, zuó tiān gāng mǎi de. nǐ yào xiǎo xīn yòng o, bié nòng diū le.
dialogue.en: Yes, just bought it yesterday. Use it carefully, don't lose it.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我一定會小心的。課後就還給你。
dialogue.py: wǒ yī dìng huì xiǎo xīn de. kè hòu jiù huán gěi nǐ.
dialogue.en: I'll definitely be careful. I'll return it to you after class.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 不用急，你先用吧。
dialogue.py: bù yòng jí, nǐ xiān yòng ba.
dialogue.en: No rush, you use it first.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 對了，你有橡皮擦嗎？我的也沒帶。
dialogue.py: duì le, nǐ yǒu xiàng pí cā ma? wǒ de yě méi dài.
dialogue.en: By the way, do you have an eraser? I didn't bring mine either.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 你也太糊塗了！橡皮擦只有一個，我們一起用吧。
dialogue.py: nǐ yě tài hú tu le! xiàng pí cā zhǐ yǒu yī gè, wǒ men yī qǐ yòng ba.
dialogue.en: You're too absent-minded! I only have one eraser, let's use it together.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，謝謝你。下次我請你喝飲料。
dialogue.py: hā hā, xiè xie nǐ. xià cì wǒ qǐng nǐ hē yǐn liào.
dialogue.en: Haha, thanks. Next time I'll treat you to a drink.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 一言為定！
dialogue.py: yī yán wéi dìng!
dialogue.en: It's a deal!

key_sentences.en: Do you want to borrow one?
No rush / No need to hurry.

speaking.part_b: Role-play: You forgot your textbook. Ask your classmate to share or borrow one. Promise to be careful and return it promptly.
part_c: 你常忘記帶東西嗎？
你借過別人的東西嗎？

comprehension.q: What did Mark forget to bring?
How many pens does David have?
What color pen does David lend to Mark?
What other item did Mark forget to bring?
What does Mark promise to do for David next time?

true_false.q: Mark has a pen in his bag.
David bought his pen recently.
Mark will return the pen next year.
David has many erasers.
They agree to share the eraser.

passage.title: Borrowing Something Listening Passage
passage.zh: 大衛，不好意思，我今天忘記帶筆了。沒關係，我有兩支。你要借一支嗎？可以嗎？太謝謝你了！當然可以。這支黑色的借給你。喔，這支筆寫起來很順。是新買的嗎？對，昨天剛買的。你要小心用喔，別弄丟了。
passage.en: The class is about to start. Mark is checking his bag. He realizes he doesn't have a pen. He asks his neighbor for help. They talk about borrowing and lending politely.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Write 5 borrowing requests: e.g., 'May I borrow your pen?', 'Can I use your eraser?'.

grammar.explanation: Using '借 (jiè)' for both borrow and lend. Using '還 (huán)' for returning. Using 'Verb + 起來' to describe an experience/perception.
examples: 我借你一本書。 (I lend you a book.)
我向你借。 (I borrow from you.)
把筆還我。 (Return the pen to me.)
喝起來很甜。 (Tastes sweet.)
不用謝。 (No need to thank.)

practice.q: Translate: Can I borrow your car?
Complete: 他把書___我了。 (He returned the book...)
Complete: 我___記了他的名字。 (I forgot...)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你可以借我一些錢嗎？我忘了帶錢包。
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ kě yǐ jiè wǒ yī xiē qián ma? wǒ wàng le dài qián bāo.
expansion_dialogue.en: Can you lend me some money? I forgot to bring my wallet.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你要多少？
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ yào duō shǎo?
expansion_dialogue.en: How much do you need?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 五十塊就夠了，我買午飯用。
expansion_dialogue.py: wǔ shí kuài jiù gòu le, wǒ mǎi wǔ fàn yòng.
expansion_dialogue.en: Fifty dollars is enough, for buying lunch.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 好的，給你。明天還我就行。
expansion_dialogue.py: hǎo de, gěi nǐ. míng tiān huán wǒ jiù xíng.
expansion_dialogue.en: Okay, here you go. Just return it to me tomorrow.

review.speaking: Ask to borrow something from a friend.
review.writing: Write 5 polite borrowing requests.
review.self_check: Can you politely ask to borrow and return objects?

title: Simple Homework Talk
story_description: Two classmates discuss homework and due dates.
story_intro: The class has finished.
Students have some homework to do.
Two friends talk about the tasks.
They discuss if the homework is hard or easy.
They talk about when they will finish it.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 今天的功課你做了嗎？
dialogue.py: jīn tiān de gōng kè nǐ zuò le ma?
dialogue.en: Have you done today's homework?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 還沒，我打算等一下再做。你呢？
dialogue.py: hái méi, wǒ dǎ suàn děng yī xià zài zuò. nǐ ne?
dialogue.en: Not yet, I plan to do it later. How about you?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我剛才看了一下，覺得有點兒難。
dialogue.py: wǒ gāng cái kàn le yī xià, jué de yǒu diǎn r nán.
dialogue.en: I just took a look, and I think it's a bit hard.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 哪一部分難？是聽寫還是閱讀？
dialogue.py: nǎ yī bù fèn nán? shì tīng xiě hái shì yuè dú?
dialogue.en: Which part is hard? Dictation or reading?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 是聽寫。老師說的很快，我聽不清楚。
dialogue.py: shì tīng xiě. lǎo shī shuō de hěn kuài, wǒ tīng bù qīng chu.
dialogue.en: It's the dictation. The teacher speaks very fast, I can't hear clearly.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 沒關係。閱讀很簡單，我們可以先做閱讀。
dialogue.py: méi guān xi. yuè dú hěn jiǎn dān, wǒ men kě yǐ xiān zuò yuè dú.
dialogue.en: No problem. The reading is very simple, we can do that first.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 功課什麼時候要交？
dialogue.py: gōng kè shén me shí hou yào jiāo?
dialogue.en: When should the homework be handed in?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 明天早上第一節課。你有時間跟我一起做嗎？
dialogue.py: míng tiān zǎo shang dì yī jié kè. nǐ yǒu shí jiān gēn wǒ yī qǐ zuò ma?
dialogue.en: Tomorrow morning during the first period. Do you have time to do it with me?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 有。我們去圖書館吧，那裡比較安靜。
dialogue.py: yǒu. wǒ men qù tú shū guǎn ba, nà lǐ bǐ jiào ān jìng.
dialogue.en: Yes. Let's go to the library; it's relatively quiet there.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 好主意。我還得帶上我的字典。
dialogue.py: hǎo zhǔ yì. wǒ hái děi dài shàng wǒ de zì diǎn.
dialogue.en: Good idea. I also have to bring my dictionary.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我已經帶了。我們現在就走吧。
dialogue.py: wǒ yǐ jīng dài le. wǒ men xiàn zài jiù zǒu ba.
dialogue.en: I've already brought mine. Let's go right now.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 好的，走吧！
dialogue.py: hǎo de, zǒu ba!
dialogue.en: Okay, let's go!

speaking.part_b: Role-play: Talk to a classmate about a difficult assignment. Ask when it's due and suggest doing it together in a quiet place.
part_c: 你喜歡做功課嗎？
你覺得聽寫難還是閱讀難？

comprehension.q: Has David done his homework yet?
comprehension.a: No, he plans to do it later

comprehension.q: Which part of the homework does Mark find difficult?
Why does Mark find dictation hard?
comprehension.a: The teacher speaks very fast and he can't hear clearly

comprehension.q: When is the homework due?
comprehension.a: Tomorrow morning during the first period

comprehension.q: Where do they decide to go to do their homework?

passage.en: The class has finished. Students have some homework to do. Two friends talk about the tasks. They discuss if the homework is hard or easy. They talk about when they will finish it.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Write a homework reminder: include what the task is, whether it's easy/hard, and when to hand it in.

grammar.explanation: Topic-Comment structure (e.g., '功課你做了嗎'). Using '再 (zài)' for 'doing something later'. Potential complement '不清楚' (cannot hear/see clearly).
examples: 這本書我看完了。 (Topic-Comment: I finished this book.)
等一下再吃。 (Eat later.)
聽不清楚 (Cannot hear clearly)
看不明白 (Cannot understand [by reading])
第一節課 (The first period)

practice.q: Translate: Have you finished the apple?

Complete: 第___節課是中文。 (The second period...)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 明天的考試，你準備好了嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: míng tiān de kǎo shì, nǐ zhǔn bèi hǎo le ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: Are you prepared for tomorrow's exam?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 差不多了。但是聽力部分我還想多練習。
expansion_dialogue.py: chā bù duō le. dàn shì tīng lì bù fèn wǒ hái xiǎng duō liàn xí.
expansion_dialogue.en: Almost. But I want to practice the listening part more.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 我也一樣。我們一起聽CD吧。
expansion_dialogue.py: wǒ yě yī yàng. wǒ men yī qǐ tīng CD ba.
expansion_dialogue.en: Me too. Let's listen to the CD together.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 好，這樣效果更好。
expansion_dialogue.py: hǎo, zhè yàng xiào guǒ gèng hǎo.
expansion_dialogue.en: Okay, that will be more effective.

review.writing: Write a short homework reminder.

title: My Favorite Subject
story_description: Students talk about school subjects they like.
story_intro: The students are taking a break between classes.
They talk about their weekly schedule.
They discuss which subjects they like and which ones they find difficult.
They share their reasons for their preferences.
They talk about their future goals related to these subjects.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 大衛，你這學期修了幾門課？
dialogue.py: dà wèi, nǐ zhè xué qī xiū le jǐ mén kè?
dialogue.en: David, how many courses are you taking this semester?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 我修了五門課：中文、歷史、數學、體育和藝術。
dialogue.py: wǒ xiū le wǔ mén kè: zhōng wén, lì shǐ, shù xué, tǐ yù hé yì shù.
dialogue.en: I'm taking five courses: Chinese, History, Math, PE, and Art.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 哇，那很忙！你最喜歡哪一門課？
dialogue.py: wa, nà hěn máng! nǐ zuì xǐ huan nǎ yī mén kè?
dialogue.en: Wow, that's busy! Which course do you like the most?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 我最喜歡藝術課。我喜歡畫畫，覺得很有意思。
dialogue.py: wǒ zuì xǐ huan yì shù kè. wǒ xǐ huan huà huà, jué de hěn yǒu yì si.
dialogue.en: I like Art class the most. I like drawing and find it very interesting.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 藝術課確實不錯。我不擅長畫畫，我比較喜歡數學。
dialogue.py: yì shù kè què shí bù cuò. wǒ bù shàn cháng huà huà, wǒ bǐ jiào xǐ huan shù xué.
dialogue.en: Art class is indeed not bad. I'm not good at drawing; I prefer Math.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 數學？你不覺得數學很枯燥嗎？公式那麼多。
dialogue.py: shù xué? nǐ bù jué de shù xué hěn kū zào ma? gōng shì nà me duō.
dialogue.en: Math? Don't you think Math is boring? There are so many formulas.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 雖然公式多，但是很有邏輯。解出答案的時候很有成就感。
dialogue.py: suī rán gōng shì duō, dàn shì hěn yǒu luó jí. jiě chū dá àn de shí hou hěn yǒu chéng jiù gǎn.
dialogue.en: Although there are many formulas, it's very logical. I feel a great sense of achievement when I solve the answer.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 你真厲害。那歷史課呢？你覺得難嗎？
dialogue.py: nǐ zhēn lì hai. nà lì shǐ kè ne? nǐ jué de nán ma?
dialogue.en: You're really impressive. What about History class? Do you find it hard?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 歷史課要背的年份和人名太多了，我覺得有點兒吃力。
dialogue.py: lì shǐ kè yào bèi de nián fèn hé rén míng tài duō le, wǒ jué de yǒu diǎn r chī lì.
dialogue.en: There are too many years and names to memorize in History class; I find it a bit strenuous.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 我也這麼覺得。所以我們要多互相幫助。
dialogue.py: wǒ yě zhè me jué de. suǒ yǐ wǒ men yào duō hù xiāng bāng zhù.
dialogue.en: I feel the same way. So we should help each other more.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。如果你數學有問題，儘管問我。
dialogue.py: méi wèn tí. rú guǒ nǐ shù xué yǒu wèn tí, jǐn guǎn wèn wǒ.
dialogue.en: No problem. If you have questions in Math, feel free to ask me.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 太好了，謝謝你！
dialogue.py: tài hǎo le, xiè xie nǐ!
dialogue.en: Great, thank you!

key_sentences.en: How many courses are you taking this semester?
I like Art class the most.
I find it a bit strenuous.

vocabulary.meaning: to be good at / expert in

speaking.part_b: Role-play: Talk to a friend about your favorite and least favorite subjects. Explain why you find one difficult (e.g., too much to memorize) and offer to help with the one you are good at.
part_c: 你覺得學中文吃力嗎？
你最擅長哪一門科目？

comprehension.q: How many courses is David taking this semester?
Why does David like Art class?
comprehension.a: Because he likes drawing and finds it interesting

comprehension.q: Which subject does Mark prefer over Art?
What does Mark like about Math?
comprehension.a: It's logical and gives a sense of achievement when solving answers

comprehension.q: Why does Mark find History class strenuous?
comprehension.a: There are too many years and names to memorize

true_false.q: David is taking a Music class.
Mark is not good at drawing.
David thinks Math is interesting.
Mark thinks History is easy.
They agree to help each other.

passage.title: My Favorite Subject Listening Passage
passage.zh: 大衛，你這學期修了幾門課？我修了五門課：中文、歷史、數學、體育和藝術。哇，那很忙！你最喜歡哪一門課？我最喜歡藝術課。我喜歡畫畫，覺得很有意思。藝術課確實不錯。我不擅長畫畫，我比較喜歡數學。數學？你不覺得數學很枯燥嗎？公式那麼多。
passage.en: The students are taking a break between classes. They talk about their weekly schedule. They discuss which subjects they like and which ones they find difficult. They share their reasons for their preferences. They talk about their future goals related to these subjects.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Write a short paragraph about your favorite school subject: what it is, why you like it, and if it's easy or hard for you (40-60 words).

grammar.explanation: Using '擅長 (shàn cháng)' for 'be good at'. Using '儘管 (jǐn guǎn)' to encourage someone to do something. Measure word '門' for subjects.
examples: 他很擅長打球。 (He is good at playing ball.)
有事儘管找我。 (If something is up, feel free to find me.)
這門課很有用。 (This course is very useful.)
成就感 (Sense of achievement)
吃力 (Strenuous)

practice.q: Translate: I'm not good at Math.
Complete: 他___長唱歌。 (He is good at singing.)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你喜歡理科還是文科？
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ xǐ huan lǐ kē hái shì wén kē?
expansion_dialogue.en: Do you like sciences or humanities?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 我比較喜歡文科，比如文學和哲學。
expansion_dialogue.py: wǒ bǐ jiào xǐ huan wén kē, bǐ rú wén xué hé zhé xué.
expansion_dialogue.en: I prefer humanities, such as literature and philosophy.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 為什麼？理科不是更實用嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: wèi shén me? lǐ kē bù shì gèng shí yòng ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: Why? Aren't sciences more practical?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 雖然理科實用，但文科能讓我思考人生。
expansion_dialogue.py: suī rán lǐ kē shí yòng, dàn wén kē néng ràng wǒ sī kǎo rén shēng.
expansion_dialogue.en: Although sciences are practical, humanities can make me reflect on life.

review.speaking: Explain your favorite subject and why.
review.writing: Write 5 sentences about school subjects.
review.self_check: Can you name several school subjects and express your level of interest/skill?

title: The Test Is Tomorrow
story_description: Two students prepare for a test and talk about studying.
story_intro: There is a big test tomorrow morning.
The students are studying late in the library.
They talk about how they feel before the test.
They discuss which parts they have reviewed.
They encourage each other to keep going.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 大衛，你複習得怎麼樣了？明天的考試我很緊張。
dialogue.py: dà wèi, nǐ fù xí de zěn me yàng le? míng tiān de kǎo shì wǒ hěn jǐn zhāng.
dialogue.en: David, how is your review going? I'm very nervous about tomorrow's exam.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 我也很緊張。我剛看完前三個單元，還有兩個單元沒看。
dialogue.py: wǒ yě hěn jǐn zhāng. wǒ gāng kàn wán qián sān gè dān yuán, hái yǒu liǎng gè dān yuán méi kàn.
dialogue.en: I'm also nervous. I just finished the first three units, there are still two units I haven't looked at.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你還有兩個單元？我才複習完第一單元呢。
dialogue.py: nǐ hái yǒu liǎng gè dān yuán? wǒ cái fù xí wán dì yī dān yuán ne.
dialogue.en: You still have two units? I only just finished reviewing the first unit.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 那你要快點了。老師說第四單元是重點。
dialogue.py: nà nǐ yào kuài diǎn le. lǎo shī shuō dì sì dān yuán shì zhòng diǎn.
dialogue.en: Then you need to hurry up. The teacher said unit four is the key point.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 重點？完了，我最怕重點了。我現在頭有點兒暈。
dialogue.py: zhòng diǎn? wán le, wǒ zuì pà zhòng diǎn le. wǒ xiàn zài tóu yǒu diǎn r yūn.
dialogue.en: Key point? Oh no, I'm most afraid of 'key points'. My head is a bit dizzy now.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 別擔心，我們先休息十分鐘，喝點水吧。
dialogue.py: bié dān xīn, wǒ men xiān xiū xi shí fēn zhōng, hē diǎn shuǐ ba.
dialogue.en: Don't worry, let's rest for ten minutes first and drink some water.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好。你覺得這次考試會很難嗎？
dialogue.py: hǎo. nǐ jué de zhè cì kǎo shì huì hěn nán ma?
dialogue.en: Okay. Do you think this exam will be very hard?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 應該會有一點兒難。不過只要我們認真複習，一定沒問題。
dialogue.py: yīng gāi huì yǒu yī diǎn r nán. bù guò zhǐ yào wǒ men rèn zhēn fù xí, yī dìng méi wèn tí.
dialogue.en: It should be a bit hard. But as long as we review seriously, there will definitely be no problem.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 希望如此。我打算今晚熬夜複習。
dialogue.py: xī wàng rú cǐ. wǒ dǎ suàn jīn wǎn áo yè fù xí.
dialogue.en: Hope so. I plan to stay up late tonight to review.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 熬夜對身體不好，也影響明天的精神。你最好早點睡。
dialogue.py: áo yè duì shēn tǐ hǎo, yě yǐng xiǎng míng tiān de jīng shén. nǐ zuì hǎo zǎo diǎn shuì.
dialogue.en: Staying up late is bad for the body and also affects tomorrow's energy. You'd better sleep early.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你說得對。那我複習完重點就睡。
dialogue.py: nǐ shuō de duì. nà wǒ fù xí wán zhòng diǎn jiù shuì.
dialogue.en: You're right. Then I'll sleep after I finish reviewing the key points.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 好。我們一起加油吧！
dialogue.py: hǎo. wǒ men yī qǐ jiā yóu ba!
dialogue.en: Okay. Let's keep at it together!

key_sentences.en: Staying up late is bad for health.
Go for it! / Keep it up!

vocabulary.meaning: to stay up late / all night
to make an extra effort / go for it

speaking.part_b: Role-play: You are studying with a friend for tomorrow's test. Express your nervousness and ask which units are most important. Advise them not to stay up too late.
part_c: 你考試前會緊張嗎？
你複習功課時喜歡熬夜嗎？

comprehension.q: How do both Mark and David feel about tomorrow's exam?
How many units has David finished reviewing?
Which unit is the most important (key point)?
What physical symptom does Mark have?
What is David's advice about staying up late?
comprehension.a: It's bad for the body and affects energy; sleep early instead

true_false.q: Mark has finished all units.
David suggests taking a short break.
The exam is today.
Serious review will help pass the test.
David plans to stay up all night.

passage.title: The Test Is Tomorrow Listening Passage
passage.zh: 大衛，你複習得怎麼樣了？明天的考試我很緊張。我也很緊張。我剛看完前三個單元，還有兩個單元沒看。你還有兩個單元？我才複習完第一單元呢。那你要快點了。老師說第四單元是重點。重點？完了，我最怕重點了。我現在頭有點兒暈。別擔心，我們先休息十分鐘，喝點水吧。
passage.en: There is a big test tomorrow morning. The students are studying late in the library. They talk about how they feel before the test. They discuss which parts they have reviewed. They encourage each other to keep going.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Write a study plan for an upcoming test: include which subjects to review, when you will study, and how you will stay focused (40-60 words).

grammar.explanation: Using '才 (cái)' to emphasize that progress is slow or something happened late. Using '最好 (zuì hǎo)' for 'had better'. Resultative complement '完' (finished).
examples: 他才做完。 (He only just finished [slowly].)
你最好現在就走。 (You'd better leave right now.)
看完了 (Finished reading)
做完了 (Finished doing)
應該... (Should ...)

practice.q: Complete: 我___看完。 (I just finished reading.)
Complete: 他___睡覺了。 (He has already slept.)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 這題你做出來了嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: zhè tí nǐ zuò chū lái le ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: Did you figure out this problem?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 還沒，公式我記不清楚了。
expansion_dialogue.py: hái méi, gōng shì wǒ jì bù qīng chu le.
expansion_dialogue.en: Not yet, I can't remember the formula clearly.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 沒關係，我幫你看看。喔，這題要用勾股定理。
expansion_dialogue.py: méi guān xi, wǒ bāng nǐ kàn kàn. ō, zhè tí yào yòng gōu gǔ dìng lǐ.
expansion_dialogue.en: No problem, I'll help you look. Oh, this problem requires the Pythagorean theorem.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 原來是這樣，我明白了！
expansion_dialogue.py: yuán lái shì zhè yàng, wǒ míng bai le!
expansion_dialogue.en: So that's how it is, I understand now!

review.speaking: Encourage a friend before a test.
review.writing: Write a short study plan.
review.self_check: Can you discuss test preparation and give advice to classmates?

title: At the Doctor
story_description: A student feels sick and visits a doctor.
story_intro: Mark is not feeling well today.
He has a headache and a fever.
He goes to a nearby clinic.
He talks to the doctor about his symptoms.
The doctor gives him a check-up and advice.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.zh: 你好，哪裡不舒服？
dialogue.py: nǐ hǎo, nǎ lǐ bù shū fu?
dialogue.en: Hello, where do you feel unwell?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 醫生，我頭很疼，嗓子也痛。
dialogue.py: yī shēng, wǒ tóu hěn téng, sǎng zi yě tòng.
dialogue.en: Doctor, I have a bad headache and my throat also hurts.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.zh: 從什麼時候開始的？發燒嗎？
dialogue.py: cóng shén me shí hou kāi shǐ de? fā shāo ma?
dialogue.en: When did it start? Do you have a fever?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 從昨天晚上開始的。剛才量了一下，三十八度五。
dialogue.py: cóng zuó tiān wǎn shang kāi shǐ de. gāng cái liáng le yī xià, sān shí bā dù wǔ.
dialogue.en: It started last night. I just measured it, 38.5 degrees.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.zh: 請張開嘴，讓我看看。啊——
dialogue.py: qǐng zhāng kāi zuǐ, ràng wǒ kàn kàn. ā——
dialogue.en: Please open your mouth and let me see. Ah—

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.en: Ah—

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.zh: 嗓子有點兒紅腫。咳嗽嗎？
dialogue.py: sǎng zi yǒu diǎn r hóng zhǒng. ké sou ma?
dialogue.en: The throat is a bit red and swollen. Do you have a cough?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 有一點兒，特別是晚上的時候。
dialogue.py: yǒu yī diǎn r, tè bié shì wǎn shang de shí hou.
dialogue.en: A little bit, especially at night.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，是普通的感冒。我給你開點藥。
dialogue.py: méi guān xi, shì pǔ tōng de gǎn mào. wǒ gěi nǐ kāi diǎn yào.
dialogue.en: It's okay; it's a common cold. I'll prescribe some medicine for you.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝醫生。這藥怎麼吃？
dialogue.py: xiè xie yī shēng. zhè yào zěn me chī?
dialogue.en: Thank you, doctor. How should I take this medicine?

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.zh: 一天三次，飯後吃。你要多喝水，多休息。
dialogue.py: yī tiān sān cì, fàn hòu chī. nǐ yào duō hē shuǐ, duō xiū xi.
dialogue.en: Three times a day, take after meals. You need to drink plenty of water and rest a lot.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的，我知道了。謝謝醫生。
dialogue.py: hǎo de, wǒ zhī dào le. xiè xie yī shēng.
dialogue.en: Okay, I got it. Thank you, doctor.

speaking.part_b: Role-play: You are at a clinic. Tell the doctor you have a headache and a cough. Ask how many times a day you should take the medicine.
part_c: 你生病時會去看醫生嗎？
你覺得健康重要嗎？

comprehension.q: What are Mark's symptoms?
When did Mark's illness start?
What is Mark's body temperature?
What does the doctor diagnose it as?
How often should Mark take the medicine?
comprehension.a: Three times a day, after meals

true_false.q: Mark feels very comfortable.
Mark has a fever.
Mark's throat is normal.
The doctor didn't give Mark any medicine.
Mark should rest more.

passage.title: At the Doctor Listening Passage
passage.zh: 你好，哪裡不舒服？醫生，我頭很疼，嗓子也痛。從什麼時候開始的？發燒嗎？從昨天晚上開始的。剛才量了一下，三十八度五。請張開嘴，讓我看看。啊——。啊——。
passage.en: Mark is not feeling well today. He has a headache and a fever. He goes to a nearby clinic. He talks to the doctor about his symptoms. The doctor gives him a check-up and advice.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Write a short note describing your symptoms to a doctor or a note for taking sick leave (3-5 sentences).

grammar.explanation: Describing frequency with 'Number + 次 (cì)'. Using '多 + Verb' (e.g., '多喝水') to give advice. Asking '哪裡不舒服' for wellness check.
examples: 一天兩次 (Twice a day)
多吃水果 (Eat more fruit)
我頭痛。 (I have a headache.)
量體溫 (Measure temperature)
開藥 (Prescribe medicine)

practice.q: Complete: 你要多___休息。 (You need to rest more.)
Complete: 他發___了。 (He has a fever.)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你肚子還疼嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ dù zi hái téng ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: Does your stomach still hurt?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 好多了，吃了藥就不疼了。
expansion_dialogue.py: hǎo duō le, chī le yào jiù bù téng le.
expansion_dialogue.en: Much better, it doesn't hurt after taking the medicine.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 那就好。你要注意飲食衛生。
expansion_dialogue.py: nà jiù hǎo. nǐ yào zhù yì yǐn shí wèi shēng.
expansion_dialogue.en: That's good. You should pay attention to food hygiene.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 我記住了，謝謝關心。
expansion_dialogue.py: wǒ jì zhù le, xiè xie guān xīn.
expansion_dialogue.en: I'll remember, thanks for your concern.

review.speaking: Explain simple symptoms to a doctor.
review.writing: Write a short symptom note.
review.self_check: Can you describe where you feel unwell and understand medical instructions?

title: I Don’t Feel Well
story_description: A student tells the teacher they feel sick and need to go home.
story_intro: The class is ongoing.
Mark feels very weak and dizzy.
He goes to the teacher's desk.
He explains his situation and asks for permission.
The teacher shows concern and gives instructions.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 老師，不好意思，我想請假。
dialogue.py: lǎo shī, bù hǎo yì si, wǒ xiǎng qǐng jià.
dialogue.en: Teacher, sorry, I'd like to ask for leave.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 怎麼了，馬克？哪裡不舒服？
dialogue.py: zěn me le, mǎ kè? nǎ lǐ bù shū fu?
dialogue.en: What's wrong, Mark? Where do you feel unwell?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我肚子很疼，覺得渾身沒勁兒。
dialogue.py: wǒ dù zi hěn téng, jué de hún shēn méi jìn r.
dialogue.en: My stomach hurts badly, and I feel weak all over.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 臉色看起來也不太好。是不是吃壞肚子了？
dialogue.py: liǎn sè kàn qǐ lái yě bù tài hǎo. shì bù shì chī huài dù zi le?
dialogue.en: Your complexion doesn't look too good either. Did you eat something bad?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 可能吧。我想回宿舍休息一下。
dialogue.py: kě néng ba. wǒ xiǎng huí sù shè xiū xi yī xià.
dialogue.en: Maybe. I want to go back to the dormitory to rest for a bit.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 好。你自己能回去嗎？要不要人陪？
dialogue.py: hǎo. nǐ zì jǐ néng huí qù ma? yào bù yào rén péi?
dialogue.en: Okay. Can you go back by yourself? Do you need someone to accompany you?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，我可以自己回去。宿舍離這裡不遠。
dialogue.py: méi guān xi, wǒ kě yǐ zì jǐ huí qù. sù shè lí zhè lǐ bù yuǎn.
dialogue.en: No problem, I can go back by myself. The dorm is not far from here.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 那你回去以後先休息。如果還疼，一定要去看醫生。
dialogue.py: nà nǐ huí qù yǐ hòu xiān xiū xi. rú guǒ hái téng, yī dìng yào qù kàn yī shēng.
dialogue.en: Then rest first after you get back. If it still hurts, you must go see a doctor.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的。明天的作業我會補交的。
dialogue.py: hǎo de. míng tiān de zuò yè wǒ huì bǔ jiāo de.
dialogue.en: Okay. I will make up and hand in tomorrow's homework later.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 作業不急。身體最重要。快回去休息吧。
dialogue.py: zuò yè bù jí. shēn tǐ zuì zhòng yào. kuài huí qù xiū xi ba.
