dialogue.en: The homework is not urgent. Health is the most important. Go back and rest quickly.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝老師，老師再見。
dialogue.py: xiè xie lǎo shī, lǎo shī zài jiàn.
dialogue.en: Thank you, teacher. Goodbye, teacher.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 再見。祝你早日康復。
dialogue.py: zài jiàn. zhù nǐ zǎo rì kāng fù.
dialogue.en: Goodbye. Wish you a speedy recovery.

key_sentences.en: I'd like to ask for leave.
No energy all over the body.
Do you need someone to accompany you?

vocabulary.meaning: to get sick from eating bad food
to hand in late / make up a submission

speaking.part_b: Role-play: You are in class and feel very weak. Tell your teacher you need to ask for leave and go back to the dorm. Decline an offer for help and promise to hand in homework later.
part_c: 你請過病假嗎？
你覺得宿舍環境好嗎？

comprehension.q: What is Mark's request to the teacher?
How does Mark feel physically?
comprehension.a: Stomach hurts and feels weak all over

comprehension.q: What does the teacher think might be the cause of Mark's illness?
Where does Mark want to go to rest?
What well wish does the teacher give at the end?
comprehension.a: Wish you a speedy recovery (祝你早日康復)

true_false.q: Mark wants to go to the library.
Mark's complexion looks very healthy.
Mark wants someone to accompany him.
Mark plans to hand in homework later.
The teacher thinks health is more important than homework.

passage.title: I Don’t Feel Well Listening Passage
passage.zh: 老師，不好意思，我想請假。怎麼了，馬克？哪裡不舒服？我肚子很疼，覺得渾身沒勁兒。臉色看起來也不太好。是不是吃壞肚子了？可能吧。我想回宿舍休息一下。好。你自己能回去嗎？要不要人陪？
passage.en: The class is ongoing. Mark feels very weak and dizzy. He goes to the teacher's desk. He explains his situation and asks for permission. The teacher shows concern and gives instructions.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Write a sick leave message to a teacher: explain your symptoms and ask to go home (40-60 words).

grammar.explanation: Using '離 (lí)' to describe distance between two places. Using '...最重要' to express priority. Resultative complement '壞' (damaged/bad).
examples: A 離 B 很近。 (A is near B.)
健康最重要。 (Health is most important.)
吃壞肚子 (Upset stomach from bad food)
做壞了 (Did it poorly/badly)
請假 (Ask for leave)

practice.q: Translate: My home is far from school.
Complete: 時間___重要。 (Time is most important.)
Translate: I want to ask for sick leave.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 老師，大衛今天怎麼沒來上課？
expansion_dialogue.py: lǎo shī, dà wèi jīn tiān zěn me méi lái shàng kè?
expansion_dialogue.en: Teacher, why didn't David come to class today?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: Teacher
expansion_dialogue.zh: 他生病了，向我請了一天假。
expansion_dialogue.py: tā shēng bìng le, xiàng wǒ qǐng le yī tiān jià.
expansion_dialogue.en: He is sick; he asked me for a one-day leave.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 嚴不嚴重？晚點我給他發個訊息問候一下。
expansion_dialogue.py: yán bù yán zhòng? wǎn diǎn wǒ gěi tā fā gè xùn xī wèn hòu yī xià.
expansion_dialogue.en: Is it serious? I'll send him a message to check on him later.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: Teacher
expansion_dialogue.zh: 他不發燒，只是感冒。你可以問問他需不需要幫忙。
expansion_dialogue.py: tā bù fā shāo, zhǐ shì gǎn mào. nǐ kě yǐ wèn wèn tā xū bù xū yào bāng máng.
expansion_dialogue.en: He doesn't have a fever, just a cold. You can ask him if he needs any help.

review.speaking: Ask to rest or go home using '我想請假'.
review.writing: Write a sick message to a teacher.
review.self_check: Can you report health issues and ask for permission to leave a class?

title: Buying Medicine
story_description: A customer asks a pharmacist for basic medicine.
story_intro: Mark is at a pharmacy.
He needs to buy medicine for his fever and cough.
He talks to the pharmacist.
He asks about the effects and usage of the medicine.
The pharmacist gives him instructions and tips.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你好，我想買點感冒藥和止咳藥。
dialogue.py: nǐ hǎo, wǒ xiǎng mǎi diǎn gǎn mào yào hé zhǐ ké yào.
dialogue.en: Hello, I'd like to buy some cold medicine and cough medicine.

dialogue.speaker: Pharmacist
dialogue.zh: 好的。你有什麼症狀？
dialogue.py: hǎo de. nǐ yǒu shén me zhèng zhuàng?
dialogue.en: Okay. What symptoms do you have?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我發燒了，三十八度。還有點兒咳嗽，嗓子乾疼。
dialogue.py: wǒ fā shāo le, sān shí bā dù. hái yǒu diǎn r ké sou, sǎng zi gān téng.
dialogue.en: I have a fever, 38 degrees. Also a bit of a cough, and my throat is dry and painful.

dialogue.speaker: Pharmacist
dialogue.zh: 這盒是退燒藥，效果很好。這瓶是止咳糖漿。
dialogue.py: zhè hé shì tuì shāo yào, xiào guǒ hěn hǎo. zhè píng shì zhǐ ké táng jiāng.
dialogue.en: This box is fever-reducing medicine, the effect is very good. This bottle is cough syrup.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 這兩種藥可以一起吃嗎？
dialogue.py: zhè liǎng zhǒng yào kě yǐ yī qǐ chī ma?
dialogue.en: Can these two kinds of medicine be taken together?

dialogue.speaker: Pharmacist
dialogue.zh: 可以。退燒藥一天兩次，早晚各一粒。糖漿一天三次，每次十毫升。
dialogue.py: kě yǐ. tuì shāo yào yī tiān liǎng cì, zǎo wǎn gè yī lì. táng jiāng yī tiān sān cì, měi cì shí háo shēng.
dialogue.en: Yes. Fever medicine twice a day, one pill each morning and evening. Syrup three times a day, 10ml each time.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 吃了這個藥會不會想睡覺？
dialogue.py: chī le zhè ge yào huì bù huì xiǎng shuì jiào?
dialogue.en: Will taking this medicine make me want to sleep?

dialogue.speaker: Pharmacist
dialogue.zh: 退燒藥可能會讓你有點兒困。所以吃完藥後不要開車。
dialogue.py: tuì shāo yào kě néng huì ràng nǐ yǒu diǎn r kùn. suǒ yǐ chī wán yào hòu bù yào kāi chē.
dialogue.en: The fever medicine might make you a bit sleepy. So don't drive after taking the medicine.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的。除了吃藥，還要注意什麼？
dialogue.py: hǎo de. chú le chī yào, hái yào zhù yì shén me?
dialogue.en: Okay. Besides taking medicine, what else should I pay attention to?

dialogue.speaker: Pharmacist
dialogue.zh: 要注意保暖，別吹風。多吃點清淡的食物。
dialogue.py: yào zhù yì bǎo nuǎn, bié chuī fēng. duō chī diǎn qīng dàn de shí wù.
dialogue.en: Pay attention to keeping warm, don't catch a draft. Eat more light/bland food.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 明白了。一共多少錢？
dialogue.py: míng bai le. yī gòng duō shǎo qián?
dialogue.en: Understood. How much in total?

dialogue.speaker: Pharmacist
dialogue.zh: 一共三百二十塊。
dialogue.py: yī gòng sān bǎi èr shí kuài.
dialogue.en: 320 dollars in total.

key_sentences.en: One pill each morning and evening.

vocabulary.meaning: to be in a draft / blow wind

speaking.part_b: Role-play: You are at a pharmacy. Tell the pharmacist your throat is dry and you have a slight fever. Ask for medicine and how many milliliters of syrup to take.
part_c: 你喜歡吃藥嗎？
你覺得清淡的食物好吃嗎？

comprehension.q: What two types of medicine does Mark want to buy?
What are Mark's symptoms?
comprehension.a: Fever (38 degrees), cough, and dry sore throat

comprehension.q: How should Mark take the fever medicine?
comprehension.a: Twice a day, one pill each morning and evening

comprehension.q: What side effect might the fever medicine have?
comprehension.a: It might make him feel sleepy (困)

comprehension.q: What kind of food does the pharmacist recommend?

true_false.q: Mark has a high fever of 40 degrees.
Cough syrup should be taken 10ml at a time.
Mark is allowed to drive after taking the medicine.
The pharmacist suggests blowing wind/cold air.
The total cost is 320 dollars.

passage.title: Buying Medicine Listening Passage
passage.zh: 你好，我想買點感冒藥和止咳藥。好的。你有什麼症狀？我發燒了，三十八度。還有點兒咳嗽，嗓子乾疼。這盒是退燒藥，效果很好。這瓶是止咳糖漿。這兩種藥可以一起吃嗎？可以。退燒藥一天兩次，早晚各一粒。糖漿一天三次，每次十毫升。
passage.en: Mark is at a pharmacy. He needs to buy medicine for his fever and cough. He talks to the pharmacist. He asks about the effects and usage of the medicine. The pharmacist gives him instructions and tips.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Write basic medicine instructions: include how many times a day, how many pills/ml, and if it should be taken before/after meals.

grammar.explanation: Using '各 (gè)' for 'each'. Using '每次 (měi cì)' for 'each time'. Structure '除了...還...' (besides... also...).
examples: 早晚各一次 (Once each morning and evening)
每次兩粒 (Two pills each time)
除了他，我也去。 (Besides him, I'm also going.)
會不會... (Will it/Is it possible that...)
困 (Sleepy)

practice.q: Complete: 每次___毫升。 (10ml each time.)
Translate: Besides Chinese, I also study English.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 這藥有副作用嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: zhè yào yǒu fù zuò yòng ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: Does this medicine have side effects?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 可能會有口乾或者噁心的感覺。
expansion_dialogue.py: kě néng huì yǒu kǒu gān huò zhě ě xīn de gǎn jué.
expansion_dialogue.en: There might be a dry mouth or feeling of nausea.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 那我可以空腹吃嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: nà wǒ kě yǐ kōng fù chī ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: Then can I take it on an empty stomach?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 最好不要。飯後吃對胃比較好。
expansion_dialogue.py: zuì hǎo bù yào. fàn hòu chī duì wèi bǐ jiào hǎo.
expansion_dialogue.en: Better not. Taking it after meals is better for the stomach.

review.speaking: Ask for medicine instructions at a pharmacy.
review.writing: Write basic medicine instructions.
review.self_check: Can you buy medicine and follow simple usage instructions in Chinese?

title: At a Restaurant
story_description: Two friends order food at a small restaurant.
story_intro: Mark and David are hungry after class.
They find a nice local restaurant.
A waiter comes to their table.
They look at the menu and decide what to order.
They talk about portions and recommendations.

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.zh: 歡迎光臨！請問幾位？
dialogue.py: huān yíng guāng lín! qǐng wèn jǐ wèi?
dialogue.en: Welcome! How many people, please?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 兩位。有安靜一點兒的位置嗎？
dialogue.py: liǎng wèi. yǒu ān jìng yī diǎn r de wèi zhi ma?
dialogue.en: Two people. Is there a quieter seat?

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.zh: 有的，請跟我來。這邊請。
dialogue.py: yǒu de, qǐng gēn wǒ lái. zhè biān qǐng.
dialogue.en: Yes, please follow me. This way, please.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。大衛，你想吃什麼？
dialogue.py: xiè xie. dà wèi, nǐ xiǎng chī shén me?
dialogue.en: Thanks. David, what do you want to eat?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 我聽說這家的紅燒肉和清蒸魚很有名。
dialogue.py: wǒ tīng shuō zhè jiā de hóng shāo ròu hé qīng zhēng yú hěn yǒu míng.
dialogue.en: I heard their braised pork and steamed fish are very famous.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 那好，我們點一份紅燒肉、一條清蒸魚，再要一個炒青菜。
dialogue.py: nà hǎo, wǒ men diǎn yī fèn hóng shāo ròu, yī tiáo qīng zhēng yú, zài yào yī gè chǎo qīng cài.
dialogue.en: Okay then, let's order one braised pork, one steamed fish, and one stir-fried green vegetable.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 主食要米飯還是饅頭？
dialogue.py: zhǔ shí yào mǐ fàn hái shì mán tou?
dialogue.en: For staple food, do you want rice or steamed buns?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 米飯吧，兩碗米飯。
dialogue.py: mǐ fàn ba, liǎng wǎn mǐ fàn.
dialogue.en: Rice, probably, two bowls of rice.

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.zh: 好的。要喝點兒什麼嗎？這裡有免費的熱茶。
dialogue.py: hǎo de. yào hē diǎn r shén me ma? zhè lǐ yǒu miǎn fèi de rè chá.
dialogue.en: Okay. Do you want something to drink? There's free hot tea here.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 熱茶就可以了。謝謝。
dialogue.py: rè chá jiù kě yǐ le. xiè xie.
dialogue.en: Hot tea is fine. Thanks.

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.zh: 好的，請稍等。菜馬上就來。
dialogue.py: hǎo de, qǐng shāo děng. cài mǎ shàng jiù lái.
dialogue.en: Okay, please wait a moment. The dishes will be here shortly.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 這家餐廳環境真不錯。
dialogue.py: zhè jiā cān tīng huán jìng zhēn bù cuò.
dialogue.en: The environment of this restaurant is really not bad.

vocabulary.example: 一進門就聽到歡迎光臨。

vocabulary.meaning: measure word for long thin things (fish, rivers)

speaking.part_b: Role-play: You are a waiter. Greet two customers and lead them to a quiet table. Offer them free tea and tell them the food is coming soon.
part_c: 你喜歡去安靜的餐廳還是熱鬧的餐廳？
你最喜歡的一道中國菜是什麼？

comprehension.q: How many people are dining?
What kind of table does Mark ask for?
What two dishes are recommended by David?
What is the free drink offered by the restaurant?
Does the waiter say the food will take a long time?
comprehension.a: No, he says it will come immediately (馬上就來)

true_false.q: The restaurant is very loud.
Mark orders noodles for staple food.
Braised pork and steamed fish are famous here.
They have to pay for the tea.
The waiter is polite.

passage.title: At a Restaurant Listening Passage
passage.zh: 歡迎光臨！請問幾位？兩位。有安靜一點兒的位置嗎？有的，請跟我來。這邊請。謝謝。大衛，你想吃什麼？我聽說這家的紅燒肉和清蒸魚很有名。那好，我們點一份紅燒肉、一條清蒸魚，再要一個炒青菜。
passage.en: Mark and David are hungry after class. They find a nice local restaurant. A waiter comes to their table. They look at the menu and decide what to order. They talk about portions and recommendations.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Write a restaurant dialogue: include entering the shop, asking for a table, and ordering one dish and one drink.

grammar.explanation: Using '幾位 (jǐ wèi)' for polite inquiry of people count. Using '馬上 (mǎ shàng)' for immediate future actions. Measure word '份' for portions.
examples: 請問幾位？ (How many people?)
我馬上就去。 (I'll go right away.)
點一份菜 (Order one dish)
這邊請 (This way please)
很有名 (Very famous)

practice.q: Complete: 他___上就來。 (He's coming right away.)
Complete: 我點一___米飯。 (I order one portion...)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 服務員，我們可以換一個位置嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: fú wù yuán, wǒ men kě yǐ huàn yī gè wèi zhi ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: Waiter, can we switch to another seat?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 可以，您想坐哪裡？
expansion_dialogue.py: kě yǐ, nǐn xiǎng zuò nǎ lǐ?
expansion_dialogue.en: Yes, where would you like to sit?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 我想坐窗戶旁邊的位置。
expansion_dialogue.py: wǒ xiǎng zuò chuāng hu páng biān de wèi zhi.
expansion_dialogue.en: I'd like to sit at the table next to the window.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 好的，沒問題。請隨我來。
expansion_dialogue.py: hǎo de, méi wèn tí. qǐng suí wǒ lái.
expansion_dialogue.en: Okay, no problem. Please follow me.

review.speaking: Order a meal for two people at a restaurant.
review.writing: Write a 3-line dialogue for ordering food.
review.self_check: Can you interact with a waiter and order common dishes?

title: The Food Is Too Spicy
story_description: A customer asks about spicy and non-spicy food.
story_intro: The food has arrived at the table.
Mark tries the braised pork.
He finds it a bit spicy.
He talks to the waiter about the taste.
They discuss how to order less spicy food next time.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: （吃了一口）哇，這道菜好辣！
dialogue.py: (chī le yī kǒu) wa, zhè dào cài hǎo là!
dialogue.en: (After a bite) Wow, this dish is so spicy!

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？我覺得還好。你不能吃辣嗎？
dialogue.py: zhēn de ma? wǒ jué de hái hǎo. nǐ bù néng chī là ma?
dialogue.en: Really? I think it's okay. You can't eat spicy food?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我能吃一點兒，但是這個太辣了，我的嗓子都要冒火了。
dialogue.py: wǒ néng chī yī diǎn r, dàn shì zhè ge tài là le, wǒ de sǎng zi dōu yào mào huǒ le.
dialogue.en: I can eat a little, but this is too spicy; my throat feels like it's on fire.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 服務員，請給我一杯冰水，謝謝。
dialogue.py: fú wù yuán, qǐng gěi wǒ yī bēi bīng shuǐ, xiè xie.
dialogue.en: Waiter, please give me a glass of ice water, thanks.

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.zh: 好的。對不起，這道菜是中辣的。你要換成微辣嗎？
dialogue.py: hǎo de. duì bù qǐ, zhè dào cài shì zhōng là de. nǐ yào huàn chéng wēi là ma?
dialogue.en: Okay. Sorry, this dish is medium spicy. Do you want to change it to mild spicy?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 現在不用換了，我多喝點水。下次我會記得點微辣的。
dialogue.py: xiàn zài bù yòng huàn le, wǒ duō hē diǎn shuǐ. xià cì wǒ huì jì de diǎn wēi là de.
dialogue.en: No need to change now, I'll drink more water. Next time I'll remember to order mild spicy.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 這魚排一點兒也不辣，你嚐嚐看。
dialogue.py: zhè yú pái yī diǎn r yě bù là, nǐ cháng chang kàn.
dialogue.en: This fish fillet isn't spicy at all, try it.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: （嚐了一口）嗯，這個味道很清淡，剛好合我的口味。
dialogue.py: (cháng le yī kǒu) en, zhè ge wèi dào hěn qīng dàn, gāng hǎo hé wǒ de kǒu wèi.
dialogue.en: (Tries a bite) Hmm, this taste is very light, just right for my palate.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 那你多吃點魚吧。除了辣，這肉的味道其實不錯。
dialogue.py: nà nǐ duō chī diǎn yú ba. chú le là, zhè ròu de wèi dào qí shí bù cuò.
dialogue.en: Then eat more fish. Besides being spicy, the taste of this meat is actually good.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 對，如果沒那麼辣就完美了。
dialogue.py: duì, rú guǒ méi nà me là jiù wán měi le.
dialogue.en: Yes, if it weren't so spicy, it would be perfect.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: （笑）好了，快喝水吧。
dialogue.py: (xiào) hǎo le, kuài hē shuǐ ba.
dialogue.en: (Laughs) Okay, drink some water quickly.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，冰水舒服多了。
dialogue.py: xiè xie, bīng shuǐ shū fu duō le.
dialogue.en: Thanks, the ice water makes it much more comfortable.

vocabulary.meaning: to be on fire / to be furious

vocabulary.example: 你要大辣、中辣還是小辣？

speaking.part_b: Role-play: You are eating with a friend. Complain that the dish is too spicy. Ask for a glass of ice water. Your friend suggests you try another dish that isn't spicy at all.
part_c: 你喜歡吃辣嗎？
如果你覺得菜太辣，你會怎麼做？

comprehension.q: What is Mark's reaction after eating the braised pork?
What level of spiciness was the dish initially?
What does David order for Mark to help with the spiciness?
Is the fish fillet spicy?
comprehension.a: No, not at all (一點兒也不辣)

comprehension.q: How does Mark describe the taste of the fish fillet?
comprehension.a: Light (清淡) and suits his taste

true_false.q: Mark loves very spicy food.
David thinks the food is okay.
The waiter offers to change the dish to mild spicy.
Mark decides to change the dish immediately.
Ice water helps Mark feel better.

passage.title: The Food Is Too Spicy Listening Passage
passage.zh: （吃了一口）哇，這道菜好辣！真的嗎？我覺得還好。你不能吃辣嗎？我能吃一點兒，但是這個太辣了，我的嗓子都要冒火了。服務員，請給我一杯冰水，謝謝。好的。對不起，這道菜是中辣的。你要換成微辣嗎？現在不用換了，我多喝點水。下次我會記得點微辣的。
passage.en: The food has arrived at the table. Mark tries the braised pork. He finds it a bit spicy. He talks to the waiter about the taste. They discuss how to order less spicy food next time.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Write 5 sentences about food taste: include spicy, sweet, salty, and light/bland tastes.

grammar.explanation: Using '一点儿也不 (yī diǎn r yě bù)' for 'not at all'. Spicy levels: 大辣, 中辣, 小辣, 微辣. Resultative complement '成' (become/into).
examples: 他一點兒也不餓。 (He's not hungry at all.)
我一點兒也不喜歡。 (I don't like it at all.)
換成人民幣 (Change into RMB)
看成 (See as / mistake for)
好辣！ (So spicy!)

practice.q: Complete: 他一點兒也___看。 (He doesn't look at it at all.)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你要吃酸的還是甜的？
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ yào chī suān de hái shì tián de?
expansion_dialogue.en: Do you want to eat something sour or sweet?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 我喜歡酸酸甜甜的味道，比如糖醋排骨。
expansion_dialogue.py: wǒ xǐ huan suān suān tián tián de wèi dào, bǐ rú táng cù pái gǔ.
expansion_dialogue.en: I like sweet and sour tastes, like sweet and sour pork ribs.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 那正好，這家的糖醋排骨很有名。
expansion_dialogue.py: nà zhèng hǎo, zhè jiā de táng cù pái gǔ hěn yǒu míng.
expansion_dialogue.en: That's perfect then, the sweet and sour ribs at this place are famous.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 太棒了，我們點一份吧！
expansion_dialogue.py: tài bàng le, wǒ men diǎn yī fèn ba!
expansion_dialogue.en: Excellent, let's order a portion!

review.speaking: Describe different food tastes in Chinese.
review.writing: Write 5 sentences about your food preferences.
review.self_check: Can you specify spiciness levels and describe food tastes?

title: Paying the Bill
story_description: Friends finish eating and ask for the bill.
story_intro: The meal is finished.
Mark and David are very full.
They call the waiter to pay the bill.
They talk about paying together or separately.
They check the change and get ready to leave.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 服務員，結帳！請給我帳單。
dialogue.py: fú wù yuán, jié zhàng! qǐng gěi wǒ zhàng dān.
dialogue.en: Waiter, the bill! Please give me the invoice/bill.

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.zh: 好的。一共是五百八十塊。這是帳單。
dialogue.py: hǎo de. yī gòng shì wǔ bǎi bā shí kuài. zhè shì zhàng dān.
dialogue.en: Okay. Total is 580 dollars. Here is the bill.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 馬克，我們AA制吧，每人二百九十塊。
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, wǒ men AA zhì ba, měi rén èr bǎi jiǔ shí kuài.
dialogue.en: Mark, let's go Dutch (AA system), 290 dollars each.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 不用了，今天我請客。剛才那道菜太辣，害你沒吃好。
dialogue.py: bù yòng le, jīn tiān wǒ qǐng kè. gāng cái nà dào cài tài là, hài nǐ méi chī hǎo.
dialogue.en: No need, it's my treat today. That dish just now was too spicy; it caused you not to eat well.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 那怎麼行？說好一起吃的。那下次換我請。
dialogue.py: nà zěn me xíng? shuō hǎo yī qǐ chī de. nà xià cì huàn wǒ qǐng.
dialogue.en: How can that be? We agreed to eat together. Then next time it's my turn to treat.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好吧，那就下次你請。這是六百塊，不用找了。
dialogue.py: hǎo ba, nà jiù xià cì nǐ qǐng. zhè shì liù bǎi kuài, bù yòng zhǎo le.
dialogue.en: Okay, then you treat next time. Here is 600 dollars, keep the change.

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.zh: 謝謝您。歡迎下次光臨！
dialogue.py: xiè xie nín. huān yíng xià cì guāng lín!
dialogue.en: Thank you. Please come again!

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 你太客氣了。今天吃得真飽。
dialogue.py: nǐ tài kè qì le. jīn tiān chī de zhēn bǎo.
dialogue.en: You're too kind. I'm really full today.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 對，味道確實不錯。我們走吧。
dialogue.py: duì, wèi dào què shí bù cuò. wǒ men zǒu ba.
dialogue.en: Yes, the taste was indeed not bad. Let's go.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 你要去哪裡？我要回圖書館。
dialogue.py: nǐ yào qù nǎ lǐ? wǒ yào huí tú shū guǎn.
dialogue.en: Where are you going? I'm going back to the library.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我要去超市買點東西，然後也回學校。
dialogue.py: wǒ yào qù chāo shì mǎi diǎn dōng xi, rán hòu yě huí xué xiào.
dialogue.en: I'm going to the supermarket to buy some things, and then I'm also going back to school.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 好，那我們學校見。
dialogue.py: hǎo, nà wǒ men xué xiào jiàn.
dialogue.en: Okay, see you at school then.

key_sentences.en: Keep the change (lit. no need to find).

vocabulary.meaning: to split the bill / go Dutch
how can that be okay / that won't do

speaking.part_b: Role-play: You finished a meal with a friend. Call the waiter for the bill. Your friend wants to split the bill (AA制), but you insist on treating them because they helped you with homework. Tell the waiter to keep the change.
part_c: 你喜歡AA制還是請客？
你今天午飯吃得飽嗎？

comprehension.q: What is the total amount on the bill?
What does David suggest regarding the payment?
Why does Mark want to treat David today?
comprehension.a: Because a dish was too spicy and he felt David didn't eat well

comprehension.q: How much change does Mark leave for the waiter?
comprehension.a: 20 dollars (he gave 600 and said 'no need to find change')

comprehension.q: Where is David going after the meal?

true_false.q: The bill is 600 dollars.
David eventually agrees to Mark treating him.
Mark is going straight to the library.
They both think the food was good.
The waiter was unhappy.

passage.title: Paying the Bill Listening Passage
passage.zh: 服務員，結帳！請給我帳單。好的。一共是五百八十塊。這是帳單。馬克，我們AA制吧，每人二百九十塊。不用了，今天我請客。剛才那道菜太辣，害你沒吃好。那怎麼行？說好一起吃的。那下次換我請。好吧，那就下次你請。這是六百塊，不用找了。
passage.en: The meal is finished. Mark and David are very full. They call the waiter to pay the bill. They talk about paying together or separately. They check the change and get ready to leave.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Write a short dialogue (5 lines) about paying a bill, including the amount and splitting or treating.

grammar.explanation: Using 'AA制' for splitting. Using '請客' for treating. Using '害 (hài)' to describe a negative cause-effect. Resultative '飽' (full).
examples: 我請客。 (My treat.)
每人一半，AA制。 (Half each, go Dutch.)
雨害我遲到了。 (The rain caused me to be late.)
吃飽了 (Full from eating)
不用找了 (Keep the change)

practice.q: Complete: 忘記帶錢___我沒吃飯。 (Forgetting money caused me to...)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 這次你請我，下次一定換我請。
expansion_dialogue.py: zhè cì nǐ qǐng wǒ, xià cì yī dìng huàn wǒ qǐng.
expansion_dialogue.en: You treat me this time; next time it's definitely my turn.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 好啊，沒問題。只要你開心就行。
expansion_dialogue.py: hǎo a, méi wèn tí. zhǐ yào nǐ kāi xīn jiù xíng.
expansion_dialogue.en: Sure, no problem. As long as you are happy, it's fine.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 今天這頓飯真的很豐富。
expansion_dialogue.py: jīn tiān zhè dùn fàn zhēn de hěn fēng fù.
expansion_dialogue.en: This meal today is really abundant.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 是啊，我們都吃得太多了。
expansion_dialogue.py: shì a, wǒ men dōu chī de tài duō le.
expansion_dialogue.en: Yes, we both ate too much.

review.speaking: Ask for the bill and offer to treat a friend.
review.writing: Write a short payment dialogue.
review.self_check: Can you handle paying the bill and discuss payment options with friends?

title: Taking a Taxi
story_description: A passenger tells a taxi driver where to go.
story_intro: Mark is in a hurry.
He waves his hand and stops a taxi.
He tells the driver his destination.
They talk about the route and the traffic.
He asks about the estimated arrival time.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 師傅，你好！去火車站。
dialogue.py: shī fu, nǐ hǎo! qù huǒ chē zhàn.
dialogue.en: Master (Driver), hello! Go to the train station.

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.zh: 好的。你是要趕火車嗎？
dialogue.py: hǎo de. nǐ shì yào gǎn huǒ chē ma?
dialogue.en: Okay. Are you in a rush to catch a train?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 對，火車三點二十分開。現在走哪條路比較快？
dialogue.py: duì, huǒ chē sān diǎn èr shí fēn kāi. xiàn zài zǒu nǎ tiáo lù bǐ jiào kuài?
dialogue.en: Yes, the train leaves at 3:20. Which road is faster now?

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.zh: 現在是高峰時段，走高架橋可能會堵車。我走小路吧。
dialogue.py: xiàn zài shì gāo fēng shí duàn, zǒu gāo jià qiáo kě néng huì dǔ chē. wǒ zǒu xiǎo lù ba.
dialogue.en: It's rush hour now; taking the elevated bridge might result in a traffic jam. I'll take the side roads.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 可以。大概需要多久能到？
dialogue.py: kě yǐ. dà gài xū yào duō jiǔ néng dào?
dialogue.en: Can do. Roughly how long will it take to arrive?

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.zh: 如果不堵車的話，二十分鐘左右就能到。
dialogue.py: rú guǒ bù dǔ chē de huà, èr shí fēn zhōng zuǒ yòu jiù néng dào.
dialogue.en: If there's no traffic jam, we can arrive in about twenty minutes.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 太好了，麻煩你開快一點兒。
dialogue.py: tài hǎo le, má fan nǐ kāi kuài yī diǎn r.
dialogue.en: Great, please drive a bit faster.

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，安全第一。你是在哪個門下車？
dialogue.py: méi wèn tí, ān quán dì yī. nǐ shì zài nǎ gè mén xià chē?
dialogue.en: No problem, safety first. Which gate are you getting off at?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 請在北廣場入口停，那裡離進站口最近。
dialogue.py: qǐng zài běi guǎng chǎng rù kǒu tíng, nà lǐ lí jìn zhàn kǒu zuì jìn.
dialogue.en: Please stop at the North Plaza entrance; it's closest to the station entrance.

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.zh: 好的。火車站到了，一共是二百六十塊。
dialogue.py: hǎo de. huǒ chē zhàn dào le, yī gòng shì èr bǎi liù shí kuài.
dialogue.en: Okay. The train station is here; total is 260 dollars.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 給你錢。謝謝師傅！
dialogue.py: gěi nǐ qián. xiè xie shī fu!
dialogue.en: Here is the money. Thanks, driver!

dialogue.speaker: Driver
dialogue.zh: 不客氣，祝你旅途愉快！
dialogue.py: bù kè qì, zhù nǐ lǚ tú yú kuài!
dialogue.en: You're welcome, wish you a pleasant journey!

vocabulary.meaning: measure word for roads / long things
to drive / to open / to leave (of train)

speaking.part_b: Role-play: You are in a taxi. Tell the driver you are going to the airport and you are in a hurry. Ask about the traffic and the best route. Ask them to stop at the international terminal.
part_c: 你常坐計程車嗎？
你覺得這裏的交通方便嗎？

comprehension.q: Where does Mark want to go?
What time does Mark's train leave?
Why does the driver suggest taking side roads?
comprehension.a: Because it's rush hour and the overpass might be jammed

comprehension.q: How long will it take to arrive if there's no traffic jam?
Where does Mark want to get off?

true_false.q: Mark is not in a hurry.
Taking the overpass is always faster.
The driver prioritizes safety.
The total fare is 260 dollars.
The station entry is far from the North Plaza entrance.

passage.title: Taking a Taxi Listening Passage
passage.zh: 師傅，你好！去火車站。好的。你是要趕火車嗎？對，火車三點二十分開。現在走哪條路比較快？現在是高峰時段，走高架橋可能會堵車。我走小路吧。可以。大概需要多久能到？如果不堵車的話，二十分鐘左右就能到。
passage.en: Mark is in a hurry. He waves his hand and stops a taxi. He tells the driver his destination. They talk about the route and the traffic. He asks about the estimated arrival time.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Write taxi instructions: include the address/destination, a request for speed or route, and where exactly to stop.

grammar.explanation: Using '赶 (gǎn)' for catching transport. Using '条 (tiáo)' for roads. Time duration with '能 (néng)' for potential arrival. Priority with '...第一'.
examples: 趕火車 (Catch a train)
這條路 (This road)
二十分鐘能到。 (Can arrive in 20 mins.)
安全第一 (Safety first)
離這裡最近 (Nearest to here)

practice.q: Translate: We can arrive in 10 minutes.
Complete: 這裡離超市___近。 (Is nearest...)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 師傅，這裡可以停車嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: shī fu, zhè lǐ kě yǐ tíng chē ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: Driver, can you stop here?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 這裡不能停，有紅線。前面路口再停吧。
expansion_dialogue.py: zhè lǐ bù néng tíng, yǒu hóng xiàn. qián miàn lù kǒu zài tíng ba.
expansion_dialogue.en: Can't stop here; there's a red line. Let's stop at the next intersection.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 好的，謝謝。一共多少錢？
expansion_dialogue.py: hǎo de, xiè xie. yī gòng duō shǎo qián?
expansion_dialogue.en: Okay, thanks. How much in total?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 一百五十塊。請拿好隨身物品。
expansion_dialogue.py: yī bǎi wǔ shí kuài. qǐng ná hǎo suí shēn wù pǐn.
expansion_dialogue.en: 150 dollars. Please take your belongings.

review.speaking: Give a destination and route preference to a taxi driver.
review.writing: Write 3 sentences of taxi instructions.
review.self_check: Can you handle a taxi ride and communicate with the driver effectively?

title: Lost in the City
story_description: A tourist gets lost and asks someone for directions.
story_intro: Mark is exploring the city alone.
He wants to find a famous temple.
His phone has no internet.
He feels a bit lost and confused.
He asks a passerby for directions using landmarks.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，請問一下，去龍山寺怎麼走？
dialogue.py: bù hǎo yì si, qǐng wèn yī xià, qù lóng shān sì zěn me zǒu?
dialogue.en: Excuse me, how do I get to Longshan Temple?

dialogue.speaker: Passerby
dialogue.zh: 龍山寺？離這裡有一段路。你現在走反了。
dialogue.py: lóng shān sì? lí zhè lǐ yǒu yī duàn lù. nǐ xiàn zài zǒu fǎn le.
dialogue.en: Longshan Temple? It's a way from here. You are walking in the wrong direction now.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 喔，糟了！我應該往哪邊走？
dialogue.py: ō, zāo le! wǒ yīng gāi wǎng nǎ biān zǒu?
dialogue.en: Oh, no! Which way should I go?

dialogue.speaker: Passerby
dialogue.zh: 你先過馬路，然後一直往前走。
dialogue.py: nǐ xiān guò mǎ lù, rán hòu yī zhí wǎng qián zǒu.
dialogue.en: First cross the street, then go straight forward.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 一直走，會看到什麼標誌嗎？
dialogue.py: yī zhí zǒu, huì kàn dào shén me biāo zhì ma?
dialogue.en: Go straight, will I see any landmarks/signs?

dialogue.speaker: Passerby
dialogue.zh: 你會看到一家很大的百貨公司。在路口向右轉。
dialogue.py: nǐ huì kàn dào yī jiā hěn dà de bǎi huò gōng sī. zài lù kǒu xiàng yòu zhuǎn.
dialogue.en: You will see a large department store. Turn right at the intersection.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 向右轉以後呢？
dialogue.py: xiàng yòu zhuǎn yǐ hòu ne?
dialogue.en: And after turning right?

dialogue.speaker: Passerby
dialogue.zh: 右轉後再走五分鐘，你會看到一個捷運站入口。寺廟就在捷運站對面。
dialogue.py: yòu zhuǎn hòu zài zǒu wǔ fēn zhōng, nǐ huì kàn dào yī gè jié yùn zhàn rù kǒu. sì miào jiù zài jié yùn zhàn duì miàn.
dialogue.en: After turning right, walk for another five minutes, and you'll see a metro station entrance. The temple is right opposite the metro station.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 捷運站對面...好的，我記住了。現在那裡人多嗎？
dialogue.py: jié yùn zhàn duì miàn... hǎo de, wǒ jì zhù le. xiàn zài nà lǐ rén duō ma?
dialogue.en: Opposite the metro station... okay, I've remembered it. Are there many people there now?

dialogue.speaker: Passerby
dialogue.zh: 今天週末，遊客肯定不少。那裡很熱鬧。
dialogue.py: jīn tiān zhōu mò, yóu kè kěn dìng bù shǎo. nà lǐ hěn rè nao.
dialogue.en: It's the weekend today; there are bound to be many tourists. It's very lively there.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的，太感謝你了！
dialogue.py: hǎo de, tài gǎn xiè nǐ le!
dialogue.en: Okay, thank you so much!

dialogue.speaker: Passerby
dialogue.zh: 不客氣，慢慢逛吧。
dialogue.py: bù kè qì, màn màn guàng ba.
dialogue.en: You're welcome, enjoy your stroll.

key_sentences.en: How to get to Longshan Temple?

vocabulary.meaning: to walk in the wrong direction

speaking.part_b: Role-play: You are lost in a new city. Ask a local how to get to the department store. They tell you to cross the road and look for the metro station entrance. Confirm the directions.
part_c: 你方向感好嗎？
你喜歡去熱鬧的地方參觀嗎？

comprehension.q: Where does Mark want to go?
What is Mark's mistake at the beginning?
comprehension.a: He is walking in the wrong direction (走反了)

comprehension.q: What is the first landmark mentioned by the passerby?
comprehension.a: A large department store (百貨公司)

comprehension.q: Where is the temple located relative to the metro station?
Why is it lively at the temple today?
comprehension.a: Because it's the weekend and there are many tourists

true_false.q: The temple is very close.
Mark should cross the road first.
Mark needs to turn left at the department store.
Mark remembers the directions.
There are few tourists today.

passage.title: Lost in the City Listening Passage
passage.zh: 不好意思，請問一下，去龍山寺怎麼走？龍山寺？離這裡有一段路。你現在走反了。喔，糟了！我應該往哪邊走？你先過馬路，然後一直往前走。一直走，會看到什麼標誌嗎？你會看到一家很大的百貨公司。在路口向右轉。
passage.en: Mark is exploring the city alone. He wants to find a famous temple. His phone has no internet. He feels a bit lost and confused. He asks a passerby for directions using landmarks.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Write directions to a local landmark from where you are: use 'first', 'then', and at least one landmark.

grammar.explanation: Using '一直 (yī zhí)' for 'straight/continuously'. Using '向/往 (xiàng/wǎng)' for 'towards'. Directional '反' (wrong/opposite).
examples: 一直走 (Go straight)
向右轉 (Turn right)
方向走反了 (Walking the wrong way)
肯定很忙 (Definitely busy)
就在對面 (Right opposite)

practice.q: Translate: You're walking the wrong way.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 請問這附近有書店嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: qǐng wèn zhè fù jìn yǒu shū diàn ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: Excuse me, is there a bookstore nearby?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 有，就在下一個路口，便利商店旁邊。
expansion_dialogue.py: yǒu, jiù zài xià yī gè lù kǒu, biàn lì shāng diàn páng biān.
expansion_dialogue.en: Yes, it's at the next intersection, next to the convenience store.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 遠嗎？需要坐公車嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: yuǎn ma? xū yào zuò gōng chē ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: Is it far? Do I need to take a bus?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 不遠，走路三分鐘就到了。
expansion_dialogue.py: bù yuǎn, zǒu lù sān fēn zhōng jiù dào le.
expansion_dialogue.en: Not far, a three-minute walk and you're there.

review.speaking: Ask for directions to a specific place.
review.writing: Write simple directions using landmarks.
review.self_check: Can you ask for help when lost and follow landmark-based directions?

title: At the Train Station
story_description: A traveler buys a ticket and asks about the platform.
story_intro: Mark has arrived at the train station.
He needs to buy a ticket to another city.
He goes to the ticket window.
He asks about the train schedule and platforms.
He makes sure he has enough time to catch the train.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你好，我想買一張去台中的票。
dialogue.py: nǐ hǎo, wǒ xiǎng mǎi yī zhāng qù tái zhōng de piào.
dialogue.en: Hello, I'd like to buy a ticket to Taichung.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 好的。你要對號座還是自由座？
dialogue.py: hǎo de. nǐ yào duì hào zuò hái shì zì yóu zuò?
dialogue.en: Okay. Do you want a reserved seat or a non-reserved seat?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 對號座。下一班車幾點開？
dialogue.py: duì hào zuò. xià yī bān chē jǐ diǎn kāi?
dialogue.en: Reserved seat. What time does the next train leave?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 下一班車是三點四十分，那是普快車。
dialogue.py: xià yī bān chē shì sān diǎn sì shí fēn, nà shì pǔ kuài chē.
dialogue.en: The next train is at 3:40; that's a regular express.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 有快一點的車嗎？我有點兒急。
dialogue.py: yǒu kuài yī diǎn de chē ma? wǒ yǒu diǎn r jí.
dialogue.en: Is there a faster train? I'm in a bit of a hurry.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 四點整有一班特快車，大約一個小時就到了。
dialogue.py: sì diǎn zhěng yǒu yī bān tè kuài chē, dà yuē yī gè xiǎo shí jiù dào le.
dialogue.en: There is a super express at 4:00 sharp; it arrives in about an hour.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 那就買四點那一班吧。多少錢？
dialogue.py: nà jiù mǎi sì diǎn nà yī bān ba. duō shǎo qián?
dialogue.en: Then I'll buy the 4:00 one. How much?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 七百五十塊。這是你的票，請拿好。
dialogue.py: qī bǎi wǔ shí kuài. zhè shì nǐ de piào, qǐng ná hǎo.
dialogue.en: 750 dollars. Here is your ticket, please take it.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。請問在幾號月台乘車？
dialogue.py: xiè xie. qǐng wèn zài jǐ hào yuè tái chéng chē?
dialogue.en: Thanks. Which platform do I board at?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 在第二月台。你可以看大廳的電子螢幕。
dialogue.py: zài dì èr yuè tái. nǐ kě yǐ kàn dà tīng de diàn zǐ yíng mù.
dialogue.en: At platform number two. You can look at the electronic screen in the lobby.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的，我知道了。現在可以進站了嗎？
dialogue.py: hǎo de, wǒ zhī dào le. xiàn zài kě yǐ jìn zhàn le ma?
dialogue.en: Okay, I got it. Can I enter the station now?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 可以。祝你旅途愉快！
dialogue.py: kě yǐ. zhù nǐ lǚ tú yú kuài!
dialogue.en: Yes. Wish you a pleasant journey!

key_sentences.en: What time does the next train leave?

vocabulary.meaning: to leave / to start (of a vehicle)

speaking.part_b: Role-play: You are at a train station. Buy two reserved tickets to Taipei. Ask about the fastest train and which platform you need to go to. Confirm the price.
part_c: 你喜歡坐火車旅行嗎？
你覺得這裏的月台容易找嗎？

comprehension.q: Where does Mark want to go?
Does Mark want a reserved or non-reserved seat?
What time does the super express train leave?
How long does the super express take to reach Taichung?
Which platform should Mark go to?

true_false.q: Mark is in a hurry.
The 3:40 train is a super express.
The ticket costs 750 dollars.
Mark can find information on an electronic screen.
Mark cannot enter the station yet.

passage.title: At the Train Station Listening Passage
passage.zh: 你好，我想買一張去台中的票。好的。你要對號座還是自由座？對號座。下一班車幾點開？下一班車是三點四十分，那是普快車。有快一點的車嗎？我有點兒急。四點整有一班特快車，大約一個小時就到了。
passage.en: Mark has arrived at the train station. He needs to buy a ticket to another city. He goes to the ticket window. He asks about the train schedule and platforms. He makes sure he has enough time to catch the train.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Write a travel information card: include destination, departure time, seat type, and platform number (3-5 items).

grammar.explanation: Using '...整 (zhěng)' for 'o'clock sharp'. Time duration with '小時 (xiǎo shí)'. Question structure 'A 還是 B'.
examples: 五點整 (5:00 sharp)
學了一個小時 (Studied for an hour)
你要茶還是咖啡？ (Tea or coffee?)
坐火車 (Take a train)
請拿好 (Please take [it] well/firmly)

practice.q: Complete: 我看了一___鐘頭。 (One hour.)
Complete: 你去台北___台中？ (Taipei or Taichung?)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 糟了，我把票弄丟了！
expansion_dialogue.py: zāo le, wǒ bǎ piào nòng diū le!
expansion_dialogue.en: Oh no, I lost my ticket!

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 別急，你去服務台問問能不能補辦。
expansion_dialogue.py: bié jí, nǐ qù fú wù tái wèn wèn néng bù néng bǔ bàn.
expansion_dialogue.en: Don't panic; go to the service desk and ask if it can be replaced.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 好，我現在就去。車快要開了。
expansion_dialogue.py: hǎo, wǒ xiàn zài jiù qù. chē kuài yào kāi le.
expansion_dialogue.en: Okay, I'll go right now. The train is about to leave.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 快點！我在月台等你。
expansion_dialogue.py: kuài diǎn! wǒ zài yuè tái děng nǐ.
expansion_dialogue.en: Hurry up! I'll wait for you at the platform.

review.speaking: Buy a train ticket and ask for boarding details.
review.writing: Write a travel info card.
review.self_check: Can you buy various types of train tickets and find the correct platform?

title: On the Bus
story_description: A passenger asks where to get off.
story_intro: Mark is sitting on a bus.
He is going to a new place.
He is not sure when to get off.
He asks another passenger for help.
They talk about 'next stop' and 'last stop'.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，請問這路車去美術館嗎？
dialogue.py: bù hǎo yì si, qǐng wèn zhè lù chē qù měi shù guǎn ma?
dialogue.en: Excuse me, does this bus go to the Fine Arts Museum?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 去的。大概還有五六站就到了。
dialogue.py: qù de. dà gài hái yǒu wǔ liù zhàn jiù dào le.
dialogue.en: Yes, it does. Arrives in about five or six more stops.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我應該在哪一站下車？
dialogue.py: tài hǎo le. wǒ yīng gāi zài nǎ yī zhàn xià chē?
dialogue.en: Great. At which stop should I get off?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 你在'中山公園'站下車。那裡離美術館最近。
dialogue.py: nǐ zài 'zhōng shān gōng yuán' zhàn xià chē. nà lǐ lí měi shù guǎn zuì jìn.
dialogue.en: Get off at 'Zhongshan Park' stop. That's closest to the museum.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 下一站是中山公園嗎？
dialogue.py: xià yī zhàn shì zhōng shān gōng yuán ma?
dialogue.en: Is the next stop Zhongshan Park?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 不是，下一站是'火車站'。中山公園是第四站。
dialogue.py: bù shì, xià yī zhàn shì 'huǒ chē zhàn'. zhōng shān gōng yuán shì dì sì zhàn.
dialogue.en: No, the next stop is 'Train Station'. Zhongshan Park is the fourth stop.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的，我知道了。公車上有語音播報嗎？
dialogue.py: hǎo de, wǒ zhī dào le. gōng chē shàng yǒu yǔ yīn bō bào ma?
dialogue.en: Okay, I got it. Is there a voice announcement on the bus?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 有，每一站都會播報站名。你聽清楚就好。
dialogue.py: yǒu, měi yī zhàn dōu huì bō bào zhàn míng. nǐ tīng qīng chu jiù hǎo.
dialogue.en: Yes, it announces the stop name at every stop. Just listen clearly.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 如果不小心坐過站了怎麼辦？
dialogue.py: rú guǒ bù xiǎo xīn zuò guò zhàn le zěn me bàn?
dialogue.en: What if I accidentally miss my stop (go past it)?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 坐過站也沒關係。到下一站下車，再坐反方向的車回來就行。
dialogue.py: zuò guò zhàn yě méi guān xi. dào xià yī zhàn xià chē, zài zuò fǎn fāng xiàng de chē huí lái jiù xíng.
dialogue.en: It's okay if you miss it. Get off at the next stop, and then take the bus in the opposite direction back.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的，非常感謝你的幫助。
dialogue.py: hǎo de, fēi cháng gǎn xiè nǐ de bāng zhù.
dialogue.en: Okay, thank you very much for your help.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 不客氣，慢慢坐吧。
dialogue.py: bù kè qì, màn màn zuò ba.
dialogue.en: You're welcome, enjoy the ride.

key_sentences.en: Does this bus go to the museum?
At which stop to get off?

vocabulary.example: 我剛才睡著了，坐過站了。

speaking.part_b: Role-play: You are on a bus. Ask a passenger if the bus goes to the library. Ask how many stops are left and which specific stop to get off at. React to missing a stop.
part_c: 你坐公車時會玩手機嗎？
你有過坐過站的經歷嗎？

comprehension.q: Where is Mark going on the bus?
How many stops away is the destination roughly?
Which stop is closest to the museum?
Is 'Zhongshan Park' the next stop?
What should Mark do if he misses his stop?
comprehension.a: Get off at the next stop and take the bus in the opposite direction back

true_false.q: The bus does not go to the museum.
The train station is the next stop.
There are no voice announcements on the bus.
Mark is worried about missing his stop.
A is helpful to Mark.

passage.title: On the Bus Listening Passage
passage.zh: 不好意思，請問這路車去美術館嗎？去的。大概還有五六站就到了。太好了。我應該在哪一站下車？你在'中山公園'站下車。那裡離美術館最近。下一站是中山公園嗎？不是，下一站是'火車站'。中山公園是第四站。
passage.en: Mark is sitting on a bus. He is going to a new place. He is not sure when to get off. He asks another passenger for help. They talk about 'next stop' and 'last stop'.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Write a bus route note: include the bus number, starting point, ending point, and 2 important stops in between.

grammar.explanation: Using '...站 (zhàn)' as a measure word for stops. Using '过 (guò)' as a resultative for 'passing/overshooting'. Asking '怎么办 (zěn me bàn)' for solutions.
examples: 還有三站。 (Three more stops.)
坐過站 (Missed the stop)
走過頭 (Walked too far)
那怎麼辦？ (What should we do then?)
反方向 (Opposite direction)

practice.q: Complete: 我坐___站了。 (I missed my stop.)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 下一站停不停？
expansion_dialogue.py: xià yī zhàn tíng bù tíng?
expansion_dialogue.en: Are you stopping at the next stop?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 要停。你要下車的話，請先按鈴。
expansion_dialogue.py: yào tíng. nǐ yào xià chē de huà, qǐng xiān àn líng.
expansion_dialogue.en: Yes. If you want to get off, please press the bell first.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 鈴在哪裡？我看不到。
expansion_dialogue.py: líng zài nǎ lǐ? wǒ kàn bù dào.
expansion_dialogue.en: Where is the bell? I can't see it.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 就在窗戶旁邊，那個紅色的按鈕。
expansion_dialogue.py: jiù zài chuāng hu páng biān, nà gè hóng sè de àn niǔ.
expansion_dialogue.en: Right by the window, that red button.

review.speaking: Ask about bus stops and how to handle overshooting.
review.writing: Write a short bus route note.
review.self_check: Can you ask for stop information and navigate public bus transport?

title: A Rainy Day Problem
story_description: Two friends change their plan because it is raining.
story_intro: Mark and David planned to go to the park.
But suddenly, it starts raining heavily.
They are stuck indoors.
They talk about the weather and their cancelled plans.
They decide to do something else indoors instead.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 看，外面突然下起大雨了。
dialogue.py: kàn, wài miàn tū rán xià qǐ dà yǔ le.
dialogue.en: Look, it suddenly started raining hard outside.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 是啊，剛才還是晴天呢。看來我們去不了公園了。
dialogue.py: shì a, gāng cái hái shì qíng tiān ne. kàn lái wǒ men qù bù liǎo gōng yuán le.
dialogue.en: Yeah, it was just sunny. Looks like we can't go to the park anymore.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 真倒霉！我本來很期待去野餐的。
dialogue.py: zhēn dǎo méi! wǒ běn lái hěn qī dài qù yě cān de.
dialogue.en: So unlucky! I was really looking forward to the picnic.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，下雨天也沒辦法。你帶傘了嗎？
dialogue.py: méi guān xi, xià yǔ tiān yě méi bàn fǎ. nǐ dài sǎn le ma?
dialogue.en: No problem, nothing can be done on a rainy day. Did you bring an umbrella?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 帶了，但是風太大，打傘也沒用。
dialogue.py: dài le, dàn shì fēng tài dà, dǎ sǎn yě méi yòng.
dialogue.en: I did, but the wind is too strong; even an umbrella is useless.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 那我們現在做什麼？一直待在教室裡也很悶。
dialogue.py: nà wǒ men xiàn zài zuò shén me? yī zhí dāi zài jiào shì lǐ yě hěn mèn.
dialogue.en: So what do we do now? Staying in the classroom all the time is also very boring.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 要不我們去逛商場吧？那裡在室內，不會淋雨。
dialogue.py: yào bù wǒ men qù guàng shāng chǎng ba? nà lǐ zài shì nèi, bù huì lín yǔ.
dialogue.en: How about we go wander the shopping mall? It's indoors there, we won't get rained on.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 好主意！商場裡還有電影院，我們可以看場電影。
dialogue.py: hǎo zhǔ yì! shāng chǎng lǐ hái yǒu diàn yǐng yuàn, wǒ men kě yǐ kàn chǎng diàn yǐng.
dialogue.en: Good idea! There's also a cinema in the mall; we can watch a movie.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 太棒了！那我們怎麼去？坐公車還是打車？
dialogue.py: tài bàng le! nà wǒ men zěn me qù? zuò gōng chē hái shì dǎ chē?
dialogue.en: Great! How shall we get there? Take the bus or catch a cab?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 公車站離這裡有點兒遠，還是打車吧，直接到門口。
dialogue.py: gōng chē zhàn lí zhè lǐ yǒu diǎn r yuǎn, hái shì dǎ chē ba, zhí jiē dào mén kǒu.
dialogue.en: The bus stop is a bit far from here; let's catch a cab instead, goes straight to the door.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 行。那我現在用手機叫車。
dialogue.py: xíng. nà wǒ xiàn zài yòng shǒu jī jiào chē.
dialogue.en: Okay. Then I'll call a car with my phone now.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 好，我們在門廳等車吧。
dialogue.py: hǎo, wǒ men zài mén tīng děng chē ba.
dialogue.en: Okay, let's wait for the car in the lobby.

vocabulary.meaning: to get caught in the rain
to take a taxi / call a car
to call for a car (e.g. via app)

speaking.part_b: Role-play: You had a plan to go hiking, but it's raining. Talk to your friend about cancelling the plan. Suggest going to the cinema or staying at home to play games instead.
part_c: 你喜歡下雨天嗎？
下雨天你通常做什麼？

comprehension.q: What was the original plan for the two friends?
comprehension.a: To go to the park (for a picnic)

comprehension.q: Why can't they go to the park now?
comprehension.a: Because it suddenly started raining hard

comprehension.q: Why is Mark's umbrella useless according to him?
comprehension.a: Because the wind is too strong (風太大)

comprehension.q: What indoor activity does Mark suggest?
comprehension.a: Going to the shopping mall (逛商場)

comprehension.q: How do they decide to get to the mall?

true_false.q: It was raining from the beginning.
Mark is very happy about the rain.
The mall has a cinema.
They will wait for the bus outside.
Mark will call a car using his phone.

passage.title: A Rainy Day Problem Listening Passage
passage.zh: 看，外面突然下起大雨了。是啊，剛才還是晴天呢。看來我們去不了公園了。真倒霉！我本來很期待去野餐的。沒關係，下雨天也沒辦法。你帶傘了嗎？帶了，但是風太大，打傘也沒用。那我們現在做什麼？一直待在教室裡也很悶。
passage.en: Mark and David planned to go to the park. But suddenly, it starts raining heavily. They are stuck indoors. They talk about the weather and their cancelled plans. They decide to do something else indoors instead.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Write a rainy-day plan: what will you do instead of your original outdoor plan? (3-5 sentences).

grammar.explanation: Potential complement 'V + 不了' (cannot do). Using '要不 (yào bù)' for 'how about / otherwise'. Adverb '本來 (běn lái)' for original intentions.
examples: 我去不了。 (I can't go.)
要不我們去吃飯吧。 (How about we go eat?)
我本來想睡覺。 (I originally wanted to sleep.)
下起雨來 (Started raining)
淋雨 (Get rained on)

practice.q: Translate: Originally I was at home.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 雨停了嗎？我想出門。
expansion_dialogue.py: yǔ tíng le ma? wǒ xiǎng chū mén.
expansion_dialogue.en: Has the rain stopped? I want to go out.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 還沒停，但是小了一點兒。
expansion_dialogue.py: hái méi tíng, dàn shì xiǎo le yī diǎn r.
expansion_dialogue.en: Not yet, but it's gotten a bit lighter.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 那我再等一會兒吧。
expansion_dialogue.py: nà wǒ zài děng yī huì r ba.
expansion_dialogue.en: Then I'll wait a bit longer.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 好。等雨停了再走，路滑。
expansion_dialogue.py: hǎo. děng yǔ tíng le zài zǒu, lù huá.
expansion_dialogue.en: Okay. Leave when the rain stops; the road is slippery.

review.speaking: Change a plan politely because of the weather.
review.writing: Write a short rainy-day plan.
review.self_check: Can you handle a change in plans and suggest alternatives using '要不'?

title: Cleaning My Room
story_description: A parent asks a child to clean their room before going out.
story_intro: The weekend morning has arrived.
Mark's room is very messy.
His mother is not happy about it.
She asks him to clean up before he can go play.
They talk about specific tasks like sweeping and organizing.

dialogue.speaker: Mom
dialogue.zh: 馬克，你看看你的房間，也太亂了吧！
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, nǐ kàn kàn nǐ de fáng jiān, yě tài luàn le ba!
dialogue.en: Mark, look at your room, it's way too messy!

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 媽，我知道了。我等一下再收。
dialogue.py: mā, wǒ zhī dào le. wǒ děng yī xià zài shōu.
dialogue.en: Mom, I know. I'll tidy up later.

dialogue.speaker: Mom
dialogue.zh: 不行！你現在就得收。你下午不是要出去玩嗎？
dialogue.py: bù xíng! nǐ xiàn zài jiù děi shōu. nǐ xià wǔ bù shì yào chū qù wán ma?
dialogue.en: No! You have to tidy up right now. Aren't you going out to play this afternoon?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 對，我要跟大衛去打球。
dialogue.py: duì, wǒ yào gēn dà wèi qù dǎ qiú.
dialogue.en: Yes, I'm going to play ball with David.

dialogue.speaker: Mom
dialogue.zh: 那你在出門前，必須把房間整理乾淨。
dialogue.py: nà nǐ zài chū mén qián, bì xū bǎ fáng jiān zhěng lǐ gān jìng.
dialogue.en: Then before you go out, you must organize your room clean.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好吧。我要做哪些事？
dialogue.py: hǎo ba. wǒ yào zuò nǎ xiē shì?
dialogue.en: Okay then. What things do I need to do?

dialogue.speaker: Mom
dialogue.zh: 先要把衣服疊好，放在櫃子裡。書桌也要收拾一下。
dialogue.py: xiān yào bǎ yī fu dié hǎo, fàng zài guì zi lǐ. shū zhuō yě yào shōu shi yī xià.
dialogue.en: First, you need to fold the clothes well and put them in the closet. The desk also needs to be tidied up.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 还要掃地嗎？
dialogue.py: hái yào sǎo dì ma?
dialogue.en: Do I still need to sweep the floor?

dialogue.speaker: Mom
dialogue.zh: 當然要。地板上有不少灰塵。最後記得倒垃圾。
dialogue.py: dāng rán yào. dì bǎn shàng yǒu bù shǎo huī chén. zuì hòu jì de dào lā jī.
dialogue.en: Of course. There's quite a bit of dust on the floor. Finally, remember to take out the trash.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 这么多事啊！這得花不少時間吧。
dialogue.py: zhè me duō shì a! zhè děi huā bù shǎo shí jiān ba.
dialogue.en: So many things! This will probably take quite a lot of time.

dialogue.speaker: Mom
dialogue.zh: 只要你動作快一點兒，半個小時就能做完。
dialogue.py: zhǐ yào nǐ dòng zuò kuài yī diǎn r, bàn gè xiǎo shí jiù néng zuò wán.
dialogue.en: As long as your movements are a bit faster, you can finish in half an hour.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 行，我現在就開始。完成任務就能出去玩了！
dialogue.py: xíng, wǒ xiàn zài jiù kāi shǐ. wán chéng rèn wu jiù néng chū qù wán le!
dialogue.en: Fine, I'll start right now. Once I complete the mission, I can go out to play!

key_sentences.en: Take quite a lot of time.

speaking.part_b: Role-play: You are a parent. Give commands to your child to clean their room. Mention folding clothes, tidying the desk, and sweeping the floor. Tell them they can't go out until they finish.
part_c: 你喜歡收拾房間嗎？
你覺得做家務累不累？

comprehension.q: What is Mom's opinion of Mark's room?
What does Mark want to do in the afternoon?
What is the condition for Mark being able to go out?
comprehension.a: He must clean/organize his room first

comprehension.q: What two things should Mark do with his clothes?
comprehension.a: Fold them and put them in the closet

comprehension.q: How long does Mom estimate the cleaning will take?
comprehension.a: Half an hour (if he moves fast)

true_false.q: Mark is happy to clean right away.
Mark needs to sweep the floor.
There is no dust on the floor.
Mark needs to take out the trash at the end.
Mark starts cleaning immediately after talking to Mom.

passage.title: Cleaning My Room Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克，你看看你的房間，也太亂了吧！媽，我知道了。我等一下再收。不行！你現在就得收。你下午不是要出去玩嗎？對，我要跟大衛去打球。那你在出門前，必須把房間整理乾淨。好吧。我要做哪些事？
passage.en: The weekend morning has arrived. Mark's room is very messy. His mother is not happy about it. She asks him to clean up before he can go play. They talk about specific tasks like sweeping and organizing.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Write a chore list for your weekend: include at least 5 tasks using '把' structure if possible.

grammar.explanation: Using '把 (bǎ)' structure to describe actions on objects. Using '...前 (qián)' for 'before ...'. Using '得 (děi)' for necessity.
examples: 把衣服疊好。 (Fold the clothes well.)
把地掃乾淨。 (Sweep the floor clean.)
出門前 (Before going out)
我得工作。 (I have to work.)
花時間 (Spend time)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你洗完碗了嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ xǐ wán wǎn le ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: Have you finished washing the dishes?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 還沒，還有兩個鍋子沒洗。
expansion_dialogue.py: hái méi, hái yǒu liǎng gè guō zi méi xǐ.
expansion_dialogue.en: Not yet, there are still two pots unwashed.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 快點洗吧，洗完我們去散步。
expansion_dialogue.py: kuài diǎn xǐ ba, xǐ wán wǒ men qù sàn bù.
expansion_dialogue.en: Wash them quickly; let's go for a walk after you finish.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 好，我馬上就好。
expansion_dialogue.py: hǎo, wǒ mǎ shàng jiù hǎo.
expansion_dialogue.en: Okay, I'll be done immediately.

review.speaking: List 3 chores you do at home.
review.writing: Write a chore list.
review.self_check: Can you give and understand commands for household tasks using '把'?

title: Review Story: A Busy Weekend
story_description: A learner shops, eats out, travels by bus, gets sick, and changes plans.
story_intro: Mark has had a very busy weekend.
He did many things in the city.
He wrote a diary entry about his experiences.
He mentions shopping, eating, transport, and health.
He reflects on his progress in Stage 2.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 五月十九號，星期日，晴轉多雲。
dialogue.py: wǔ yuè shí jiǔ hào, xīng qī rì, qíng zhuǎn duō yún.
dialogue.en: May 19th, Sunday, sunny turning cloudy.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 這個週末我過得非常充實，但也有一點兒累。
dialogue.py: zhè ge zhōu mò wǒ guò de fēi cháng chōng shí, dàn yě yǒu yī diǎn r lèi.
dialogue.en: I had a very productive weekend, but also a bit tired.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 昨天上午，我先去便利商店買了點零食和水。
dialogue.py: zuó tiān shàng wǔ, wǒ xiān qù biàn lì shāng diàn mǎi le diǎn líng shí hé shuǐ.
dialogue.en: Yesterday morning, I first went to the convenience store to buy some snacks and water.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 然後我坐公車去火車站接父母。公車差點誤點，真緊張。
dialogue.py: rán hòu wǒ zuò gōng chē qù huǒ chē zhàn jiē fù mǔ. gōng chē chà diǎn wù diǎn, zhēn jǐn zhāng.
dialogue.en: Then I took the bus to the train station to pick up my parents. The bus almost was delayed; so nervous.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 中午我們去了一家有名的餐廳，點了紅燒肉和清蒸魚。
dialogue.py: zhōng wǔ wǒ men qù le yī jiā yǒu míng de cān tīng, diǎn le hóng shāo ròu hé qīng zhēng yú.
dialogue.en: At noon we went to a famous restaurant and ordered braised pork and steamed fish.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 爸爸覺得菜有點兒辣，但他很喜歡那個味道。
dialogue.py: bà ba jué de cài yǒu diǎn r là, dàn tā hěn xǐ huan nà gè wèi dào.
dialogue.en: Dad thought the dishes were a bit spicy, but he liked the taste very much.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 下午突然下大雨了，我們只好打車去逛百貨公司。
dialogue.py: xià wǔ tū rán xià dà yǔ le, wǒ men zhǐ hǎo dǎ chē qù guàng bǎi huò gōng sī.
dialogue.en: In the afternoon it suddenly rained hard, so we had to take a taxi to browse the department store.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 晚上我覺得肚子有點兒疼，可能是吃壞東西了。
dialogue.py: wǎn shang wǒ jué de dù zi yǒu diǎn r téng, kě néng shì chī huài dōng xi le.
dialogue.en: At night my stomach hurt a bit; maybe I ate something bad.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我吃了一粒感冒藥，早早就睡了。今天早上感覺舒服多了。
dialogue.py: wǒ chī le yī lì gǎn mào yào, zǎo zǎo jiù shuì le. jīn tiān zǎo shang gǎn jué shū fu duō le.
dialogue.en: I took a cold pill and went to sleep early. This morning I feel much better.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我現在學會了怎麼訂餐、買票和問路。
dialogue.py: wǒ xiàn zài xué huì le zěn me dìng cān, mǎi piào hé wèn lù.
dialogue.en: I've now learned how to order meals, buy tickets, and ask for directions.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 中文真的很有用。下個週末我打算去台中旅遊。
dialogue.py: zhōng wén zhēn de hěn yǒu yòng. xià gè zhōu mò wǒ dǎ suàn qù tái zhōng lǚ yóu.
dialogue.en: Chinese is really useful. Next weekend I plan to go to Taichung to travel.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 加油，馬克！你可以的。
dialogue.py: jiā yóu, mǎ kè! nǐ kě yǐ de.
dialogue.en: Keep it up, Mark! You can do it.

vocabulary.meaning: to be forced to / have to

speaking.part_b: Role-play: Tell a friend about your busy weekend. Mention picking someone up, a weather problem that forced you to change plans, and how you feel now. Use '只好' and '感覺'.
part_c: 你覺得學習中文有用嗎？
你下個週末打算做什麼？

comprehension.q: How was Mark's weekend according to his diary?
Why was Mark nervous at the train station?
comprehension.a: The bus almost delayed his pickup of his parents

comprehension.q: What dishes did they eat at the restaurant?
Why did they go to the department store by taxi?
How does Mark feel today?

true_false.q: Mark went to the convenience store yesterday morning.
Mark's dad hated the spicy food.
It was raining all day long.
Mark took a pill before sleeping.
Mark plans to go to Taichung next weekend.

passage.title: Review Story: A Busy Weekend Listening Passage
passage.zh: 五月十九號，星期日，晴轉多雲。這個週末我過得非常充實，但也有一點兒累。昨天上午，我先去便利商店買了點零食和水。然後我坐公車去火車站接父母。公車差點誤點，真緊張。中午我們去了一家有名的餐廳，點了紅燒肉和清蒸魚。爸爸覺得菜有點兒辣，但他很喜歡那個味道。
passage.en: Mark has had a very busy weekend. He did many things in the city. He wrote a diary entry about his experiences. He mentions shopping, eating, transport, and health. He reflects on his progress in Stage 2.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Write a short story about your busy weekend (70-100 words): include shopping, transport, eating, and your future plans.

grammar.explanation: Review: '只好' (had to), '差点' (almost), '...转...' (weather transition), '早早' (early - emphasis).
examples: 我只好去。 (I have to go [no choice].)
我差點忘了。 (I almost forgot.)
晴轉多雲 (Sunny to cloudy)
早早出發 (Set off very early)
有用 (Useful)

practice.q: Translate: I had to walk home.
Complete: 我___點遲到了。 (I almost arrived late.)
Complete: 他___早就走了。 (He left very early.)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你的週末計劃是什麼？
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ de zhōu mò jì huà shì shén me?
expansion_dialogue.en: What is your weekend plan?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 我本來想去爬山，但天氣預報說會下雨。
expansion_dialogue.py: wǒ běn lái xiǎng qù pá shān, dàn tiān qì yù bào shuō huì xià yǔ.
expansion_dialogue.en: I originally wanted to go hiking, but the forecast says it will rain.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 那真可惜。你要換個計劃嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: nà zhēn kě xī. nǐ yào huàn gè jì huà ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: That's a pity. Are you going to change plans?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 對，我打算去參觀新開的博物館。
expansion_dialogue.py: duì, wǒ dǎ suàn qù cān guān xīn kāi de bó wù guǎn.
expansion_dialogue.en: Yes, I plan to visit the newly opened museum.

review.speaking: Describe a busy weekend experience.
review.writing: Write a 70-word story about your weekend.
review.self_check: Can you summarize a variety of daily activities and situations in Chinese?

title: Yesterday Was Busy
story_description: 兩位同學在聊昨天做了什麼。馬克昨天非常忙，做了很多事情。
story_intro: 今天是星期一。
馬克和大衛在學校見面。
大衛問馬克昨天過得怎麼樣。
馬克告訴大衛他昨天做了很多事情。
他們練習使用過去的時間表達。

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 馬克，早安！你昨天過得怎麼樣？
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, zǎo ān! nǐ zuó tiān guò de zěn me yàng?
dialogue.en: Mark, morning! How was your yesterday?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 早安，大衛。我昨天真的非常忙。
dialogue.py: zǎo ān, dà wèi. wǒ zuó tiān zhēn de fēi cháng máng.
dialogue.en: Morning, David. I was really very busy yesterday.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 是嗎？你昨天都做了些什麼？
dialogue.py: shì ma? nǐ zuó tiān dōu zuò le xiē shén me?
dialogue.en: Really? What did you do all day yesterday?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我早上七點就起床了，先去公園跑了一個小時步。
dialogue.py: wǒ zǎo shang qī diǎn jiù qǐ chuáng le, xiān qù gōng yuán pǎo le yī gè xiǎo shí bù.
dialogue.en: I got up at 7:00, and first went to the park for an hour run.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 那麼早！運動以後呢？
dialogue.py: nà me zǎo! yùn dòng yǐ hòu ne?
dialogue.en: So early! What about after exercising?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 運動以後，我回家吃了早飯，然後去圖書館寫功課。
dialogue.py: yùn dòng yǐ hòu, wǒ huí jiā chī le zǎo fàn, rán hòu qù tú shū guǎn xiě gōng kè.
dialogue.en: After exercising, I went home and ate breakfast, then went to the library to do homework.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 你在圖書館待了多久？
dialogue.py: nǐ zài tú shū guǎn dāi le duō jiǔ?
dialogue.en: How long did you stay at the library?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我從上午十點一直待到下午三點。
dialogue.py: wǒ cóng shàng wǔ shí diǎn yī zhí dāi dào xià wǔ sān diǎn.
dialogue.en: I stayed from 10:00 AM all the way until 3:00 PM.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 哇，那在那裡待了五個小時啊！
dialogue.py: wa, nà zài nà lǐ dāi le wǔ gè xiǎo shí a!
dialogue.en: Wow, you stayed there for five hours!

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 對，功課很多。後來，我還去超市買了一些生活用品。
dialogue.py: duì, gōng kè hěn duō. hòu lái, wǒ hái qù chāo shì mǎi le yī xiē shēng huó yòng pǐn.
dialogue.en: Yes, lots of homework. Later, I also went to the supermarket to buy some daily necessities.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 晚上呢？你休息了嗎？
dialogue.py: wǎn shang ne? nǐ xiū xi le ma?
dialogue.en: What about the evening? Did you rest?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 晚上我和朋友一起吃了晚飯，然後看了一部電影。
dialogue.py: wǎn shang wǒ hé péng you yī qǐ chī le wǎn fàn, rán hòu kàn le yī bù diàn yǐng.
dialogue.en: In the evening I ate dinner with a friend, then watched a movie.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 難怪你今天看起來有點兒累。
dialogue.py: nán guài nǐ jīn tiān kàn qǐ lái yǒu diǎn r lèi.
dialogue.en: No wonder you look a bit tired today.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 是啊，我昨晚十一點半才睡覺。你呢？你昨天做了什麼？
dialogue.py: shì a, wǒ zuó wǎn shí yī diǎn bàn cái shuì jiào. nǐ ne? nǐ zuó tiān zuò le shén me?
dialogue.en: Yeah, I didn't sleep until 11:30 last night. How about you? What did you do?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 我昨天在家休息了一整天，哪兒也沒去。
dialogue.py: wǒ zuó tiān zài jiā xiū xi le yī zhěng tiān, nǎ r yě méi qù.
dialogue.en: I rested at home all day yesterday and didn't go anywhere.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 真羨慕你！我也想好好休息一下。
dialogue.py: zhēn xiàn mù nǐ! wǒ yě xiǎng hǎo hǎo xiū xi yī xià.
dialogue.en: I envy you! I want to have a good rest too.

key_sentences.zh: 我從上午十點一直待到下午三點。
key_sentences.en: I stayed from 10 AM until 3 PM.
No wonder you look tired today.

speaking.part_b: Role-play: 問你的朋友昨天做了什麼。他告訴你他去爬山了，你表示羨慕並問他待了多久。

passage.title: Yesterday Was Busy Listening Passage
passage.zh: 今天是星期一。馬克和大衛在學校見面。大衛問馬克昨天過得怎麼樣。馬克告訴大衛他昨天做了很多事情。他們練習使用過去的時間表達。
passage.en: Mark, morning! How was your yesterday? Morning, David. I was really very busy yesterday. Really? What did you do all day yesterday? I got up at 7:00, and first went to the park for an hour run. So early! What about after exercising? After exercising, I went home and ate breakfast, then went to the library to do homework.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫 3 到 5 句話描述你昨天的生活。包含你幾點起床、做了哪些重要的事情，以及你的感覺。

grammar.explanation: 使用 '了' 表示動作完成。時間長度放在動詞後面。'才' 用於強調動作發生得晚或費時。
examples: 我跑了一個小時步。 (I ran for an hour.)
我看了一部電影。 (I watched a movie.)
他十點才來。 (He didn't come until 10.)
待了多久？ (How long did you stay?)
一整天 (A whole day)

expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ zuó tiān qù nǎ r wán le?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B

title: My Last Weekend
story_description: 馬克向朋友描述他上週末的旅行。他去了海邊，經歷了有趣的事情。
story_intro: 上週末馬克去旅行了。
他剛回到學校。
他告訴朋友大衛他的旅行經歷。
他談到了天氣、活動和食物。
他們練習使用順序詞：先、然後、最後。

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 馬克，歡迎回來！聽說你上週末去海邊了？
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, huān yíng huí lái! tīng shuō nǐ shàng zhōu mò qù hǎi biān le?
dialogue.en: Mark, welcome back! I heard you went to the seaside last weekend?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 對，我和幾個朋友去了墾丁。那裡真的太美了！
dialogue.py: duì, wǒ hé jǐ gè péng you qù le kěn dīng. nà lǐ zhēn de tài měi le!
dialogue.en: Yes, a few friends and I went to Kenting. It was really so beautiful there!

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 墾丁？那很遠吧。你們在那裡做了什麼？
dialogue.py: kěn dīng? nà hěn yuǎn ba. nǐ men zài nà lǐ zuò le shén me?
dialogue.en: Kenting? That's quite far. What did you do there?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我們先在海灘上曬太陽，然後去潛水看魚。
dialogue.py: wǒ men xiān zài hǎi tān shàng shài tài yáng, rán hòu qù qián shuǐ kàn yú.
dialogue.en: We first sunbathed on the beach, then went diving to see the fish.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 潛水？好玩嗎？我一直想試試。
dialogue.py: qián shuǐ? hǎo wán ma? wǒ yī zhí xiǎng shì shi.
dialogue.en: Diving? Was it fun? I've always wanted to try.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 非常好玩！水很清澈，能看見很多五顏六色的魚。
dialogue.py: fēi cháng hǎo wán! shuǐ hěn qīng chè, néng kàn jiàn hěn duō wǔ yán liù sè de yú.
dialogue.en: Extremely fun! The water was very clear, and we could see many colorful fish.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 太棒了。你們晚餐吃了什麼？海鮮嗎？
dialogue.py: tài bàng le. nǐ men wǎn cān chī le shén me? hǎi xiān ma?
dialogue.en: Great. What did you eat for dinner? Seafood?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 對，我們去夜市吃了很多海鮮，最後還喝了當地的特色果汁。
dialogue.py: duì, wǒ men qù yè shì chī le hěn duō hǎi xiān, zuì hòu hái hē le dāng dì de tè sè guǒ zhī.
dialogue.en: Yes, we went to the night market and ate lots of seafood, and finally drank the local specialty juice.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 聽起來是一個完美的週末。你拍照片了嗎？
dialogue.py: tīng qǐ lái shì yī gè wán měi de zhōu mò. nǐ pāi zhào piàn le ma?
dialogue.en: Sounds like a perfect weekend. Did you take photos?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 拍了很多！等一下我發給你看看。
dialogue.py: pāi le hěn duō! děng yī xià wǒ fā gěi nǐ kàn kàn.
dialogue.en: Took a lot! I'll send them to you in a bit to take a look.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 好。不過墾丁太陽很大，你有沒有曬傷？
dialogue.py: hǎo. bù guò kěn dīng tài yáng hěn dà, nǐ yǒu méi yǒu shài shāng?
dialogue.en: Okay. But the sun is strong in Kenting, did you get sunburned?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 有一點兒。雖然塗了防曬油，但還是曬黑了。
dialogue.py: yǒu yī diǎn r. suī rán tú le fáng shài yóu, dàn shì hái shì shài hēi le.
dialogue.en: A little bit. Although I applied sunscreen, I still got tanned.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 曬黑一點兒看起來更健康。
dialogue.py: shài hēi yī diǎn r kàn qǐ lái gèng jiàn kāng.
dialogue.en: Getting a bit tanned makes you look healthier.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我也這麼想。下次我們一起去吧！
dialogue.py: wǒ yě zhè me xiǎng. xià cì wǒ men yī qǐ qù ba!
dialogue.en: I think so too. Let's go together next time!

key_sentences.en: I'll send [them] to you to see.

vocabulary.example: 花園裡開滿了五顏六色的花。

passage.title: My Last Weekend Listening Passage
passage.zh: 上週末馬克去旅行了。他剛回到學校。他告訴朋友大衛他的旅行經歷。他談到了天氣、活動和食物。他們練習使用順序詞：先、然後、最後。
passage.en: Mark, welcome back! I heard you went to the seaside last weekend? Yes, a few friends and I went to Kenting. It was really so beautiful there! Kenting? That's quite far. What did you do there? We first sunbathed on the beach, then went diving to see the fish. Diving? Was it fun? I've always wanted to try. Extremely fun! The water was very clear, and we could see many colorful fish.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

grammar.explanation: 使用順序詞 '先 (xiān)'、'然後 (rán hòu)'、'最後 (zuì hòu)'。使用 '雖然 (suī rán)...但是 (dàn shì)...' 表轉折。
examples: 我先吃飯，然後看電視。 (I first eat, then watch TV.)
雖然下雨，但我還是去了。 (Although it rained, I still went.)
拍了照片 (Took photos)

expansion_dialogue.zh: 你的假期過得怎麼樣？
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ de jià qī guò de zěn me yàng?
expansion_dialogue.en: How was your vacation?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 過得很愉快。我去了日本，玩了十天。
expansion_dialogue.py: guò de hěn yú kuài. wǒ qù le rì běn, wán le shí tiān.
expansion_dialogue.en: Very pleasant. I went to Japan and played for ten days.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A

expansion_dialogue.py: wa, nà yī dìng hěn yǒu qù. nǐ mǎi le hěn duō dōng xi ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: Wow, that must have been interesting. Did you buy a lot of things?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B

expansion_dialogue.py: duì, mǎi le hěn duō dāng dì de xiǎo chī hé jì niàn pǐn.
expansion_dialogue.en: Yes, bought lots of local snacks and souvenirs.

title: I Forgot My Homework
story_description: 馬克忘記帶作業了。他向老師解釋原因並誠懇道歉。
story_intro: 現在是中文課。
老師正在收大家的作業。
馬克發現他忘記帶作業了。
他感到很抱歉，並向老師說明情況。
他們練習使用道歉和承諾的表達。

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 各位同學，請把昨天的作業交上來。
dialogue.py: gè wèi tóng xué, qǐng bǎ zuó tiān de zuò yè jiāo shàng lái.
dialogue.en: Class, please hand in yesterday's homework.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: （小聲地）糟糕，我的作業呢？
dialogue.py: (xiǎo shēng de) zāo gāo, wǒ de zuò yè ne?
dialogue.en: (Softly) Oh no, where is my homework?

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 馬克，你的作業在哪裡？大家都交了。
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, nǐ de zuò yè zài nǎ lǐ? dà jiā dōu jiāo le.
dialogue.en: Mark, where is your homework? Everyone else has handed theirs in.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 老師，非常抱歉。我忘記帶了。
dialogue.py: lǎo shī, fēi cháng bào qiàn. wǒ wàng jì dài le.
dialogue.en: Teacher, I'm very sorry. I forgot to bring it.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 忘記帶了？你做了嗎？
dialogue.py: wàng jì dài le? nǐ zuò le ma?
dialogue.en: Forgot to bring it? Did you do it?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我真的做了。但我今早出門太急，把它留在書桌上了。
dialogue.py: wǒ zhēn de zuò le. dàn wǒ jīn zǎo chū mén tài jí, bǎ tā liú zài shū zhuō shàng le.
dialogue.en: I really did it. But I was in such a hurry leaving this morning, I left it on my desk.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 這已經是本學期第二次了。你應該更細心一點。
dialogue.py: zhè yǐ jīng shì běn xué qī dì èr cì le. nǐ yīng gāi gèng xì xīn yī diǎn.
dialogue.en: This is already the second time this semester. You should be a bit more careful.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我知道。對不起，我保證下次不會再犯了。
dialogue.py: wǒ zhī dào. duì bù qǐ, wǒ bǎo zhèng xià cì bù huì zài fàn le.
dialogue.en: I know. I'm sorry; I promise I won't do it again next time.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 那你打算怎麼辦？這份作業今天必須交。
dialogue.py: nà nǐ dǎ suàn zěn me bàn? zhè fèn zuò yè jīn tiān bì xū jiāo.
dialogue.en: So what do you plan to do? This assignment must be handed in today.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我下課後馬上回宿舍拿，下午三點前交給您，可以嗎？
dialogue.py: wǒ xià kè hòu mǎ shàng huí sù shè ná, xià wǔ sān diǎn qián jiāo gěi nín, kě yǐ ma?
dialogue.en: I'll go back to the dorm to get it immediately after class and give it to you before 3:00 PM; is that okay?

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 好吧。既然你保證了，我就再給你一次機會。
dialogue.py: hǎo ba. jì rán nǐ bǎo zhèng le, wǒ jiù zài gěi nǐ yī cì jī huì.
dialogue.en: Okay then. Since you promised, I'll give you one more chance.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝老師！我一定會準時交的。
dialogue.py: xiè xie lǎo shī! wǒ yī dìng huì zhǔn shí jiāo de.
dialogue.en: Thank you, teacher! I will definitely hand it in on time.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 記住，態度比分數更重要。
dialogue.py: jì zhù, tài dù bǐ fēn shù gèng zhòng yào.
dialogue.en: Remember, attitude is more important than grades.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 明白了，我會記住的。
dialogue.py: míng bai le, wǒ huì jì zhù de.
dialogue.en: Understood, I'll keep that in mind.

key_sentences.en: Promise not to repeat next time.
Attitude is more important than grades.

vocabulary.example: 在圖書館要小聲地說話。
希望你不要再犯同樣的錯誤。

passage.title: I Forgot My Homework Listening Passage
passage.zh: 現在是中文課。老師正在收大家的作業。馬克發現他忘記帶作業了。他感到很抱歉，並向老師說明情況。他們練習使用道歉和承諾的表達。
passage.en: Class, please hand in yesterday's homework. (Softly) Oh no, where is my homework? Mark, where is your homework? Everyone else has handed theirs in. Teacher, I'm very sorry. writing: 請寫一封簡短的道歉信給老師或朋友。說明你忘記了什麼、原因是什麼，以及你打算怎麼補救（40 到 60 個字）。

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
