title: Living in a Dormitory
story_description: 馬克搬進了學校宿舍。他和室友大衛討論宿舍的規矩、公共設施以及如何保持環境整潔。
story_intro: 馬克第一天住進學校宿舍。
大衛是他的學長，也是室友。
宿舍的空間雖然不大，但很乾淨。
大衛向馬克介紹宿舍的公共規定。
他們約定好如何分擔衛生工作。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 大衛，這是我第一次住校，有很多地方還不習慣。
dialogue.py: dà wèi, zhè shì wǒ dì yī cì zhù xiào, yǒu hěn duō dì fang hái bù xí guàn.
dialogue.en: David, this is my first time living on campus; there are many things I'm not used to yet.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，慢慢來。宿舍生活很有趣，但也需要互相體諒。
dialogue.py: méi guān xi, màn màn lái. sù shè shēng huó hěn yǒu qù, dàn yě xū yào hù xiāng tǐ liàng.
dialogue.en: No problem; take your time. Dorm life is fun, but it also requires mutual understanding.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 請問宿舍有哪些規定？比如熄燈時間或者訪客規定？
dialogue.py: qǐng wèn sù shè yǒu nǎ xiē guī dìng? bǐ rú xī dēng shí jiān huò zhě fǎng kè guī dìng?
dialogue.en: What are the dorm rules? Like lights-out time or visitor rules?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 我們宿舍十一點半熄燈，之後要保持安靜。訪客必須在晚上十點前離開。
dialogue.py: wǒ men sù shè shí yī diǎn bàn xī dēng, zhī hòu yào bǎo chí ān jìng. fǎng kè bì xū zài wǎn shang shí diǎn qián lí kāi.
dialogue.en: Lights out in our dorm is at 11:30 PM; after that, keep quiet. Visitors must leave before 10:00 PM.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 那洗衣服和烘乾機在哪裡？
dialogue.py: nà xǐ yī fu hé hōng gān jī zài nǎ lǐ?
dialogue.en: And where are the laundry and dryers?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 每層樓的盡頭都有洗衣房。投幣式洗衣機一次三十塊，烘乾機也是三十塊。
dialogue.py: měi céng lóu de jìn tóu dōu yǒu xǐ yī fáng. tóu bì shì xǐ yī jī yī cì sān shí kuài, hōng gān jī yě shì sān shí kuài.
dialogue.en: There's a laundry room at the end of every floor. Coin-operated washing machines are 30 dollars a time; dryers are also 30.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 公共廚房可以用嗎？我想偶爾煮點麵。
dialogue.py: gōng gòng chú fáng kě yǐ yòng ma? wǒ xiǎng ǒu ěr zhǔ diǎn miàn.
dialogue.en: Can the public kitchen be used? I want to cook noodles occasionally.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 可以用，但用完一定要收拾乾淨，不能把髒碗筷留在水槽裡。
dialogue.py: kě yǐ yòng, dàn yòng wán yī dìng yào shōu shi gān jìng, bù néng bǎ zāng wǎn kuài liú zài shuǐ cáo lǐ.
dialogue.en: You can, but you must clean up after use; don't leave dirty dishes in the sink.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。關於房間的衛生，我們怎麼分工？
dialogue.py: méi wèn tí. guān yú fáng jiān de wèi shēng, wǒ men zěn me fēn gōng?
dialogue.en: No problem. Regarding the room's hygiene, how do we divide the work?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 我建議每週末大掃除一次。你負責掃地，我負責擦桌子和倒垃圾。
dialogue.py: wǒ jiàn yì měi zhōu mò dà sǎo chú yī cì. nǐ fù zé sǎo dì, wǒ fù zé cā zhuō zi hé dào lā jī.
dialogue.en: I suggest a big clean-up once every weekend. You're responsible for sweeping; I'll handle wiping tables and taking out the trash.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好，這樣很公平。希望能和你相處愉快！
dialogue.py: hǎo, zhè yàng hěn gōng píng. xī wàng néng hé nǐ xiāng chǔ yú kuài!
dialogue.en: Okay, that's very fair. I hope we get along well!

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 一定會的。歡迎成為我們的一員。
dialogue.py: yī dìng huì de. huān yíng chéng wéi wǒ men de yī yuán.
dialogue.en: Definitely. Welcome to the team.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝！
dialogue.py: xiè xie!
dialogue.en: Thanks!

to put out the light / lights out

宿舍什麼時候熄燈？
訪客最晚幾點必須離開？

大掃除時，馬克負責做什麼？

passage.title: Living in a Dormitory Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克第一天住進學校宿舍。大衛是他的學長，也是室友。宿舍的空間雖然不大，但很乾淨。大衛向馬克介紹宿舍的公共規定。他們約定好如何分擔衛生工作。
passage.en: David, this is my first time living on campus; there are many things I'm not used to yet. No problem; take your time. Dorm life is fun, but it also requires mutual understanding. What are the dorm rules? Like lights-out time or visitor rules? Lights out in our dorm is at 11:30 PM; after that, keep quiet. Visitors must leave before 10:00 PM. And where are the laundry and dryers? There's a laundry room at the end of every floor. Coin-operated washing machines are 30 dollars a time; dryers are also 30. Can the public kitchen be used? I want to cook noodles occasionally.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫 3 到 5 句話描述你的室友或理想中的室友。他應該是一個什麼樣的人？你們如何分擔家務？

grammar.explanation: 使用 '互相' 表示雙向動作。'習慣' 既是名詞也是動詞。'用完/做完' 表示動作結束並達到結果。
examples: 我們要互相學習。 (We should learn from each other.)
我習慣早起。 (I'm used to getting up early.)
這是一個好習慣。 (This is a good habit.)
飯吃完了。 (Finished eating.)
收拾乾淨 (Cleaned up clean)

practice.q: Complete: 我不____慣吃辣。 (Not used to...)
Complete: 做____功課後去玩。 (After finishing...)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你的宿舍離教學樓遠嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ de sù shè lí jiào xué lóu yuǎn ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: Is your dorm far from the teaching building?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 挺近的，走路只要五分鐘。你呢？
expansion_dialogue.py: tǐng jìn de, zǒu lù zhǐ yào wǔ fēn zhōng. nǐ ne?
expansion_dialogue.en: Quite close; only five minutes on foot. How about you?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 我住在校外，每天要騎半個小時車。
expansion_dialogue.py: wǒ zhù zài xiào wài, měi tiān yào qí bàn gè xiǎo shí chē.
expansion_dialogue.en: I live off-campus; I have to ride for half an hour every day.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 那挺辛苦的，不過校外住應該更自由一點。
expansion_dialogue.py: nà tǐng xīn kǔ de, bù guò xiào wài zhù yīng gāi gèng zì yóu yī diǎn.
expansion_dialogue.en: That's quite tough, but living off-campus should be a bit more free.

title: Looking for an Apartment
story_description: 馬克想搬出宿舍，在校外租一套公寓。他在房屋中介那裡了解租房信息。
story_intro: 馬克覺得宿舍有點兒吵。
他想找一個更安靜的地方。
他來到了一家房屋中介公司。
他告訴中介他對房子和地段的要求。
中介向他推薦了幾套合適的房源。

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.zh: 下午好！想租房嗎？有什麼具體要求？
dialogue.py: xià wǔ hǎo! xiǎng zū fáng ma? yǒu shén me jù tǐ yāo qiú?
dialogue.en: Good afternoon! Looking to rent? Any specific requirements?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你好。我想在學校附近租一套單人公寓。最好離地鐵站近一點。
dialogue.py: nǐ hǎo. wǒ xiǎng zài xué xiào fù jìn zū yī tào dān rén gōng yù. zuì hǎo lí dì tiě zhàn jìn yī diǎn r.
dialogue.en: Hello. I want to rent a single apartment near the school. Preferably close to the MRT station.

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.zh: 您的租金預算是多少？
dialogue.py: nín de zū jīn yù suàn shì duō shǎo?
dialogue.en: What is your rent budget?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 每個月一萬五千台幣左右。環境要安靜。
dialogue.py: měi gè yuè yī wàn wǔ qiān tái bì zuǒ yòu. huán jìng yào ān jìng.
dialogue.en: Around 15,000 NTD per month. The environment must be quiet.

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。我這裡有兩套房源很符合您的要求。一套是公寓，一套是套房。
dialogue.py: méi wèn tí. wǒ zhè lǐ yǒu liǎng tào fáng yuán hěn fú hé nín de yāo qiú. yī tào shì gōng yù, yī tào shì tào fáng.
dialogue.en: No problem. I have two listings here that match your requirements. One is an apartment, one is a studio suite.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 公寓和套房有什麼區別？
dialogue.py: gōng yù hé tào fáng yǒu shén me qū bié?
dialogue.en: What's the difference between an apartment and a suite?

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.zh: 這套公寓面積大一點，有獨立的廚房和陽台。套房雖然小，但裝修很新。
dialogue.py: zhè tào gōng yù miàn jī dà yī diǎn r, yǒu dú lì de chú fáng hé yáng tái. tào fáng suī rán xiǎo, dàn zhuāng xiū hěn xīn.
dialogue.en: This apartment is a bit larger, with an independent kitchen and balcony. The suite is small, but the renovation is very new.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 那水電費和物業費怎麼算？包括在租金裡嗎？
dialogue.py: nà shuǐ diàn fèi hé wù yè fèi zěn me suàn? bāo kuò zài zū jīn lǐ ma?
dialogue.en: And how are utilities and management fees calculated? Are they included in the rent?

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.zh: 物業費和網路費是包括的。水電費要按照電表讀數另外支付。
dialogue.py: wù yè fèi hé wǎng lù fèi shì bāo kuò de. shuǐ diàn fèi yào àn zhào diàn biǎo dú shù lì wài zhī fù.
dialogue.en: Management and internet fees are included. Utilities are paid separately according to the meter readings.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我可以去看看房子嗎？什麼時候方便？
dialogue.py: wǒ kě yǐ qù kàn kàn fáng zi ma? shén me shí hou fāng biàn?
dialogue.en: Can I go see the places? When is it convenient?

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.zh: 現在就可以。我有鑰匙。我們先去看那套帶陽台的，就在前面那條街。
dialogue.py: xiàn zài jiù kě yǐ. wǒ yǒu yào shi. wǒ men xiān qù kàn nà tào dài yáng tái de, jiù zài qián mian nà tiáo jiē.
dialogue.en: We can go right now. I have the keys. Let's go see the one with the balcony first; it's just on the street ahead.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我們走吧。
dialogue.py: tài hǎo le, wǒ men zǒu ba.
dialogue.en: Great, let's go.

speaking.part_b: Role-play: 你正在跟中介看房子。你覺得房子採光很好，但是廚房太小了。你問中介還有沒有別的房源。中介說明天會有一套新的。

passage.title: Looking for an Apartment Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克覺得宿舍有點兒吵。他想找一個更安靜的地方。他來到了一家房屋中介公司。他告訴中介他對房子和地段的要求。中介向他推薦了幾套合適的房源。

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你這套房子的採光真不錯，陽光很充足。
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ zhè tào fáng zi de cǎi guāng zhēn bù cuò, yáng guāng hěn chōng zú.
expansion_dialogue.en: The lighting in your place is really good; there's plenty of sunlight.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 對，這是朝南的。冬天特別暖和。
expansion_dialogue.py: duì, zhè shì cháo nán de. dōng tiān tè bié nuǎn huo.
expansion_dialogue.en: Yes, it faces south. It's especially warm in winter.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 真羨慕你！我的房間朝北，白天也要開燈。
expansion_dialogue.py: zhēn xiàn mù nǐ! wǒ de fáng jiān cháo běi, bái tiān yě yào kāi dēng.
expansion_dialogue.en: I really envy you! My room faces north; I have to turn on the lights even during the day.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 那確實有點兒壓抑，下次換房一定要選朝南的。
expansion_dialogue.py: nà què shí yǒu diǎn r yā yì, xià cì huàn fáng yī dìng yào xuǎn cháo nán de.
expansion_dialogue.en: That is indeed a bit depressing; next time you move, definitely choose one that faces south.

title: Signing a Lease
story_description: 馬克看中了一套房子，決定租下來。他和房東見面，討論租賃合同的條款並簽字。
story_intro: 馬克對那套帶陽台的房子很滿意。
他決定和房東簽約。
他們約在房屋中介公司見面。
他們仔細查看了合同上的條款。
馬克付了押金和第一個月的租金。

dialogue.speaker: Landlord
dialogue.zh: 馬克先生，很高興你喜歡這套房子。這是我們的租賃合同。
dialogue.py: mǎ kè xiān sheng, hěn gāo xìng nǐ xǐ huan zhè tào fáng zi. zhè shì wǒ men de zū lìn hé tong.
dialogue.en: Mr. Mark, I'm glad you like this apartment. This is our lease contract.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 您好。簽約前，我想確認一下合同期限和付款方式。
dialogue.py: nín hǎo. qiān yuē qián, wǒ xiǎng què rèn yī xià hé tong qī xiàn hé fù kuǎn fāng shì.
dialogue.en: Hello. Before signing, I'd like to confirm the contract term and payment method.

dialogue.speaker: Landlord
dialogue.zh: 合同期限是一年，一年後可以優先續約。租金每個月一號前交。
dialogue.py: hé tong qī xiàn shì yī nián, yī nián hòu kě yǐ yōu xiān xù yuē. zū jīn měi gè yuè yī hào qián jiāo.
dialogue.en: The contract term is one year; after a year, you have priority to renew. Rent is paid before the 1st of each month.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的。押金是多少？退租時怎麼退還？
dialogue.py: hǎo de. yā jīn shì duō shǎo? tuì zū shí zěn me tuì huán?
dialogue.en: Okay. How much is the security deposit? How is it returned when I move out?

dialogue.speaker: Landlord
dialogue.zh: 押金是兩個月的租金。如果您沒有損壞家具且沒有欠費，退租時會全額退還。
dialogue.py: yā jīn shì liǎng gè yuè de zū jīn. rú guǒ nín méi yǒu sǔn huài jiā jù qiě méi yǒu qiàn fèi, tuì zū shí huì quán é tuì huán.
dialogue.en: The deposit is two months' rent. If you haven't damaged furniture and have no unpaid bills, it'll be fully refunded at checkout.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 明白。合同上寫著租客不能擅自改變房屋結構，是嗎？
dialogue.py: míng bai. hé tong shàng xiě zhe zū kè bù néng shàn zì gǎi biàn fáng wū jié gòu, shì ma?
dialogue.en: Understood. It says in the contract that tenants cannot change the house structure without authorization, right?

dialogue.speaker: Landlord
dialogue.zh: 對，如果要刷漆或者改動線路，必須提前徵得我的同意。
dialogue.py: duì, rú guǒ yào shuā qī huò zhě gǎi dòng xiàn lù, bì xū tí qián zhēng dé wǒ de tóng yì.
dialogue.en: Yes; if you want to paint or change circuits, you must obtain my consent in advance.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。另外，如果電器自然損壞了，誰負責修理？
dialogue.py: méi wèn tí. lìng wài, rú guǒ diàn qì zì rán sǔn huài le, shéi fù zé xiū lǐ?
dialogue.en: No problem. Additionally, if appliances fail naturally, who is responsible for repairs?

dialogue.speaker: Landlord
dialogue.zh: 如果是電器老化，由房東負責維修。但如果是人為弄壞的，就要由您負責了。
dialogue.py: rú guǒ shì diàn qì lǎo huà, yóu fáng dōng fù zé wéi xiū. dàn rú guǒ shì rén wéi nòng huài de, jiù yào yóu nín fù zé le.
dialogue.en: If it's appliance aging, the landlord handles the maintenance. But if it's man-made, you'll be responsible.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的。我都看清楚了。我在這裡簽名，對吧？
dialogue.py: hǎo de. wǒ dōu kàn qīng chu le. wǒ zài zhè lǐ qiān míng, duì ba?
dialogue.en: Okay. I've read it all clearly. I sign here, right?

dialogue.speaker: Landlord
dialogue.zh: 對。簽好後，請付一下押金和首月租金。這是鑰匙。
dialogue.py: duì. qiān hǎo hòu, qǐng fù yī xià yā jīn hé shǒu yuè zū jīn. zhè shì yào shi.
dialogue.en: Yes. After signing, please pay the deposit and first month's rent. Here are the keys.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的，錢已經轉帳過去了。謝謝！
dialogue.py: hǎo de, qián yǐ jīng zhuǎn zhàng guò qù le. xiè xie!
dialogue.en: Okay, the money has already been transferred. Thanks!

speaking.part_b: Role-play: 你想和房東續約，但是希望房東能降一點兒租金。房東說最近房價漲了，不能降，但是可以幫你換一個新的冰箱。你接受了。
part_c: 你簽合同前會仔細看條款嗎？
你覺得押金收兩個月合不合理？

comprehension.q: 這份租賃合同的期限是多久？
租金應該在每個月的什麼時候交？
押金是多少個月的租金？
誰負責修理老化損壞的電器？
馬克是通過什麼方式付錢的？

true_false.q: 一年後馬克可以優先續約。
如果家具弄壞了，押金不能全額退還。
馬克可以隨便刷牆壁的顏色。
馬克還沒有拿到房子的鑰匙。
房東同意提前徵得同意後可以改動線路。

passage.title: Signing a Lease Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克對那套帶陽台的房子很滿意。他決定和房東簽約。他們約在房屋中介公司見面。他們仔細查看了合同上的條款。馬克付了押金和第一個月的租金。
passage.en: Mr. Mark, I'm glad you like this apartment. This is our lease contract. Hello. Before signing, I'd like to confirm the contract term and payment method. The contract term is one year; after a year, you have priority to renew. Rent is paid before the 1st of each month. Okay. How much is the security deposit? How is it returned when I move out? The deposit is two months' rent. If you haven't damaged furniture and have no unpaid bills, it'll be fully refunded at checkout. Understood. It says in the contract that tenants cannot change the house structure without authorization, right? Yes; if you want to paint or change circuits, you must obtain my consent in advance.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫 3 到 5 句話總結這份租約的重要條款：租期、租金交付日期以及關於押金的規定。

grammar.explanation: 使用 '由...負責' 明確責任。'擅自' 表達否定性的隨意。'欠' 作為動詞表欠款。
examples: 由我來開會。 (I will be responsible for the meeting.)
禁止擅自停車。 (Unauthorized parking is prohibited.)
他欠我十塊錢。 (He owes me 10 dollars.)
優先續約 (Priority renewal)
轉帳成功 (Transfer successful)

practice.q: Complete: 禁止擅____拍照。 (Prohibited without authorization...)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 這份合同上有你的親筆簽名嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: zhè fèn hé tong shàng yǒu nǐ de qīn bǐ qiān míng ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: Does this contract have your handwritten signature?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 有的，就在最後一頁右下角。
expansion_dialogue.py: yǒu de, jiù zài zuì hòu yī yè yòu xià jiǎo.
expansion_dialogue.en: Yes, right at the bottom right corner of the last page.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 法律效力是從簽名那天開始算嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: fǎ lǜ xiào lì shì cóng qiān míng nà tiān kāi shǐ suàn ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: Does the legal validity start counting from the day of signing?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 對，簽字蓋章後，合同就正式生效了。
expansion_dialogue.py: duì, qiān zì gài zhāng hòu, hé tong jiù zhèng shì shēng xiào le.
expansion_dialogue.en: Correct; after signing and stamping, the contract officially takes effect.

review.writing: Write a 40-word contract summary.

title: Moving In
story_description: 搬家公司把馬克的行李送到了新家。馬克正忙著拆箱、擺放家具並整理生活空間。
story_intro: 今天是馬克搬家的日子。
貨車停在公寓門口。
搬家工人們幫忙把重物抬進房間。
房間裡到處都是紙箱。
馬克開始一件一件地整理他的東西。

dialogue.speaker: Worker
dialogue.zh: 先生，最後一個大箱子搬進來了。您點一下件數。
dialogue.py: xiān sheng, zuì hòu yī gè dà xiāng zi bān jìn lái le. nín diǎn yī xià jiàn shù.
dialogue.en: Sir, the last large box has been moved in. Please count the number of pieces.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好，我數數。一、二...一共十五件，對了。辛苦你們了！
dialogue.py: hǎo, wǒ shǔ shu. yī, èr... yī gòng shí wǔ jiàn, duì le. xīn kǔ nǐ men le!
dialogue.en: Okay, let me count. One, two... fifteen pieces total, that's right. Thanks for your hard work!

dialogue.speaker: Worker
dialogue.zh: 不客氣。這些家具要放在哪裡？沙發放客廳中間嗎？
dialogue.py: bù kè qì. zhè xiē jiā jù yào fàng zài nǎ lǐ? shā fā fàng kè tīng zhōng jiān ma?
dialogue.en: You're welcome. Where should these furniture items be placed? Sofa in the middle of the living room?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 沙發靠牆放，餐桌放在窗戶旁邊。床幫我抬進臥室吧。
dialogue.py: shā fā kào qiáng fàng, cān zhuō fàng zài chuāng hu páng biān. chuáng bāng wǒ tái jìn wò shì ba.
dialogue.en: Place the sofa against the wall, and the dining table next to the window. Help me lift the bed into the bedroom.

dialogue.speaker: Worker
dialogue.zh: 好的。小心台階。我們這就去放。
dialogue.py: hǎo de. xiǎo xīn tái jiē. wǒ men zhè jiù qù fàng.
dialogue.en: Okay. Watch the steps. We'll go place them now.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: （工人走後）呼，終於搬完了。現在要開始拆箱了。
dialogue.py: (gōng rén zǒu hòu) hū, zhōng yú bān wán le. xiàn zài yào kāi shǐ chāi xiāng le.
dialogue.en: (After workers leave) Phew, finally finished moving. Now I need to start unboxing.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 先把廚具拿出來，晚上要自己做飯。衣服先掛進衣櫃裡。
dialogue.py: xiān bǎ chú jù ná chū lái, wǎn shang yào zì jǐ zuò fàn. yī fu xiān guà jìn yī guì lǐ.
dialogue.en: Get the kitchenware out first; I need to cook for myself tonight. Hang the clothes in the wardrobe first.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 對了，還得檢查一下水電。水龍頭有水，電燈也亮。
dialogue.py: duì le, hái děi jiǎn chá yī xià shuǐ diàn. shuǐ lóng tóu yǒu shuǐ, diàn dēng yě liàng.
dialogue.en: By the way, still need to check the utilities. The faucet has water, and the lights are on.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 空調遙控器在哪裡？啊，在沙發底下的盒子裡。
dialogue.py: kōng tiáo yáo kòng qì zài nǎ lǐ? ā, zài shā fā dǐ xia de hé zi lǐ.
dialogue.en: Where's the AC remote? Ah, in the box under the sofa.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 雖然很累，但看到新家慢慢變得整齊，心裡真高興。
dialogue.py: suī rán hěn lèi, dàn kàn dào xīn jiā màn màn biàn de zhěng qí, xīn lǐ zhēn gāo xìng.
dialogue.en: Although very tired, seeing the new home slowly become tidy makes me really happy.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 明天去超市買點兒生活用品和裝飾品吧。
dialogue.py: míng tiān qù chāo shì mǎi diǎn r shēng huó yòng pǐn hé zhuāng shì pǐn ba.
dialogue.en: Tomorrow I'll go to the supermarket to buy some daily necessities and decorations.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 開始新生活！
dialogue.py: kāi shǐ xīn shēng huó!
dialogue.en: Start a new life!

vocabulary.meaning: to lift / carry (by two or more)

part_c: 你喜歡搬家嗎？為什麼？
搬家時你覺得最麻煩的事情是什麼？

comprehension.q: 馬克明天打算去超市買什麼？

馬克覺得新家慢慢變得整齊很有成就感。
馬克需要工人幫他把床抬進臥室。

passage.zh: 今天是馬克搬家的日子。貨車停在公寓門口。搬家工人們幫忙把重物抬進房間。房間裡到處都是紙箱。馬克開始一件一件地整理他的東西。

You're welcome. Where should these furniture items be placed? Sofa in the middle of the living room? Place the sofa against the wall, and the dining table next to the window. Help me lift the bed into the bedroom. Okay. Watch the steps. We'll go place them now. (After workers leave) Phew, finally finished moving. Now I need to start unboxing. writing: 請寫 3 到 5 句話描述你的一次搬家經歷：你是自己搬還是請公司搬？你花了多久時間整理？

grammar.explanation: 使用 '靠' 表示位置依附。'V + 進去/出來' 的趨向補語。形容詞重疊 '一件一件' 表示逐一。
examples: 靠右行。 (Keep to the right.)
把書拿出來。 (Take out the books.)
一個一個數。 (Count one by one.)
收拾乾淨 (Tidy up clean)
點數 (Count the number)

practice.q: Translate: Count them one by one.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 搬新家了，要請大家來熱鬧熱鬧嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: bān xīn jiā le, yào qǐng dà jiā lái rè nao rè nao ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: Moved to a new home; going to invite everyone over to celebrate (make it lively)?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 好啊！我打算下週辦一個暖房派對，你一定要來。
expansion_dialogue.py: hǎo a! wǒ dǎ suàn xià zhōu bàn yī gè nuǎn fáng pài duì, nǐ yī dìng yào lái.
expansion_dialogue.en: Sure! I plan to hold a housewarming party next week; you must come.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 需要我帶點兒什麼嗎？飲料還是零食？
expansion_dialogue.py: xū yào wǒ dài diǎn r shén me ma? yǐn liào hái shì líng shí?
expansion_dialogue.en: Need me to bring anything? Drinks or snacks?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 帶點兒飲料就好，零食我會準備。人來了最重要！
expansion_dialogue.py: dài diǎn r yǐn liào jiù hǎo, líng shí wǒ huì zhǔn bèi. rén lái le zuì zhòng yào!
expansion_dialogue.en: Just bring some drinks; I'll prepare the snacks. Your presence is what matters most!

title: At the Library
story_description: 馬克在學校圖書館查閱資料。他學習了如何使用圖書館的搜索系統、借書和預約自修室。
story_intro: 圖書館環境非常安靜。
馬克需要寫一份關於中國歷史的報告。
他在電子檢索台查找書籍。
他向圖書管理員諮詢借閱規定。
他在自修室認真學習。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你好，我想查一下關於中國藝術史的書籍。請問在哪裡搜索？
dialogue.py: nǐ hǎo, wǒ xiǎng chá yī xià guān yú zhōng guó yì shù shǐ de shū jí. qǐng wèn zài nǎ lǐ sōu suǒ?
dialogue.en: Hello, I'd like to check for books on Chinese Art History. Where do I search?

dialogue.speaker: Librarian
dialogue.zh: 你可以使用那邊的電子檢索系統。輸入關鍵詞或書名就可以了。
dialogue.py: nǐ kě yǐ yòng nà biān de diàn zǐ jiǎn suǒ xì tǒng. shū rù guān jiàn cí huò shū míng jiù kě yǐ le.
dialogue.en: You can use the electronic retrieval system over there. Just input keywords or the book title.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的，我查到了。這本書顯示'在庫'，它的索書號是 730.5/M2。
dialogue.py: hǎo de, wǒ chá dào le. zhè běn shū xiǎn shì 'zài kù', tā de suǒ shū hào shì qī sān líng diǎn wǔ, M èr.
dialogue.en: Okay, I've found it. The book shows as 'In Stock'; its call number is 730.5/M2.

dialogue.speaker: Librarian
dialogue.zh: 這本書在三樓的社會科學閱覽室。您可以去那邊的書架找。
dialogue.py: zhè běn shū zài sān lóu de shè huì kē xué yuè lǎn shì. nín kě yǐ qù nà biān de shū jià zhǎo.
dialogue.en: This book is in the Social Sciences Reading Room on the 3rd floor. You can go look on the shelves there.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。請問一次最多可以借幾本書？能借多久？
dialogue.py: xiè xie. qǐng wèn yī cì zuì duō kě yǐ jiè jǐ běn shū? néng jiè duō jiǔ?
dialogue.en: Thanks. How many books can I borrow at most at one time? And for how long?

dialogue.speaker: Librarian
dialogue.zh: 本科生一次可以借十本，期限是一個月。如果沒人預約，可以在網上續借一次。
dialogue.py: běn kē shēng yī cì kě yǐ jiè shí běn, qī xiàn shì yī gè yuè. rú guǒ méi rén yù yuē, kě yǐ zài wǎng shàng xù jiè yī cì.
dialogue.en: Undergraduates can borrow 10 at a time for a term of one month. If no one has reserved them, you can renew once online.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 明白了。那如果逾期還書，會有罰款嗎？
dialogue.py: míng bai le. nà rú guǒ yú qī huán shū, huì yǒu fá kuǎn ma?
dialogue.en: Understood. If I return books late, is there a fine?

dialogue.speaker: Librarian
dialogue.zh: 有的。逾期一天罰款五塊台幣。所以請記得按時歸還。
dialogue.py: yǒu de. yú qī yī tiān fá kuǎn wǔ kuài tái bì. suǒ yǐ qǐng jì de àn shí guī huán.
dialogue.en: Yes. There's a 5 NTD fine per day overdue. So please remember to return them on time.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我記住了。另外，我想預約下午的個人自修室，現在還有空位嗎？
dialogue.py: wǒ jì zhù le. lìng wài, wǒ xiǎng yù yuē xià wǔ de gè rén zì xiū shì, xiàn zài hái yǒu kòng wèi ma?
dialogue.en: I've noted it. Additionally, I want to reserve a personal study room for this afternoon; are there still openings?

dialogue.speaker: Librarian
dialogue.zh: 下午三點到五點還有一個。請刷一下你的學生證，我在系統裡幫你登記。
dialogue.py: xià wǔ sān diǎn dào wǔ diǎn hái yǒu yī gè. qǐng shuā yī xià nǐ de xué sheng zhèng, wǒ zài xì tǒng lǐ bāng nǐ dēng jì.
dialogue.en: There's one left from 3:00 to 5:00 PM. Please swipe your student ID, and I'll register it for you in the system.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的，謝謝老師的幫助。
dialogue.py: hǎo de, xiè xie lǎo shī de bāng zhù.
dialogue.en: Okay, thank you for your help, teacher (librarian).

dialogue.speaker: Librarian
dialogue.zh: 不客氣。在館內請保持安靜，不要接打電話。
dialogue.py: bù kè qì. zài guǎn nèi qǐng bǎo chí ān jìng, bù yào jiē dǎ diàn huà.
dialogue.en: You're welcome. Please keep quiet inside the library and don't take or make calls.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。
dialogue.py: méi wèn tí.
dialogue.en: No problem.

speaking.part_b: Role-play: 你在圖書館想借一本雜誌。管理員說雜誌只能在館內閱覽，不能外借。你問可不可以複印（fù yìn）其中的幾頁。管理員說可以並指引你複印機的位置。
part_c: 你喜歡在圖書館學習還是在家學習？
你覺得圖書館最方便的功能是什麼？

grammar.explanation: 使用 '最多/最少' 表極限。'V + 借' 的複合詞 (續借、外借)。'接打' 是接聽和撥打的合稱。
examples: 這家店最多坐十人。 (This shop seats 10 at most.)
我想續借這本書。 (I want to renew this book.)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 這本期刊可以借出去嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: zhè běn qī kān kě yǐ jiè chū qù ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: Can this journal be borrowed?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 抱歉，當年的期刊只能在館內閱覽。往年的可以外借。

expansion_dialogue.en: Sorry, journals from the current year can only be read inside. Those from previous years can be borrowed.

expansion_dialogue.py: nà wǒ kě yǐ zài zhè lǐ sǎo miáo yī xià ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: Then can I scan it here?

title: Preparing for a Presentation
story_description: 馬克和大衛需要合作完成一個課堂演講。他們正在討論分工、製作PPT以及演講的要點。
story_intro: 下週有一場小組演講。
主題是'我的家鄉文化'。
馬克和大衛是一個小組。
他們在咖啡店討論演講稿。
他們練習如何有邏輯地表達觀點。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 大衛，關於下週的演講，我們得抓緊時間準備了。
dialogue.py: dà wèi, guān yú xià zhōu de yǎn jiǎng, wǒ men děi zhuā jǐn shí jiān zhǔn bèi le.
dialogue.en: David, regarding next week's presentation, we need to hurry up and prepare.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 對，主題已經定好了。我們怎麼分工？
dialogue.py: duì, zhǔ tí yǐ jīng dìng hǎo le. wǒ men zěn me fēn gōng?
dialogue.en: Right, the theme is set. How do we divide the work?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我來負責查資料和寫初稿。你對軟體很熟，你來製作PPT吧。
dialogue.py: wǒ lái fù zé chá zī liào hé xiě chū gǎo. nǐ duì ruǎn tǐ hěn shú, nǐ lái zhì zuò PPT ba.
dialogue.en: I'll handle the research and the first draft. You're very familiar with the software; you create the PPT.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。PPT要放一些生動的照片和圖表，這樣觀眾才不會覺得無聊。
dialogue.py: méi wèn tí. PPT yào fàng yī xiē shēng dòng de zhào piàn hé tú biǎo, zhè yàng guān zhòng cái bù huì jué de wú liáo.
dialogue.en: No problem. The PPT should have some vivid photos and charts; that way the audience won't feel bored.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好主意。演講時間只有十分鐘，我們得控制好節奏。
dialogue.py: hǎo zhǔ yì. yǎn jiǎng shí jiān zhǐ yǒu shí fēn zhōng, wǒ men děi kòng zhì hǎo jié zòu.
dialogue.en: Good idea. The speaking time is only ten minutes; we have to control the pace.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 沒錯。我建議我們先列一個提綱：開頭、正文和結尾。
dialogue.py: méi cuò. wǒ jiàn yì wǒ men xiān liè yī gè tí gāng: kāi tóu, zhèng wén hé jié wěi.
dialogue.en: Exactly. I suggest we first list an outline: introduction, body, and conclusion.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 正文部分我們分兩個重點來講。最後要留兩分鐘讓大家提問。
dialogue.py: zhèng wén bù fèn wǒ men fēn liǎng gè zhòng diǎn lái jiǎng. zuì hòu yào liú liǎng fēn zhōng ràng dà jiā tí wèn.
dialogue.en: In the body section, let's divide it into two key points to speak. At the end, we should leave two minutes for Q&A.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 你寫完稿子後，我們得一起排練幾次。發音和神態都很重要。
dialogue.py: nǐ xiě wán gǎo zi hòu, wǒ men děi yī qǐ pái liàn jǐ cì. fā yīn hé shén tài dōu hěn zhòng yào.
dialogue.en: After you finish the script, we need to rehearse together a few times. Pronunciation and manner are both important.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我也這麼想。我怕到時候在台上太緊張，會忘詞。
dialogue.py: wǒ yě zhè me xiǎng. wǒ pà dào shí hou zài tái shàng tài jǐn zhāng, huì wàng cí.
dialogue.en: I think so too. I'm afraid I'll be too nervous on stage then and will forget my lines.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 別擔心，我們可以準備一些小卡片，把要點寫在上面。
dialogue.py: bié dān xīn, wǒ men kě yǐ zhǔn bèi yī xiē xiǎo kǎ piàn, bǎ yào diǎn xiě zài shàng mian.
dialogue.en: Don't worry; we can prepare some index cards and write the key points on them.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 太好了。那我們這週五前完成初稿和PPT，週日排練。
dialogue.py: tài hǎo le. nà wǒ men zhè zhōu wǔ qián wán chéng chū gǎo hé PPT, zhōu rì pái liàn.
dialogue.en: Great. Then we'll finish the draft and PPT before this Friday, and rehearse on Sunday.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 一言為定！加油！
dialogue.py: yī yán wéi dìng! jiā yóu!
dialogue.en: It's a deal! Go for it!

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A

expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ de yǎn jiǎng fēi cháng chéng gōng, dà jiā dōu tīng de hěn rù shén.
expansion_dialogue.en: Your speech was very successful; everyone listened intently.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B

expansion_dialogue.py: zhēn de ma? xiè xie. qí shí wǒ shǒu xīn dōu zài mào hàn.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A

expansion_dialogue.en: I couldn't tell at all. Your manner was very natural, and the interaction was good.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B

title: Midterm Exams
story_description: 期中考試週快到了。馬克和大衛感到壓力很大，他們正在圖書館複習，並討論如何更有效地複習。
story_intro: 校園裡氣氛緊張。
學生們都在忙著複習功課。
馬克下週有三場考試。
他覺得有些知識點還沒掌握。
大衛教他一些複習的技巧。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 大衛，我快要崩潰了！期中考試週簡直是噩夢。
dialogue.py: dà wèi, wǒ kuài yào bēng kuì le! qī zhōng kǎo shì zhōu jiǎn zhí shì è mèng.
dialogue.en: David, I'm about to break down! Midterm week is simply a nightmare.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 冷靜點兒，馬克。壓力大家都有，關鍵是要有計劃。
dialogue.py: lěng jìng diǎn r, mǎ kè. yā lì dà jiā dōu yǒu, guān jiàn shì yào yǒu jì huà.
dialogue.en: Calm down, Mark. Everyone has pressure; the key is to have a plan.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我現在還有好幾章的課文沒看，單詞也記不住。你複習得怎麼樣了？
dialogue.py: wǒ xiàn zài hái yǒu hǎo jǐ zhāng de kè wén méi kàn, dān cí yě jì bù zhù. nǐ fù xí de zěn me yàng le?
dialogue.en: I still have several chapters of text to read, and I can't remember the words. How's your revision going?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 我也在趕進度。我覺得你不能死記硬背，得理解著記。
dialogue.py: wǒ yě zài gǎn jìn dù. wǒ jué de nǐ bù néng sǐ jì yìng bèi, děi lǐ jiě zhe jì.
dialogue.en: I'm also rushing to catch up. I feel you can't just rote memorize; you have to memorize through understanding.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我也想啊，可是時間不夠了。你每天複習幾個小時？
dialogue.py: wǒ yě xiǎng a, kě shì shí jiān bù gòu le. nǐ měi tiān fù xí jǐ gè xiǎo shí?
dialogue.en: I want to, but time isn't enough. How many hours do you revise every day?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 我每天在圖書館待六個小時。我會把知識點總結成思維導圖，很有效。
dialogue.py: wǒ měi tiān zài tú shū guǎn dāi liù gè xiǎo shí. wǒ huì bǎ zhī shi diǎn zǒng jié chéng sī wéi dǎo tú, hěn yǒu xiào.
dialogue.en: I stay at the library for six hours every day. I summarize the knowledge points into mind maps; it's very effective.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 思維導圖？能借我看看嗎？
dialogue.py: sī wéi dǎo tú? néng jiè wǒ kàn kàn ma?
dialogue.en: Mind maps? Can I take a look?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 給。這是我做的中國藝術史的導圖。你可以參考一下。
dialogue.py: gěi. zhè shì wǒ zuò de zhōng guó yì shù shǐ de dǎo tú. nǐ kě yǐ cān kǎo yī xià.
dialogue.en: Here. This is the one I made for Chinese Art History. You can refer to it.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 哇，一目了然！這比看厚厚的課本強多了。
dialogue.py: wa, yī mù liǎo rán! zhè bǐ kàn hòu hòu de kè běn qiáng duō le.
dialogue.en: Wow, crystal clear! This is much better than reading thick textbooks.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 還有，別熬夜。充足的睡眠對記憶力很有幫助。
dialogue.py: hái yǒu, bié áo yè. chōng zú de shuì mián duì jì yì lì hěn yǒu bāng zhù.
dialogue.en: Also, don't stay up late. Adequate sleep is very helpful for memory.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 知道了。希望我們都能順利通過考試。
dialogue.py: zhī dào le. xī wàng wǒ men dōu néng shùn lì tōng guò kǎo shì.
dialogue.en: Got it. I hope we both pass the exams smoothly.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 加油，我們一起努力！
dialogue.py: jiā yóu, wǒ men yī qǐ nǔ lì!
dialogue.en: Keep it up, let's work hard together!

title: Feedback on a Paper
story_description: 馬克寫完了一篇論文，他去教授的辦公室諮詢修改意見。教授對他的文章給出了具體的反饋。
story_intro: 馬克提交了他的期中論文。
教授邀請他去辦公室面談。
馬克心裡有點兒忐忑。
教授指出了文章的優點和不足。
馬克學會了如何從反饋中進步。

dialogue.speaker: Professor
dialogue.zh: 馬克，請坐。我看了你的論文初稿。
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, qǐng zuò. wǒ kàn le nǐ de lùn wén chū gǎo.
dialogue.en: Mark, please sit down. I've read your paper draft.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝教授。請問您覺得我的論點清楚嗎？
dialogue.py: xiè xie jiào shòu. qǐng wèn nín jué de wǒ de lùn diǎn qīng chu ma?
dialogue.en: Thank you, Professor. Do you think my argument is clear?

dialogue.speaker: Professor
dialogue.zh: 你的論點很有創意，特別是關於文化交流的部分。
dialogue.py: nǐ de lùn diǎn hěn chuàng yì, tè bié shì guān yú wén huà jiāo liú de bù fèn.
dialogue.en: Your argument is very creative, especially the part about cultural exchange.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？太好了。那還有哪些地方需要修改？
dialogue.py: zhēn de ma? tài hǎo le. nà hái yǒu nǎ xiē dì fang xū yào xiū gǎi?
dialogue.en: Really? Great. Then what other areas need modification?

dialogue.speaker: Professor
dialogue.zh: 首先，文章的結構有點兒鬆散。你應該把第二段和第三段合併。
dialogue.py: shǒu xiān, wén zhāng de jié gòu yǒu diǎn r sōng sàn. nǐ yīng gāi bǎ dì èr duàn hé dì sān duàn hé bìng.
dialogue.en: First, the structure of the article is a bit loose. You should merge the second and third paragraphs.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 合併段落...好的，我記下來了。
dialogue.py: hé bìng duàn luò... hǎo de, wǒ jì xià lái le.
dialogue.en: Merge paragraphs... okay, I've noted it down.

dialogue.speaker: Professor
dialogue.zh: 另外，你引用的數據有點兒過時了。我建議你查閱一下去年的最新統計。
dialogue.py: lìng wài, nǐ yǐn yòng de shù jù yǒu diǎn r guò shí le. wǒ jiàn yì nǐ chá yuè yī xià qù nián de zuì xīn tǒng jì.
dialogue.en: Additionally, the data you cited is a bit outdated. I suggest you check last year's latest statistics.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 喔，沒想到數據更新這麼快。我會去圖書館補查資料的。
dialogue.py: ō, méi xiǎng dào shù jù gēng xīn zhè me kuài. wǒ huì qù tú shū guǎn bǔ chá zī liào de.
dialogue.en: Oh, I didn't expect data to update so fast. I'll go to the library to re-check the information.

dialogue.speaker: Professor
dialogue.zh: 最後，注意一下學術用語的規範。有些句子太口語化了。
dialogue.py: zuì hòu, zhù yì yī xià xué shù yòng yǔ de guī fàn. yǒu xiē jù zi tài kǒu yǔ huà le.
dialogue.en: Finally, pay attention to the standards of academic language. Some sentences are too colloquial.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 明白了。謝謝教授的指導，這些意見對我非常有幫助。
dialogue.py: míng bai le. xiè xie jiào shòu de zhǐ dǎo, zhè xiē yì jiàn duì wǒ fēi cháng yǒu bāng zhù.
dialogue.en: Understood. Thank you for your guidance, Professor; these suggestions are very helpful to me.

dialogue.speaker: Professor
dialogue.zh: 不客氣。修改完後再發給我看一次。期待你的終稿。
dialogue.py: bù kè qì. xiū gǎi wán hòu zài fā gěi wǒ kàn yī cì. qī dài nǐ de zhōng gǎo.
dialogue.en: You're welcome. Send it to me one more time after revising. I look forward to your final version.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，我一定會努力改好的！
dialogue.py: méi wèn tí, wǒ yī dìng huì nǔ lì gǎi hǎo de!
dialogue.en: No problem, I will definitely work hard to revise it well!

speaking.part_b: Role-play: 你去辦公室找助教詢問作業。助教說你的作業沒寫名字，而且第三題做錯了。你向助教道歉並保證立刻重寫上交。
part_c: 你害怕被老師批評嗎？
你覺得修改論文最難的地方在哪裡？

comprehension.q: 教授對馬克的論文論點評價如何？
教授建議馬克對第二和第三段做什麼處理？
論文中的數據出了什麼問題？
教授覺得馬克的有些句子有什麼缺點？
馬克修改完後需要做什麼？
options: C. 再發給教授看一次

true_false.q: 馬克心裡感到很忐忑。
教授不喜歡馬克關於文化交流的部分。
馬克打算去圖書館補查資料。
學術用語不需要規範。
教授期待看到馬克的終稿。

passage.title: Feedback on a Paper Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克提交了他的期中論文。教授邀請他去辦公室面談。馬克心裡有點兒忐忑。教授指出了文章的優點和不足。馬克學會了如何從反饋中進步。
passage.en: Mark, please sit down. I've read your paper draft. Thank you, Professor. Do you think my argument is clear? Your argument is very creative, especially the part about cultural exchange. Really? Great. Then what other areas need modification? First, the structure of the article is a bit loose. You should merge the second and third paragraphs. Merge paragraphs... okay, I've noted it down. Additionally, the data you cited is a bit outdated. I suggest you check last year's latest statistics.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫 3 到 5 句話描述一次你收到的有用的建議。是誰給你的？是什麼內容？對你有什麼幫助？

grammar.explanation: 使用 '首先...另外...最後' 引導邏輯步驟。'V + 完/到' 表結果。形容詞化標誌 '化' (口語化)。
examples: 這件事化繁為簡。 (Make this complicated matter simple.)
現代化城市 (Modernized city)
我聽到了他的聲音。 (I heard his voice.)
初稿修改 (Draft revision)
數據統計 (Data statistics)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你論文寫得怎麼樣了？查到資料了嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ lùn wén xiě de zěn me yàng le? chá dào zī liào le ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: How is your paper going? Have you found the materials?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 大部分都查到了，但還缺一些具體的案例。
expansion_dialogue.py: dà bù fèn dōu chá dào le, dàn hái quē yī xiē jù tǐ de àn lì.
expansion_dialogue.en: Found most of them, but still missing some specific case studies.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你可以去期刊庫看看，那裡有很多實地調研的報告。
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ kě yǐ qù qī kān kù kàn kàn, nà lǐ huì yǒu hěn duō shí dì diào yán de bào gào.
expansion_dialogue.en: You can check the journal database; there are many field research reports there.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 好主意，我下午就去檢索一下。謝謝你！
expansion_dialogue.py: hǎo zhǔ yì, wǒ xià wǔ jiù qù jiǎn suǒ yī xià. xiè xie nǐ!
expansion_dialogue.en: Good idea; I'll go search this afternoon. Thanks!

title: Joining a Research Lab
story_description: 馬克對電腦視覺感興趣，他想申請加入李教授的實驗室。他去面見教授，介紹自己的背景和興趣。
story_intro: 李教授是領域內的專家。
實驗室正在招收實習生。
馬克學過一點編程基礎。
他希望能參與到實際的項目中。
他來到教授的辦公室進行面試。

dialogue.speaker: Professor Li
dialogue.zh: 馬克，我看過你的簡歷。你對電腦視覺很有熱情？
dialogue.py: lǐ jiào shòu, wǒ kàn guò nǐ de jiǎn lì. nǐ duì diàn nǎo shì jué hěn rè qíng?
dialogue.en: Mark, I've read your resume. You have a lot of passion for computer vision?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 是的，教授。我上學期選了您的基礎課，覺得這項技術很有前景。
dialogue.py: shì de, jiào shòu. wǒ shàng xué qī xuǎn le nín de jī chǔ kè, jué de zhè xiàng jì shù hěn yǒu qián jǐng.
dialogue.en: Yes, Professor. I took your basic course last semester and feel this technology has a great future.

dialogue.speaker: Professor Li
dialogue.zh: 很好。我們實驗室目前正在做一個關於自動駕駛的項目。你掌握哪些編程語言？
dialogue.py: hěn hǎo. wǒ men shí yàn shì mù qián zhèng zài zuò yī gè guān yú zì dòng jià shǐ de xiàng mù. nǐ zhǎng wò nǎ xiē biān chéng yǔ yán?
dialogue.en: Very good. Our lab is currently doing a project on autonomous driving. Which programming languages have you mastered?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我熟悉 Python 和 C++。雖然我還沒有實際開發經驗，但我學習能力很強。
dialogue.py: wǒ shú xī Python hé C++. suī rán wǒ hái méi yǒu shí jì kāi fā jīng yàn, dàn wǒ xué xí néng lì hěn qiáng.
dialogue.en: I'm familiar with Python and C++. Although I don't have practical development experience yet, my learning ability is very strong.

dialogue.speaker: Professor Li
dialogue.zh: 實驗室的工作很辛苦，通常需要查閱大量的外文文獻，還要經常加班調試代碼。
dialogue.py: shí yàn shì de gōng zuò hěn xīn kǔ, tōng cháng xū yào chá yuè dà liàng de wài wén wén xiàn, hái yào jīng cháng jiā bān tiáo shì dài mǎ.
dialogue.en: Lab work is tough; usually requires reading a lot of foreign literature and frequent overtime for debugging code.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我不怕辛苦。我希望能跟著前輩們多學習，積累一些實踐經驗。
dialogue.py: wǒ bù pà xīn kǔ. wǒ xī wàng néng gēn zhe qián bèi men duō xué xí, jī lěi yī xiē shí jiàn jīng yàn.
dialogue.en: I'm not afraid of hard work. I hope to learn more from my seniors and accumulate some practical experience.

dialogue.speaker: Professor Li
dialogue.zh: 好的。你可以先作為實習生加入我們。每週至少要來三天。可以嗎？
dialogue.py: hǎo de. nǐ kě yǐ xiān zuò wéi shí xí shēng jiā rù wǒ men. měi zhōu zhì shǎo yào lái sān tiān. kě yǐ ma?
dialogue.en: Okay. You can join us as an intern first. You must come at least three days a week. Is that okay?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，我會調整一下課表時間。謝謝教授給我這個機會！
dialogue.py: méi wèn tí, wǒ huì tiáo zhěng yī xià kè biǎo shí jiān. xiè xie jiào shòu gěi wǒ zhè ge jī huì!
dialogue.en: No problem; I'll adjust my course schedule. Thank you, Professor, for giving me this opportunity!

dialogue.speaker: Professor Li
dialogue.zh: 那是實驗室的門禁卡，明天早上九點來報到吧。
dialogue.py: nà shì shí yàn shì de mén jìn kǎ, míng tiān zǎo shang jiǔ diǎn lái bào dào ba.
dialogue.en: That's the lab access card; come report at 9:00 tomorrow morning.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的。那我需要帶自己的電腦嗎？
dialogue.py: hǎo de. nà wǒ xū yào dài zì jǐ de diàn nǎo ma?
dialogue.en: Okay. Do I need to bring my own computer?

dialogue.speaker: Professor Li
dialogue.zh: 實驗室有高性能工作站，你人來了就行。記得穿實驗服。
dialogue.py: shí yàn shì yǒu gāo xìng néng gōng zuò zhàn, nǐ rén lái le jiù xíng. jì de chuān shí yàn fú.
dialogue.en: The lab has high-performance workstations; just you coming is enough. Remember to wear a lab coat.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 明白了，明天見！
dialogue.py: míng bai le, míng tiān jiàn!
dialogue.en: Understood, see you tomorrow!

passage.title: Joining a Research Lab Listening Passage
passage.zh: 李教授是領域內的專家。實驗室正在招收實習生。馬克學過一點編程基礎。他希望能參與到實際的項目中。他來到教授的辦公室進行面試。
passage.en: Mark, I've read your resume. You have a lot of passion for computer vision? Yes, Professor. I took your basic course last semester and feel this technology has a great future. Very good. Our lab is currently doing a project on autonomous driving. Which programming languages have you mastered? I'm familiar with Python and C++. Although I don't have practical development experience yet, my learning ability is very strong. Lab work is tough; usually requires reading a lot of foreign literature and frequent overtime for debugging code. I'm not afraid of hard work. I hope to learn more from my seniors and accumulate some practical experience. Okay. You can join us as an intern first. You must come at least three days a week. Is that okay?
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫 3 到 5 句話描述一個你擅長或想學的技能（如編程、烹飪、樂器）。你為什麼對它感興趣？

grammar.explanation: 使用 '掌握' 描述技能熟練。'至少' 表示最低要求。'人來了就行' 表示只需本人到場。
examples: 他掌握了三種語言。 (He mastered three languages.)
我每天至少喝兩升水。 (I drink at least 2 liters of water daily.)
不用帶東西，人來了就行。 (No need to bring things; just coming is fine.)
自動駕駛 (Autonomous driving)
實習工作 (Internship work)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你在實驗室過得怎麼樣？適應嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ zài shí yàn shì guò de zěn me yàng? shì yìng ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: How are you doing in the lab? Are you adapting?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 剛開始壓力很大，大家都很優秀。但現在慢慢上手了。
expansion_dialogue.py: gāng kāi shǐ yā lì hěn dà, dà jiā dōu hěn yōu xiù. dàn xiàn zài màn màn shàng shǒu le.
expansion_dialogue.en: The pressure was high at first; everyone is excellent. But now I'm slowly getting the hang of it.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 那就好。在實驗室能學到很多課本上沒有的知識。
expansion_dialogue.py: nà jiù hǎo. zài shí yàn shì néng xué dào hěn duō kè běn shàng méi yǒu de zhī shi.
expansion_dialogue.en: That's good. In the lab, you can learn a lot of knowledge not found in textbooks.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 對，實踐確實是最好的學習方式。
expansion_dialogue.py: duì, shí jiàn què shí shì zuì hǎo de xué xí fāng shì.
expansion_dialogue.en: Yes, practice is indeed the best way to learn.

title: Campus Part-time Job
story_description: 馬克在學校圖書館找到了一份兼職工作。他在培訓期間了解工作內容、時薪和排班安排。
story_intro: 馬克想賺點兒零用錢。
他在學校官網看到了招聘信息。
他申請了圖書館管理助理的工作。
主管正在給他做入職培訓。
馬克學會了如何處理借還書和諮詢。

dialogue.speaker: Supervisor
dialogue.zh: 馬克，歡迎加入圖書館團隊。這是你的工作證。
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, huān yíng jiā rù tú shū guǎn tuán duì. zhè shì nǐ de gōng zuò zhèng.
dialogue.en: Mark, welcome to the library team. Here is your staff ID.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。我很珍惜這次兼職機會。請問我的具體工作是什麼？
dialogue.py: xiè xie. wǒ hěn zhēn xī zhè cì jiān zhí jī huì. qǐng wèn wǒ de jù tǐ gōng zuò shì shén me?
dialogue.en: Thanks. I really treasure this part-time opportunity. What exactly is my job?

dialogue.speaker: Supervisor
dialogue.zh: 你負責在服務台幫同學辦理借書和還書，還要負責整理書架上的書籍。
dialogue.py: nǐ fù zé zài fú wù tái bāng tóng xué bàn lǐ jiè shū hé huán shū, hái yào fù zé zhěng lǐ shū jià shàng de shū jí.
dialogue.en: You're responsible for helping students borrow and return books at the service desk, and also for organizing the books on the shelves.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 明白了。那工作時間是怎麼安排的？
dialogue.py: míng bai le. nà gōng zuò shí jiān shì zěn me ān pái de?
dialogue.en: Understood. How is the work time arranged?

dialogue.speaker: Supervisor
dialogue.zh: 我們實行排班制。每週你需要工作十個小時。你把課表給我，我來排班。
dialogue.py: wǒ men shí xíng pái bān zhì. měi zhōu nǐ xū yào gōng zuò shí gè xiǎo shí. nǐ bǎ kè biǎo gěi wǒ, wǒ lái pái bān.
dialogue.en: We implement a shift system. You need to work 10 hours a week. Give me your course schedule, and I'll arrange the shifts.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的。請問時薪是多少？工資怎麼發？
dialogue.py: hǎo de. qǐng wèn shí xīn shì duō shǎo? gōng zī zěn me fā?
dialogue.en: Okay. What's the hourly wage? How is the salary paid?

dialogue.speaker: Supervisor
dialogue.zh: 目前時薪是 180 台幣。每個月十號會打入你的銀行賬戶。
dialogue.py: mù qián shí xīn shì yī bǎi bā shí tái bì. měi gè yuè shí hào huì dǎ rù nǐ de yín háng zhàng hù.
dialogue.en: The current hourly wage is 180 NTD. It will be deposited into your bank account on the 10th of every month.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 太好了。如果我有急事需要請假，應該找誰？
dialogue.py: tài hǎo le. rú guǒ wǒ yǒu jí shì xū yào qǐng jià, yīng gāi zhǎo shéi?
dialogue.en: Great. If I have an emergency and need to ask for leave, who should I contact?

dialogue.speaker: Supervisor
dialogue.zh: 請至少提前一天發郵件給我，或者在工作群組裡留言。
dialogue.py: qǐng zhì shǎo tí qián yī tiān fā yóu jiàn gěi wǒ, huò zhě zài gōng zuò qún zǔ lǐ liú yán.
dialogue.en: Please send me an email at least one day in advance, or leave a message in the work group.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 知道了。工作時需要穿制服嗎？
dialogue.py: zhī dào le. gōng zuò shí xū yào chuān zhì fú ma?
dialogue.en: Got it. Do I need to wear a uniform while working?

dialogue.speaker: Supervisor
dialogue.zh: 不需要，但請穿著整潔。現在我帶你熟悉一下圖書分類法。
dialogue.py: bù xū yào, dàn qǐng chuān zhuó zhěng jié. xiàn zài wǒ dài nǐ shú xī yī xià tú shū fēn lèi fǎ.
dialogue.en: No, but please dress neatly. Now I'll take you to get familiar with the library classification system.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的，麻煩您了。
dialogue.py: hǎo de, má fan nín le.
dialogue.en: Okay, thank you for your trouble.

key_sentences.en: How much is the hourly wage?

speaking.part_b: Role-play: 你在便利商店兼職。主管告訴你今天要負責補貨和打掃。你問主管如果晚上要早點走行不行，因為你有個小組會議。主管同意了。
part_c: 你覺得大學生做兼職好嗎？

passage.title: Campus Part-time Job Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克想賺點兒零用錢。他在學校官網看到了招聘信息。他申請了圖書館管理助理的工作。主管正在給他做入職培訓。馬克學會了如何處理借還書和諮詢。

You're responsible for helping students borrow and return books at the service desk, and also for organizing the books on the shelves. Understood. How is the work time arranged? We implement a shift system. You need to work 10 hours a week. Give me your course schedule, and I'll arrange the shifts. Okay. What's the hourly wage? How is the salary paid? The current hourly wage is 180 NTD. It will be deposited into your bank account on the 10th of every month.

title: Group Project
story_description: 學生們正在分配小組報告的任務。他們討論了如何分工合作以及完成任務的最後期限。
story_intro: 下週有一份重要的小組報告。
馬克、大衛和莉莉分在同一個小組。
他們下課後留在教室裡開會。
每個人都需要承擔一部分工作。
他們正在討論詳細的分工計劃。

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 大家注意，我們的小組報告下週五就要交了。我們得趕快分工。
dialogue.py: dà jiā zhù yì, wǒ men de xiǎo zǔ bào gào xià zhōu wǔ jiù yào jiāo le. wǒ men děi gǎn kuài fēn gōng.
dialogue.en: Attention everyone, our group report is due next Friday. We need to divide the work quickly.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 這次的報告主題是環境保護。我們需要查資料、寫大綱，還要製作幻燈片。
dialogue.py: zhè cì de bào gào zhǔ tí shì huán jìng bǎo hù. wǒ men xū yào chá zī liào, xiě dà gāng, hái yào zhì zuò huàn dēng piàn.
dialogue.en: The topic of this report is environmental protection. We need to do research, write an outline, and also make slides.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 我對查資料比較在行。我來負責收集關於減少塑膠使用的數據吧。
dialogue.py: wǒ duì chá zī liào bǐ jiào zài háng. wǒ lái fù zé shōu jí guān yú jiǎn shǎo sù jiāo shǐ yòng de shù jù ba.
dialogue.en: I'm quite good at doing research. I'll be responsible for collecting data on reducing plastic use.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 好，那大衛負責找資料。馬克，你負責寫大綱和總結，可以嗎？
dialogue.py: hǎo, nà dà wèi fù zé zhǎo zī liào. mǎ kè, nǐ fù zé xiě dà gāng hé zǒng jié, kě yǐ ma?
dialogue.en: Okay, then David is responsible for finding information. Mark, you're in charge of writing the outline and summary, is that okay?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。我週末就把大綱寫出來發給你們看。
dialogue.py: méi wèn tí. wǒ zhōu mò jiù bǎ dà gāng xiě chū lái fā gěi nǐ men kàn.
dialogue.en: No problem. I'll write out the outline this weekend and send it to you to look at.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 至於幻燈片，就交給我來設計吧。我會找一些好看的圖片。
dialogue.py: zhì yú huàn dēng piàn, jiù jiāo gěi wǒ lái shè jì ba. wǒ huì zhǎo yī xiē hǎo kàn de tú piàn.
dialogue.en: As for the slides, leave the design to me. I'll find some nice-looking pictures.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 太好了。那我們什麼時候把所有的東西合併在一起？
dialogue.py: tài hǎo le. nà wǒ men shén me shí hou bǎ suǒ yǒu de dōng xi hé bìng zài yī qǐ?
dialogue.en: Great. Then when do we merge everything together?

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 下週二晚上怎麼樣？我們在圖書館見面，一起修改。
dialogue.py: xià zhōu èr wǎn shang zěn me yàng? wǒ men zài tú shū guǎn jiàn miàn, yī qǐ xiū gǎi.
dialogue.en: How about next Tuesday night? We can meet at the library and revise it together.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 週二晚上我可能要打工。改成週三下午可以嗎？
dialogue.py: zhōu èr wǎn shang wǒ kě néng yào dǎ gōng. gǎi chéng zhōu sān xià wǔ kě yǐ ma?
dialogue.en: I might have to work part-time on Tuesday night. Can we change it to Wednesday afternoon?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 週三下午我有空。莉莉，你呢？
dialogue.py: zhōu sān xià wǔ wǒ yǒu kòng. lì lì, nǐ ne?
dialogue.en: I'm free on Wednesday afternoon. Lily, how about you?

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 我也沒問題。那就定在週三下午兩點。
dialogue.py: wǒ yě méi wèn tí. nà jiù dìng zài zhōu sān xià wǔ liǎng diǎn.
dialogue.en: I have no problem either. Then it's set for Wednesday afternoon at two o'clock.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的。大家一定要在週三之前把自己的部分做完喔。
dialogue.py: hǎo de. dà jiā yī dìng yào zài zhōu sān zhī qián bǎ zì jǐ de bù fèn zuò wán ō.
dialogue.en: Okay. Everyone must finish their own parts before Wednesday.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 放心吧！我不會拖後腿的。
dialogue.py: fàng xīn ba! wǒ bù huì tuō hòu tuǐ de.
dialogue.en: Don't worry! I won't hold you back.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 合作愉快！
dialogue.py: hé zuò yú kuài!
dialogue.en: Happy cooperating!

title: Presenting in Class
story_description: 馬克準備在課堂上做簡報。他感到非常緊張，同學大衛在旁邊鼓勵他，並給他一些演講的建議。
story_intro: 今天是課堂簡報的日子。
下一個就輪到馬克上台了。
馬克看著講稿，手心冒汗。
他害怕自己會忘詞或說錯話。
大衛在一旁給他加油打氣。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 大衛，我好緊張。我的心跳得很快。
dialogue.py: dà wèi, wǒ hǎo jǐn zhāng. wǒ de xīn tiào de hěn kuài.
dialogue.en: David, I'm so nervous. My heart is beating very fast.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 深呼吸，馬克。你已經準備得很充分了，沒問題的。
dialogue.py: shēn hū xī, mǎ kè. nǐ yǐ jīng zhǔn bèi de hěn chōng fèn le, méi wèn tí de.
dialogue.en: Take a deep breath, Mark. You have already prepared very thoroughly; there will be no problem.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 可是我怕等一下站在台上會忘詞。如果大家都看著我，我會結巴的。
dialogue.py: kě shì wǒ pà děng yī xià zhàn zài tái shàng huì wàng cí. rú guǒ dà jiā dōu kàn zhe wǒ, wǒ huì jié ba de.
dialogue.en: But I'm afraid I'll forget my words when I stand on stage later. If everyone is looking at me, I'll stutter.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 你就把觀眾當作是大白菜。看著後面的牆壁說話，這樣就不會那麼緊張了。
dialogue.py: nǐ jiù bǎ guān zhòng dāng zuò shì dà bái cài. kàn zhe hòu mian de qiáng bì shuō huà, zhè yàng jiù bù huì nà me jǐn zhāng le.
dialogue.en: Just treat the audience as cabbages. Look at the wall in the back and speak; that way you won't be so nervous.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 大白菜？這方法聽起來有點好笑。那我忘了詞怎麼辦？
dialogue.py: dà bái cài? zhè fāng fǎ tīng qǐ lái yǒu diǎn hǎo xiào. nà wǒ wàng le cí zěn me bàn?
dialogue.en: Cabbages? This method sounds a bit funny. Then what if I forget my words?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 忘詞了就停頓一下，看看幻燈片上的提示，然後繼續說。大家都能理解的。
dialogue.py: wàng cí le jiù tíng dùn yī xià, kàn kàn huàn dēng piàn shàng de tí shì, rán hòu jì xù shuō. dà jiā dōu néng lǐ jiě de.
dialogue.en: If you forget, just pause a bit, look at the prompts on the slides, and then continue. Everyone can understand.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好吧。開場白我再複習一次：'各位老師、同學，大家早上好，今天我要報告的主題是...'
dialogue.py: hǎo ba. kāi chǎng bái wǒ zài fù xí yī cì: 'gè wèi lǎo shī, tóng xué, dà jiā zǎo shang hǎo, jīn tiān wǒ yào bào gào de zhǔ tí shì...'
dialogue.en: Okay. I'll review the opening remarks once more: 'Teachers, students, good morning everyone, the topic I will report on today is...'

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 對，就是這樣！聲音要宏亮，保持微笑。你可以的！
dialogue.py: duì, jiù shì zhè yàng! shēng yīn yào hóng liàng, bǎo chí wēi xiào. nǐ kě yǐ de!
dialogue.en: Yes, just like that! Your voice needs to be loud and clear, keep smiling. You can do it!

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 下一位，請馬克同學上台報告。
dialogue.py: xià yī wèi, qǐng mǎ kè tóng xué shàng tái bào gào.
dialogue.en: Next, Mark please come to the stage to present.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 輪到我了。祝我好運吧。
dialogue.py: lún dào wǒ le. zhù wǒ hǎo yùn ba.
dialogue.en: It's my turn. Wish me luck.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 加油！相信自己！
dialogue.py: jiā yóu! xiāng xìn zì jǐ!
dialogue.en: Go for it! Believe in yourself!

writing: 請寫 70 到 100 個字，準備一段簡短的演講開場白。包含問候語、自我介紹、以及你今天要討論的主題。

grammar.explanation: 使用 '把...當作...' 結構表示將A視為B。'V + 得 + 程度補語' 描述狀態 (準備得充分、心跳得快)。
examples: 他把公司當作自己的家。 (He treats the company as his own home.)

title: After the Presentation
story_description: 馬克完成了課堂報告。老師和同學給予他反饋。雖然有一點小瑕疵，但整體表現很好。
story_intro: 馬克的簡報終於結束了。
他回到座位上鬆了一口氣。
教授開始對他的報告進行點評。
同學們也提出了自己的看法。
馬克虛心接受了大家的建議。

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 馬克，你的報告做得很不錯。準備得很用心。
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, nǐ de bào gào zuò de hěn bù cuò. zhǔn bèi de hěn yòng xīn.
dialogue.en: Mark, your presentation was done very well. You prepared with a lot of effort.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝老師。其實我剛才在台上超級緊張，差點兒忘詞。
dialogue.py: xiè xie lǎo shī. qí shí wǒ gāng cái zài tái shàng chāo jí jǐn zhāng, chà diǎn r wàng cí.
dialogue.en: Thank you, Teacher. Actually, I was super nervous on stage just now and almost forgot my words.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 我們都沒看出來。你的聲音很穩定，幻燈片的圖表也很清晰。不過，有一個小缺點。
dialogue.py: wǒ men dōu méi kàn chū lái. nǐ de shēng yīn hěn wěn dìng, huàn dēng piàn de tú biǎo yě hěn qīng xī. bù guò, yǒu yī gè xiǎo quē diǎn.
dialogue.en: None of us could tell. Your voice was stable, and the charts on the slides were very clear. However, there is a small shortcoming.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 是什麼缺點？請老師指教。
dialogue.py: shì shén me quē diǎn? qǐng lǎo shī zhǐ jiào.
dialogue.en: What shortcoming? Please instruct me, Teacher.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 你在講第二部分的時候，語速稍微快了一點。有的同學可能沒聽清楚。
dialogue.py: nǐ zài jiǎng dì èr bù fèn de shí hou, yǔ sù shāo wēi kuài le yī diǎn. yǒu de tóng xué kě néng méi tīng qīng chu.
dialogue.en: When you were speaking in the second part, the speaking speed was slightly too fast. Some students might not have heard clearly.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 喔，我明白了。我當時怕超時，所以就不自覺地加快了速度。
dialogue.py: ō, wǒ míng bai le. wǒ dāng shí pà chāo shí, suǒ yǐ jiù bù zì jué de jiā kuài le sù dù.
dialogue.en: Oh, I understand. I was afraid of going overtime then, so I unconsciously sped up.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 對，我也覺得那邊稍微快了點。但整體的內容非常有趣，特別是你舉的那個例子。
dialogue.py: duì, wǒ yě jué de nà biān shāo wēi kuài le diǎn. dàn zhěng tǐ de nèi róng fēi cháng yǒu qù, tè bié shì nǐ jǔ de nà ge lì zi.
dialogue.en: Yes, I also felt it was a bit fast there. But the overall content was very interesting, especially the example you gave.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝大衛。下次我會注意控制語速的。
dialogue.py: xiè xie dà wèi. xià cì wǒ huì zhù yì kòng zhì yǔ sù de.
dialogue.en: Thanks David. Next time I'll pay attention to controlling the speaking speed.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 能意識到問題並願意改進，這才是最重要的。給你一個 A-。
dialogue.py: néng yì shí dào wèn tí bìng yuàn yì gǎi jìn, zhè cái shì zuì zhòng yào de. gěi nǐ yī gè A-.
dialogue.en: Being able to realize the problem and willing to improve, this is the most important thing. I give you an A-.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 太好了！謝謝老師！
dialogue.py: tài hǎo le! xiè xie lǎo shī!
dialogue.en: Great! Thank you Teacher!

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 恭喜你！報告終於順利結束了，晚上我們去吃頓好的慶祝一下吧！
dialogue.py: gōng xǐ nǐ! bào gào zhōng yú shùn lì jié shù le, wǎn shang wǒ men qù chī dùn hǎo de qìng zhù yī xià ba!
dialogue.en: Congratulations! The presentation has finally finished smoothly; let's go have a good meal tonight to celebrate!

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好主意，我請客！
dialogue.py: hǎo zhǔ yì, wǒ qǐng kè!
dialogue.en: Good idea, my treat!

The speaking speed was slightly too fast.
Pay attention to controlling speaking speed.

passage.en: Mark, your presentation was done very well. You prepared with a lot of effort. Thank you, Teacher. Actually, I was super nervous on stage just now and almost forgot my words. None of us could tell. Your voice was stable, and the charts on the slides were very clear. However, there is a small shortcoming. What shortcoming? Please instruct me, Teacher. When you were speaking in the second part, the speaking speed was slightly too fast. Some students might not have heard clearly. Oh, I understand. I was afraid of going overtime then, so I unconsciously sped up. Yes, I also felt it was a bit fast there. But the overall content was very interesting, especially the example you gave.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫 70 到 100 個字給你的同學寫一段反饋。先稱讚他的優點（例如聲音宏亮），然後委婉地提出一個改進建議（例如語速稍快）。

grammar.explanation: 使用 '稍微...一點' 表示程度輕微。'沒看出來' 中的 '出來' 是結果補語，表示辨認出。'為了...怕...' 表達動機與擔憂。
examples: 這件衣服稍微大了一點。 (This dress is slightly too big.)
我沒聽出來那是誰的聲音。 (I couldn't recognize whose voice that was.)
我怕遲到，所以跑得很快。 (I was afraid of being late, so I ran very fast.)

意識到問題 (Realize the problem)

expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ jué de wǒ gāng cái miàn shì biǎo xiàn de zěn me yàng?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 整體很好，回答問題很有邏輯。不過你的手一直動，看起來有點兒緊張。
expansion_dialogue.py: zhěng tǐ hěn hǎo, huí dá wèn tí hěn yǒu luó ji. bù guò nǐ de shǒu yī zhí dòng, kàn qǐ lái yǒu diǎn r jǐn zhāng.
expansion_dialogue.en: Overall very good; answering questions was very logical. But your hands kept moving; you looked a bit nervous.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A

expansion_dialogue.en: Sigh, whenever I'm nervous I don't know where to put my hands.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B

expansion_dialogue.en: Next time you can try holding a pen, or resting both hands naturally on your knees.

title: Part-Time Job Interview
story_description: 馬克去一家咖啡廳面試兼職工作。店長詢問他的工作經驗、可上班的時間以及他的優點。
story_intro: 馬克看到咖啡廳在招人。
他遞交了履歷並獲得了面試機會。
今天他穿得整整齊齊去見店長。
店長問了他幾個關於服務業的問題。
馬克自信地回答了店長的提問。

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 你好，馬克。請坐。我看過你的履歷了，你是大學二年級的學生，對吧？
dialogue.py: nǐ hǎo, mǎ kè. qǐng zuò. wǒ kàn guò nǐ de lǚ lì le, nǐ shì dà xué èr nián jí de xué sheng, duì ba?
dialogue.en: Hello, Mark. Please sit down. I've read your resume; you are a second-year university student, right?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 是的，店長。我在這附近的大學讀書，走路過來只要十分鐘。
dialogue.py: shì de, diàn zhǎng. wǒ zài zhè fù jìn de dà xué dú shū, zǒu lù guò lái zhǐ yào shí fēn zhōng.
dialogue.en: Yes, Manager. I study at the university nearby; walking here only takes ten minutes.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 很好，距離很近。請問你以前有過餐飲服務業的經驗嗎？
dialogue.py: hěn hǎo, jù lí hěn jìn. qǐng wèn nǐ yǐ qián yǒu guò cān yǐn fú wù yè de jīng yàn ma?
dialogue.en: Very good, the distance is close. Excuse me, have you had food and beverage service experience before?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我在老家的時候，暑假在一家麵包店打過工，負責收銀和整理商品。
dialogue.py: wǒ zài lǎo jiā de shí hou, shǔ jià zài yī jiā miàn bāo diàn dǎ guò gōng, fù zé shōu yín hé zhěng lǐ shāng pǐn.
dialogue.en: When I was in my hometown, I worked part-time at a bakery during summer vacation, responsible for cashiering and organizing goods.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 所以你知道怎麼使用收銀機。那你會做咖啡嗎？
dialogue.py: suǒ yǐ nǐ zhī dào zěn me shǐ yòng shōu yín jī. nà nǐ huì zuò kā fēi ma?
dialogue.en: So you know how to use a cash register. Then can you make coffee?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我不太會拉花，但我會做基本的義式咖啡。我很願意學習新技能。
dialogue.py: wǒ bù tài huì lā huā, dàn wǒ huì zuò jī běn de yì shì kā fēi. wǒ hěn yuàn yì xué xí xīn jì néng.
dialogue.en: I'm not very good at latte art, but I can make basic espresso coffee. I am very willing to learn new skills.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 咖啡技巧我們可以培訓。做服務業，最重要的是態度。你覺得你最大的優點是什麼？
dialogue.py: kā fēi jì qiǎo wǒ men kě yǐ péi xùn. zuò fú wù yè, zuì zhòng yào de shì tài du. nǐ jué de nǐ zuì dà de yōu diǎn shì shén me?
dialogue.en: Coffee skills we can train. Working in the service industry, the most important thing is attitude. What do you think is your biggest strength?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我覺得我很有耐心，而且不怕辛苦。遇到挑剔的客人，我也能保持禮貌。
dialogue.py: wǒ jué de wǒ hěn yǒu nài xīn, ér qiě bù pà xīn kǔ. yù dào tiāo tì de kè rén, wǒ yě néng bǎo chí lǐ mào.
dialogue.en: I think I am very patient, and moreover, I'm not afraid of hard work. Even encountering picky customers, I can also remain polite.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 不錯。那你一週可以排幾天班？週末能來嗎？
dialogue.py: bù cuò. nà nǐ yī zhōu kě yǐ pái jǐ tiān bān? zhōu mò néng lái ma?
dialogue.en: Not bad. Then how many days a week can you be scheduled for shifts? Can you come on weekends?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我一週可以排三天班。週末我都有空，可以上全天班。
dialogue.py: wǒ yī zhōu kě yǐ pái sān tiān bān. zhōu mò wǒ dōu yǒu kòng, kě yǐ shàng quán tiān bān.
dialogue.en: I can be scheduled three days a week. I'm free all weekend; I can work full-day shifts.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 我們的時薪是兩百塊，有提供員工餐。你覺得可以接受嗎？
dialogue.py: wǒ men de shí xīn shì liǎng bǎi kuài, yǒu tí gōng yuán gōng cān. nǐ jué de kě yǐ jiē shòu ma?
dialogue.en: Our hourly wage is 200 dollars, providing employee meals. Do you think you can accept?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我覺得非常合理。期待能有機會在這裡工作！
dialogue.py: wǒ jué de fēi cháng hé lǐ. qī dài néng yǒu jī huì zài zhè lǐ gōng zuò!
dialogue.en: I think it's very reasonable. I look forward to having the opportunity to work here!

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 好的，我們這兩天會通知你面試結果。謝謝你今天過來。
dialogue.py: hǎo de, wǒ men zhè liǎng tiān huì tōng zhī nǐ miàn shì jié guǒ. xiè xie nǐ jīn tiān guò lái.
dialogue.en: Okay, we will notify you of the interview result within these two days. Thank you for coming over today.

key_sentences.zh: 有過餐飲服務業的經驗嗎？
key_sentences.en: Have you had food and beverage service experience?
Responsible for cashiering and organizing goods.
I am very willing to learn new skills.

passage.zh: 馬克看到咖啡廳在招人。他遞交了履歷並獲得了面試機會。今天他穿得整整齊齊去見店長。店長問了他幾個關於服務業的問題。馬克自信地回答了店長的提問。

writing: 請寫 70 到 100 個字作為一段求職自我介紹。說明你的身分、你有過什麼經驗，以及你的優點。

grammar.explanation: 使用 '對...感興趣' 表達愛好。'願意' 表示強烈的意願。'遇到...也能...' 表示在困難條件下的能力。

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 請問你們這裡還缺人嗎？我想應徵服務生。
expansion_dialogue.py: qǐng wèn nǐ men zhè lǐ hái quē rén ma? wǒ xiǎng yìng zhēng fú wù shēng.
expansion_dialogue.en: Excuse me, are you still short of staff here? I want to apply for a waiter position.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 我們目前全職已經滿了，但還需要幾名兼職。
expansion_dialogue.py: wǒ men mù qián quán zhí yǐ jīng mǎn le, dàn hái xū yào jǐ míng jiān zhí.
expansion_dialogue.en: Our full-time positions are currently full, but we still need a few part-timers.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 兼職也可以。請問需要自備履歷表嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: jiān zhí yě kě yǐ. qǐng wèn xū yào zì bèi lǚ lì biǎo ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: Part-time is also fine. Do I need to bring my own resume?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 是的，請你明天帶履歷表過來，店長會親自面試你。
expansion_dialogue.py: shì de, qǐng nǐ míng tiān dài lǚ lì biǎo guò lái, diàn zhǎng huì qīn zì miàn shì nǐ.
expansion_dialogue.en: Yes, please bring your resume over tomorrow; the manager will interview you personally.

title: First Day at Work
story_description: 馬克被咖啡廳錄用了。今天是他的第一天上班，經理正在教他如何完成日常任務。
story_intro: 馬克收到了咖啡廳的錄取通知。
今天是他第一天來上班。
他提早了十分鐘到達店裡。
經理發給他一套員工制服。
經理帶著他熟悉工作環境和流程。

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 早安，馬克。歡迎你加入。這是你的圍裙和名牌。
dialogue.py: zǎo ān, mǎ kè. huān yíng nǐ jiā rù. zhè shì nǐ de wéi qún hé míng pái.
dialogue.en: Good morning, Mark. Welcome aboard. This is your apron and name tag.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 早安，經理。我已經換好衣服了，請問第一件事要做什麼？
dialogue.py: zǎo ān, jīng lǐ. wǒ yǐ jīng huàn hǎo yī fu le, qǐng wèn dì yī jiàn shì yào zuò shén me?
dialogue.en: Good morning, Manager. I've already changed clothes; what's the first thing to do?

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 我們每天開門前，必須先打掃環境。你要負責把外面的桌椅擦乾淨。
dialogue.py: wǒ men měi tiān kāi mén qián, bì xū xiān dǎ sǎo huán jìng. nǐ yào fù zé bǎ wài miàn de zhuō yǐ cā gān jìng.
dialogue.en: Before we open every day, we must first clean the environment. You are responsible for wiping the tables and chairs outside clean.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的，抹布和清潔劑在哪裡拿？
dialogue.py: hǎo de, mǎ bù hé qīng jié jì zài nǎ lǐ ná?
dialogue.en: Okay, where do I get the rag and cleaning agent?

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 都在後面的儲藏室裡。擦完桌子後，來吧檯學一下收銀機的操作。
dialogue.py: dōu zài hòu mian de chǔ cáng shì lǐ. cā wán zhuō zi hòu, lái bā tái xué yī xià shōu yín jī de cāo zuò.
dialogue.en: They are all in the storage room in the back. After wiping the tables, come to the bar counter to learn the operation of the cash register.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: （十分鐘後）經理，桌子都擦好了。
dialogue.py: (shí fēn zhōng hòu) jīng lǐ, zhuō zi dōu cā hǎo le.
dialogue.en: (Ten minutes later) Manager, the tables are all wiped.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 動作很快。你看，這是我們的點單系統。客人點餐時，先選擇內用還是外帶。
dialogue.py: dòng zuò hěn kuài. nǐ kàn, zhè shì wǒ men de diǎn dān xì tǒng. kè rén diǎn cān shí, xiān xuǎn zé nèi yòng hái shì wài dài.
dialogue.en: Fast action. Look, this is our ordering system. When customers order, first choose dine-in or takeout.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 內用或外帶。然後呢？
dialogue.py: nèi yòng huò wài dài. rán hòu ne?
dialogue.en: Dine-in or takeout. And then?

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 然後在屏幕上點選飲料的名稱，選擇冰塊和甜度。最後按結帳。
dialogue.py: rán hòu zài píng mù shàng diǎn xuǎn yǐn liào de míng chēng, xuǎn zé bīng kuài hé tián dù. zuì hòu àn jié zhàng.
dialogue.en: Then click the name of the beverage on the screen, select ice and sweetness levels. Finally, press checkout.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 看起來不難。如果是刷卡或者行動支付，也是在這裡操作嗎？
dialogue.py: kàn qǐ lái bù nán. rú guǒ shì shuā kǎ huò zhě xíng dòng zhī fù, yě shì zài zhè lǐ cāo zuò ma?
dialogue.en: It doesn't look hard. If it's swiping a card or mobile payment, is it also operated here?

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 對，刷卡機在旁邊。你要確認付款成功後，再把明細給客人。
dialogue.py: duì, shuā kǎ jī zài páng biān. nǐ yào què rèn fù kuǎn chéng gōng hòu, zài bǎ míng xì gěi kè rén.
dialogue.en: Yes, the card machine is next to it. You must confirm the payment is successful before giving the receipt to the customer.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我懂了。如果有不懂的地方，我可以隨時問您嗎？
dialogue.py: wǒ dǒng le. rú guǒ yǒu bù dǒng de dì fang, wǒ kě yǐ suí shí wèn nín ma?
dialogue.en: I understand. If there are things I don't understand, can I ask you anytime?

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 當然可以。第一天不用太緊張，慢慢熟悉流程最重要。準備好迎接客人了嗎？
dialogue.py: dāng rán kě yǐ. dì yī tiān bù yòng tài jǐn zhāng, màn màn shú xī liú chéng zuì zhòng yào. zhǔn bèi hǎo yíng jiē kè rén le ma?
dialogue.en: Of course. No need to be too nervous on the first day; slowly getting familiar with the process is most important. Ready to welcome customers?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 準備好了！
dialogue.py: zhǔn bèi hǎo le!
dialogue.en: Ready!

key_sentences.en: What's the first thing to do?
Wipe the tables and chairs outside clean.
The operation of the cash register.
Give the receipt to the customer.
Slowly get familiar with the process.

vocabulary.meaning: to check out / pay the bill

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B

expansion_dialogue.py: méi guān xi. nǐ xiān bǎ yuán jiàn fàng zài zhè lǐ, rán hòu xuǎn zé hēi bái hái shì cǎi sè.
expansion_dialogue.en: No worries. You first put the original here, then choose black & white or color.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A

expansion_dialogue.py: xuǎn hǎo le. jiē xià lái àn zhè ge lǜ sè de àn niǔ ma?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B

title: Talking to a Customer
story_description: 馬克在咖啡廳為客人點餐。他使用了禮貌的服務用語，並準確地記錄了客人的需求。
story_intro: 現在是咖啡廳最忙碌的下午。
馬克站在收銀台前準備迎接客人。
一位女士走進來點餐。
馬克禮貌地向她問好。
他仔細確認了飲料的溫度和甜度。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 歡迎光臨！請問今天想喝點什麼？
dialogue.py: huān yíng guāng lín! qǐng wèn jīn tiān xiǎng hē diǎn shén me?
dialogue.en: Welcome! What would you like to drink today?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 你好。我要一杯美式咖啡，還要一塊巧克力蛋糕。
dialogue.py: nǐ hǎo. wǒ yào yī bēi měi shì kā fēi, hái yào yī kuài qiǎo kè lì dàn gāo.
dialogue.en: Hello. I want an Americano and a piece of chocolate cake.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的。請問美式咖啡要熱的還是冰的？
dialogue.py: hǎo de. qǐng wèn měi shì kā fēi yào rè de hái shì bīng de?
dialogue.en: Okay. Would you like the Americano hot or iced?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 我要冰的。少冰，無糖。
dialogue.py: wǒ yào bīng de. shǎo bīng, wú táng.
dialogue.en: I want iced. Less ice, no sugar.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。冰美式少冰無糖，配一塊巧克力蛋糕。請問是在這裡用還是外帶？
dialogue.py: méi wèn tí. bīng měi shì shǎo bīng wú táng, pèi yī kuài qiǎo kè lì dàn gāo. qǐng wèn shì zài zhè lǐ yòng hái shì wài dài?
dialogue.en: No problem. Iced Americano, less ice, no sugar, paired with a piece of chocolate cake. For here or to go?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 在這裡用。我可以用手機支付嗎？
dialogue.py: zài zhè lǐ yòng. wǒ kě yǐ yòng shǒu jī zhī fù ma?
dialogue.en: For here. Can I pay with my phone?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 當然可以。一共是兩百一十塊。請出示您的付款條碼。
dialogue.py: dāng rán kě yǐ. yī gòng shì liǎng bǎi yī shí kuài. qǐng chū shì nín de fù kuǎn tiáo mǎ.
dialogue.en: Of course. The total is 210 dollars. Please show your payment barcode.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 好的，給你掃描。
dialogue.py: hǎo de, gěi nǐ sǎo miáo.
dialogue.en: Okay, here for you to scan.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: （掃描條碼）付款成功。這是您的明細和取餐呼叫器。
dialogue.py: (sǎo miáo tiáo mǎ) fù kuǎn chéng gōng. zhè shì nín de míng xì hé qǔ cān hū jiào qì.
dialogue.en: (Scans barcode) Payment successful. Here is your receipt and meal pager.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。請問洗手間在哪裡？
dialogue.py: xiè xie. qǐng wèn xǐ shǒu jiān zài nǎ lǐ?
dialogue.en: Thanks. Excuse me, where is the restroom?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 洗手間在走廊盡頭右轉。您的餐點準備好後，呼叫器會震動。
dialogue.py: xǐ shǒu jiān zài zǒu láng jìn tóu yòu zhuǎn. nín de cān diǎn zhǔn bèi hǎo hòu, hū jiào qì huì zhèn dòng.
dialogue.en: The restroom is at the end of the hallway, turn right. When your meal is ready, the pager will vibrate.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.zh: 好，謝謝你的幫忙。
dialogue.py: hǎo, xiè xie nǐ de bāng máng.
dialogue.en: Okay, thanks for your help.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 不客氣。祝您有美好的一天！
dialogue.py: bù kè qì. zhù nín yǒu měi hǎo de yī tiān!
dialogue.en: You're welcome. Have a nice day!

key_sentences.en: What would you like to drink?
Turn right at the end of the hallway.

title: Asking for a Day Off
story_description: 馬克下週有期中考試，他向咖啡廳經理請假，並說明他已經找好代班的人了。
story_intro: 馬克下週五有一場重要的期中考試。
但他那天下午原本要排班打工。
他需要向經理請假。
他提前找了大衛來幫他代班。
他去找經理說明情況並請求批准。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 經理，您現在有空嗎？我想跟您談一下下週的排班。
dialogue.py: jīng lǐ, nín xiàn zài yǒu kòng ma? wǒ xiǎng gēn nín tán yī xià xià zhōu de pái bān.
dialogue.en: Manager, are you free right now? I'd like to talk to you about next week's schedule.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 有空。怎麼了，馬克？排班有什麼問題嗎？
dialogue.py: yǒu kòng. zěn me le, mǎ kè? pái bān yǒu shén me wèn tí ma?
dialogue.en: I'm free. What's wrong, Mark? Is there a problem with the schedule?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 下週五下午我有一場很重要的期中考試，所以我想請半天假。
dialogue.py: xià zhōu wǔ xià wǔ wǒ yǒu yī chǎng hěn zhòng yào de qī zhōng kǎo shì, suǒ yǐ wǒ xiǎng qǐng bàn tiān jià.
dialogue.en: Next Friday afternoon I have a very important midterm exam, so I want to ask for a half-day leave.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 下週五下午是店裡最忙的時候。你請假的話，人手可能不夠。
dialogue.py: xià zhōu wǔ xià wǔ shì diàn lǐ zuì máng de shí hou. nǐ qǐng jià de huà, rén shǒu kě néng bù gòu.
dialogue.en: Next Friday afternoon is the busiest time in the shop. If you take leave, we might be short-handed.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我知道。所以我已經跟大衛商量好了，他願意那天下午來替我代班。
dialogue.py: wǒ zhī dào. suǒ yǐ wǒ yǐ jīng gēn dà wèi shāng liang hǎo le, tā yuàn yì nà tiān xià wǔ lái tì wǒ dài bān.
dialogue.en: I know. So I have already discussed it with David; he is willing to cover my shift that afternoon.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 大衛？他那天本來沒有班嗎？
dialogue.py: dà wèi? tā nà tiān běn lái méi yǒu bān ma?
dialogue.en: David? Didn't he originally have no shift that day?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 對，他那天正好休息。我們把班換了一下，我下週日替他上班。
dialogue.py: duì, tā nà tiān zhèng hǎo xiū xi. wǒ men bǎ bān huàn le yī xià, wǒ xià zhōu rì tì tā shàng bān.
dialogue.en: Right, he happens to be resting that day. We swapped shifts; I will work for him next Sunday.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 既然你們已經協調好了，那就沒問題。考試準備得怎麼樣了？
dialogue.py: jì rán nǐ men yǐ jīng xié tiáo hǎo le, nà jiù méi wèn tí. kǎo shì zhǔn bèi de zěn me yàng le?
dialogue.en: Since you guys have already coordinated it, then there's no problem. How is your exam preparation going?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 還在努力複習中。謝謝經理的理解！
dialogue.py: hái zài nǔ lì fù xí zhōng. xiè xie jīng lǐ de lǐ jiě!
dialogue.en: Still working hard on reviewing. Thank you for your understanding, Manager!

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 不客氣，學業為重。你記得在員工系統裡提交一下換班申請。
dialogue.py: bù kè qì, xué yè wéi zhòng. nǐ jì de zài yuán gōng xì tǒng lǐ tí jiāo yī xià huàn bān shēn qǐng.
dialogue.en: You're welcome, studies come first. Remember to submit a shift-swap application in the employee system.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的，我馬上就去提交。給您添麻煩了。
dialogue.py: hǎo de, wǒ mǎ shàng jiù qù tí jiāo. gěi nín tiān má fan le.
dialogue.en: Okay, I'll go submit it right away. Sorry for the trouble.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 沒事，祝你考試順利。
dialogue.py: méi shì, zhù nǐ kǎo shì shùn lì.
dialogue.en: It's nothing, good luck on your exam.

key_sentences.en: Want to ask for a half-day leave.

vocabulary.meaning: to substitute for / on behalf of

passage.title: Asking for a Day Off Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克下週五有一場重要的期中考試。但他那天下午原本要排班打工。他需要向經理請假。他提前找了大衛來幫他代班。他去找經理說明情況並請求批准。
passage.en: Manager, are you free right now? I'd like to talk to you about next week's schedule. I'm free. What's wrong, Mark? Is there a problem with the schedule? Next Friday afternoon I have a very important midterm exam, so I want to ask for a half-day leave. Next Friday afternoon is the busiest time in the shop. If you take leave, we might be short-handed. I know. So I have already discussed it with David; he is willing to cover my shift that afternoon. David? Didn't he originally have no shift that day? Right, he happens to be resting that day. We swapped shifts; I will work for him next Sunday.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫一封請假訊息給經理：包含請假日期、原因以及你找了誰代班（40 到 60 個字）。

grammar.explanation: 使用 '替 (tì)' 表示替代或代替。'既然...那就...' 表示基於已發生的事實得出結論。'以...為重' 表示將某事視為最重要。
examples: 我替你去。 (I'll go in your place.)
既然你來了，那就坐吧。 (Since you're here, then take a seat.)
以健康為重。 (Health comes first.)
商量好了 (Discussed and settled)
人手不夠 (Short-handed)

practice.q: Complete: ____然你不想去，那就別去了。 (Since...)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 大衛，你這週末能替我上個夜班嗎？我突然有點事。
expansion_dialogue.py: dà wèi, nǐ zhè zhōu mò néng tì wǒ shàng gè yè bān ma? wǒ tū rán yǒu diǎn shì.
expansion_dialogue.en: David, can you cover a night shift for me this weekend? Something came up suddenly.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 這週末？可是我已經約了朋友吃飯。很急嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: zhè zhōu mò? kě shì wǒ yǐ jīng yuē le péng you chī fàn. hěn jí ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: This weekend? But I've already made plans to eat with a friend. Is it very urgent?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 對，我家裡出了點急事，必須回去一趟。拜託了！
expansion_dialogue.py: duì, wǒ jiā lǐ chū le diǎn jí shì, bì xū huí qù yī tàng. bài tuō le!
expansion_dialogue.en: Yes, an urgent matter came up at home; I must go back for a trip. Please!

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 好吧，那我跟朋友改期。你去忙你的吧，夜班交給我。
expansion_dialogue.py: hǎo ba, nà wǒ gēn péng you gǎi qī. nǐ qù máng nǐ de ba, yè bān jiāo gěi wǒ.
expansion_dialogue.en: Okay then, I'll reschedule with my friend. Go handle your business; leave the night shift to me.
