title: Choosing What to Watch
story_description: 馬克和莉莉打算在週六晚上在家看電影。他們在串流平台上翻找，在動作片、喜劇片和紀錄片之間猶豫不決。他們需要透過協商達成共識。
story_intro: 今天晚上馬克和莉莉想在家放鬆一下。
串流平台上的選擇實在太多了。
馬克想看刺激的動作片，莉莉想看輕鬆的喜劇。
他們還看到了一部關於環境保護的紀錄片。
他們正在討論每部片的優缺點，最後做出決定。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 莉莉，快過來！串流平台剛上架了幾部新片。你想看哪一種類型的？
dialogue.py: lì lì, kuài guò lái! chuàn liú píng tái gāng shàng jià le jǐ bù xīn piàn. nǐ xiǎng kàn nǎ yī zhǒng lèi xíng de?
dialogue.en: Lily, come here quick! The streaming platform just uploaded several new movies. Which genre do you want to watch?

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 我今天工作好累，只想看一些不用動腦筋的喜劇片。這部《瘋狂週末》看起來不錯。
dialogue.py: wǒ jīn tiān gōng zuò hǎo lèi, zhǐ xiǎng kàn yī xiē bú yòng dòng nǎo jīn de xǐ jù piàn. zhè bù 'fēng kuáng zhōu mò' kàn qǐ lái bù cuò.
dialogue.en: I'm so tired from work today; I only want to watch some comedy movies that don't require using my brain. This 'Crazy Weekend' looks good.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 喜劇片啊...我本來想看這部評價很高的動作片，據說打鬥場面非常精彩。
dialogue.py: xǐ jù piàn a... wǒ běn lái xiǎng kàn zhè bù píng jià hěn gāo de dòng zuò piàn, jù shuō dǎ dòu chǎng miàn fēi cháng jīng cǎi.
dialogue.en: Comedy... I originally wanted to watch this highly-rated action movie; it's said the fight scenes are very exciting.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 動作片太吵了，我怕看了會頭痛。能不能遷就我一下？
dialogue.py: dòng zuò piàn tài chǎo le, wǒ pà kàn le huì tóu tòng. néng bù néng qiān jiù wǒ yī xià?
dialogue.en: Action movies are too noisy; I'm afraid I'll get a headache. Can you accommodate me for once?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 那這部紀錄片呢？關於亞馬遜雨林的。看起來視覺效果很漂亮，而且也很有意義。
dialogue.py: nà zhè bù jì lù piàn ne? guān yú yà mǎ xùn yǔ lín de. kàn qǐ lái shì jué xiào guǒ hěn piào liang, ér qiě yě hěn yǒu yì yì.
dialogue.en: How about this documentary? About the Amazon rainforest. It looks like the visual effects are beautiful, and it's also very meaningful.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 紀錄片是有意義，但我現在不想學習新知識，我只想笑一笑。
dialogue.py: jì lù piàn shì yǒu yì yì, dàn wǒ xiàn zài bù xiǎng xué xí xīn zhī shí, wǒ zhǐ xiǎng xiào yī xiào.
dialogue.en: Documentaries are meaningful, but I don't want to learn new knowledge right now; I just want to have a laugh.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好吧。那我們折衷一下。這裡有一部『動作喜劇』，叫《烏龍特務》，既有刺激的場面，又很幽默。
dialogue.py: hǎo ba. nà wǒ men zhé zhōng yī xià. zhè lǐ yǒu yī bù 'dòng zuò xǐ jù', jiào 'wū lóng tè wù', jì yǒu cì jī de chǎng miàn, yòu hěn yōu mò.
dialogue.en: Okay. Then let's compromise a bit. There's an 'action comedy' here called 'Oolong Agent'; it has exciting scenes and is also very humorous.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 《烏龍特務》？我有聽說過，評價似乎還行。主角是誰演的？
dialogue.py: 'wū lóng tè wù'? wǒ yǒu tīng shuō guò, píng jià sì hū hái xíng. zhǔ jiǎo shì shuí yǎn de?
dialogue.en: 'Oolong Agent'? I've heard of it; the reviews seem okay. Who's the lead actor?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 是巨石強森演的。他的電影通常都很有趣，不會太沉重。
dialogue.py: shì jù shí qiáng sēn yǎn de. tā de diàn yǐng tōng cháng dōu hěn yǒu qù, bú huì tài chén zhòng.
dialogue.en: It's starring Dwayne Johnson. His movies are usually very interesting and won't be too heavy/serious.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 那聽起來不錯。我接受這個提案。不過，你要負責準備爆米花和可樂。
dialogue.py: nà tīng qǐ lái bù cuò. wǒ jiē shòu zhè ge tí àn. bù guò, nǐ yào fù zé zhǔn bèi bào mǐ huā hé kě lè.
dialogue.en: That sounds good. I accept this proposal. However, you have to be responsible for preparing popcorn and cola.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 沒問題！這是我應該做的。我現在去微波爆米花。
dialogue.py: méi wèn tí! zhè shì wǒ yīng gāi zuò de. wǒ xiàn zài qù wēi bō bào mǐ huā.
dialogue.en: No problem! That's what I should do. I'll go microwave the popcorn now.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我先去換件舒服的睡衣，然後我們就開始。
dialogue.py: tài hǎo le. wǒ xiān qù huàn jiàn shū fu de shuì yī, rán hòu wǒ men jiù kāi shǐ.
dialogue.en: Great. I'll go change into some comfortable pajamas first, and then we'll start.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 這部片時長兩小時，看完剛好可以睡覺。完美！
dialogue.py: zhè bù piàn shí cháng liǎng xiǎo shí, kàn wán gāng hǎo kě yǐ shuì jiào. wán měi!
dialogue.en: This movie is two hours long; after finishing, we can just go to sleep. Perfect!

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 對了，這部片有中文字幕嗎？我想順便學一點中文。
dialogue.py: duì le, zhè bù piàn yǒu zhōng wén zì mù ma? wǒ xiǎng shùn biàn xué yī diǎn zhōng wén.
dialogue.en: By the way, does this movie have Chinese subtitles? I want to learn a bit of Chinese at the same time.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 有的。我會把字幕調出來。那我們開始囉！
dialogue.py: yǒu de. wǒ huì bǎ zì mù tiáo chū lái. nà wǒ men kāi shǐ luo!
dialogue.en: Yes. I'll pull the subtitles up. Then let's start!

passage.title: Choosing What to Watch Listening Passage
passage.zh: 今天晚上馬克和莉莉想在家放鬆一下。串流平台上的選擇實在太多了。馬克想看刺激的動作片，莉莉想看輕鬆的喜劇。他們還看到了一部關於環境保護的紀錄片。他們正在討論每部片的優缺點，最後做出決定。
passage.en: Lily, come here quick! The streaming platform just uploaded several new movies. Which genre do you want to watch? I'm so tired from work today; I only want to watch some comedy movies that don't require using my brain. This 'Crazy Weekend' looks good. Comedy... I originally wanted to watch this highly-rated action movie; it's said the fight scenes are very exciting. Action movies are too noisy; I'm afraid I'll get a headache. Can you accommodate me for once? How about this documentary? About the Amazon rainforest. It looks like the visual effects are beautiful, and it's also very meaningful. Documentaries are meaningful, but I don't want to learn new knowledge right now; I just want to have a laugh. Okay. Then let's compromise a bit. There's an 'action comedy' here called 'Oolong Agent'; it has exciting scenes and is also very humorous.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫 70 到 100 個字。描述一次你和朋友或家人決定某件事（如看電影、吃飯或旅行地點）的過程。你們有不同的意見嗎？最後是如何達成共識的？

grammar.explanation: 使用 '猶豫不決' 形容難以做決定。'折衷' 用於描述在兩個極端之間尋找平衡。'既...又...' 用於連接兩個同時具備的特點。
examples: 這件衣服既漂亮又便宜。 (This dress is both beautiful and cheap.)
我們決定折衷，去中間的餐廳。 (We decided to compromise and go to a restaurant in the middle.)
別再猶豫不決了，快決定吧。 (Stop being so hesitant; decide quickly.)
動腦筋想辦法 (Use brain to think of a way)
順便去買菜 (Buy groceries at the same time)

practice.q: Complete: 順___幫我開門。 (At the same time/by the way.)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 我也猶豫不決。不如我們折衷一下，去吃那家有韓式烤肉也有日式拉麵的複合式餐廳？
expansion_dialogue.py: wǒ yě yóu yù bù jué. bù rú wǒ men zhé zhōng yī xià, qù chī nà jiā yǒu hán shì kǎo ròu yě yǒu rì shì lā miàn de fù hé shì cān tīng?
expansion_dialogue.en: I'm also undecided. Why don't we compromise and go to that fusion restaurant that has both Korean BBQ and Japanese ramen?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 聽起來很棒！這樣既能滿足你想吃烤肉的願望，也能滿足我想喝湯的願望。
expansion_dialogue.py: tīng qǐ lái hěn bàng! zhè yàng jì néng mǎn zú nǐ xiǎng chī kǎo ròu de yuàn wàng, yě néng mǎn zú wǒ xiǎng hē tāng de yuàn wàng.
expansion_dialogue.en: Sounds great! This way it can satisfy your wish for BBQ and also my wish for soup.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 一言為定，我們現在就出發！
expansion_dialogue.py: yī yán wéi dìng, wǒ men xiàn zài jiù chū fā!
expansion_dialogue.en: It's a deal; let's head out now!

title: Talking About Music
story_description: 馬克在學校咖啡廳遇到了正在戴耳機聽音樂的安娜。他們開始交流彼此喜愛的音樂風格、歌手，以及音樂對他們生活的影響。
story_intro: 安娜是一個熱愛音樂的人。
馬克注意到安娜正沉浸在音樂的世界裡。
他們分享了各自播放清單裡的歌曲。
安娜喜歡爵士樂的慵懶，馬克喜歡搖滾樂的熱血。
他們討論了音樂如何幫助他們放鬆和減壓。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 安娜，看你聽得這麼入神，在聽什麼好歌呢？
dialogue.py: ān nà, kàn nǐ tīng de zhè me rù shén, zài tīng shén me hǎo gē ne?
dialogue.en: Anna, seeing you listening so intently, what good song are you listening to?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.zh: 是一首爵士樂。我很喜歡這種節奏，聽起來讓人覺得很慵懶、很放鬆。
dialogue.py: shì yī shǒu jué shì yuè. wǒ hěn xǐ huān zhè zhǒng jié zòu, tīng qǐ lái ràng rén jué de hěn yōng lǎn, hěn fàng sōng.
dialogue.en: It's a jazz song. I really like this rhythm; it sounds very lazy/mellow and relaxing.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 爵士樂啊。我比較少聽，我通常是聽搖滾樂，特別是那種鼓聲很強的，聽了會很有精神。
dialogue.py: jué shì yuè a. wǒ bǐ jiào shǎo tīng, wǒ tōng cháng shì tīng yáo gǔn yuè, tè bié shì nà zhǒng gǔ shēng hěn qiáng de, tīng le huì hěn yǒu jīng shén.
dialogue.en: Jazz... I listen to it less; I usually listen to rock music, especially the kind with strong drums; listening to it makes me feel energetic.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.zh: 搖滾樂對我來說有點太吵了。但我能理解那種『熱血』的感覺。你有推薦的樂團嗎？
dialogue.py: yáo gǔn yuè duì wǒ lái shuō yǒu diǎn tài chǎo le. dàn wǒ néng lǐ jiě nà zhǒng 'rè xiě' de gǎn jué. nǐ yǒu tuī jiàn de yuè tuán ma?
dialogue.en: Rock is a bit too noisy for me. But I can understand that 'passionate' feeling. Do you have a recommended band?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你可以聽聽看這個樂團，他們的旋律很好聽，主唱的嗓音也很有特色。
dialogue.py: nǐ kě yǐ tīng tīng kàn zhè ge yuè tuán, tā men de xuán lǜ hěn hǎo tīng, zhǔ chàng de sǎng yīn yě hěn yǒu tè sè.
dialogue.en: You can try listening to this band; their melody is very nice, and the lead singer's voice is very unique.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.zh: 好的，我先加入我的播放清單。你聽音樂通常是在什麼時候？
dialogue.py: hǎo de, wǒ xiān jiā rù wǒ de bō fàng qīng dān. nǐ tīng yīn lè tōng cháng shì zài shén me shí hou?
dialogue.en: Okay, I'll add it to my playlist first. When do you usually listen to music?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我通勤的時候一定會聽，或者是寫作業需要專心的時候。你呢？
dialogue.py: wǒ tōng qín de shí hou yī dìng huì tīng, huò zhě shì xiě zuò yè xū yào zhuān xīn de shí hou. nǐ ne?
dialogue.en: I definitely listen when commuting, or when I need to concentrate on my homework. How about you?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.zh: 我習慣在晚上睡前聽一點輕音樂。那能幫我把白天的壓力都忘掉。
dialogue.py: wǒ xí guàn zài wǎn shang shuì qián tīng yī diǎn qīng yīn lè. nà néng bāng wǒ bǎ bái tiān de yā lì dōu wàng diào.
dialogue.en: I'm used to listening to some light music before bed at night. That can help me forget all the daytime's stress.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 確實。音樂真的是一種跨國界的語言。對了，你有去聽過現場演唱會嗎？
dialogue.py: què shí. yīn lè zhēn de shì yī zhǒng kuà guó jiè de yǔ yán. duì le, nǐ yǒu qù tīng guò xiàn chǎng yǎn chàng huì ma?
dialogue.en: Indeed. Music truly is a language that transcends borders. By the way, have you ever been to a live concert?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.zh: 去過幾次。現場的氣氛和音效真的跟耳機裡聽到的完全不一樣。
dialogue.py: qù guò jǐ mèi. xiàn chǎng de qì fēn hé yīn xiào zhēn de gēn ěr jī lǐ tīng dào de wán quán bù yī yàng.
dialogue.en: Been a few times. The live atmosphere and sound effects are truly completely different from what you hear in headphones.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我也這麼覺得。雖然門票有時候很貴，但那種震撼感是值得的。
dialogue.py: wǒ yě zhè me jué de. suī rán mén piào yǒu shí hou hěn guì, dàn nà zhǒng zhèn hàn gǎn shì zhí de de.
dialogue.en: I feel so too. Although tickets are sometimes very expensive, that sense of shock/spectacle is worth it.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.zh: 最近有一個戶外音樂節，有很多獨立樂團會去表演，你有興趣嗎？
dialogue.py: zuì jìn yǒu yī gè hù wài yīn lè jié, yǒu hěn duō dú lì yuè tuán huì qù biǎo yǎn, nǐ yǒu xìng qù ma?
dialogue.en: There's an outdoor music festival recently; many indie bands will perform. Are you interested?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 戶外音樂節？聽起來很酷！在什麼地方？
dialogue.py: hù wài yīn lè jié? tīng qǐ lái hěn kù! zài shén me dì fāng?
dialogue.en: Outdoor music festival? Sounds cool! Where is it?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.zh: 在大安森林公園。這週日有免費的場次，我們可以一起去逛逛。
dialogue.py: zài dà ān sēn lín gōng yuán. zhè zhōu rì yǒu miǎn fèi de chǎng cì, wǒ men kě yǐ yī qǐ qù guàng guang.
dialogue.en: At Daan Forest Park. There are free sessions this Sunday; we can go wander around together.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我這週日剛好沒事。那我們到時候見！
dialogue.py: tài hǎo le, wǒ zhè zhōu rì gāng hǎo méi shì. nà wǒ men dào shí hòu jiàn!
dialogue.en: Great, I happen to be free this Sunday. Then I'll see you then!

key_sentences.en: Listening so intently / lost in the music.
Light music that makes you forget stress.

passage.en: Anna, seeing you listening so intently, what good song are you listening to? It's a jazz song. I really like this rhythm; it sounds very lazy/mellow and relaxing. Jazz... I listen to it less; I usually listen to rock music, especially the kind with strong drums; listening to it makes me feel energetic. Rock is a bit too noisy for me. But I can understand that 'passionate' feeling. Do you have a recommended band? You can try listening to this band; their melody is very nice, and the lead singer's voice is very unique. Okay, I'll add it to my playlist first. When do you usually listen to music? I definitely listen when commuting, or when I need to concentrate on my homework. How about you?

writing: 請寫 70 到 100 個字，向朋友介紹你最喜歡的一位歌手或一個樂團。描述他們的音樂風格，以及為什麼你推薦這份播放清單。這份音樂帶給你什麼樣的感受？

grammar.explanation: 使用 '入神' 形容專注的程度。'慵懶' 與 '熱血' 是描述音樂氛圍的生動詞彙。'跨國界' 用於描述超越地理限制的事物。

輕音樂 (Light music)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你聽過這個日本搖滾樂團嗎？他們的現場表演超震撼的！
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ tīng guò zhè ge rì běn yáo gǔn yuè tuán ma? tā men de xiàn chǎng biǎo yǎn chāo zhèn hàn de!
expansion_dialogue.en: Have you heard of this Japanese rock band? Their live performance is super spectacular!

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 還沒耶。我對搖滾樂的認識比較少。我平常都聽韓語流行音樂。
expansion_dialogue.py: hái méi ye. wǒ duì yáo gǔn yuè de rèn shi bǐ jiào shǎo. wǒ píng cháng dōu tīng hán yǔ liú xíng yīn lè.
expansion_dialogue.en: Not yet. My knowledge of rock music is relatively limited. I usually listen to K-pop.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 那很不一樣！韓語歌的舞蹈很厲害，但搖滾樂主要是聽樂器的技巧。
expansion_dialogue.py: nà hěn bù yī yàng! hán yǔ gē de wǔ dǎo hěn lì hai, dàn yáo gǔn yuè zhǔ yào shì tīng yuè qì de jì qiǎo.
expansion_dialogue.en: That's very different! K-pop dances are amazing, but rock music is mainly about listening to instrumental skills.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 原來如此。那你傳幾首代表作給我，我回去聽聽看。
expansion_dialogue.py: yuán lái rú cǐ. nà nǐ chuán jǐ shǒu dài biǎo zuò gěi wǒ, wǒ huí qù tīng tīng kàn.
expansion_dialogue.en: I see. Then send a few representative works to me, and I'll listen to them when I get back.

title: At a Concert
story_description: 馬克和安娜這週日來到大安森林公園參加戶外音樂節。他們擠在人群中，近距離欣賞了獨立樂團的演出。馬克被現場的感染力深深打動。
story_intro: 今天是個陽光明媚的週日。
大安森林公園的草地上坐滿了人。
舞台上的音響效果非常震撼。
歌手在台上賣力地演唱，歌迷們在台下熱情地歡呼。
馬克和安娜享受了一場難忘的視聽盛宴。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.zh: 馬克，快看！那個樂團準備要開演了。我們擠到前面一點吧？
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, kuài kàn! nà ge yuè tuán zhǔn bèi yào kāi yǎn le. wǒ men jǐ dào qián miàn yī diǎn ba?
dialogue.en: Mark, look! That band is about to start performing. Let's squeeze to the front a bit?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好！哇，這裡的人真多。大家看起來都好興奮。
dialogue.py: hǎo! wa, zhè lǐ de rén zhēn duō. dà jiā kàn qǐ lái dōu hǎo xìng fèn.
dialogue.en: Okay! Wow, there are really a lot of people here. Everyone looks so excited.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.zh: 這個樂團最近在網路上很火紅。他們曲風很多變，很受年輕人歡迎。
dialogue.py: zhè ge yuè tuán zuì jìn zài wǎng lù shàng hěn huǒ hóng. tā men qǔ fēng hěn duō biàn, hěn shòu nián qīng rén huān yíng.
dialogue.en: This band has been very popular on the internet recently. Their music style is very versatile, and they're very welcome among young people.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: （吉他聲響起）這節奏好強！現場的音響效果比在家裡聽立體多了。
dialogue.py: (jí tā shēng xiǎng qǐ) zhè jié zòu hǎo qiáng! xiàn chǎng de yīn xiǎng xiào guǒ bǐ zài jiā lǐ tīng lì tǐ duō le.
dialogue.en: (Guitar starts playing) This rhythm is so strong! The live sound effects are much more three-dimensional/stereo than listening at home.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.zh: 主唱出來了！你看他的造型，好酷喔！
dialogue.py: zhǔ chàng chū lái le! nǐ kàn tā de zào xíng, hǎo kù ō!
dialogue.en: The lead singer is out! Look at his styling; so cool!

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: （音樂變得熱烈）大家都在跟著拍手。這種集體的感染力真的好強，我忍不住也想跳起來。
dialogue.py: (yīn lè biàn de rè liè) dà jiā dōu zài gēn zhe pāi shǒu. zhè zhǒng jí tǐ de gǎn rǎn lì zhēn de hǎo qiáng, wǒ rěn bú zhù yě xiǎng tiào qǐ lái.
dialogue.en: (Music gets intense) Everyone is clapping along. This collective infectiousness is truly so strong; I can't help but want to jump up too.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.zh: 對吧！這就是現場表演的魅力。你看，那邊還有歌迷在揮舞著螢光棒。
dialogue.py: duì ba! zhè jiù shì xiàn chǎng biǎo yǎn de mèi lì. nǐ kàn, nà biān hái yǒu gē mí zài huī wǔ zhe yíng guāng bàng.
dialogue.en: Right! This is the charm of live performances. Look, there are even fans over there waving glow sticks.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 剛才那首慢歌，大家都打開手機的手電筒，草地看起來像一片星海，好浪漫。
dialogue.py: gāng cái nà shǒu màn gē, dà jiā dōu dǎ kāi shǒu jī de shǒu diàn tǒng, cǎo dì kàn qǐ lái xiàng yī piàn xīng hǎi, hǎo làng màn.
dialogue.en: The slow song just now, everyone turned on their phone flashlights; the grass looked like a sea of stars, so romantic.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.zh: 我也被感動到了。主唱的聲音很有渲染力，歌詞也寫得很有深度。
dialogue.py: wǒ yě bèi gǎn dòng dào le. zhǔ chàng de shēng yīn hěn yǒu xuàn rǎn lì, gē cí yě xiě de hěn yǒu shēn dù.
dialogue.en: I was moved too. The lead singer's voice is very expressive, and the lyrics are written with a lot of depth.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 整場演出大概多久？現在已經一小時了。
dialogue.py: zhěng chǎng yǎn chū dà gài duō jiǔ? xiàn zài yǐ jīng yī xiǎo shí le.
dialogue.en: How long is the whole performance roughly? It's been an hour already.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.zh: 通常一個樂團會表演九十分鐘。最後應該還會有安可曲。
dialogue.py: tōng cháng yī gè yuè tuán huì biǎo yǎn jiǔ shí fèn zhòng. zuì hòu yīng gāi hái huì yǒu ān kě qǔ.
dialogue.en: Usually a band will perform for ninety minutes. At the end there should still be an encore.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我已經流汗流得全身濕透了，但真的好爽！
dialogue.py: wǒ yǐ jīng liú hàn liú de quán shēn shī tòu le, dàn zhēn de hǎo shuǎng!
dialogue.en: I'm already drenched in sweat, but it feels truly great/refreshing!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.zh: 我也是。這種釋放壓力的感覺真好。你看，大家都還不想走。
dialogue.py: wǒ yě shì. zhè zhǒng shì fàng yā lì de gǎn jué zhēn hǎo. nǐ kàn, dà jiā dōu hái bù xiǎng zǒu.
dialogue.en: Me too. This feeling of releasing stress is so good. Look, everyone still doesn't want to leave.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 音樂節結束後，我們去附近喝杯冰的飲料吧？
dialogue.py: yīn lè jié jié shù hòu, wǒ men qù fù jìn hē bēi bīng de yǐn liào ba?
dialogue.en: After the music festival ends, shall we go nearby and have a cold drink?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.zh: 好啊！我現在口渴得要命。我們走吧。
dialogue.py: hǎo a! wǒ xiàn zài kǒu kě de yào mìng. wǒ men zǒu ba.
dialogue.en: Sure! I'm thirsty to death right now. Let's go.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 走！安可！安可！
dialogue.py: zǒu! ān kě! ān kě!
dialogue.en: Go! Encore! Encore!

key_sentences.en: Squeeze to the front a bit.
Very popular/viral on the internet recently.
Like a sea of stars, so romantic.

passage.zh: 今天是個陽光明媚的週日。大安森林公園的草地上坐滿了人。舞台上的音響效果非常震撼。歌手在台上賣力地演唱，歌迷們在台下熱情地歡呼。馬克和安娜享受了一場難忘的視聽盛宴。

grammar.explanation: 使用 '火紅' 形容受歡迎的程度。'感染力' 常用於描述藝術表現或情緒的傳播。'得要命' 是強烈的程度補語。
examples: 這則新聞在網路上火紅。 (This news is viral on the internet.)
他的演講很有感染力。 (His speech is very infectious/persuasive.)
今天熱得要命。 (Today is extremely hot.)
造型獨特 (Unique styling)
視聽盛宴 (Audiovisual feast)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你有去昨晚的校園歌唱大賽嗎？聽說現場氣氛超熱烈的。
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ yǒu qù zuó wǎn de xué yuán gē chàng dà sài ma? tīng shuō xiàn chǎng qì fēn chāo rè liè de.
expansion_dialogue.en: Did you go to the campus singing competition last night? I heard the live atmosphere was super intense/heated.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 我有去！特別是冠軍出來的那一刻，全場都在尖叫。
expansion_dialogue.py: wǒ yǒu qù! tè bié shì guàn jūn chū lái de nà yī kè, quán chǎng dōu zài jiān jiào.
expansion_dialogue.en: I did! Especially at the moment the champion came out, the whole place was screaming.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 哇，我真後悔沒去。我昨晚在宿舍趕作業，忙得要命。
expansion_dialogue.py: wa, wǒ zhēn hòu huǐ méi qù. wǒ zuó wǎn zài sù shè gǎn zuò yè, máng de yào mìng.
expansion_dialogue.en: Wow, I really regret not going. I was rushing homework in the dorm last night, busy to death.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B

expansion_dialogue.py: méi wèn tí, wǒ yǒu lù yǐng. děng děng chuán gěi nǐ, ràng nǐ gǎn shòu yī xià nà zhǒng xuàn rǎn lì.
expansion_dialogue.en: No problem, I have a recording. I'll send it to you later to let you feel that infectiousness.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 太好了，謝啦！
expansion_dialogue.py: tài hǎo le, xiè la!
expansion_dialogue.en: Great, thanks!

title: Reading a Book
story_description: 馬克在圖書館看到莉莉正在讀一本中文小說。他們開始討論閱讀的習慣、喜歡的書籍類型，以及如何透過閱讀提升語言能力。
story_intro: 馬克想找一本適合他的中文讀物。
他看到莉莉正專心地讀著一本厚厚的書。
莉莉向他推薦了一本有趣且簡單的小說。
他們分享了閱讀帶來的樂趣。
馬克決定挑戰自己，每天讀五頁中文書。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 莉莉，你在讀什麼書？看你讀得這麼入迷，連我走過來都沒發現。
dialogue.py: lì lì, nǐ zài dú shén me shū? kàn nǐ dú de zhè me rù mí, lián wǒ zǒu guò lái dōu méi fā xiàn.
dialogue.en: Lily, what book are you reading? Seeing you read so absorbedly, you didn't even notice me walking over.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 是一本當代文學小說。作者的文筆非常優美，故事的情節也很吸引人。
dialogue.py: shì yī běn dāng dài wén xué xiǎo shuō. zuò zhě de wén bǐ fēi cháng yōu měi, gù shì de qíng jié yě hěn xī yǐn rén.
dialogue.en: It's a contemporary literature novel. The author's writing style is very beautiful, and the story plot is also very attractive.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 文學小說啊...對我來說可能太難了。我現在只看得懂有插圖的繪本或漫畫。
dialogue.py: wén xué xiǎo shuō a... duì wǒ lái shuō kě néng tài nán le. wǒ xiàn zài zhǐ kàn de dǒng yǒu chā tú de huì běn huò màn huà.
dialogue.en: Literature novels... might be too hard for me. I can only understand picture books with illustrations or comics right now.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 別灰心。其實閱讀是累積詞彙最快的方法。你可以從『分級讀物』開始。
dialogue.py: bié huī xīn. qí shí yuè dú shì lěi jī cí huì zuì kuài de fāng fǎ. nǐ kě yǐ cóng 'fēn jí dú wù' kāi shǐ.
dialogue.en: Don't lose heart. Actually, reading is the fastest method to accumulate vocabulary. You can start with 'graded readers'.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 分級讀物？那是什麼？
dialogue.py: fēn jí dú wù? nà shì shén me?
dialogue.en: Graded readers? What are those?

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 就是專門為語言學習者編寫的書，會根據你的程度來控制詞彙的難度。
dialogue.py: jiù shì zhuān mén wèi yǔ yán xué xí zhě biān xiě de shū, huì gēn jù nǐ de chéng dù lái kòng zhì cí huì de nán dù.
dialogue.en: They are books specifically compiled for language learners; the difficulty of vocabulary is controlled according to your level.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 聽起來很實用。你有推薦的嗎？我喜歡冒險或懸疑類的故事。
dialogue.py: tīng qǐ lái hěn shí yòng. nǐ yǒu tuī jiàn de ma? wǒ xǐ huān mào xiǎn huò xuán yí lèi de gù shì.
dialogue.en: Sounds very practical. Do you have any recommendations? I like adventure or suspenseful stories.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 這本《小鎮秘密》應該很適合你。它雖然是 A2 程度，但情節設計得很巧妙，會讓人想一直讀下去。
dialogue.py: zhè běn 'xiǎo zhèn mì mì' yīng gāi hěn shì hé nǐ. tā suī rán shì A2 chéng dù, dàn qíng jié shè jì de hěn qiǎo miào, huì ràng rén xiǎng yī zhí dú xià qù.
dialogue.en: This 'Secret of the Small Town' should be very suitable for you. Although it's A2 level, the plot is designed very ingeniously; it makes you want to keep reading.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 太好了！閱讀時遇到不會的字，你建議馬上查字典嗎？
dialogue.py: tài hǎo le! yuè dú shí yù dào bú huì de zì, nǐ jiàn yì mǎ shàng chá zì diǎn ma?
dialogue.en: Great! When encountering words you don't know while reading, do you suggest checking the dictionary immediately?

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 我不建議每字必查。你可以先試著從上下文猜測意思。這樣才不會打斷閱讀的流暢度。
dialogue.py: wǒ bù jiàn yì měi zì bì chá. nǐ kě yǐ xiān shì zhe cóng shàng xià wén cāi cè yì si. zhè yàng cái bú huì dǎ duàn yuè dú de liú chàng dù.
dialogue.en: I don't suggest checking every word. You can first try to guess the meaning from the context. This way the fluency of reading won't be interrupted.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 有道理。如果一直查字典，可能讀兩頁就想睡覺了。
dialogue.py: yǒu dào lǐ. rú guǒ yī zhí chá zì diǎn, kě néng dú liǎng yè jiù xiǎng shuì jiào le.
dialogue.en: Makes sense. If you keep checking the dictionary, you might want to sleep after reading two pages.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 沒錯。養成閱讀習慣很重要。我每天睡前都會讀半小時，這是我最享受的時光。
dialogue.py: méi cuò. yǎng chéng yuè dú xí guàn zhòng yào. wǒ měi tiān shuì qián dōu huì dú bàn xiǎo shí, zhè shì wǒ zuì xiǎng shòu de shí guāng.
dialogue.en: Exactly. Developing a reading habit is important. I read for half an hour every night before bed; this is the time I enjoy most.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我也要開始挑戰自己。從今天起，我每天讀五頁這本小說。
dialogue.py: wǒ yě yào kāi shǐ tiǎo zhàn zì jǐ. cóng jīn tiān qǐ, wǒ měi tiān dú wǔ yè zhè běn xiǎo shuō.
dialogue.en: I also want to start challenging myself. Starting from today, I'll read five pages of this novel every day.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 好啊，讀完之後我們可以一起討論心得。這也是練習口說的好機會。
dialogue.py: hǎo a, dú wán zhī hòu wǒ men kě yǐ yī qǐ tǎo lùn xīn dé. zhè yě shì liàn xí kǒu shuō de hǎo jī huì.
dialogue.en: Sure, after finishing we can discuss our reflections together. This is also a good opportunity to practice speaking.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 沒問題！謝謝你的推薦。
dialogue.py: méi wèn tí! xiè xie nǐ de tuī jiàn.
dialogue.en: No problem! Thank you for your recommendation.

key_sentences.en: Read so absorbedly / lost in the book.
This novel is very suitable for you.

speaking.part_b: Role-play: 你去書店找書。你告訴店員你喜歡懸疑故事，但你的中文程度只有 A2。店員推薦你一套分級讀物，並建議你試著從上下文猜測意思。你決定買一本來挑戰自己。

莉莉和馬克打算讀完後一起討論心得。

passage.title: Reading a Book Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克想找一本適合他的中文讀物。他看到莉莉正專心地讀著一本厚厚的書。莉莉向他推薦了一本有趣且簡單的小說。他們分享了閱讀帶來的樂趣。馬克決定挑戰自己，每天讀五頁中文書。
passage.en: Lily, what book are you reading? Seeing you read so absorbedly, you didn't even notice me walking over. It's a contemporary literature novel. The author's writing style is very beautiful, and the story plot is also very attractive. Literature novels... might be too hard for me. I can only understand picture books with illustrations or comics right now. Don't lose heart. Actually, reading is the fastest method to accumulate vocabulary. You can start with 'graded readers'. Graded readers? What are those? They are books specifically compiled for language learners; the difficulty of vocabulary is controlled according to your level. Sounds very practical. Do you have any recommendations? I like adventure or suspenseful stories.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫 70 到 100 個字，推薦一本你最近讀過的書。這本書的主題是什麼？你為什麼喜歡它？這本書適合什麼程度的讀者？

grammar.explanation: 使用 '入迷' 形容對某事的強烈興趣。'分級讀物' 是語言學習的專業術語。'心得' 是指學習或體驗後的回報與感受。
examples: 他看電視看入迷了。 (He was absorbed in watching TV.)
這份心得寫得很深刻。 (This reflection is written very deeply.)
我們要累積經驗。 (We need to accumulate experience.)
文筆優美 (Beautiful writing style)
巧妙設計 (Cleverly designed)

practice.q: Complete: 他很有文___。 (Literary talent/writing style.)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 我買了你推薦的那本《小鎮秘密》，但我發現還是有很多生字。
expansion_dialogue.py: wǒ mǎi le nǐ tuī jiàn de nà běn 'xiǎo zhèn mì mì', dàn wǒ fā xiàn hái shì yǒu hěn duō shēng zì.
expansion_dialogue.en: I bought that 'Secret of the Small Town' you recommended, but I found there are still many new words.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 別擔心，這很正常。你可以把重複出現的字標記起來，那些才是最重要的核心詞彙。
expansion_dialogue.py: bié dān xīn, zhè hěn zhèng cháng. nǐ kě yǐ bǎ chóng fù chū xiàn de zì biāo jì qǐ lái, nà xiē cái shì zuì zhòng yào de hé xīn cí huì.
expansion_dialogue.en: Don't worry, this is normal. You can mark the words that appear repeatedly; those are the most important core vocabulary.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 好主意。我發現有些字雖然不認識，但猜得出大概的意思，故事還是能讀下去。
expansion_dialogue.py: hǎo zhǔ yì. wǒ fā xiàn yǒu xiē zì suī rán bù rèn shi, dàn cāi de chū dà gài de yì si, gù shì hái shì néng dú xià qù.
expansion_dialogue.en: Good idea. I found that although I don't know some words, I can guess the general meaning, and the story can still be read through.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 這就是進步的開始！只要堅持讀完第一本，後面的書就會越來越輕鬆。
expansion_dialogue.py: zhè jiù shì jìn bù de kāi shǐ! zhǐ yào jiān chí dú wán dì yī běn, hòu miàn de shū jiù huì yuè lái yuè qīng sōng.
expansion_dialogue.en: This is the beginning of progress! As long as you persist in finishing the first book, the books after will become easier and easier.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 希望如此！我會加油的。
expansion_dialogue.py: xī wàng rú cǐ! wǒ huì jiā yóu de.
expansion_dialogue.en: I hope so! I'll go for it.

review.speaking: Recommend a book to a friend and explain why it is suitable for their level in Chinese.
review.writing: Write a 70-word summary of a book you recently read and your thoughts on it.
review.self_check: 你能用中文討論閱讀（入迷）、推薦『分級讀物』並分享『心得』嗎？

title: At the Bookstore
story_description: 馬克來到一家大型書店，希望能找到適合他目前中文程度的『分級讀物』。他向店員尋求專業的推薦，並詢問是否有暢銷排行榜。
story_intro: 書店裡安靜而溫馨，充滿了書香味。
馬克在架子前徘徊，有些不知所措。
他決定請店員幫忙挑選。
他想找故事性強且詞彙不過於艱澀的書。
他發現現在有很多專門為外國人設計的中文讀物。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你好，我想請問一下，你們有專門給外國人的中文『分級讀物』嗎？
dialogue.py: nǐ hǎo, wǒ xiǎng qǐng wèn yī xià, nǐ men yǒu zhuān mén gěi wài guó rén de zhōng wén 'fēn jí dú wù' ma?
dialogue.en: Hello, I'd like to ask, do you have Chinese 'graded readers' specifically for foreigners?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 有的，請跟我往這邊走。這整區都是語言學習和分級讀物區。
dialogue.py: yǒu de, qǐng gēn wǒ wǎng zhè biān zǒu. zhè zhěng qū dōu shì yǔ yán xué xí hé fēn jí dú wù qū.
dialogue.en: Yes, please come this way. This whole section is for language learning and graded readers.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。這裡的書真的很多。我目前的程度大約是 A2，有什麼推薦的系列嗎？
dialogue.py: xiè xie. zhè lǐ de shū zhēn de hěn duō. wǒ mù qián de chéng dù dà yuē shì A2, yǒu shén me tuī jiàn de xì liè ma?
dialogue.en: Thank you. There are really a lot of books here. My current level is about A2; any recommended series?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 我推薦《當代漢語故事》系列。這套書的詞彙量控制得很精準，而且故事非常貼近現代生活。
dialogue.py: wǒ tuī jiàn 'dāng dài hàn yǔ gù shì' xì liè. zhè tào shū de cí huì liàng kòng zhì de hěn jīng zhǔn, ér qiě gù shì fēi cháng tiē jìn xiàn dài shēng huó.
dialogue.en: I recommend the 'Contemporary Chinese Stories' series. The vocabulary in this series is controlled very precisely, and the stories are very close to modern life.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 這系列看起來不錯。除了學習書，你們有最近的『暢銷書排行榜』嗎？我想看看台灣人都在讀什麼。
dialogue.py: zhè xì liè kàn qǐ lái bù cuò. chú le xué xí shū, nǐ men yǒu zuì jìn de 'chàng xiāo shū pái háng bǎng' ma? wǒ xiǎng kàn kan tái wān rén dōu zài dú shén me.
dialogue.en: This series looks good. Besides study books, do you have the recent 'bestseller list'? I want to see what Taiwanese people are reading.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 有的。這週的第一名是一本關於『職場溝通技巧』的心理學書籍。如果您對這個主題感興趣，也可以參考看看。
dialogue.py: yǒu de. zhè zhōu de dì yī míng shì yī běn guān yú 'zhí chǎng gōu tōng jì qiǎo' de xīn lǐ xué shū jí. rú guǒ nín duì zhè ge zhǔ tí gǎn xìng qù, yě kě yǐ cān kǎo kàn kan.
dialogue.en: Yes. This week's number one is a psychology book about 'workplace communication skills'. If you're interested in this topic, you can also take a look.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 職場溝通啊...對我來說可能還有點太早，我的商業詞彙還不夠。
dialogue.py: zhí chǎng gōu tōng a... duì wǒ lái shuō kě néng hái yǒu diǎn tài zǎo, wǒ de shāng yè cí huì hái bù gòu.
dialogue.en: Workplace communication... might be a bit too early for me; my business vocabulary isn't enough yet.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 那您可以看看這本繪本，雖然它是給青少年看的，但它的插圖非常精美，文字也很優美。
dialogue.py: nà nín kě yǐ kàn kan zhè běn huì běn, suī rán tā shì gěi qīng shào nián kàn de, dàn tā de chā tú fēi cháng jīng měi, wén zì yě hěn yōu měi.
dialogue.en: Then you can look at this picture book; although it's for teenagers, its illustrations are very exquisite and the text is also very beautiful.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 這本我很喜歡！主題是關於環境保護的。請問這本有折扣嗎？
dialogue.py: zhè běn wǒ hěn xǐ huān! zhǔ tí shì guān yú huán jìng bǎo hù de. qǐng wèn zhè běn yǒu zhé kòu ma?
dialogue.en: I like this one very much! The theme is about environmental protection. Does this one have a discount?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 有的，目前新書都有七九折優惠。如果您辦理會員卡，還可以積點換贈品。
dialogue.py: yǒu de, mù qián xīn shū dōu yǒu qī jiǔ zhé yōu huì. rú guǒ nín bàn lǐ huì yuán kǎ, hái kě yǐ jī diǎn huàn zèng pǐn.
dialogue.en: Yes, currently all new books have a 21% discount (79% of original price). If you apply for a membership card, you can also accumulate points to exchange for gifts.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好，我想辦一張會員卡。對了，這附近有坐下來讀書的地方嗎？
dialogue.py: hǎo, wǒ xiǎng bàn yī zhāng huì yuán kǎ. duì le, zhè fù jìn yǒu zuò xià lái dú shū de dì fāng ma?
dialogue.en: Okay, I'd like to apply for a membership card. By the way, is there a place to sit down and read nearby?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 二樓有一家附設的咖啡廳，買完書後您可以去那裡慢慢享受閱讀。
dialogue.py: èr lóu yǒu yī jiā fù shè de kā fēi tīng, mǎi wán shū hòu nín kě yǐ qù nà lǐ màn màn xiǎng shòu yuè dú.
dialogue.en: There's an attached coffee shop on the second floor; after buying the books, you can go there and slowly enjoy reading.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 太完美了。那我買這本繪本和剛才那套分級讀物的第一冊。
dialogue.py: tài wán měi le. nà wǒ mǎi zhè běn huì běn hé gāng cái nà tào fēn jí dú wù de dì yī cè.
dialogue.en: Perfect. Then I'll buy this picture book and the first volume of that graded reader series.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.zh: 好的，請跟我到櫃檯結帳。祝您閱讀愉快！
dialogue.py: hǎo de, qǐng gēn wǒ dào guì tái jié zhàng. zhù nín yuè dú yú kuài!
dialogue.en: Okay, please follow me to the counter to check out. Wish you a happy reading!

key_sentences.en: Accumulate points to exchange for gifts.

vocabulary.meaning: to pace back and forth / linger
to be at a loss / not knowing what to do

speaking.part_b: Role-play: 你去書店幫朋友買生日禮物。你告訴店員朋友喜歡推理小說。店員指著排行榜上的新書，並告訴你這本現在打八折。你決定買下它並請店員包裝。
part_c: 你喜歡去書店還是網上買書？為什麼？
你覺得繪本適合大人讀嗎？為什麼？

comprehension.q: 馬克去書店想找什麼樣的書？
options: B. 適合外國人的中文分級讀物

comprehension.q: 店員推薦的系列有什麼優點？
options: A. 詞彙精準且貼近生活

comprehension.q: 馬克為什麼暫時不想看職場溝通的書？
options: B. 他的商業詞彙還不夠

comprehension.q: 那本環境保護的繪本目前的優惠是多少？
馬克打算買完書後去哪裡？
options: B. 二樓附設的咖啡廳

true_false.q: 馬克現在的中文程度大約是 A2。
排行榜的第一名是一本食譜。
辦理會員卡可以積點換贈品。
店員推薦了一本青少年繪本給馬克。
馬克最後決定買了三本書。

passage.title: At the Bookstore Listening Passage
passage.zh: 書店裡安靜而溫馨，充滿了書香味。馬克在架子前徘徊，有些不知所措。他決定請店員幫忙挑選。他想找故事性強且詞彙不過於艱澀的書。他發現現在有很多專門為外國人設計的中文讀物。
passage.en: Hello, I'd like to ask, do you have Chinese 'graded readers' specifically for foreigners? Yes, please come this way. This whole section is for language learning and graded readers. Thank you. There are really a lot of books here. My current level is about A2; any recommended series? I recommend the 'Contemporary Chinese Stories' series. The vocabulary in this series is controlled very precisely, and the stories are very close to modern life. This series looks good. Besides study books, do you have the recent 'bestseller list'? I want to see what Taiwanese people are reading. Yes. This week's number one is a psychology book about 'workplace communication skills'. If you're interested in this topic, you can also take a look. Workplace communication... might be a bit too early for me; my business vocabulary isn't enough yet.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫 70 到 100 個字。描述你最喜歡的一家書店。它的環境如何？你有在那裡買過什麼印象深刻的書嗎？你覺得逛書店的樂趣是什麼？

grammar.explanation: 使用 '...區' 表示特定的區域。'貼近' 常用於描述抽象事物與現實的接近。'七九折' 在中文中表示原價的 79%，即 21% off。
examples: 這裡有美食區和服裝區。 (Here are a food area and a clothing area.)
他的演講很貼近人心。 (His speech is very close to people's hearts.)
這件衣服打八五折。 (This dress is 15% off.)
辦理會員 (Apply for membership)
暢銷排行榜 (Bestseller list)

practice.q: Complete: 打八折是便宜了百分之___。 (20.)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 這本雜誌怎麼賣？封面上寫著『特價』。
expansion_dialogue.py: zhè běn zá zhì zěn me mài? fēng miàn shàng xiě zhe 'tè jià'.
expansion_dialogue.en: How much is this magazine? The cover says 'special price'.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 那本特價九十九元。不過每人限購一本喔。
expansion_dialogue.py: nà běn tè jià jiǔ shí jiǔ yuán. bù guò měi rén xiàn gòu yī běn ō.
expansion_dialogue.en: That one is a special price of 99 dollars. However, it's limited to one per person.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 太便宜了！那我也要幫我室友買一本，可以嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: tài pián yi le! nà wǒ yě yào bāng wǒ shì yǒu mǎi yī běn, kě yǐ ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: Too cheap! Then I also want to buy one for my roommate, is that okay?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 如果您們分開結帳，那是可以的。
expansion_dialogue.py: rú guǒ nín men fēn kāi jié zhàng, nà shì kě yǐ de.
expansion_dialogue.en: If you check out separately, then it's okay.

review.speaking: Ask a clerk for a book recommendation based on your interests and level in Chinese.
review.writing: Write a 70-word description of your favorite bookstore section.
review.self_check: 你能用中文詢問『分級讀物』、理解折扣（七九折）並表達對繪本的興趣嗎？

title: Talking About Hobbies
story_description: 馬克和大衛在放學後聊天，發現他們雖然性格不同，但對生活都有很多熱情。他們互相分享了自己的愛好以及這些愛好帶來的成就感。
story_intro: 馬克注意到大衛包包裡有一台專業相機。
大衛其實是一位業餘攝影師。
馬克則對烹飪非常有研究。
他們分享了在愛好中投入的時間和金錢。
他們發現擁有一個愛好能讓生活變得多采多姿。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 大衛，這台相機看起來很專業耶。你平常喜歡拍照嗎？
dialogue.py: dà wèi, zhè tái xiàng jī kàn qǐ lái hěn zhuān yè ye. nǐ píng cháng xǐ huān pāi zhào ma?
dialogue.en: David, this camera looks very professional. Do you usually like taking photos?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 對，攝影是我的頭號愛好。我週末常去郊外拍一些風景或野生動物。
dialogue.py: duì, shè yǐng shì wǒ de tóu hào ài hào. wǒ zhōu mò cháng qù jiāo wài pāi yī xiē fēng jǐng huò yě shēng dòng wù.
dialogue.en: Yes, photography is my number one hobby. I often go to the countryside on weekends to shoot some landscapes or wildlife.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 哇，那很有趣！那你一定累積了很多漂亮的作品吧？
dialogue.py: wa, nà hěn yǒu qù! nà nǐ yī dìng lěi jī le hěn duō piào liang de zuò pǐn ba?
dialogue.en: Wow, that's interesting! Then you must have accumulated many beautiful works?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 還行吧，還在學習中。攝影讓我學會觀察生活中微小的美。那你呢？你放假都做什麼？
dialogue.py: hái xíng ba, hái zài xué xí zhōng. shè yǐng ràng wǒ xué huì guān chá shēng huó zhōng wēi xiǎo de měi. nà nǐ ne? nǐ fàng jià dōu zuò shén me?
dialogue.en: It's okay, still learning. Photography taught me to observe the tiny beauties in life. What about you? What do you do on holidays?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我對烹飪非常有熱情。我喜歡嘗試各種不同的食譜，特別是法式料理。
dialogue.py: wǒ duì pēng rèn fēi cháng yǒu rè qíng. wǒ xǐ huān cháng shì gè zhǒng bù tóng de shí pǔ, tè bié shì fǎ shì liào lǐ.
dialogue.en: I'm very passionate about cooking. I like to try all kinds of different recipes, especially French cuisine.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 法式料理？那很考驗耐心和技巧喔！你覺得烹飪最吸引你的地方是什麼？
dialogue.py: fǎ shì liào lǐ? nà hěn kǎo yàn nài xīn hé jì qiǎo ō! nǐ jué de pēng rèn zuì xī yǐn nǐ de dì fāng shì shén me?
dialogue.en: French cuisine? That really tests patience and skill! What do you think is the most attractive part of cooking?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我覺得是那種『從無到有』的成就感。特別是看到朋友們把我做的菜吃光，我會覺得一切努力都值得了。
dialogue.py: wǒ jué de shì nà zhǒng 'cóng wú dào yǒu' de chéng jiù gǎn. tè bié shì kàn dào péng you men bǎ wǒ zuò de cài chī guāng, wǒ huì jué de yī qiè nǔ lì dōu zhí de le.
dialogue.en: I think it's that 'from scratch (nothing to something)' sense of achievement. Especially seeing friends eat all the food I made, I feel all the effort was worth it.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 完全同意！攝影也是。當你拍到一張完美的瞬間，那種快樂是無法形容的。
dialogue.py: wán quán tóng yì! shè yǐng yě shì. dāng nǐ pāi dào yī zhāng wán měi de shùn jiān, nà zhǒng kuài lè shì wú fǎ xíng róng de.
dialogue.en: Completely agree! Photography is the same. When you capture a perfect moment, that kind of happiness is indescribable.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 不過愛好有時候也很花錢。我最近想買一套新的專業廚具，但價格超出了我的預算。
dialogue.py: bù guò ài hào yǒu shí hou yě hěn huā qián. wǒ zuì jìn xiǎng mǎi yī tào xīn de zhuān yè chú jù, dàn jià gé chāo chū le wǒ de yù suàn.
dialogue.en: But hobbies are sometimes expensive too. I recently want to buy a new set of professional cookware, but the price exceeded my budget.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 我懂。鏡頭也是，隨便一個都要好幾萬。所以我們得更努力工作才行。
dialogue.py: wǒ dǒng. jìng tóu yě shì, suí biàn yī gè dōu yào hǎo jǐ wàn. suǒ yǐ wǒ men děi gèng nǔ lì gōng zuò cái xíng.
dialogue.en: I get it. Lenses too; any random one costs tens of thousands. So we have to work harder.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 對了，你有攝影作品集嗎？我想觀摩一下。
dialogue.py: duì le, nǐ yǒu shè yǐng zuò pǐn jí ma? wǒ xiǎng guān mó yī xià.
dialogue.en: By the way, do you have a photography portfolio? I want to take a look and learn.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 有的，我放在個人的網站上。等一下傳連結給你。下次你做大餐，我也可以去幫你拍照。
dialogue.py: yǒu de, wǒ fàng zài gè rén de wǎng zhàn shàng. děng yī xià chuán lián jié gěi nǐ. xià cì nǐ zuò dà cān, wǒ yě kě yǐ qù bāng nǐ pāi zhào.
dialogue.en: Yes, I put it on my personal website. I'll send the link to you later. Next time you make a big meal, I can also go help you take photos.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好主意！這叫『強強聯手』。我負責煮，你負責拍。
dialogue.py: hǎo zhǔ yì! zhè jiào 'qiáng qiáng lián shǒu'. wǒ fù zé zhǔ, nǐ fù zé pāi.
dialogue.en: Good idea! This is called 'strong partnership (joining forces)'. I'm responsible for cooking, you're responsible for shooting.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 一言為定！
dialogue.py: yī yán wéi dìng!
dialogue.en: It's a deal!

key_sentences.en: Photography is my number one hobby.
A sense of achievement from nothing to something.
I'd like to observe and learn.

vocabulary.meaning: to observe and learn from each other

speaking.part_b: Role-play: 你告訴朋友你的愛好是彈吉他。朋友問你學了多久，你說學了兩年，每天練習一小時。朋友說他也喜歡音樂，想觀摩一下你的表演。你答應下次錄影傳連結給他。
part_c: 你有什麼愛好是很花錢的嗎？你覺得值得嗎？
如果你可以選擇一個新愛好，你會選什麼？為什麼？

comprehension.q: 大衛的『頭號愛好』是什麼？
大衛週末通常去哪裡拍照？
馬克對什麼事情非常有熱情？
馬克覺得烹飪最吸引他的地方是什麼？
大衛打算如何幫助馬克？
options: B. 在馬克做大餐時幫他拍照

true_false.q: 大衛覺得攝影讓他學會觀察微小的美。
馬克覺得愛好一點都不花錢。
大衛的作品集放在個人的網站上。
馬克最近想買一套新的專業攝影鏡頭。
他們決定『強強聯手』，馬克煮菜大衛拍。

passage.title: Talking About Hobbies Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克注意到大衛包包裡有一台專業相機。大衛其實是一位業餘攝影師。馬克則對烹飪非常有研究。他們分享了在愛好中投入的時間和金錢。他們發現擁有一個愛好能讓生活變得多采多姿。
passage.en: David, this camera looks very professional. Do you usually like taking photos? Yes, photography is my number one hobby. I often go to the countryside on weekends to shoot some landscapes or wildlife. Wow, that's interesting! Then you must have accumulated many beautiful works? It's okay, still learning. Photography taught me to observe the tiny beauties in life. What about you? What do you do on holidays? I'm very passionate about cooking. I like to try all kinds of different recipes, especially French cuisine. French cuisine? That really tests patience and skill! What do you think is the most attractive part of cooking? I think it's that 'from scratch (nothing to something)' sense of achievement. Especially seeing friends eat all the food I made, I feel all the effort was worth it.

grammar.explanation: 使用 '從無到有' 描述創造的過程。'無法形容' 是強烈的形容方式。'強強聯手' 形容兩個有能力的人或團體合作。
examples: 他白手起家，從無到有建立了這家公司。 (He started from scratch and built this company.)
那裡的風景美得無法形容。 (The scenery there is indescribably beautiful.)

投入時間 (Invest time)
觀察生活 (Observe life)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你看，這是我昨天拍的雲海。我覺得光線抓得很好。
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ kàn, zhè shì wǒ zuó wǎn pāi de yún hǎi. wǒ jué de guāng xiàn zhuā de hěn hǎo.
expansion_dialogue.en: Look, this is the sea of clouds I took last night. I think the light was captured very well.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 哇！這張真的可以去參加比賽了。你是用什麼模式拍的？
expansion_dialogue.py: wa! zhè zhāng zhēn de kě yǐ qù cān jiā bǐ sài le. nǐ shì yòng shén me mó shì pāi de?
expansion_dialogue.en: Wow! This one can really enter a competition. What mode did you use to shoot?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 我用的是手動模式。雖然比較麻煩，但能拍出我想要的感覺。
expansion_dialogue.py: wǒ yòng de shì shǒu dòng mó shì. suī rán bǐ jiào má fan, dàn néng pāi chū wǒ xiǎng yào de gǎn jué.
expansion_dialogue.en: I used manual mode. Although it's more troublesome, it can produce the feeling I want.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 果然是專業的。我也想學，下次外拍能帶上我嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: guǒ rán shì zhuān yè de. wǒ yě xiǎng xué, xià cì wài pāi néng dài shàng wǒ ma?
expansion_dialogue.en: As expected of a professional. I want to learn too; can you take me along on your next outdoor shoot?

title: Trying a New Hobby
story_description: 馬克決定跨出舒適圈，報名了一堂『手工陶藝體驗課』。他從未接觸過陶土，感到既緊張又期待。在老師的引導下，他完成了人生中第一個手作杯子。
story_intro: 馬克今天來到一家溫馨的陶藝工作室。
桌上擺滿了濕潤的陶土和各種工具。
馬克擔心自己沒有藝術細胞，會搞砸一切。
老師溫柔地鼓勵他，並示範了基本的技巧。
經過兩小時的努力，馬克感受到手作的魅力。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 老師你好，我是今天報名體驗課的馬克。這是我第一次玩陶土，有點緊張。
dialogue.py: lǎo shī nǐ hǎo, wǒ shì jīn tiān bào míng tǐ yàn kè de mǎ kè. zhè shì wǒ dì yī cì wán táo tǔ, yǒu diǎn jǐn zhāng.
dialogue.en: Hello Teacher, I'm Mark, signed up for today's trial class. This is my first time playing with clay; I'm a bit nervous.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 馬克你好！放輕鬆。玩陶土就是要享受觸摸泥土的過程。你今天想做什麼呢？
dialogue.py: mǎ kè nǐ hǎo! fàng qīng sōng. wán táo tǔ jiù shì yào xiǎng shòu chù mō ní tǔ de guò chéng. nǐ jīn tiān xiǎng zuò shén me ne?
dialogue.en: Hello Mark! Relax. Playing with clay is about enjoying the process of touching the mud. What do you want to make today?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我想做一個簡單的馬克杯，送給我自己。我怕我的手太笨，做出來很醜。
dialogue.py: wǒ xiǎng zuò yī gè jiǎn dān de mǎ kè bēi, sòng gěi wǒ zì jǐ. wǒ pà wǒ de shǒu tài bèn, zuò chū lái hěn chǒu.
dialogue.en: I want to make a simple mug for myself. I'm afraid my hands are too clumsy and it'll turn out ugly.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 別這麼說。手作的魅力就在於那種『不完美』的自然感。我們先從捏出底部開始。
dialogue.py: bié zhè me shuō. shǒu zuò de mèi lì jiù zài yú nà zhǒng 'bù wán měi' de zì rán gǎn. wǒ men xiān cóng niē chū dǐ bù kāi shǐ.
dialogue.en: Don't say that. The charm of handmade is exactly in that 'imperfect' natural feel. Let's start by pinching out the bottom.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的。（開始動手）這陶土比我想像中還要濕潤，而且很有彈性。
dialogue.py: hǎo de. (kāi shǐ dòng shǒu) zhè táo tǔ bǐ wǒ xiǎng xiàng zhōng hái yào shī rùn, ér qiě hěn yǒu tán xìng.
dialogue.en: Okay. (Starts working) This clay is even moister than I imagined, and very elastic.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 沒錯。現在我們要把它拉高，力道要均勻。如果太用力，杯壁會破掉喔。
dialogue.py: méi cuò. xiàn zài wǒ men yào bǎ tā lā gāo, lì dào yào jūn yún. rú guǒ tài yòng lì, bēi bì huì pò diào ō.
dialogue.en: Exactly. Now we need to pull it high; the force must be even. If you use too much force, the cup wall will break.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: （小心翼翼地）哎呀，形狀歪了！老師快幫我救一下！
dialogue.py: (xiǎo xīn yì yì de) āi yā, xíng zhuàng wāi le! lǎo shī kuài bāng wǒ jiù yī xià!
dialogue.en: (Carefully) Oh no, the shape is crooked! Teacher, help me save it quick!

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 沒事，陶土的好處就是可以重來。我們把它壓扁，再重新拉一次。要有耐心。
dialogue.py: méi shì, táo tǔ de hǎo chù jiù shì kě yǐ chóng lái. wǒ men bǎ tā yā biǎn, zài chóng xīn lā yī cì. yào yǒu nài xīn.
dialogue.en: It's fine; the benefit of clay is that it can be redone. Let's flatten it and pull it again. Have patience.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 呼...這真的很需要專注力。我現在腦子裡什麼都不想，只盯著這塊土。
dialogue.py: hū... zhè zhēn de hěn xū yào zhuān zhù lì. wǒ xiàn zài nǎo zi lǐ shén me dōu bù xiǎng, zhǐ dīng zhe zhè kuài tǔ.
dialogue.en: Phew... this really needs concentration. My brain is thinking of nothing right now, just staring at this piece of clay.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 這就是陶藝的『療癒』之處。很多人來這裡就是為了放鬆心情，暫時忘掉煩惱。
dialogue.py: zhè jiù shì táo yì de 'liáo yù' zhī chù. hěn duō rén lái zhè lǐ jiù shì wèi le fàng sōng xīn qíng, zàn shí wàng diào fán nǎo.
dialogue.en: This is the 'healing' aspect of pottery. Many people come here just to relax and temporarily forget their worries.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: （終於完成杯身）看！雖然杯口有點不平，但這是我親手做的第一個杯子！
dialogue.py: (zhōng yú wán chéng bēi shēn) kàn! suī rán bēi kǒu yǒu diǎn bù píng, dàn zhè shì wǒ qīn shǒu zuò de dì yī gè bēi zi!
dialogue.en: (Finally finishes the cup body) Look! Although the rim is a bit uneven, this is the first cup I made with my own hands!

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 做得很好，很有個性！接下來我們要幫它裝上手把，然後風乾幾天再拿去燒。
dialogue.py: zuò de hěn hǎo, hěn yǒu gè xìng! jiē xià lái wǒ men yào bāng tā zhuāng shàng shǒu bà, rán hòu fēng gān jǐ tiān zài ná qù shāo.
dialogue.en: Well done, very individualistic! Next we'll attach a handle, then air-dry it for a few days before firing it.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我很期待看到成品！雖然過程中有點挫折，但成功的那一刻真的很有成就感。
dialogue.py: wǒ hěn qī dài kàn dào chéng pǐn! suī rán guò chéng zhōng yǒu diǎn cuò zhé, dàn chéng gōng de nà yī kè zhēn de hěn yǒu chéng jiù gǎn.
dialogue.en: I'm looking forward to seeing the finished product! Although there were some setbacks in the process, the moment of success truly brought a sense of achievement.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.zh: 歡迎你下次再來挑戰進階課程。陶藝的大門隨時為你敞開。
dialogue.py: huān yíng nǐ xià cì zài lái tiǎo zhàn jìn jiē kè chéng. táo yì de dà mén suí shí wèi nǐ chǎng kāi.
dialogue.en: You're welcome to come back next time and challenge the advanced courses. The door of pottery is always open to you.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝老師，我今天過得很充實！
dialogue.py: xiè xie lǎo shī, wǒ jīn tiān guò de hěn chōng shí!
dialogue.en: Thank you Teacher, I've had a very fulfilling day today!

key_sentences.en: Enjoy the process of touching the mud.
Although uneven, it has a lot of character.
Looking forward to seeing the finished product.

speaking.part_b: Role-play: 你去參加一堂油畫體驗課。你告訴老師你怕畫得很醜，老師鼓勵你享受色彩的過程。你畫了一朵花，雖然跟照片不像，但你覺得很浪漫。你謝謝老師的引導。
part_c: 你喜歡手作的東西嗎？為什麼？
當你學習新技能遇到挫折時，你會怎麼鼓勵自己？

comprehension.q: 老師認為手作的魅力在哪裡？

writing: 請寫 70 到 100 個字。描述一次你嘗試『第一次』做某件事的經驗（如第一次滑雪、第一次上台演講或第一次做菜）。你當時的心情如何？你學到了什麼？

grammar.explanation: 使用 '從未...' 表示以前沒有做過。'既...又...' 用於並列兩種情緒 (既緊張又期待)。'之處' 表示特點或地方。

practice.q: Translate: This is the healing part.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A

title: A Small Argument
story_description: 馬克因為打工延誤，在和莉莉約會時遲到了四十分鐘。莉莉感到被忽視，兩人發生了一場小爭論。馬克必須誠懇地道歉並尋求對方的諒解。
story_intro: 今天是馬克和莉莉約好去看展覽的日子。
莉莉在展覽館門口等了很久。
馬克滿頭大汗地跑來，卻沒有第一時間道歉。
莉莉的情緒終於爆發了。
他們學習了如何冷靜地表達感受並化解矛盾。

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 馬克，你看看現在幾點了？我已經在這裡等了你四十分鐘！
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, nǐ kàn kan xiàn zài jǐ diǎn le? wǒ yǐ jīng zài zhè lǐ děng le nǐ sì shí fèn zhòng!
dialogue.en: Mark, look at what time it is! I've been waiting for you here for forty minutes!

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 對不起，對不起！咖啡廳突然客人很多，經理不讓我走，我真的沒辦法。
dialogue.py: duì bù qǐ, duì bù qǐ! kā fēi tīng tū rán kè rén hěn duō, jīng lǐ bù ràng wǒ zǒu, wǒ zhēn de méi bàn fǎ.
dialogue.en: Sorry, sorry! The coffee shop suddenly had many guests, the manager wouldn't let me leave, I really had no choice.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 又是因為打工。你既然知道會遲到，為什麼不先傳個訊息告訴我？
dialogue.py: yòu shì yīn wèi dǎ gōng. nǐ jì rán zhī dào huì chí dào, wèi shén me bù xiān chuán gè xùn xī gào su wǒ?
dialogue.en: Part-time job again. Since you knew you'd be late, why didn't you send a message to tell me first?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我剛才太忙了，手機放在櫃檯後面的包包裡，根本沒時間拿。
dialogue.py: wǒ gāng cái tài máng le, shǒu jī fàng zài guì tái hòu miàn de bāo bāo lǐ, gēn běn méi shí jiān ná.
dialogue.en: I was too busy just now; my phone was in my bag behind the counter, I simply had no time to take it.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 這不是藉口。我覺得你根本不重視我們的約定。每次都要我等，我的時間就不重要嗎？
dialogue.py: zhè bú shì jiè kǒu. wǒ jué de nǐ gēn běn bú zhòng shì wǒ men de yuē dìng. měi cì dōu yào wǒ děng, wǒ de shí jiān jiù bù zhòng yào ma?
dialogue.en: This is not an excuse. I feel you simply don't value our engagement. Every time I have to wait; is my time not important?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 莉莉，你太誇張了吧？我不是故意的，我都已經道歉了，你還要怎樣？
dialogue.py: lì lì, nǐ tài kuā zhāng le ba? wǒ bú shì gù yì de, wǒ dōu yǐ jīng dào qiàn le, nǐ hái yào zěn yàng?
dialogue.en: Lily, you're exaggerating, right? I didn't do it on purpose; I've already apologized, what more do you want?

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 道歉要有誠意，而不是隨便說說。我覺得好累，我想回家了。
dialogue.py: dào qiàn yào yǒu chéng yì, ér bú shì suí biàn shuō shuō. wǒ jué de hǎo lèi, wǒ xiǎng huí jiā le.
dialogue.en: Apologies need sincerity, not just saying it casually. I feel so tired; I want to go home.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: （深呼吸，冷靜下來）等一下，莉莉。對不起，剛才我的語氣不好。我知道讓你等這麼久很不應該。
dialogue.py: (shēn hū xī, lěng jìng xià lái) děng yī xià, lì lì. duì bù qǐ, gāng cái wǒ de yǔ qì bù hǎo. wǒ zhī dào ràng nǐ děng zhè me jiǔ hěn bù yīng gāi.
dialogue.en: (Takes a deep breath, calms down) Wait a minute, Lily. Sorry, my tone just now was bad. I know making you wait so long is not right.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 我在乎的不是那四十分鐘，而是那種不被尊重的感覺。
dialogue.py: wǒ zài hū de bú shì nà sì shí fèn zhòng, ér shì nà zhǒng bú bèi zūn zhòng de gǎn jué.
dialogue.en: What I care about is not those forty minutes, but that feeling of not being respected.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我懂了。我保證以後如果會遲到，一定會想辦法提早聯絡你。請原諒我這一次，好嗎？
dialogue.py: wǒ dǒng le. wǒ bǎo zhèng yǐ hòu rú guǒ huì chí dào, yī dìng huì xiǎng bàn fǎ tí zǎo lián luò nǐ. qǐng yuán liàng wǒ zhè yī cì, hǎo ma?
dialogue.en: I understand. I promise in the future if I'll be late, I'll definitely find a way to contact you early. Please forgive me this once, okay?

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: （沉默了一會兒）這可是你說的喔。我不希望還有下次。
dialogue.py: (chén mò le yī huǐ er) zhè kě shì nǐ shuō de ō. wǒ bù xī wàng hái yǒu xià cì.
dialogue.en: (Silent for a while) That's what you said. I don't want there to be a next time.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 絕對不會了。為了補償你，等一下看完展覽，我請你吃你最愛的那家甜點店，好不好？
dialogue.py: jué duì bú huì le. wèi le bǔ cháng nǐ, děng yī xià kàn wán zhǎn lǎn, wǒ qǐng nǐ chī nǐ zuì ài de nà jiā tián diǎn diàn, hǎo bù hǎo?
dialogue.en: Absolutely not. To compensate you, after we finish seeing the exhibition, I'll treat you to your favorite dessert shop, okay?

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 好吧，看在甜點的份上，我原諒你了。我們快進去吧，展覽快結束了。
dialogue.py: hǎo ba, kàn zài tián diǎn de fèn shàng, wǒ yuán liàng nǐ le. wǒ men kuài jìn qù ba, zhǎn lǎn kuài jié shù le.
dialogue.en: Fine, for the sake of the dessert, I forgive you. Let's go in quick; the exhibition is ending soon.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 走吧！謝謝你的諒解。我以後會更珍惜我們相處的時間。
dialogue.py: zǒu ba! xiè xie nǐ de liàng jiě. wǒ yǐ hòu huì gèng zhēn xī wǒ men xiāng chǔ de shí jiān.
dialogue.en: Let's go! Thank you for your understanding. I will cherish our time together more in the future.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 知道就好。快跑！
dialogue.py: zhī dào jiù hǎo. kuài pǎo!
dialogue.en: Good that you know. Run!

passage.title: A Small Argument Listening Passage
passage.zh: 今天是馬克和莉莉約好去看展覽的日子。莉莉在展覽館門口等了很久。馬克滿頭大汗地跑來，卻沒有第一時間道歉。莉莉的情緒終於爆發了。他們學習了如何冷靜地表達感受並化解矛盾。
passage.en: Mark, look at what time it is! I've been waiting for you here for forty minutes! Sorry, sorry! The coffee shop suddenly had many guests, the manager wouldn't let me leave, I really had no choice. Part-time job again. Since you knew you'd be late, why didn't you send a message to tell me first? I was too busy just now; my phone was in my bag behind the counter, I simply had no time to take it. This is not an excuse. I feel you simply don't value our engagement. Every time I have to wait; is my time not important? Lily, you're exaggerating, right? I didn't do it on purpose; I've already apologized, what more do you want? Apologies need sincerity, not just saying it casually. I feel so tired; I want to go home.

grammar.explanation: 使用 '既然...為什麼不...' 表達質問。'誠意' 是社交中非常重要的詞彙。'看在...的份上' 表示基於某種理由給予寬容。
examples: 既然你知道，為什麼不告訴我？ (Since you know, why didn't you tell me?)
這份禮物代表我的誠意。 (This gift represents my sincerity.)
看在朋友的份上，我再幫你一次。 (For the sake of being friends, I'll help you once more.)
重視約定 (Value engagement)

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B

title: Review Story: Better Communication
story_description: 馬克來到台灣已經三個月了。回顧這段時間，他處理過考試壓力、管理過個人財務、解決過網購糾紛，也結交了許多志同道合的朋友。他發現，最好的溝通方式就是誠實與尊重。
story_intro: 今天是馬克這學期的最後一天。
他坐在校園的長椅上，回憶著這幾個月的點點滴滴。
從一開始的生疏，到現在能流利地和當地人溝通。
他覺得自己不僅中文進步了，心智也成熟了許多。
他決定寫一封信給未來的自己，記錄這段成長的旅程。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: （自言自語）哇，不知不覺來台灣三個月了。回想起來，這段旅程真的很充實。
dialogue.py: (zì yán zì yǔ) wa, bù zhī bù jué lái tái wān sān gè yuè le. huí xiǎng qǐ lái, zhè duàn lǚ chéng zhēn de hěn chōng shí.
dialogue.en: (Talking to himself) Wow, before I knew it, I've been in Taiwan for three months. Thinking back, this journey has been truly fulfilling.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 馬克！在發呆啊？考完試了，心情很輕鬆吧？
dialogue.py: mǎ kè! zài fā dāi a? kǎo wán shì le, xīn qíng hěn qīng sōng ba?
dialogue.en: Mark! Daydreaming? Finished the exams, feeling relaxed, right?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 對啊。我在想，剛來的時候，我連點餐都會緊張。現在我甚至能跟客服吵架換貨了。
dialogue.py: duì a. wǒ zài xiǎng, gāng lái de shí hou, wǒ lián diǎn cān dōu huì jǐn zhāng. xiàn zài wǒ shèn zhì néng gēn kè fú chǎo jià huàn huò le.
dialogue.en: Yeah. I was thinking, when I first arrived, I'd get nervous even just ordering food. Now I can even argue with customer service for an exchange.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，那是成長的表現。我還記得你為了去日本旅行，強迫自己存錢的那股狠勁。
dialogue.py: hā hā, nà shì chéng zhǎng de biǎo xiàn. wǒ hái jì de nǐ wèi le qù rì běn lǚ xíng, qiáng pò zì jǐ cún qián de nà gǔ hěn jìn.
dialogue.en: Haha, that's a sign of growth. I still remember that ruthless determination when you forced yourself to save money for the trip to Japan.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 是啊，那次理財計畫讓我學會了區分『需要』和『想要』。這對我以後的生活很有幫助。
dialogue.py: shì a, nà cì lǐ cái jì huà ràng wǒ xué huì le qū fēn 'xū yào' hé 'xiǎng yào'. zhè duì wǒ yǐ hòu de shēng huó hěn yǒu bāng zhù.
dialogue.en: True, that financial plan taught me to distinguish between 'need' and 'want'. This is very helpful for my future life.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 還有你上次在網上回覆酸民的那種冷靜，我覺得你變得很成熟，懂得『對事不對人』。
dialogue.py: hái yǒu nǐ shàng cì zài wǎng shàng huí fù suān mín de nà zhǒng lěng jìng, wǒ jué de nǐ biàn de hěn chéng shú, dǒng de 'duì shì bú duì rén'.
dialogue.en: And your calmness when replying to trolls online last time; I feel you've become very mature, knowing to 'focus on the matter, not the person'.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 那是跟你學的。其實溝通的核心就是尊重。像我上次跟莉莉吵架，也是因為我不夠重視約定。
dialogue.py: nà shì gēn nǐ xué de. qí shí gōu tōng de hé xīn jiù shì zūn zhòng. xiàng wǒ shàng cì gēn lì lì chǎo jià, yě shì yīn wèi wǒ bú gòu zhòng shì yuē dìng.
dialogue.en: I learned that from you. Actually, the core of communication is respect. Like my argument with Lily last time, it was because I didn't value our engagement enough.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 能意識到這一點，就表示你已經學會怎麼去愛和尊重別人了。
dialogue.py: néng yì shí dào zhè yī diǎn, jiù biǎo shì nǐ yǐ jīng xué huì zěn me qù ài hé zūn zhòng bié rén le.
dialogue.en: Being able to realize this point means you've already learned how to love and respect others.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 沒錯。接下來的暑假，我打算繼續精進我的陶藝和烹飪。愛好讓我的生活更有色彩。
dialogue.py: méi cuò. jiē xià lái de shǔ jià, wǒ dǎ suàn jì xù jīng jìn wǒ de táo yì hé pēng rèn. ài hào ràng wǒ de shēng huó gèng yǒu sè cǎi.
dialogue.en: Exactly. For the coming summer vacation, I plan to continue refining my pottery and cooking. Hobbies give my life more color.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 聽起來很棒！對了，你要去日本看櫻花的計畫進行得怎麼樣了？
dialogue.py: tīng qǐ lái hěn bàng! duì le, nǐ yào qù rì běn kàn yīng huā de jì huà jìn xíng de zěn me yàng le?
dialogue.en: Sounds great! By the way, how is your plan to go see cherry blossoms in Japan going?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 存款已經達標八成了！我打算暑假去打更多的工，爭取下個月就下單機票。
dialogue.py: cún kuǎn yǐ jīng dá biāo bā chéng le! wǒ dǎ suàn shǔ jià qù dǎ gèng duō de gōng, zhēng qǔ xià gè yuè jiù xià dān jī piào.
dialogue.en: Savings have already hit 80% of the target! I plan to work more part-time during summer, striving to order the flight tickets next month.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 加油！到時候記得傳照片給我觀摩喔。
dialogue.py: jiā yóu! dào shí hòu jì de chuán zhào piàn gěi wǒ guān mó ō.
dialogue.en: Go for it! Remember to send photos for me to admire then.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 一定會的。大衛，謝謝你這段時間的陪伴。你是我在台灣最好的朋友。
dialogue.py: yī dìng huì de. dà wèi, xiè xie nǐ zhè duàn shí jiān de péi bàn. nǐ shì wǒ zài tái wān zuì hǎo de péng you.
dialogue.en: I definitely will. David, thank you for your companionship during this time. You are my best friend in Taiwan.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 別感性了，這只是個開始。走，我們去慶祝一下學期結束！
dialogue.py: bié gǎn xìng le, zhè zhǐ shì gè kāi shǐ. zǒu, wǒ men qù qìng zhù yī xià xué qī jié shù!
dialogue.en: Don't get sentimental; this is just the beginning. Let's go celebrate the end of the semester!

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好！這次我請客，不超過預算的那種！
dialogue.py: hǎo! zhè cì wǒ qǐng kè, bù chāo guò yù suàn de nà zhǒng!
dialogue.en: Okay! My treat this time—the kind that doesn't exceed the budget!

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，一言為定！
dialogue.py: hā hā, yī yán wéi dìng!
dialogue.en: Haha, it's a deal!

key_sentences.en: Been here for three months before I knew it.
That is a sign of growth.
Focus on the matter, not the person.
The core of communication is respect.
Savings have hit 80% of the target.

passage.title: Review Story: Better Communication Listening Passage
passage.zh: 今天是馬克這學期的最後一天。他坐在校園的長椅上，回憶著這幾個月的點點滴滴。從一開始的生疏，到現在能流利地和當地人溝通。他覺得自己不僅中文進步了，心智也成熟了許多。他決定寫一封信給未來的自己，記錄這段成長的旅程。
passage.en: (Talking to himself) Wow, before I knew it, I've been in Taiwan for three months. Thinking back, this journey has been truly fulfilling. Mark! Daydreaming? Finished the exams, feeling relaxed, right? Yeah. I was thinking, when I first arrived, I'd get nervous even just ordering food. Now I can even argue with customer service for an exchange. Haha, that's a sign of growth. I still remember that ruthless determination when you forced yourself to save money for the trip to Japan. True, that financial plan taught me to distinguish between 'need' and 'want'. This is very helpful for my future life. And your calmness when replying to trolls online last time; I feel you've become very mature, knowing to 'focus on the matter, not the person'. I learned that from you. Actually, the core of communication is respect. Like my argument with Lily last time, it was because I didn't value our engagement enough.

title: Environmental Protection
story_description: 馬克發現台灣的垃圾分類非常嚴格，他決定深入了解『環境保護』的重要性。他參與了社區的淨灘活動，並學習如何從日常生活中減少塑膠使用，實踐永續生活。
story_intro: 馬克第一次看到台灣的資源回收車，覺得很新奇。
他發現鄰居們都能準確地將垃圾分類。
這激發了他對環保議題的興趣。
他決定從今天起開始隨身攜帶環保餐具。
他相信每個小動作都能對地球產生正面影響。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 莉莉，我發現台灣的垃圾分類做得真徹底，連廚餘都要分生熟。
dialogue.py: lì lì, wǒ fā xiàn tái wān de lā jī fēn lèi zuò de zhēn chè dǐ, lián chú yú dōu yào fēn shēng shú.
dialogue.en: Lily, I found Taiwan's waste sorting is done so thoroughly; even kitchen waste is divided into raw and cooked.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 對啊，這是我們從小就養成的習慣。保護環境是每個人的責任嘛。
dialogue.py: duì a, zhè shì wǒ men cóng xiǎo jiù yǎng chéng de xí guàn. bǎo hù huán jìng shì měi gè rén de zé rèn ma.
dialogue.en: Yes, this is a habit we've developed since childhood. Protecting the environment is everyone's responsibility.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 這讓我想起我住的社區最近在推行『減塑行動』，鼓勵大家少用一次性餐具。
dialogue.py: zhè ràng wǒ xiǎng qǐ wǒ zhù de shè qū zuì jìn zài tuī xíng 'jiǎn sù xíng dòng', gǔ lì dà jiā shǎo yòng yī cì xìng cān jù.
dialogue.en: This reminds me that the community I live in has recently been promoting 'plastic reduction actions', encouraging everyone to use fewer disposable utensils.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 那很棒耶！一次性塑膠產品對海洋生物的威脅真的很大。
dialogue.py: nà hěn bàng ye! yī cì xìng sù jiāo chǎn pǐn duì hǎi yáng shēng wù de wēi xié zhēn de hěn dà.
dialogue.en: That's great! Disposable plastic products pose a very big threat to marine life.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 所以我今天買了一套環保餐具。你看，這是不鏽鋼吸管，還有摺疊碗。
dialogue.py: suǒ yǐ wǒ jīn tiān mǎi le yī tào huán bǎo cān jù. nǐ kàn, zhè shì bù xiù gāng xī guǎn, hái yǒu zhé dié wǎn.
dialogue.en: So I bought a set of eco-friendly utensils today. Look, this is a stainless steel straw, and a folding bowl.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 哇，這設計很精緻，攜帶也很方便。其實除了減塑，『低碳生活』也很重要。
dialogue.py: wa, zhè shè jì hěn jīng zhì, xié dài yě hěn fāng biàn. qí shí chú le jiǎn sù, 'dī tàn shēng huó' yě hěn zhòng yào.
dialogue.en: Wow, this design is very exquisite and convenient to carry. Actually, besides reducing plastic, a 'low-carbon lifestyle' is also very important.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 低碳生活是指多搭大眾運輸工具，少開車嗎？
dialogue.py: dī tàn shēng huó shì zhǐ duō dā dà zhòng yùn shū gōng jù, shǎo kāi chē ma?
dialogue.en: Does a low-carbon lifestyle mean taking more public transportation and driving less?

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，也包括選購在地食材，減少運輸過程中的碳排放。
dialogue.py: méi cuò, yě bāo kuò xuǎn gòu zài dì shí cái, jiǎn shǎo yùn shū guò chéng zhōng de tàn pái fàng.
dialogue.en: Exactly, it also includes buying local ingredients to reduce carbon emissions during transportation.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我懂了。這就是所謂的『綠色消費』吧？
dialogue.py: wǒ dǒng le. zhè jiù shì suǒ wèi de 'lǜ sè xiāo fèi' ba?
dialogue.en: I understand. This is what's called 'green consumption', right?

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 是的。馬克，你這週末有空嗎？我們要去參加一個淨灘活動。
dialogue.py: shì de. mǎ kè, nǐ zhè zhōu mò yǒu kòng ma? wǒ men yào qù cān jiā yī gè jìng tān xíng dòng.
dialogue.en: Yes. Mark, are you free this weekend? We're going to participate in a beach cleanup activity.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 淨灘？是在海邊撿垃圾嗎？聽起來很有意義！
dialogue.py: jìng tān? shì zài hǎi biān jiǎn lā jī ma? tīng qǐ lái hěn yǒu yì yì!
dialogue.en: Beach cleanup? Picking up trash at the seaside? Sounds very meaningful!

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 對，我們可以親眼看到塑膠廢棄物對環境造成的影響。通常會有很多人參加。
dialogue.py: duì, wǒ men kě yǐ qīn yǎn kàn dào sù jiāo fèi qì wù duì huán jìng zào chéng de yǐng xiǎng. tōng cháng huì yǒu hěn duō rén cān jiā.
dialogue.en: Right, we can see with our own eyes the impact that plastic waste has on the environment. Usually, many people participate.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我一定要去！我還要帶我室友一起去。我也想幫地球出一份力。
dialogue.py: wǒ yī dìng yào qù! wǒ hái yào dài wǒ shì yǒu yī qǐ qù. wǒ yě xiǎng bāng dì qiú chū yī fèn lì.
dialogue.en: I must go! I also want to take my roommate with me. I also want to contribute to the Earth.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 太好了！那天記得要防曬，還要帶足夠的水喔。
dialogue.py: tài hǎo le! nà tiān jì de yào fáng shài, hái yào dài zú gòu de shuǐ ō.
dialogue.en: Great! Remember to wear sunscreen that day and bring enough water.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。我會帶上我的新水壺。對了，淨灘需要準備什麼工具嗎？
dialogue.py: méi wèn tí. wǒ huì dài shàng wǒ de xīn shuǐ hú. duì le, jìng tān xū yào zhǔn bèi shén me gōng jù ma?
dialogue.en: No problem. I'll bring my new water bottle. By the way, do we need to prepare any tools for the beach cleanup?

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 主辦單位會提供手套和垃圾袋。我們只要穿著好活動的衣服和運動鞋就可以了。
dialogue.py: zhǔ bàn dān wèi huì tí gōng shǒu tào hé lā jī dài. wǒ men zhǐ yào chuān zhuó hǎo huó dòng de yī fu hé yùn dòng xié jiù kě yǐ le.
dialogue.en: The organizers will provide gloves and trash bags. We just need to wear clothes that are easy to move in and sneakers.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 了解。我真的很佩服台灣政府推廣環保的決心。
dialogue.py: liǎo jiě. wǒ zhēn de hěn pèi fú tái wān zhèng fǔ tuī guǎng huán bǎo de jué xīn.
dialogue.en: Got it. I really admire the Taiwanese government's determination to promote environmental protection.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 是啊，但最重要的還是民眾的配合。如果每個人都覺得不差我一個，那環境就沒救了。
dialogue.py: shì a, dàn zuì zhòng yào de hái shì mín zhòng de pèi hé. rú guǒ měi gè rén dōu jué de bù chà wǒ yī gè, nà huán jìng jiù méi jiù le.
dialogue.en: True, but the most important thing is the cooperation of the public. If everyone thinks 'it doesn't matter if it's just me', then the environment is hopeless.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你說得對。我們要從改變自己的消費習慣開始。
dialogue.py: nǐ shuō de duì. wǒ men yào cóng gǎi biàn zì jǐ de xiāo fèi xí guàn kāi shǐ.
dialogue.en: You're right. We should start by changing our own consumption habits.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 很高興你有這種想法。我們一起加油，守護這個美麗的星球！
dialogue.py: hěn gāo xìng nǐ yǒu zhè zhǒng xiǎng fǎ. wǒ men yī qǐ jiā yóu, shǒu hù zhè ge měi lì de xīng qiú!
dialogue.en: I'm glad you have this idea. Let's work together to guard this beautiful planet!

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 一言為定！週六見。
dialogue.py: yī yán wéi dìng! zhōu liù jiàn.
dialogue.en: It's a deal! See you Saturday.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 週六見！
dialogue.py: zhōu liù jiàn.
dialogue.en: See you Saturday!

key_sentences.en: Waste sorting is done very thoroughly.
Contribute a part to the Earth.
Admire the determination to promote environmental protection.

This reminds me that the community I live in has recently been promoting 'plastic reduction actions', encouraging everyone to use fewer disposable utensils. That's great! Disposable plastic products pose a very big threat to marine life. So I bought a set of eco-friendly utensils today. Look, this is a stainless steel straw, and a folding bowl. writing: 請寫 100 到 150 個字。討論你對『環境保護』的看法。在你的國家，人們對環保的意識高嗎？你自己在日常生活中做過哪些努力來實踐環保？你認為未來的環境會變好還是變壞？

grammar.explanation: 使用 '所謂的...' 來定義或引出某個術語。'出一份力' 常用於表達對集體事業的貢獻。'既然...就...' 在對話中用來引出基於某種情況的建議。
examples: 這就是所謂的『斷捨離』。 (This is the so-called 'Dan-sha-ri' / decluttering.)
