title: Global Warming
story_description: 馬克在課堂上聽到關於『全球暖化』的專題演講。教授解釋了溫室效應、海平面上升以及極端氣候對人類文明的衝擊。馬克開始反思人類的工業化進程與大自然的平衡。
story_intro: 演講廳裡坐滿了關心氣候議題的學生。
螢幕上播放著冰河融化的縮時攝影。
教授強調，現在是採取行動的最後機會。
馬克意識到這不只是科學家的事，而是每個人的事。
他決定深入探究極端氣候與生活的關聯。

dialogue.speaker: Professor
dialogue.zh: 各位，請看這張圖表。過去五十年來，全球平均氣溫上升的速度是驚人的。
dialogue.py: gè wèi, qǐng kàn zhè zhāng tú biǎo. guò qù wǔ shí nián lái, quán qiú píng jūn qì wēn shàng shēng de sù dù shì jīng rén de.
dialogue.en: Everyone, please look at this chart. Over the past fifty years, the rate of global average temperature rise has been staggering.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 教授，這就是所謂的『溫室效應』造成的嗎？
dialogue.py: jiào shòu, zhè jiù shì suǒ wèi de 'wēn shì xiào yìng' zào chéng de ma?
dialogue.en: Professor, is this caused by the so-called 'greenhouse effect'?

dialogue.speaker: Professor
dialogue.zh: 沒錯。大量排放的二氧化碳像毯子一樣覆蓋地球，讓熱量無法散發出去。
dialogue.py: méi cuò. dà liàng pái fàng de èr yǎng huà tàn xiàng tǎn zi yī yàng fù gài dì qiú, ràng rè liàng wú fǎ sàn fā chū qù.
dialogue.en: Exactly. Large amounts of carbon dioxide emissions cover the Earth like a blanket, preventing heat from escaping.

dialogue.speaker: Student B
dialogue.zh: 那這跟最近頻繁發生的『極端氣候』有關係嗎？比如超大豪雨和乾旱。
dialogue.py: nà zhè gēn zuì jìn pín fán fā shēng de 'jí duān qì hòu' yǒu guān xì ma? bǐ rú chāo dà háo yǔ hé gān hàn.
dialogue.en: Does this have a connection with the 'extreme weather' occurring frequently lately? Like torrential rain and droughts.

dialogue.speaker: Professor
dialogue.zh: 關係非常密切。全球暖化導致大氣循環混亂，原本該下雨的地方變乾，乾旱的地方卻發生洪災。
dialogue.py: guān xì fēi cháng mì qiè. quán qiú nuǎn huà dǎo zhì dà qì xún huán hùn luàn, yuán běn gāi xià yǔ de dì fāng biàn gān, gān hàn de dì fāng què fā shēng hóng zāi.
dialogue.en: The relationship is very close. Global warming causes chaos in atmospheric circulation; places that should rain become dry, while dry places suffer floods.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我在新聞上看到，北極的冰層融化導致『海平面上升』，很多島國都面臨消失的危機。
dialogue.py: wǒ zài xīn wén shàng kàn dào, běi jí de bīng céng róng huà dǎo zhì 'hǎi píng miàn shàng shēng', hěn duō dǎo guó dōu miàn lín xiāo shī de wēi jī.
dialogue.en: I saw in the news that the melting of Arctic ice layers leads to 'sea level rise', and many island nations are facing the crisis of disappearing.

dialogue.speaker: Professor
dialogue.zh: 這是一場『連鎖反應』。冰層融化不僅讓海平面上升，還會釋放更多儲存在凍土中的溫室氣體。
dialogue.py: zhè shì yī chǎng 'lián suǒ fǎn yìng'. bīng céng róng huà bù jǐn ràng hǎi píng miàn shàng shēng, hái huì shì fàng gèng duō chǔ cún zài dòng tǔ zhōng de wēn shì qì tǐ.
dialogue.en: This is a 'chain reaction'. Melting ice not only raises sea levels but also releases more greenhouse gases stored in permafrost.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 聽起來真的很絕望。那我們現在做環保還有意義嗎？
dialogue.py: tīng qǐ lái zhēn de hěn jué wàng. nà wǒ men xiàn zài zuò huán bǎo hái yǒu yì yì ma?
dialogue.en: It sounds really hopeless. Then is there still meaning in our environmental protection efforts now?

dialogue.speaker: Professor
dialogue.zh: 絕對有。雖然我們無法立刻逆轉趨勢，但我們可以減緩速度，爭取更多應對的時間。
dialogue.py: jué duì yǒu. suī rán wǒ men wú fǎ lì kè nì zhuǎn qū shì, dàn wǒ men kě yǐ jiǎn huǎn sù dù, zhēng qǔ gèng duō yìng duì de shí jiān.
dialogue.en: Absolutely. Although we can't reverse the trend immediately, we can slow down the speed and strive for more time to respond.

dialogue.speaker: Student B
dialogue.zh: 這需要全球各國的合作，特別是工業大國的減碳承諾。
dialogue.py: zhè xū yào quán qiú gè guó de hé zuò, tè bié shì gōng yè dà guó de jiǎn tàn chéng nuò.
dialogue.en: This requires global cooperation among nations, especially carbon reduction commitments from industrial giants.

dialogue.speaker: Professor
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，國際協議如《巴黎協定》就是為了這個目標。但每個公民的監督也很重要。
dialogue.py: méi cuò, guó jì xié yì rú 'bā lí xié dìng' jiù shì wèi le zhè ge mù biāo. dàn měi gè gōng mín de jiān dū yě hěn zhòng yào.
dialogue.en: Exactly, international agreements like the 'Paris Agreement' are for this goal. But the supervision of every citizen is also important.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 教授，那我們平常可以做些什麼來支持這些減碳政策呢？
dialogue.py: jiào shòu, nà wǒ men píng cháng kě yǐ zuò xiē shén me lái zhī chí zhè xiē jiǎn tàn zhèng cè ne?
dialogue.en: Professor, what can we usually do to support these carbon reduction policies?

dialogue.speaker: Professor
dialogue.zh: 首先是『知行合一』。除了回收，更要減少不必要的消費。另外，支持能源轉型也是關鍵。
dialogue.py: shǒu xiān shì 'zhī xíng hé yī'. chú le huí shōu, gèng yào jiǎn shǎo bù bì yào de xiāo fèi. lì wài, zhī chí néng yuán zhuǎn xíng yě shì guān jiàn.
dialogue.en: First is 'unity of knowledge and action'. Besides recycling, we must reduce unnecessary consumption. Additionally, supporting energy transition is key.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 能源轉型是指用太陽能或風能取代火力發電嗎？
dialogue.py: néng yuán zhuǎn xíng shì zhǐ yòng tài yáng néng huò fēng néng qǔ dài huǒ lì fā diàn ma?
dialogue.en: Does energy transition mean replacing thermal power with solar or wind energy?

dialogue.speaker: Professor
dialogue.zh: 是的。發展『再生能源』是減少碳排放的必經之路。雖然成本較高，但長期來看是值得的。
dialogue.py: shì de. fā zhǎn 'zài shēng néng yuán' shì jiǎn shǎo tàn pái fàng de bì jīng zhī lù. suī rán chéng běn jiào gāo, dàn cháng qī lái kàn shì zhí de de.
dialogue.en: Yes. Developing 'renewable energy' is the only way to reduce carbon emissions. Although the cost is higher, it's worth it in the long run.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我懂了。我們正在與時間賽跑。我會把今天的演講內容分享給我的朋友們。
dialogue.py: wǒ dǒng le. wǒ men zhèng zài yǔ shí jiān sài pǎo. wǒ huì bǎ jīn tiān de yǎn jiǎng nèi róng fēn xiǎng gěi wǒ de péng you men.
dialogue.en: I understand. We are racing against time. I'll share today's lecture content with my friends.

dialogue.speaker: Professor
dialogue.zh: 很好。傳播正確的知識也是一種力量。只有社會大眾都覺醒了，政策才會真正落實。
dialogue.py: hěn hǎo. chuán bō zhèng què de zhī shi yě shì yī zhǒng lì liàng. zhǐ yǒu shè huì dà zhòng dōu jué xǐng le, zhèng cè cái huì zhēn zhèng luò shí.
dialogue.en: Good. Spreading correct knowledge is also a kind of power. Only when the general public awakens will policies truly be implemented.

dialogue.speaker: Student B
dialogue.zh: 希望現在還來得及。我不希望以後的孩子只能在課本上看到北極熊。
dialogue.py: xī wàng xiàn zài hái lái de jí. wǒ bù xī wàng yǐ hòu de hái zi zhǐ néng zài kè běn shàng kàn dào běi jí xióng.
dialogue.en: I hope it's still in time. I don't want future children to only see polar bears in textbooks.

dialogue.speaker: Professor
dialogue.zh: 只要我們從現在開始行動，永遠不嫌晚。下課！
dialogue.py: zhǐ yào wǒ men cóng xiàn zài kāi shǐ xíng dòng, yǒng yuǎn bù xián wǎn. xià kè!
dialogue.en: As long as we start acting now, it's never too late. Class dismissed!

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝教授！這堂課真的讓我受益匪淺。
dialogue.py: xiè xie jiào shòu! zhè táng kè zhēn de ràng wǒ shòu yì fěi qiǎn.
dialogue.en: Thank you Professor! This class really benefited me a lot.

dialogue.speaker: Professor
dialogue.zh: 不客氣。加油！
dialogue.py: bú kè qi. jiā yóu!
dialogue.en: You're welcome. Keep it up!

key_sentences.zh: 氣溫上升的速度是驚人的。
key_sentences.en: The rate of temperature rise is staggering.
Strive for more time to respond.

key_sentences.zh: 發展再生能源是必經之路。
key_sentences.en: Developing renewable energy is the inevitable path.

key_sentences.example: 醫療救援是在與時間賽跑。

key_sentences.en: To benefit a lot / gain a great deal.
key_sentences.example: 這趟旅行讓我受益匪淺。

vocabulary.example: 老師的話讓我受益匪淺。

part_a: 氣溫上升的速度很驚人。
speaking.part_b: 角色扮演：你正在和朋友討論極端氣候。朋友覺得全球暖化離他很遠，你舉出最近的超大豪雨和高溫為例，說服他每個人都應該採取行動減少碳排放。朋友最後被你說服，決定開始省電。
part_c: 你覺得你所在的城市，這幾年的天氣有什麼明顯的變化嗎？
對於『再生能源』，你支持發展哪一種？（太陽能、風能、核能等）為什麼？

comprehension.q: 教授說過去五十年來，氣溫上升的速度如何？
溫室氣體像什麼一樣覆蓋地球？
北極冰層融化會導致什麼結果？
面對全球暖化，我們現在應該怎麼做？
options: B. 減緩速度，爭取應對時間

comprehension.q: 什麼是減少碳排放的『必經之路』？

true_false.q: 溫室效應可以讓熱量很快散發到外太空。
極端氣候包括超大豪雨和嚴重的乾旱。
《巴黎協定》是一個國際性的減碳協議。
教授認為個人在環保政策中不具備任何影響力。
馬克覺得這堂課讓他受益匪淺。

fill_blank.q: 發展再生能源是必____之路。

passage.title: Global Warming Listening Passage
passage.zh: 演講廳裡坐滿了關心氣候議題的學生。螢幕上播放著冰河融化的縮時攝影。教授強調，現在是採取行動的最後機會。馬克意識到這不只是科學家的事，而是每個人的事。他決定深入探究極端氣候與生活的關聯。
passage.en: Everyone, please look at this chart. Over the past fifty years, the rate of global average temperature rise has been staggering. Professor, is this caused by the so-called 'greenhouse effect'? Exactly. Large amounts of carbon dioxide emissions cover the Earth like a blanket, preventing heat from escaping. Does this have a connection with the 'extreme weather' occurring frequently lately? Like torrential rain and droughts. The relationship is very close. Global warming causes chaos in atmospheric circulation; places that should rain become dry, while dry places suffer floods. I saw in the news that the melting of Arctic ice layers leads to 'sea level rise', and many island nations are facing the crisis of disappearing. This is a 'chain reaction'. Melting ice not only raises sea levels but also releases more greenhouse gases stored in permafrost. It sounds really hopeless. Then is there still meaning in our environmental protection efforts now?
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫 100 到 150 個字。如果你是某個國家的環保部長，你會優先推行哪三項政策來應對『全球暖化』？請說明你的理由。你認為民眾會支持你的政策嗎？為什麼？

grammar.explanation: 使用 '連鎖反應' 描述因果關係的擴散。'受益匪淺' 是形容學習成果豐碩的高級成語。'必經之路' 常用於描述達成某個目標不可或缺的階段。
examples: 這件事引發了嚴重的連鎖反應。 (This matter triggered a serious chain reaction.)
跟長輩聊天讓我受益匪淺。 (Chatting with elders benefited me a lot.)
挫折是成長的必經之路。 (Setbacks are an inevitable path to growth.)
面臨危機 (Face a crisis)
與時間賽跑 (Race against time)

review.speaking: Explain the basics of climate change and its impacts in Chinese.
review.writing: Write a 130-word summary of a lecture on global warming.
review.self_check: 你能用中文討論氣候變遷（溫室效應、極端氣候）、理解『再生能源』的重要性並使用『受益匪淺』嗎？

title: Job Search and Career Planning
story_description: 馬克快要大學畢業了，他開始思考未來的職業生涯。他來到就業服務中心，詢問關於外籍人士在台灣實習和工作的相關規定，並向職業顧問諮詢如何撰寫一份有競爭力的履歷表。
story_intro: 馬克的書桌上堆滿了各大企業的招募簡章。
他對未來感到有些焦慮，但也充滿期待。
他在考慮是留在台灣工作，還是回美國發展。
他希望能找一份能結合中文專長和商業背景的工作。
他預約了學校的職業發展座談會。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 老師，我最近在準備履歷，但不知道外商公司和本土公司看重的重點有什麼不同？
dialogue.py: lǎo shī, wǒ zuì jìn zài zhǔn bèi lǚ lì, dàn bù zhī dào wài shāng gōng sī hé běn tǔ gōng sī kàn zhòng de zhòng diǎn yǒu shén me bù tóng?
dialogue.en: Teacher, I've been preparing my resume lately, but I don't know the difference between what foreign firms and local companies value?

dialogue.speaker: Advisor
dialogue.zh: 馬克，這是一個好問題。外商通常看重的是『個人特質』和主動性；而台灣公司可能更在意你的穩定性和學歷背景。
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, zhè shì yī gè hǎo wèn tí. wài shāng tōng cháng kàn zhòng de shì 'gè rén tè zhì' hé zhǔ dòng xìng; ér tái wān gōng sī kě néng gèng zài yì nǐ de wěn dìng xìng hé xué lì bèi jǐng.
dialogue.en: Mark, that's a good question. Foreign firms usually value 'personality traits' and initiative, while Taiwanese companies might care more about your stability and educational background.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 原來如此。那關於『實習經驗』呢？我聽說很多公司都要求有相關經驗。
dialogue.py: yuán lái rú cǐ. nà guān yú 'shí xí jīng yàn' ne? wǒ tīng shuō hěn duō gōng sī dōu yāo qiú yǒu guān xián jīng yàn.
dialogue.en: I see. What about 'internship experience'? I heard many companies require relevant experience.

dialogue.speaker: Advisor
dialogue.zh: 沒錯。實習能證明你已經初步了解『職場環境』。你的中文流利是一大優勢，應該要在履歷中強調。
dialogue.py: méi cuò. shí xí néng zhèng míng nǐ yǐ jīng chū bù liǎo jiě 'zhí chǎng huán jìng'. nǐ de zhōng wén liú lì shì yī dà yōu shì, yīng gāi yào zài lǚ lì zhōng qiáng diào.
dialogue.en: Exactly. Internships can prove you already have a preliminary understanding of the 'workplace environment'. Your fluent Chinese is a big advantage; you should emphasize it in your resume.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我還在擔心簽證的問題。外籍人士在台灣找工作，是不是要達到一定的薪資門檻？
dialogue.py: wǒ hái zài dān xīn qiān zhèng de wèn tí. wài jí rén shì zài tái wān zhǎo gōng zuò, shì bú shì yào dá dào yī dìng de xīn zī mén kǎn?
dialogue.en: I'm also worried about visa issues. When foreigners look for work in Taiwan, is there a certain salary threshold to reach?

dialogue.speaker: Advisor
dialogue.zh: 是的，勞動部有規定最低薪資標準。不過如果你有特殊的專業技能，申請『就業金卡』會更方便。
dialogue.py: shì de, láo dòng bù yǒu guī dìng zuì dī xīn zī biāo zhǔn. bù guò rú guǒ nǐ yǒu tè shū de zhuān yè jì néng, shēn qǐng 'jiù yè jīn kǎ' huì gèng fāng biàn.
dialogue.en: Yes, the Ministry of Labor has regulations for the minimum salary standard. However, if you have special professional skills, applying for an 'Employment Gold Card' would be more convenient.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 就業金卡？聽起來很厲害。那在台灣面試時，有沒有什麼特別的『潛規則』？
dialogue.py: jiù yè jīn kǎ? tīng qǐ lái hěn lì hai. nà zài tái wān miàn shì shí, yǒu méi yǒu shén me tè bié de 'qián guī zé'?
dialogue.en: Employment Gold Card? Sounds impressive. Are there any special 'unspoken rules' when interviewing in Taiwan?

dialogue.speaker: Advisor
dialogue.zh: 台灣的面試通常比較保守且有禮貌。建議你要準時，服裝要正式。回答問題時要表現出謙虛但自信的態度。
dialogue.py: tái wān de miàn shì tōng cháng bǐ jiào bǎo shǒu qiě yǒu lǐ mào. jiàn yì nǐ yào zhǔn shí, fú zhuāng yào zhèng shì. huí dá wèn tí shí yào biǎo xiàn chū qiān xū dàn zì xìn de tài dù.
dialogue.en: Interviews in Taiwan are usually more conservative and polite. I suggest you be on time and dress formally. When answering questions, show a humble but confident attitude.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 懂了。我最近常去參加一些『產業研討會』，希望能擴展人脈。
dialogue.py: dǒng le. wǒ zuì jìn cháng qù cān jiā yī xiē 'chǎn yè yán tǎo huì', xī wàng néng kuò zhǎn rén mài.
dialogue.en: Got it. I've been attending some 'industry seminars' lately, hoping to expand my network.

dialogue.speaker: Advisor
dialogue.zh: 這做法非常正確！在職場上，『人脈』往往跟專業能力一樣重要。你可以多利用 LinkedIn 聯繫學長姐。
dialogue.py: zhè zuò fǎ fēi cháng zhèng què! zài zhí chǎng shàng, 'rén mài' wǎng wǎng gēn zhuān yè néng lì yī yàng zhòng yào. nǐ kě yǐ duō lì yòng LinkedIn lián xì xué zhǎng jiě.
dialogue.en: This approach is very correct! In the workplace, 'networking' is often as important as professional ability. You can use LinkedIn more to contact alumni.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的，我會去試試看。我也在考慮要不要先在台灣讀個研究所，精進商業知識。
dialogue.py: hǎo de, wǒ huì qù shì shì kàn. wǒ yě zài kǎo lǜ yào bú yào xiān zài tái wān dú gè yán jiū suǒ, jīng jìn shāng yè zhī shi.
dialogue.en: Okay, I'll give it a try. I'm also considering whether to study for a master's degree in Taiwan first to refine my business knowledge.

dialogue.speaker: Advisor
dialogue.zh: 這取決於你的長遠職業規劃。如果你想在亞洲發展，台灣的學歷確實有加分作用。
dialogue.py: zhè qǔ jué yú nǐ de cháng yuǎn zhí yè guī huà. rú guǒ nǐ xiǎng zài yà zhōu fā zhǎn, tái wān de xué lì què shí yǒu jiā fēn zuò yòng.
dialogue.en: That depends on your long-term career planning. If you want to develop in Asia, a Taiwanese degree does have a bonus effect.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 壓力真的不小。每個人看起來都很有競爭力。
dialogue.py: yā lì zhēn de bù xiǎo. měi gè rén kàn qǐ lái dōu hěn yǒu jìng zhēng lì.
dialogue.en: The pressure is really not small. Everyone looks very competitive.

dialogue.speaker: Advisor
dialogue.zh: 別擔心，每個人都有自己的步調。最重要的是認清自己的優勢，並持續學習。
dialogue.py: bié dān xīn, měi gè rén dōu yǒu zì jǐ de bù diào. zuì zhòng yào de shì rèn qīng zì jǐ de yōu shì, bìng chí xù xué xí.
dialogue.en: Don't worry; everyone has their own pace. The most important thing is to recognize your advantages and keep learning.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝老師的建議。我會先去修改我的履歷，並把今天學到的重點放進去。
dialogue.py: xiè xie lǎo shī de jiàn yì. wǒ huì xiān qù xiū gǎi wǒ de lǚ lì, bìng bǎ jīn tiān xué dào de zhòng diǎn fàng jìn qù.
dialogue.en: Thank you for the advice, teacher. I'll modify my resume first and put the key points I learned today into it.

dialogue.speaker: Advisor
dialogue.zh: 不客氣。如果有需要模擬面試，隨時來找我。
dialogue.py: bú kè qi. rú guǒ yǒu xū yào mó nǐ miàn shì, suí shí lái zhǎo wǒ.
dialogue.en: You're welcome. If you need a mock interview, come find me anytime.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 太好了！那我就不客氣了。我真的需要練習怎麼用中文自我介紹。
dialogue.py: tài hǎo le! nà wǒ jiù bú kè qi le. wǒ zhēn de xū yào liàn xí zěn me yòng zhōng wén zì wǒ jiè shào.
dialogue.en: Great! Then I won't be formal. I really need to practice how to introduce myself in Chinese.

dialogue.speaker: Advisor
dialogue.zh: 加油，我看好你！
dialogue.py: jiā yóu, wǒ kàn hǎo nǐ!
dialogue.en: Keep it up, I have high hopes for you!

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝老師！我會努力的。
dialogue.py: xiè xie lǎo shī! wǒ huì nǔ lì de.
dialogue.en: Thank you teacher! I'll work hard.

dialogue.speaker: Advisor
dialogue.zh: 再見！
dialogue.py: zài jiàn!
dialogue.en: Goodbye!

key_sentences.zh: 看重的重點有什麼不同？
key_sentences.en: What's the difference in what is valued?
I have high hopes for you! / I'm rooting for you!

part_a: 看重的重點有什麼不同？
speaking.part_b: 角色扮演：你正在參加一個求職座談會。你向主講人詢問：如果你沒有相關的工作經驗，應該如何在履歷中吸引雇主的注意？主講人建議你強調實習中的具體成果，以及你在學校參與的社團領導經驗。你謝謝主講人的建議。
part_c: 你覺得在你的國家，『人脈』和『學歷』哪一個對找工作更重要？為什麼？

外商公司通常比較看重什麼？

『就業金卡』是給什麼樣的人申請的？
options: B. 有特殊專業技能的人

comprehension.q: 顧問建議馬克利用什麼社交平台聯繫學長姐？

true_false.q: 台灣的面試通常比較保守且有禮貌。
馬克覺得找工作的壓力一點都不大。

馬克需要練習用中文自我介紹。

passage.title: Job Search and Career Planning Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克的書桌上堆滿了各大企業的招募簡章。他對未來感到有些焦慮，但也充滿期待。他在考慮是留在台灣工作，還是回美國發展。他希望能找一份能結合中文專長和商業背景的工作。他預約了學校的職業發展座談會。
passage.en: Teacher, I've been preparing my resume lately, but I don't know the difference between what foreign firms and local companies value? Mark, that's a good question. Foreign firms usually value 'personality traits' and initiative, while Taiwanese companies might care more about your stability and educational background. I see. What about 'internship experience'? I heard many companies require relevant experience. Exactly. Internships can prove you already have a preliminary understanding of the 'workplace environment'. Your fluent Chinese is a big advantage; you should emphasize it in your resume. I'm also worried about visa issues. When foreigners look for work in Taiwan, is there a certain salary threshold to reach? Yes, the Ministry of Labor has regulations for the minimum salary standard. However, if you have special professional skills, applying for an 'Employment Gold Card' would be more convenient. Employment Gold Card? Sounds impressive. Are there any special 'unspoken rules' when interviewing in Taiwan? Interviews in Taiwan are usually more conservative and polite. I suggest you be on time and dress formally. When answering questions, show a humble but confident attitude.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫 120 到 150 個字。如果你現在要應徵你夢想中的工作，請寫一段自我介紹（Cover Letter 的開頭）。描述你的背景、你的主要優勢，以及你為什麼對這份工作感興趣。請盡量展現你的自信與誠意。

grammar.explanation: 使用 '看重' 描述對某種品質的重視。'潛規則' 指的是社會或行業中不公開但大家都遵守的規則。'我看好你' 是對他人非常有信心的表達方式。
examples: 這家公司非常看重員工的創新能力。 (This company values employees' innovation ability very much.)
我們要學會適應社會的潛規則。 (We need to learn to adapt to society's unspoken rules.)
雖然比賽很難，但我還是看好你。 (Although the competition is hard, I still have high hopes for you.)
擴展人脈 (Expand connections)
加分作用 (Bonus effect)

practice.q: Complete: 我看___你！ (Rooting for you/High hopes.)
Translate: Unspoken rules of the industry.

review.writing: Write a 140-word cover letter introduction in Chinese.

title: The First Day at Work
story_description: 馬克順利找到了一份在貿易公司的實習工作。今天是他在這家公司的第一天。他穿著整齊，戰戰兢兢地踏入辦公室，認識新同事，學習公司的運作流程，並體會職場溝通的微妙之處。
story_intro: 馬克昨晚緊張到差點睡不著。
他提早了十五分鐘到達公司。
經理帶領他參觀辦公室並介紹團隊。
馬克努力記住每個人的名字和職位。
他發現校園與職場的氛圍截然不同。

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 馬克，早安！歡迎加入我們的團隊。我是你的主管張經理。
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, zǎo ān! huān yíng jiā rù wǒ men de tuán duì. wǒ shì nǐ de zhǔ guǎn zhāng jīng lǐ.
dialogue.en: Mark, good morning! Welcome to our team. I'm your supervisor, Manager Zhang.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 經理早！很榮幸能來到這裡實習。我已經準備好學習了。
dialogue.py: jīng lǐ zǎo! hěn róng xìng néng lái dào zhè lǐ shí xí. wǒ yǐ jīng zhǔn bèi hǎo xué xí le.
dialogue.en: Manager, morning! It's an honor to be interning here. I'm ready to learn.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 非常有精神！我們先來認識一下同事。這位是會計部的雅婷，那位是業務部的阿明。
dialogue.py: fēi cháng yǒu jīng shén! wǒ men xiān lái rèn shi yī xià tóng shì. zhè wèi shì kuài jì bù de yǎ tíng, nà wèi shì yè wù bù de ā míng.
dialogue.en: Very energetic! Let's meet the colleagues first. This is Ya-ting from the accounting department, and that is A-ming from the sales department.

dialogue.speaker: Ya-ting
dialogue.zh: 馬克你好，以後有報帳的問題可以來找我。
dialogue.py: mǎ kè nǐ hǎo, yǐ hòu yǒu bào zhàng de wèn tí kě yǐ lái zhǎo wǒ.
dialogue.en: Hello Mark, you can come to me with accounting questions in the future.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 雅婷姐你好，請多多指教。
dialogue.py: yǎ tíng jiě nǐ hǎo, qǐng duō duō zhǐ jiào.
dialogue.en: Hello Sister Ya-ting, please guide me.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 在我們公司，『團隊合作』是最重要的。雖然你是實習生，但我希望你能主動提出想法。
dialogue.py: zài wǒ men gōng sī, 'tuán duì hé zuò' shì zuì zhòng yào de. suī rán nǐ shì shí xí shēng, dàn wǒ xī wàng nǐ néng zhǔ dòng tí chū xiǎng fǎ.
dialogue.en: In our company, 'teamwork' is the most important thing. Although you're an intern, I hope you'll proactively propose ideas.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我會努力的。經理，請問我今天的主要任務是什麼？
dialogue.py: wǒ huì nǔ lì de. jīng lǐ, qǐng wèn wǒ jīn tiān de zuì zhǔ yào rèn wu shì shén me?
dialogue.en: I'll work hard. Manager, may I ask what my main task is today?

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 今天先幫你設定電腦帳號，並請你閱讀這份『員工手冊』，熟悉公司的文化和規章。
dialogue.py: jīn tiān xiān bāng nǐ shè dìng diàn nǎo zhàng hào, bìng qǐng nǐ yuè dú zhè fèn 'yuán gōng shǒu cè', shú xī gōng sī de wén huà hé guī zhāng.
dialogue.en: Today we'll set up your computer account first, and please read this 'employee handbook' to familiarize yourself with the company culture and regulations.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的。我注意到辦公室很安靜，大家工作都很專注。
dialogue.py: hǎo de. wǒ zhù yì dào bàn gōng shì hěn ān jìng, dà jiā gōng zuò dōu hěn zhuān zhù.
dialogue.en: Okay. I noticed the office is very quiet; everyone is very focused on their work.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 是的，我們強調效率。另外，如果你要離開位置，記得跟隔壁同事打聲招呼。
dialogue.py: shì de, wǒ men qiáng diào xiào lǜ. lì wài, rú guǒ nǐ yào lí kāi wèi zhì, jì de gēn gé bì tóng shì dǎ shēng zhāo hu.
dialogue.en: Yes, we emphasize efficiency. Also, if you're going to leave your seat, remember to say hello to the colleague next to you.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 懂了，這是職場的『基本禮儀』吧？
dialogue.py: dǒng le, zhè shì zhí chǎng de 'jī běn lǐ yí' ba?
dialogue.en: Understood, this is basic 'workplace etiquette', right?

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 沒錯。中午我們會一起去樓下的餐廳吃飯，歡迎你加入，那是交流感情的好機會。
dialogue.py: méi cuò. zhōng wǔ wǒ men huì yī qǐ qù lóu xià de cān tīng chī fàn, huān yíng nǐ jiā rù, nà shì jiāo liú gǎn qíng de hǎo jī huì.
dialogue.en: Exactly. We'll go to the restaurant downstairs for lunch together at noon; you're welcome to join. That's a good opportunity to bond.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝經理！我一定會準時出席的。
dialogue.py: xiè xie jīng lǐ! wǒ yī dìng huì zhǔn shí chū xí de.
dialogue.en: Thank you Manager! I'll definitely be there on time.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 還有一點，如果遇到不懂的事，千萬不要『裝懂』，隨時發問。沒人會怪你的。
dialogue.py: hái yǒu yī diǎn, rú guǒ yù dào bù dǒng de shì, qiān wàn bú yào 'zhuāng dǒng', suí shí fā wèn. méi rén huì guài nǐ de.
dialogue.en: One more thing, if you encounter something you don't understand, absolutely don't 'pretend to understand'; ask anytime. No one will blame you.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 這點我記住了。溝通要誠實、有效率。
dialogue.py: zhè diǎn wǒ jì zhù le. gōu tōng yào chéng shí, yǒu xiào lǜ.
dialogue.en: I'll keep that in mind. Communication should be honest and efficient.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 很好。這張桌子就是你的。雖然位置不大，但光線很好。希望你能盡快適應。
dialogue.py: hěn hǎo. zhè zhāng zhuō zi jiù shì nǐ de. suī rán wèi zhì bú dà, dàn guāng xiàn hěn hǎo. xī wàng nǐ néng jǐn kuài shì yìng.
dialogue.en: Good. This desk is yours. Although the spot isn't large, the light is good. Hope you can adapt as soon as possible.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝經理。我會努力成為團隊的一份子。
dialogue.py: xiè xie jīng lǐ. wǒ huì nǔ lì chéng wéi tuán duì de yī fèn zi.
dialogue.en: Thank you Manager. I'll work hard to become a member of the team.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 那就開始工作吧。加油！
dialogue.py: nà jiù kāi shǐ gōng zuò ba. jiā yóu!
dialogue.en: Then let's start working. Good luck!

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 加油！
dialogue.py: jiā yóu!
dialogue.en: Good luck!

key_sentences.zh: 很榮幸能來到這裡實習。
key_sentences.en: It's an honor to be interning here.
Please guide me. / Please give me your advice.
Familiarize yourself with the company culture.
A good opportunity to bond/exchange feelings.
Absolutely do not pretend to understand.
Adapt to the environment as soon as possible.

vocabulary.meaning: to submit an expense report / claim expenses

speaking.part_b: 角色扮演：今天是你在新公司上班的第一天。你主動向隔壁座位的同事自我介紹，並詢問公司的飲水機和洗手間在哪裡。同事非常親切地回答你，並邀請你中午一起吃飯。你謝謝他的熱情。
part_c: 你覺得在職場中，『專業能力』和『人際關係』哪一個更重要？為什麼？

passage.title: The First Day at Work Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克昨晚緊張到差點睡不著。他提早了十五分鐘到達公司。經理帶領他參觀辦公室並介紹團隊。馬克努力記住每個人的名字和職位。他發現校園與職場的氛圍截然不同。
passage.en: Mark, good morning! Welcome to our team. I'm your supervisor, Manager Zhang. Manager, morning! It's an honor to be interning here. I'm ready to learn. Very energetic! Let's meet the colleagues first. This is Ya-ting from the accounting department, and that is A-ming from the sales department. Hello Mark, you can come to me with accounting questions in the future. Hello Sister Ya-ting, please guide me. In our company, 'teamwork' is the most important thing. Although you're an intern, I hope you'll proactively propose ideas. I'll work hard. Manager, may I ask what my main task is today? Today we'll set up your computer account first, and please read this 'employee handbook' to familiarize yourself with the company culture and regulations.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫 120 到 150 個字。描述你人生中『第一天上班』或『第一天上學』的經驗。你當時的心情如何？你遇到了哪些有趣的人或事？這次經驗對你以後面對新環境有什麼啟發？

grammar.explanation: 使用 '榮幸' 表達對某種機會的感激。'請多多指教' 是職場非常正式的社交語。'截然不同' 形容事物之間的巨大差異。
examples: 能參加這個晚宴，我深感榮幸。 (I'm deeply honored to attend this dinner.)
我是新來的助理，請多多指教。 (I'm the new assistant, please guide me.)
這兩本書的風格截然不同。 (The styles of these two books are completely different.)
交流感情 (Bonding)
裝懂 (Pretend to know)

review.speaking: Introduce yourself and handle basic interactions on your first day of work in Chinese.
review.writing: Write a 140-word diary entry about your first day at a new job.
review.self_check: 你能用中文自我介紹（指教）、表達榮幸並理解『裝懂』與『截然不同』嗎？

title: Deadlines and Management
story_description: 實習兩週後，馬克接到了他的第一個正式專案：協助籌備『年度貿易洽談會』。由於時間緊迫，馬克必須學習如何排定優先順序、處理突發狀況，並在截稿日期前完成工作。
story_intro: 專案的截止日期就在下週五。
馬克需要聯絡五十位潛在客戶。
他感覺到職場上那種真正的『時間壓力』。
他開始使用電子看板管理他的工作進度。
他在過程中體會到細節決定成敗。

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 馬克，這是你負責的部分。我們必須在下週五前完成客戶名單的確認。
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, zhè shì nǐ fù zé de bù fen. wǒ men bì xū zài xià zhōu wǔ qián wán chéng kè hù míng dān de què rèn.
dialogue.en: Mark, this is the part you're responsible for. We must complete the confirmation of the customer list before next Friday.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。我會盡力如期完成。不過這名單上有幾位客戶的聯絡資訊好像過期了。
dialogue.py: méi wèn tí. wǒ huì jìn lì rú qī wán chéng. bù guò zhè míng dān shàng yǒu jǐ wèi kè hù de lián luò zī xùn hǎo xiàng guò qī le.
dialogue.en: No problem. I'll do my best to complete it as scheduled. However, the contact information for several customers on this list seems to have expired.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 這就是你要克服的困難。你得想辦法找到更新的資訊，這是個『挑戰』。
dialogue.py: zhè jiù shì nǐ yào kè fú de kùn nan. nǐ děi xiǎng bàn fǎ zhǎo dào gèng xīn de zī xùn, zhè shì gè 'tiǎo zhàn'.
dialogue.en: That's the difficulty you need to overcome. You have to find a way to find updated information; it's a 'challenge'.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我懂了。我會先排定『優先順序』，從最重要的客戶開始聯絡。
dialogue.py: wǒ dǒng le. wǒ huì xiān pái dìng 'yōu xiān shùn xù', cóng zuì zhòng yào de kè hù kāi shǐ lián luò.
dialogue.en: Got it. I'll set the 'priority order' first, starting with the most important customers.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 很好。記住，『細節決定成敗』。每個電話和郵件都要非常客氣且專業。
dialogue.py: hěn hǎo. jì zhù, 'xì jié jué dìng chéng bài'. měi gè diàn huà hé yóu jiàn dōu yào fēi cháng kè qi qiě zhuān yè.
dialogue.en: Good. Remember, 'details determine success or failure'. Every phone call and email must be very polite and professional.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: （三天後）經理，進度比我想像中慢。有幾位客戶一直沒接電話。
dialogue.py: (sān tiān hòu) jīng lǐ, jìn dù bǐ wǒ xiǎng xiàng zhōng màn. yǒu jǐ wèi kè hù yī zhí méi jiē diàn huà.
dialogue.en: (Three days later) Manager, the progress is slower than I imagined. Several customers haven't been answering the phone.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 職場上總會有『突發狀況』。你不能只是乾等，試著發郵件或聯繫他們的助理。
dialogue.py: zhí chǎng shàng zǒng huì yǒu 'tū fā zhuàng kuàng'. nǐ bù néng zhǐ shì gān děng, shì zhe fā yóu jiàn huò lián xì tā men de zhù lǐ.
dialogue.en: There are always 'unexpected situations' in the workplace. You can't just wait; try sending an email or contacting their assistants.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的。我現在感覺到一股強大的『壓力』，但我會堅持下去的。
dialogue.py: hǎo de. wǒ xiàn zài gǎn jué dào yī gǔ qiáng dà de 'yā lì', dàn wǒ huì jiān chí xià qù de.
dialogue.en: Okay. I feel a strong 'pressure' now, but I'll persist.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 有壓力是好事，那會激發你的潛力。但也要注意休息，別把身體累壞了。
dialogue.py: yǒu yā lì shì hǎo shì, nà huì jī fā nǐ de qián lì. dàn yě yào zhù yì xiū xi, bié bǎ shēn tǐ lèi huài le.
dialogue.en: Having pressure is a good thing; it'll spark your potential. But also pay attention to rest; don't wear yourself out.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 經理，我剛才確認了。所有的名單都已經更新並確認完畢了，比預計提前了一天！
dialogue.py: jīng lǐ, wǒ gāng cái què rèn le. suǒ yǒu de míng dān dōu yǐ jīng gèng xīn bìng què rèn wán bì le, bǐ yù jì tí qián le yī tiān!
dialogue.en: Manager, I just confirmed. All lists have been updated and confirmed, one day ahead of schedule!

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 太棒了！你的表現超出了我的預期。這份報告寫得很完整。
dialogue.py: tài bàng le! nǐ de biǎo xiàn chāo chū le wǒ de yù qī. zhè fèn bào gào xiě de hěn wán zhěng.
dialogue.en: Excellent! Your performance exceeded my expectations. This report is written very completely.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝經理的鼓勵。這兩天我學會了怎麼在『限期』內管理我的時間。
dialogue.py: xiè xie jīng lǐ de gǔ lì. zhè liǎng tiān wǒ xué huì le zěn me zài 'xiàn qī' nèi guǎn lǐ wǒ de shí jiān.
dialogue.en: Thank you for the encouragement, Manager. Over these two days, I learned how to manage my time within the 'deadline'.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 這對你以後的職業生涯非常有幫助。下一個任務會更具挑戰性喔。
dialogue.py: zhè duì nǐ yǐ hòu de zhí yè shēng yá fēi cháng yǒu bāng zhù. xià yī gè rèn wu huì gèng jù tiǎo zhàn xìng ō.
dialogue.en: This will be very helpful for your future career. The next task will be even more challenging.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我準備好了。我現在對處理複雜的工作更有信心了。
dialogue.py: wǒ zhǔn bèi hǎo le. wǒ xiàn zài duì chǔ lǐ fù zá de gōng zuò gèng yǒu xìn xīn le.
dialogue.en: I'm ready. I'm more confident about handling complex work now.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 很好。這就是實習的價值。我們先去喝杯咖啡慶祝一下這個階段的成功吧。
dialogue.py: hěn hǎo. zhè jiù shì shí xí de jià zhí. wǒ men xiān qù hē bēi kā fēi qìng zhù yī xià zhè ge jiē duàn de chéng gōng ba.
dialogue.en: Good. That's the value of interning. Let's go have a cup of coffee to celebrate the success of this phase first.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝經理，這次換我請客！
dialogue.py: xiè xie jīng lǐ, zhè cì huàn wǒ qǐng kè!
dialogue.en: Thank you Manager, my treat this time!

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，實習生請客？那我可要點最貴的喔。
dialogue.py: hā hā, shí xí shēng qǐng kè? nà wǒ kě yào diǎn zuì guì de ō.
dialogue.en: Haha, intern treating? Then I'll have to order the most expensive one.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 沒問題！
dialogue.py: méi wèn tí!
dialogue.en: No problem!

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 開玩笑的，走吧！
dialogue.py: kāi wán xiào de, zǒu ba!
dialogue.en: Just kidding, let's go!

speaking.part_b: 角色扮演：你的主管交給你一個很緊急的任務，截止日期就在明天下午。你手上還有其他工作，你必須向主管溝通你的『優先順序』，並請求一位同事協助。主管同意了你的安排。你謝謝主管的諒解。
part_c: 當你面對很大的工作壓力時，你會如何放鬆自己？
你同意『細節決定成敗』這句話嗎？請舉出一個例子。

comprehension.q: 馬克接到的第一個正式專案是什麼？
options: B. 協助籌備貿易洽談會

comprehension.q: 專案的截止日期是什麼時候？
馬克如何管理他的工作進度？
經理說什麼東西會決定成敗？
馬克最後完成工作的進度如何？
options: C. 比預計提前了一天

true_false.q: 名單上幾位客戶的聯絡資訊已經過期了。
經理認為有壓力是一件壞事。
馬克的表現超出了經理的預期。
馬克不打算請經理喝咖啡。
下一個任務會比這一個更輕鬆。

passage.title: Deadlines and Management Listening Passage
passage.zh: 專案的截止日期就在下週五。馬克需要聯絡五十位潛在客戶。他感覺到職場上那種真正的『時間壓力』。他開始使用電子看板管理他的工作進度。他在過程中體會到細節決定成敗。
passage.en: Mark, this is the part you're responsible for. We must complete the confirmation of the customer list before next Friday. No problem. I'll do my best to complete it as scheduled. However, the contact information for several customers on this list seems to have expired. That's the difficulty you need to overcome. You have to find a way to find updated information; it's a 'challenge'. Got it. I'll set the 'priority order' first, starting with the most important customers. Good. Remember, 'details determine success or failure'. Every phone call and email must be very polite and professional. (Three days later) Manager, the progress is slower than I imagined. Several customers haven't been answering the phone. There are always 'unexpected situations' in the workplace. You can't just wait; try sending an email or contacting their assistants. Okay. I feel a strong 'pressure' now, but I'll persist.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫 120 到 150 個字。如果你同時有三件事要在今天下午五點前完成：1. 準備明天的會議簡報。 2. 回覆客戶的重要郵件。 3. 幫主管影印資料。你會如何排定『優先順序』？請說明理由。你覺得時間管理的關鍵是什麼？

grammar.explanation: 使用 '如期' 描述按計畫進行。'細節決定成敗' 是一個常用的職場格言。'超出的預期' 用於表達令人驚喜的表現。
examples: 雖然天氣不好，但活動還是如期舉行。 (Although the weather was bad, the event was held as scheduled.)
我們要從細節做起，因為細節決定成敗。 (We should start from details because details determine success or failure.)
這份禮物完全超出了我的預期。 (This gift completely exceeded my expectations.)
突發狀況 (Emergency)
管理時間 (Time management)

title: Mental Health and Stress
story_description: 馬克在繁忙的實習和學業中感到焦慮，他決定向心理諮商師尋求幫助。他學習了如何識別壓力的來源，並掌握了一些緩解情緒、保持心理健康的實用技巧。
story_intro: 馬克最近經常失眠，總覺得心跳很快。
他意識到這可能是長期的壓力造成的。
他在學校預約了專業的心理諮商。
諮商師引導他表達內心的不安。
馬克開始學習如何與壓力『共處』。

dialogue.speaker: Counselor
dialogue.zh: 馬克，請坐。今天想聊聊什麼？你看起來有些疲憊。
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, qǐng zuò. jīn tiān xiǎng liáo liao shén me? nǐ kàn qǐ lái yǒu xiē pí bèi.
dialogue.en: Mark, please sit. What would you like to talk about today? You look a bit exhausted.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 老師，我最近覺得壓力大到快要窒息了。實習、功課、還有社交活動，我總覺得時間不夠用。
dialogue.py: lǎo shī, wǒ zuì jìn jué de yā lì dà dào kuài yào zhì xī le. shí xí, gōng kè, hái yǒu shè jiāo huó dòng, wǒ zǒng jué de shí jiān bù gòu yòng.
dialogue.en: Teacher, I've been feeling like the stress is about to suffocate me lately. Interning, homework, and social activities—I always feel like there's not enough time.

dialogue.speaker: Counselor
dialogue.zh: 這是典型的『現代人焦慮症』。你覺得這種壓力主要是來自外界的要求，還是你對自己的期許？
dialogue.py: zhè shì diǎn xíng de 'xiàn dài rén jiāo lǜ zhèng'. nǐ jué de zhè zhǒng yā lì zhǔ yào shì lái zì wài jiè de yāo qiú, hái shì nǐ duì zì jǐ de qī xǔ?
dialogue.en: This is a typical 'modern anxiety'. Do you feel this pressure mainly comes from external demands or your expectations of yourself?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我想兩者都有吧。我害怕失敗，怕辜負了身邊人的期望。這讓我感到很焦慮。
dialogue.py: wǒ xiǎng liǎng zhě dōu yǒu ba. wǒ hài pà shī bài, pà gū fù le shēn biān rén de qī wàng. zhè ràng wǒ gǎn dào hěn jiāo lǜ.
dialogue.en: I think it's both. I'm afraid of failure, afraid of letting down the expectations of those around me. This makes me feel very anxious.

dialogue.speaker: Counselor
dialogue.zh: 承認自己的脆弱是勇敢的第一步。你聽過『正念冥想』嗎？這對調節情緒很有幫助。
dialogue.py: chéng rèn zì jǐ de cuì ruò shì yǒng gǎn de dì yī bù. nǐ tīng guò 'zhèng niàn míng xiǎng' ma? zhè duì tiáo jié qíng xù hěn yǒu bāng zhù.
dialogue.en: Admitting your vulnerability is the first step of courage. Have you heard of 'mindfulness meditation'? It's very helpful for regulating emotions.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 聽說過，但我總覺得安靜坐著很浪費時間。我現在最缺的就是時間。
dialogue.py: tīng shuō guò, dàn wǒ zǒng jué de ān jìng zuò zhe hěn làng fèi shí jiān. wǒ xiàn zài zuì quē de jiù shì shí jiān.
dialogue.en: I've heard of it, but I always feel sitting quietly is a waste of time. What I lack most right now is time.

dialogue.speaker: Counselor
dialogue.zh: 這就是誤區。磨刀不誤砍柴工，每天花十分鐘讓大腦『重啟』，你的效率反而會更高。
dialogue.py: zhè jiù shì wù qū. mó dāo bú wù kǎn chái gōng, měi tiān huā shí fēn zhōng ràng dà nǎo 'chóng qǐ', nǐ de xiào lǜ fǎn ér huì gèng gāo.
dialogue.en: That's a misconception. Sharpening the saw doesn't delay the woodcutting; spending ten minutes a day to 'reboot' your brain will actually make your efficiency higher.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我懂了。就像手機當機時需要重啟一樣。那我應該怎麼開始呢？
dialogue.py: wǒ dǒng le. jiù xiàng shǒu jī dàng jī shí xū yào chóng qǐ yī yàng. nà wǒ yīng gāi zěn me kāi shǐ ne?
dialogue.en: I understand. Just like a phone needing a reboot when it crashes. How should I start?

dialogue.speaker: Counselor
dialogue.zh: 從觀察呼吸開始。當你感到壓力湧上來時，停下手中的工作，專注於呼吸三分鐘。
dialogue.py: cóng guān chá hū xī kāi shǐ. dāng nǐ gǎn dào yā lì yǒng shàng lái shí, tíng xià shǒu zhōng de gōng zuò, zhuān zhù yú hū xī sān fēn zhōng.
dialogue.en: Start with observing your breath. When you feel stress surging up, stop the work in your hands and focus on breathing for three minutes.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 聽起來很簡單，我會試試看。另外，我發現我一有壓力就想吃甜食，這正常嗎？
dialogue.py: tīng qǐ lái hěn jiǎn dān, wǒ huì shì shì kàn. lì wài, wǒ fā xiàn wǒ yī yǒu yā lì jiù xiǎng chī tián shí, zhè zhèng cháng ma?
dialogue.en: Sounds simple, I'll give it a try. Also, I found that as soon as I have stress I want to eat sweets; is this normal?

dialogue.speaker: Counselor
dialogue.zh: 這是大腦在尋求補償。但長期來看，這會造成情緒的劇烈波動。建議你用運動來代替甜食。
dialogue.py: zhè shì dà nǎo zài xún qiú bǔ cháng. dàn cháng qī lái kàn, zhè huì zào chéng qíng xù de jù liè bō dòng. jiàn yì nǐ yòng yùn dòng lái qǔ dài tián shí.
dialogue.en: This is the brain seeking compensation. But in the long run, this will cause intense emotional fluctuations. I suggest you use exercise to replace sweets.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我明白了。原來心理健康和生理習慣是息息相關的。
dialogue.py: wǒ míng bai le. yuán lái xīn lǐ jiàn kāng hé shēng lǐ xí guàn shì xī xī xiāng guān de.
dialogue.en: I understand. Turns out mental health and physiological habits are closely linked.

dialogue.speaker: Counselor
dialogue.zh: 沒錯。除了運動，保持良好的社交關係也能減壓。不要把問題都悶在心裡。
dialogue.py: méi cuò. chú le yùn dòng, bǎo chí liáng hǎo de shè jiāo guān xì yě néng jiǎn yā. bù yào bǎ wèn tí dōu mèn zài xīn lǐ.
dialogue.en: Exactly. Besides exercise, maintaining good social relationships can also reduce stress. Don't keep problems bottled up inside.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝老師。跟您聊完後，我覺得胸口沒那麼悶了。我會努力調整生活節奏的。
dialogue.py: xiè xie lǎo shī. gēn nín liáo wán hòu, wǒ jué de xiōng kǒu méi nà me mèn le. wǒ huì nǔ lì tiáo zhěng shēng huó jié zòu de.
dialogue.en: Thank you, Teacher. After chatting with you, I feel my chest isn't so stuffy anymore. I'll work hard to adjust my life rhythm.

dialogue.speaker: Counselor
dialogue.zh: 很好。你要學會對自己溫柔一點。沒人是完美的。下週見！
dialogue.py: hěn hǎo. nǐ yào xué huì duì zì jǐ wēn róu yī diǎn. méi rén shì wán měi de. xià zhōu jiàn!
dialogue.en: Good. You need to learn to be a bit gentler with yourself. No one is perfect. See you next week!

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 下週見！
dialogue.py: xià zhōu jiàn!
dialogue.en: See you next week!

key_sentences.en: Stressed to the point of nearly suffocating.
Sharpening the axe doesn't delay the woodcutting (Preparation pays off).

speaking.part_b: 角色扮演：你的朋友最近因為失戀感到很沮喪，他一直躲在家裡不出來。你打電話關心他，告訴他『承認脆弱是勇敢的第一步』，並邀請他去公園散步，呼吸新鮮空氣以『調節情緒』。朋友最後答應了。

passage.title: Mental Health and Stress Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克最近經常失眠，總覺得心跳很快。他意識到這可能是長期的壓力造成的。他在學校預約了專業的心理諮商。諮商師引導他表達內心的不安。馬克開始學習如何與壓力『共處』。
passage.en: Mark, please sit. What would you like to talk about today? You look a bit exhausted. Teacher, I've been feeling like the stress is about to suffocate me lately. Interning, homework, and social activities—I always feel like there's not enough time. This is a typical 'modern anxiety'. Do you feel this pressure mainly comes from external demands or your expectations of yourself? I think it's both. I'm afraid of failure, afraid of letting down the expectations of those around me. This makes me feel very anxious. Admitting your vulnerability is the first step of courage. Have you heard of 'mindfulness meditation'? It's very helpful for regulating emotions. I've heard of it, but I always feel sitting quietly is a waste of time. What I lack most right now is time. That's a misconception. Sharpening the saw doesn't delay the woodcutting; spending ten minutes a day to 'reboot' your brain will actually make your efficiency higher. I understand. Just like a phone needing a reboot when it crashes. How should I start?
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫 120 到 150 個字。討論你對『心理健康』的看法。你認為現代社會中人們面臨的最大壓力是什麼？你會如何建議一個感到焦慮的朋友？請結合你在本課學到的詞彙（如：調節、正念、息息相關）。

grammar.explanation: 使用 '大到...' 表示程度。'辜負' 常用於承載信任或期望。'息息相關' 形容極其密切的關係。'悶在心裡' 表示情感的壓抑。
examples: 雨大到看不清路。 (It rained so hard I couldn't see the road.)
我不會辜負你的信任。 (I will not fail your trust.)
環保與我們每個人的未來息息相關。 (Environmental protection is closely linked to our future.)
調節情緒 (Regulate emotions)
窒息感 (Feeling of suffocation)

practice.q: Translate: Stressed to the point of crying.
Complete: 不要____負父母的期望。 (Fail to live up to...)

title: A Healthy Lifestyle
story_description: 馬克在健身房遇到了一位資深的健身愛好者陳教練。陳教練不僅教他如何正確使用器材，還分享了關於營養均衡和生活規律的重要性。馬克開始重新定義他的『健康』。
story_intro: 馬克在健身房練習舉重，姿勢不太正確。
陳教練主動過來糾正他的動作。
他們談到了『三分練，七分吃』的原則。
馬克了解到規律作息對肌肉恢復的重要性。
他決定從根本上改變不健康的生活方式。

dialogue.speaker: Coach Chen
dialogue.zh: 同學，等一下！你剛才舉重的姿勢會傷到腰。背要挺直，力道要從腿部發出。
dialogue.py: tóng xué, děng yī xià! nǐ gāng cái jǔ zhòng de zī shì huì shāng dào yāo. bèi yào tǐng zhí, lì dào yào cóng tuǐ bù fā chū.
dialogue.en: Wait a minute! Your weightlifting posture just now will hurt your lower back. Your back must be straight; the strength must come from your legs.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 喔，謝謝教練。我剛開始練，還不太掌握要領。
dialogue.py: ō, xiè xie jiào liàn. wǒ gāng kāi shǐ liàn, hái bù tài zhǎng wò yào lǐng.
dialogue.en: Oh, thanks coach. I just started practicing and haven't quite mastered the essentials yet.

dialogue.speaker: Coach Chen
dialogue.zh: 健身不能急於求成，受傷就划不來了。你目前的目標是減脂還是增肌？
dialogue.py: jiàn shēn bù néng jí yú qiú chéng, shòu shāng jiù huá bù lái le. nǐ mù qián de mù biāo shì jiǎn zhī hái shì zēng jī?
dialogue.en: Fitness can't be rushed for success; getting injured isn't worth it. Is your current goal fat loss or muscle gain?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我想增肌，因為我覺得體力太弱了。但我發現練了一陣子，效果不明顯。
dialogue.py: wǒ xiǎng zēng jī, yīn wèi wǒ jué de tǐ lì tài ruò le. dàn wǒ fā xiàn liàn le yī zhèn zi, xiào guǒ bù míng xiǎn.
dialogue.en: I want to gain muscle because I feel my physical strength is too weak. But I found after practicing for a while, the effect isn't obvious.

dialogue.speaker: Coach Chen
dialogue.zh: 健身界有一句話：『三分練，七分吃』。你平常的飲食習慣怎麼樣？
dialogue.py: jiàn shēn jiè yǒu yī jù huà: 'sān fèn liàn, qī fèn chī'. nǐ píng cháng de yǐn shí xí guàn zěn me yàng?
dialogue.en: There's a saying in the fitness world: '30% training, 70% eating'. How are your usual eating habits?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 實不相瞞，我常吃速食，也很少吃早餐。但我有在喝高蛋白粉。
dialogue.py: shí bù xiāng mán, wǒ cháng chī sù shí, yě hěn shǎo chī zǎo fàn. dàn wǒ yǒu zài hē gāo dàn bái fěn.
dialogue.en: To tell the truth, I often eat fast food and rarely eat breakfast. But I do drink protein powder.

dialogue.speaker: Coach Chen
dialogue.zh: 只靠蛋白粉是不夠的。你需要攝取足夠的優質碳水和維生素。飲食必須『均衡』。
dialogue.py: zhǐ kào dàn bái fěn shì bù gòu de. nǐ xū yào shè qǔ zú gòu de yōu zhì tàn shuǐ hé wéi shēng sù. yǐn shí bì xū 'jūn héng'.
dialogue.en: Relying only on protein powder is not enough. You need to intake enough quality carbs and vitamins. Diet must be 'balanced'.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 難怪我覺得雖然有在動，但身體還是很沉重。那作息呢？
dialogue.py: nán guài wǒ jué de suī rán yǒu zài dòng, dàn shēn tǐ hái shì hěn chén zhòng. nà zuò xī ne?
dialogue.en: No wonder I feel that although I'm moving, my body is still very heavy. What about the routine?

dialogue.speaker: Coach Chen
dialogue.zh: 非常重要！睡眠是肌肉恢復的黃金時間。如果你天天熬夜，肌肉是長不出來的。
dialogue.py: fēi cháng zhòng yào! shuì mián shì jī ròu huī fù de huáng jīn shí jiān. rú guǒ nǐ tiān tiān áo yè, jī ròu shì zhǎng bù chū lái de.
dialogue.en: Very important! Sleep is the golden time for muscle recovery. If you stay up late every day, muscles won't grow.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我懂了。所以健康的生活方式包括規律運動、均衡飲食和充足睡眠。
dialogue.py: wǒ dǒng le. suǒ yǐ jiàn kāng de shēng huó fāng shì bāo kuò guī lǜ yùn dòng, jūn héng yǐ n shí hé chōng zú shuì mián.
dialogue.en: I understand. So a healthy lifestyle includes regular exercise, a balanced diet, and sufficient sleep.

dialogue.speaker: Coach Chen
dialogue.zh: 沒錯。這就是所謂的『良性循環』。一旦你進入這個循環，你的精神狀態會完全不同。
dialogue.py: méi cuò. zhè jiù shì suǒ wèi de 'liáng xìng xún huán'. yī dàn nǐ jìn rù zhè ge xún huán, nǐ de jīng shén zhuàng tài huì wán quán bù tóng.
dialogue.en: Exactly. This is what's called a 'positive cycle'. Once you enter this cycle, your mental state will be completely different.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝教練。我決定從明天起，每天早起吃早餐，並嚴格執行我的健身計畫。
dialogue.py: xiè xie jiào liàn. wǒ jué dìng cóng míng tiān qǐ, měi tiān zǎo qǐ chī zǎo fàn, bìng yán gé zhí xíng wǒ de jiàn shēn jì huà.
dialogue.en: Thank you, Coach. I've decided starting tomorrow, I'll get up early for breakfast every day and strictly execute my fitness plan.

dialogue.speaker: Coach Chen
dialogue.zh: 有志者事竟成。只要你持之以恆，三個月後你一定會感謝現在的自己。
dialogue.py: yǒu zhì zhě shì jìng chéng. zhǐ yào nǐ chí zhī yǐ héng, sān gè yuè hòu nǐ yī dìng huì gǎn xiè xiàn zài de zì jǐ.
dialogue.en: Where there's a will, there's a way. As long as you persevere, in three months you will definitely thank your current self.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我會努力的！我們球場見。
dialogue.py: wǒ huì nǔ lì de! wǒ men qiú chǎng jiàn.
dialogue.en: I'll work hard! See you on the court.

dialogue.speaker: Coach Chen
dialogue.zh: 加油！
dialogue.py: jiā yóu!
dialogue.en: Keep it up!

key_sentences.en: Master the essentials of the movement.
Anxious for success / rush to achieve something.
Where there is a will, there is a way.

vocabulary.meaning: Where there's a will there's a way

speaking.part_b: 角色扮演：你在健身房教一位新手朋友如何正確跑步。告訴他姿勢要放鬆，呼吸要均勻，並強調運動後要『拉筋（lā jīn）』以防止肌肉痠痛。朋友謝謝你的指導。
part_c: 你覺得對於健康來說，『吃』和『練』哪一個更重要？為什麼？
你曾經有過『急於求成』而失敗的經歷嗎？

comprehension.q: 教練為什麼糾正馬克的舉重姿勢？
options: C. 因為他不喜歡馬克

comprehension.q: 馬克目前的健身目標是什麼？
『三分練，七分吃』強調的是什麼？
options: B. 飲食對健身的影響比練習更大

comprehension.q: 為什麼熬夜不利於增肌？
options: B. 睡眠是肌肉恢復的黃金時間

comprehension.q: 教練用哪句成語鼓勵馬克？

true_false.q: 馬克已經完全掌握了舉重的要領。
教練認為受傷是划不來的。
馬克平時常吃速食，不吃早餐。
攝取優質碳水對增肌沒有幫助。
馬克決定嚴格執行他的健身計畫。

passage.title: A Healthy Lifestyle Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克在健身房練習舉重，姿勢不太正確。陳教練主動過來糾正他的動作。他們談到了『三分練，七分吃』的原則。馬克了解到規律作息對肌肉恢復的重要性。他決定從根本上改變不健康的生活方式。
passage.en: Wait a minute! Your weightlifting posture just now will hurt your lower back. Your back must be straight; the strength must come from your legs. Oh, thanks coach. I just started practicing and haven't quite mastered the essentials yet. Fitness can't be rushed for success; getting injured isn't worth it. Is your current goal fat loss or muscle gain? I want to gain muscle because I feel my physical strength is too weak. But I found after practicing for a while, the effect isn't obvious. There's a saying in the fitness world: '30% training, 70% eating'. How are your usual eating habits? To tell the truth, I often eat fast food and rarely eat breakfast. But I do drink protein powder. Relying only on protein powder is not enough. You need to intake enough quality carbs and vitamins. Diet must be 'balanced'. No wonder I feel that although I'm moving, my body is still very heavy. What about the routine?
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫 120 到 150 個字。描述你心目中理想的『健康生活方式』。這包括哪些方面的習慣？如果你現在要改變一個不健康的習慣，你會選擇哪一個？為什麼？請使用本課學到的成語（如：持之以恆、有志者事竟成）。

grammar.explanation: 使用 '急於' 表達心情迫切。'划不來' 是常見的口語形容詞。'三分...，七分...' 的結構用於表達主次關係。
examples: 他急於知道結果。 (He is anxious to know the result.)
為了省錢走兩小時路，真是划不來。 (Walking 2 hours to save money is really not worth it.)
這件事，三分靠運氣，七分靠努力。 (This matter depends 30% on luck and 70% on effort.)
持之以恆 (Persevere)
實不相瞞 (To be honest)

practice.q: Complete: 做事不能___於求成。 (Anxious for...)
Complete: 實不相____，我不會。 (To be honest...)

title: Traditional vs. Modern Medicine
story_description: 馬克因為長期的過敏問題，在莉莉的建議下嘗試了『中醫』。他對中醫的把脈、針灸以及調理身體的理念感到非常好奇，並與西醫進行了比較。
story_intro: 馬克一直受到鼻子過敏的困擾。
西藥雖然見效快，但不能根治。
莉莉帶他去了一家有名的老字號中醫診所。
馬克第一次體驗了把脈和針灸。
他開始思考中西醫結合的可能性。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 莉莉，這家中醫診所的味道好特別喔，是一股濃濃的藥草味。
dialogue.py: lì lì, zhè jiā zhōng yī zhěn suǒ de wèi dào hǎo tè bié ō, shì yī gǔ nóng nóng de yào cǎo wèi.
dialogue.en: Lily, the smell of this Chinese medicine clinic is so special; it's a strong herbal scent.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 那是熬中藥的味道。中醫講究『標本兼治』，雖然慢，但對調理身體很有幫助。
dialogue.py: nà shì áo zhōng yào de wèi dào. zhōng yī jiǎng jiu 'biāo běn jiān zhì', suī rán màn, dàn duì tiáo lǐ shēn tǐ hěn yǒu bāng zhù.
dialogue.en: That's the smell of decocting Chinese medicine. TCM emphasizes 'treating both the symptoms and the root cause'; although slow, it's very helpful for regulating the body.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.zh: 年輕人，請坐。手伸出來，我幫你『把個脈』。
dialogue.py: nián qīng rén, qǐng zuò. shǒu shēn chū lái, wǒ bāng nǐ 'bǎ gè mài'.
dialogue.en: Young man, please sit. Stretch out your hand, let me feel your pulse.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 把脈？只靠手指按著手腕就能知道生什麼病嗎？這太神奇了。
dialogue.py: bǎ mài? zhǐ kào shǒu zhǐ àn zhe shǒu wàn jiù néng zhī dào shēng shén me bìng ma? zhè tài shén qí le.
dialogue.en: Feel the pulse? Can you know what illness it is just by fingers pressing on the wrist? This is too magical.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.zh: 這是中醫的經驗科學。你的脈象顯示你體內『濕氣』太重，脾胃也比較虛弱。
dialogue.py: zhè shì zhōng yī de jīng yàn kē xué. nǐ de mài xiàng xiǎn shì nǐ tǐ nèi 'shī qì' tài zhòng, pí wèi yě bǐ jiào xū ruò.
dialogue.en: This is the empirical science of TCM. Your pulse shows that the 'dampness' in your body is too heavy, and your spleen and stomach are relatively weak.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 濕氣？這在西醫裡好像沒有這個概念。西醫通常是檢查細菌或病毒。
dialogue.py: shī qì? zhè zài xī yī lǐ hǎo xiàng méi yǒu zhè ge gài niàn. xī yī tōng cháng shì jiǎn chá xì jùn huò bìng dú.
dialogue.en: Dampness? There doesn't seem to be this concept in Western medicine. Western medicine usually checks for bacteria or viruses.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.zh: 對，西醫看重『治標』，見效很快；中醫則看重整體的平衡。我建議你試試針灸。
dialogue.py: duì, xī yī kàn zhòng 'zhì biāo', jiàn xiào hěn kuài; zhōng yī zé kàn zhòng zhěng tǐ de píng héng. wǒ jiàn yì nǐ shì shì zhēn jiǔ.
dialogue.en: Yes, Western medicine focuses on 'treating the symptoms' and is effective very quickly; TCM focuses on overall balance. I suggest you try acupuncture.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 針灸？是用針扎在皮膚上嗎？會不會很痛？
dialogue.py: zhēn jiǔ? shì yòng zhēn zhā zài pí fū shàng ma? huì bù huì hěn tòng?
dialogue.en: Acupuncture? Using needles to prick the skin? Will it be very painful?

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.zh: 不會痛，只會有一種痠麻的感覺。這能幫你疏通經絡。
dialogue.py: bú huì tòng, zhǐ huì yǒu yī zhǒng suān má de gǎn jué. zhè néng bāng nǐ shū tōng jīng luò.
dialogue.en: It won't hurt; there will only be a kind of sour and numb sensation. This can help clear your meridians.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: （針灸完）哇，鼻子真的通了！這比吃過敏藥還管用。
dialogue.py: (zhēn jiǔ wán) wa, bí zi zhēn de tōng le! zhè bǐ chī guò mǐn yào hái guǎn yòng.
dialogue.en: (After acupuncture) Wow, my nose is truly clear! This is even more effective than taking allergy medicine.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.zh: 這只是暫時的。你還要喝兩週的中藥來『調理內在』，平時少喝冰水。
dialogue.py: zhè zhǐ shì zàn shí de. nǐ hái yào hē liǎng zhōu de zhōng yào lái 'tiáo lǐ nèi zài', píng shí shǎo hē bīng shuǐ.
dialogue.en: This is only temporary. You still need to drink Chinese medicine for two weeks to 'regulate the internal'; usually drink less ice water.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 中藥是不是很苦？我看電視上的人都要皺著臉喝。
dialogue.py: zhòng yào shì bú shì hěn kǔ? wǒ kàn diàn shì shàng de rén dōu yào zhòu zhe liǎn hē.
dialogue.en: Is Chinese medicine very bitter? I see people on TV always drinking it with a wrinkled face.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 良藥苦口嘛！為了健康，苦一點也值得。馬克，中西醫結合才是最好的辦法。
dialogue.py: liáng yào kǔ kǒu ma! wèi le jiàn kāng, kǔ yī diǎn yě zhí de. mǎ kè, zhōng xī yī jié hé cái shì zuì hǎo de bàn fǎ.
dialogue.en: Good medicine tastes bitter! For health, even being a bit bitter is worth it. Mark, combining Chinese and Western medicine is the best way.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我同意。西醫救急，中醫保養。兩者都很重要。
dialogue.py: wǒ tóng yì. xī yī jiù jí, zhōng yī bǎo yǎng. liǎng zhě dōu hěn zhòng yào.
dialogue.en: I agree. Western medicine for emergencies, TCM for maintenance. Both are very important.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.zh: 很有見地！記得按時吃藥。下週再來複診。
dialogue.py: hěn yǒu jiàn dì! jì de àn shí chī yào. xià zhōu zài lái fù zhěn.
dialogue.en: Very insightful! Remember to take medicine on time. Come back for a follow-up next week.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝醫生，再見！
dialogue.py: xiè xie yī shēng, zài jiàn!
dialogue.en: Thank you, Doctor; goodbye!

key_sentences.en: Treat both the symptoms and the root cause.
Good medicine tastes bitter (Hard truths are good for one).
Even more effective than taking medicine.

vocabulary.meaning: old and famous shop / long-established brand
to treat both root and symptoms

speaking.part_b: 角色扮演：你的外國同學感冒了很久都沒好，你建議他去試試中醫，因為可以『調理身體』。同學擔心喝中藥太苦，你用『良藥苦口』說服他。最後他同意去試試。
part_c: 你相信中醫嗎？為什麼？
你覺得西醫和中醫最大的區別在哪裡？

options: B. 標本和 root 都治（治標也治本）

針灸的感覺被描述為什麼？

醫生認為馬克的濕氣太重，脾胃虛弱。
針灸完後馬克的鼻子立刻就不通了。

passage.en: Lily, the smell of this Chinese medicine clinic is so special; it's a strong herbal scent. That's the smell of decocting Chinese medicine. TCM emphasizes 'treating both the symptoms and the root cause'; although slow, it's very helpful for regulating the body. Young man, please sit. Stretch out your hand, let me feel your pulse. Feel the pulse? Can you know what illness it is just by fingers pressing on the wrist? This is too magical. This is the empirical science of TCM. Your pulse shows that the 'dampness' in your body is too heavy, and your spleen and stomach are relatively weak. Dampness? There doesn't seem to be this concept in Western medicine. Western medicine usually checks for bacteria or viruses. Yes, Western medicine focuses on 'treating the symptoms' and is effective very quickly; TCM focuses on overall balance. I suggest you try acupuncture. Acupuncture? Using needles to prick the skin? Will it be very painful?
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫 120 到 150 個字。如果你生病了，你會優先選擇中醫還是西醫？請說明理由。你認為在現代社會，傳統醫學（如中醫）還有存在的價值嗎？請使用本課學到的詞彙（如：調理、見效、神奇）。

grammar.explanation: 使用 '比...還...' 表達程度的進一步對比。'V + 著' 表示動作的方式 (按著手腕、皺著臉)。'只有...才...' 表示唯一的必要條件。
examples: 這比我想像的還難。 (This is even harder than I imagined.)
他聽著音樂跑步。 (He runs while listening to music.)

見效快 (Quickly effective)
調理內在 (Regulate the internal)

practice.q: Translate: Even better than I thought.
Complete: 他皺____臉喝藥。 (While wrinkling his face...)

practice.a: 只有健康才是最重要的。

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 我最近肩膀好痠痛，是不是該去拔個罐？
expansion_dialogue.py: wǒ zuì jìn jiān bǎng hǎo suān tòng, shì bú shì gāi qù bá gè guàn?
expansion_dialogue.en: My shoulders are so sore lately; should I go get some cupping therapy?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 拔罐對緩解肌肉痠痛很有幫助。你看奧運運動員也常做。
expansion_dialogue.py: bá guàn duì huǎn jiě jī ròu suān tòng hěn yǒu bāng zhù. nǐ kàn ào yùn yùn dòng yuán yě cháng zuò.
expansion_dialogue.en: Cupping is very helpful for alleviating muscle soreness. You see Olympic athletes do it often too.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 可是拔完之後後背會有一圈一圈紫紅色的痕跡，好醜喔。
expansion_dialogue.py: kě shì bá wán zhī hòu hòu bèi huì yǒu yī quān yī quān zǐ hóng sè de hén jì, hǎo chǒu ō.
expansion_dialogue.en: But after doing it, there will be circles of purplish-red marks on the back; it's so ugly.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 那是正常的，過幾天就消了。跟健康比起來，外表一點都不重要吧？
expansion_dialogue.py: nà shì zhèng cháng de, guò jǐ tiān jiù xiāo le. gēn jiàn kāng bǐ qǐ lái, wài biǎo yī diǎn dōu bù zhòng yào ba?
expansion_dialogue.en: That's normal; it'll fade in a few days. Compared to health, appearance isn't important at all, right?

title: Artificial Intelligence
story_description: 馬克在課堂上討論人工智慧（AI）的崛起。他和同學們探討了 AI 在生活中的便利，以及對未來就業市場的潛在衝擊。
story_intro: AI 技術正在以驚人的速度發展。
馬克開始嘗試使用 AI 來輔助學習。
課堂上教授發起了一場關於『AI 取代人類』的討論。
學生們對這項新技術持有不同的態度。
馬克意識到提升『不被取代』的能力非常重要。

dialogue.speaker: Professor
dialogue.zh: 各位同學，這兩年人工智慧（AI）發展迅猛。你們覺得它對生活最大的影響是什麼？
dialogue.py: gè wèi tóng xué, zhè liǎng nián rén gōng zhì huì (AI) fā zhǎn xùn měng. nǐ men jué de tā duì shēng huó zuì dà de yǐng xiǎng shì shén me?
dialogue.en: Everyone, AI has been developing rapidly these past two years. What do you think is its biggest impact on life?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我覺得是效率的提升。比如翻譯軟體和程式碼輔助，真的節省了很多時間。
dialogue.py: wǒ jué de shì xiào lǜ de tí shēng. bǐ rú fān yì ruǎn tǐ hé chéng shì mǎ fǔ zhù, zhēn de jié shěng le hěn duō shí jiān.
dialogue.en: I think it's the boost in efficiency. For example, translation software and code assistance have truly saved a lot of time.

dialogue.speaker: Student B
dialogue.zh: 但也讓人感到恐懼。聽說很多重複性的工作即將被 AI 取代，那以後我們畢業怎麼辦？
dialogue.py: dàn yě ràng rén gǎn dào kǒng jù. tīng shuō hěn duō chóng fù xìng de gōng zuò jí jiāng bèi AI qǔ dài, nà yǐ hòu wǒ men bì yè zěn me bàn?
dialogue.en: But it also makes people feel fear. I heard many repetitive jobs are about to be replaced by AI; what will we do after graduation?

dialogue.speaker: Professor
dialogue.zh: 這就是所謂的『技術性失業』。但歷史告訴我們，技術革新往往會創造出新的職位。
dialogue.py: zhè jiù shì suǒ wèi de 'jì shù xìng shī yè'. dàn lì shǐ gào su wǒ men, jì shù gé xīn wǎng wǎng huì chuàng zào chū xīn de zhí wèi.
dialogue.en: This is what's called 'technological unemployment'. But history tells us that technological innovation often creates new positions.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 教授，那您覺得哪些能力是 AI 無法取代的呢？
dialogue.py: jiào shòu, nà nín jué de nǎ xiē néng lì shì AI wú fǎ qǔ dài de ne?
dialogue.en: Professor, then which abilities do you think are irreplaceable by AI?

dialogue.speaker: Professor
dialogue.zh: 情感價值、創造力以及複雜的道德判斷。AI 雖然強大，但它沒有靈魂，無法真正理解人類的情感。
dialogue.py: qíng gǎn jià zhí, chuàng zào lì yǐ jí fù zá de dào dé pàn duàn. AI suī rán qiáng dà, dàn tā méi yǒu líng hún, wú fǎ zhēn zhèng lǐ jiě rén lèi de qíng gǎn.
dialogue.en: Emotional value, creativity, and complex moral judgment. Although AI is powerful, it has no soul and cannot truly understand human emotions.

dialogue.speaker: Student B
dialogue.zh: 可是現在 AI 都能寫詩、畫畫了，這難道不是創造力嗎？
dialogue.py: kě shì xiàn zài AI dōu néng xiě shī, huà huà le, zhè nán dào bú shì chuàng zào lì ma?
dialogue.en: But now AI can write poems and paint; isn't this creativity?

dialogue.speaker: Professor
dialogue.zh: 那只是海量數據的模擬。真正的原創力來自於對生活的深刻體驗和感悟。
dialogue.py: nà zhǐ shì hǎi liàng shù jù de mó nǐ. zhēn zhèng de yuán chuàng lì lái zì yú duì shēng huó de shēn kè tǐ yàn hé gǎn wù.
dialogue.en: That is only a simulation of massive amounts of data. True originality comes from profound experiences and insights into life.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我明白了。我們不應該抗拒技術，而應該學習如何與 AI 協作，把它當作工具。
dialogue.py: wǒ míng bai le. wǒ men bù yīng gāi kàng jù jì shù, ér yīng gāi xué xí rú hé gēn AI xié zuò, bǎ tā dāng zuò gōng jù.
dialogue.en: I understand. We shouldn't resist technology but should learn how to collaborate with AI and treat it as a tool.

dialogue.speaker: Professor
dialogue.zh: 非常正確。未來屬於那些懂得如何運用 AI 並發揮人類獨特價值的人。
dialogue.py: fēi cháng zhèng què. wèi lái shǔ yú nà xiē dǒng de rú hé yùn yòng AI bìng fā huī rén lèi dú tè jià zhí de rén.
dialogue.en: Exactly right. The future belongs to those who know how to utilize AI and bring out the unique value of humans.

dialogue.speaker: Student B
dialogue.zh: 可是 AI 的道德風險呢？比如假新聞或者是數據隱私問題。
dialogue.py: kě shì AI de dào dé fēng xiǎn ne? bǐ rú jiǎ xīn wén huò zhě shì shù jù yǐn sī wèn tí.
dialogue.en: But what about the ethical risks of AI? Like fake news or data privacy issues.

dialogue.speaker: Professor
dialogue.zh: 這就需要更完善的法律和倫理規範。這也是人類需要解決的難題。
dialogue.py: zhè jiù xū yào gèng wán shàn de fǎ lǜ hé lún lǐ guī fàn. zhè yě shì rén lèi xū yào jiě jué de nán tí.
dialogue.en: This requires more complete laws and ethical norms. This is also a difficult problem humans need to solve.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 聽完這堂課，我覺得雖然未來有很多不確定性，但也充滿了機會。
dialogue.py: tīng wán zhè táng kè, wǒ jué de suī rán wèi lái yǒu hěn duō bù què dìng xìng, dàn yě chōng mǎn le jī huì.
dialogue.en: After hearing this class, I feel that although the future has many uncertainties, it's also full of opportunities.

dialogue.speaker: Professor
dialogue.zh: 保持好奇心和持續學習的能力，才是生存的關鍵。下課吧！
dialogue.py: bǎo chí hào qí xīn hé chí xù xué xí de néng lì, cái shì shēng cún de guān jiàn. xià kè ba!
dialogue.en: Maintaining curiosity and the ability for lifelong learning is exactly the key to survival. Class dismissed!

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝教授！
dialogue.py: xiè xie jiào shòu!
dialogue.en: Thank you, Professor!

passage.title: Artificial Intelligence Listening Passage
passage.zh: AI技術正在以驚人的速度發展。馬克開始嘗試使用AI來輔助學習。課堂上教授發起了一場關於『AI取代人類』的討論。學生們對這項新技術持有不同的態度。馬克意識到提升『不被取代』的能力非常重要。
passage.en: Everyone, AI has been developing rapidly these past two years. What do you think is its biggest impact on life? I think it's the boost in efficiency. For example, translation software and code assistance have truly saved a lot of time. But it also makes people feel fear. I heard many repetitive jobs are about to be replaced by AI; what will we do after graduation? This is what's called 'technological unemployment'. But history tells us that technological innovation often creates new positions. Professor, then which abilities do you think are irreplaceable by AI? Emotional value, creativity, and complex moral judgment. Although AI is powerful, it has no soul and cannot truly understand human emotions. But now AI can write poems and paint; isn't this creativity? That is only a simulation of massive amounts of data. True originality comes from profound experiences and insights into life.

title: Social Media Pros and Cons
story_description: 馬克和莉莉討論社群媒體對心理健康和人際關係的雙重影響。他們探討了『FOMO』（錯失恐懼症）以及如何建立健康的網路使用習慣。
story_intro: 馬克發現自己一小時不看手機就感到心慌。
莉莉分享了她曾經『數位排毒』的經歷。
他們談到了社群媒體上的虛假完美。
他們討論了網路霸凌的嚴重性。
馬克決定嘗試每天限制社群媒體的使用時間。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 莉莉，你有沒有發現，我們現在好像被社群媒體綁架了？我連吃飯都要先發限動。
dialogue.py: lì lì, nǐ yǒu méi yǒu fā xiàn, wǒ men xiàn zài hǎo xiàng bèi shè qún méi tǐ bǎng jià le? wǒ lián chī fàn dōu yào xiān fā xiàn dòng.
dialogue.en: Lily, have you noticed, we seem to be kidnapped by social media now? I even have to post a Story before eating.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 深有同感。這種『手機成癮』真的很普遍。你是不是也有『錯失恐懼症』？
dialogue.py: shēn yǒu tóng gǎn. zhè zhǒng 'shǒu jī chéng yǐn' zhēn de hěn pǔ biàn. nǐ shì bú shì yě yǒu 'cuò shī kǒng jù zhèng'?
dialogue.en: I feel deeply the same. This 'phone addiction' is truly common. Do you also have 'FOMO' (Fear of Missing Out)?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 對！看到大家都在參加有趣的活動，而我一個人在宿舍，我就會感到莫名的焦慮。
dialogue.py: duì! kàn dào dà jiā dōu zài cān jiā yǒu qù de huó dòng, ér wǒ yī gè rén zài sù shè, wǒ jiù huì gǎn dào mò míng de jiāo lǜ.
dialogue.en: Yes! Seeing everyone participating in fun activities while I'm alone in the dorm, I feel an inexplicable anxiety.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 那是因為社群媒體呈現的往往是『過濾後』的完美。人們只展示生活最好的那一面。
dialogue.py: nà shì yīn wèi shè qún méi tǐ chéng xiàn de wǎng wǎng shì 'guò lǜ hòu' de wán měi. rén men zhǐ zhǎn shì shēng huó zuì hǎo de nà yī miàn.
dialogue.en: That's because what's presented on social media is often 'filtered' perfection. People only show the best side of life.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 沒錯。有時候跟別人的『完美生活』比較，會讓我產生強烈的自卑感。
dialogue.py: méi cuò. yǒu shí hou gēn bié rén de 'wán měi shēng huó' bǐ jiào, huì ràng wǒ chǎn shēng qiáng liè de zì bēi gǎn.
dialogue.en: Exactly. Sometimes comparing with others' 'perfect lives' makes me feel a strong sense of inferiority.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 所以我之前嘗試過一週的『數位排毒』，完全不看任何社群媒體。感覺心裡平靜多了。
dialogue.py: suǒ yǐ wǒ zhī qián cháng shì guò yī zhōu de 'shù wèi pái dú', wán quán bù kàn rèn hé shè qún méi tǐ. gǎn jué xīn lǐ píng jìng duō le.
dialogue.en: So I previously tried a week of 'digital detox', completely not looking at any social media. I felt much calmer inside.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 一整週？那不會很不方便嗎？如果朋友找你怎麼辦？
dialogue.py: yī zhěng zhōu? nà bú huì hěn bù fāng biàn ma? rú guǒ péng you zhǎo nǐ zěn me bàn?
dialogue.en: A whole week? Wouldn't that be very inconvenient? What if friends looked for you?

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 真正重要的朋友會打電話或發簡訊。這反而幫我篩選了社交圈，留下了真實的連結。
dialogue.py: zhēn zhèng zhòng yào de péng you huì dǎ diàn huà huò fā jiǎn xùn. zhè fǎn ér bāng wǒ shāi xuǎn le shè jiāo quān, liú xià le zhēn shí de lián jié.
dialogue.en: Truly important friends will call or send a text. This actually helped me filter my social circle and left real connections.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 但社群媒體也有好處吧？比如我們可以隨時關注遠方親友的動態，或者接收新資訊。
dialogue.py: dàn shè qún méi tǐ yě yǒu hǎo chù ba? bǐ rú wǒ men kě yǐ suí shí guān zhù yuǎn fāng qīn yǒu de dòng tài, huò zhě jiē shōu xīn zī xùn.
dialogue.en: But social media has pros too, right? For example, we can follow distant relatives' updates anytime or receive new information.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 當然，它縮短了距離，也是發聲的工具。關鍵在於『適度』，不要讓它支配你的生活。
dialogue.py: dāng rán, tā suō duǎn le jù lí, yě shì fā shēng de gōng jù. guān jiàn zài yú 'shì dù', bú yào ràng tā zhī pèi nǐ de shēng huó.
dialogue.en: Of course, it shortened distances and is a tool for speaking out. The key lies in 'moderation'; don't let it dominate your life.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 還有網路霸凌的問題，很多人在網上隨便批評別人，完全不考慮後果。
dialogue.py: hái yǒu wǎng lù bà líng de wèn tí, hěn duō rén zài wǎng shàng suí biàn pī píng bié rén, wán quán bù kǎo lǜ hòu guǒ.
dialogue.en: There's also the issue of cyberbullying; many people criticize others randomly online, completely without considering the consequences.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 對，文字的殺傷力有時候比拳頭還大。我們應該推廣『數位素養』。
dialogue.py: duì, wén zì de shā shāng lì yǒu shí hou bǐ quán tou hái dà. wǒ men yīng gāi tuī guǎng 'shù wèi sù yǎng'.
dialogue.en: Yes, the lethality of words is sometimes bigger than fists. We should promote 'digital literacy'.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我也打算下載一個 App 監控自己的使用時間。每天限制在兩小時以內。
dialogue.py: wǒ yě dǎ suàn xià zài yī gè App jiān kòng zì jǐ de shǐ yòng shí jiān. měi tiān xiàn zhì zài liǎng xiǎo shí yǐ nèi.
dialogue.en: I also plan to download an App to monitor my usage time. Limit it to within two hours a day.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 我支持你！把多出來的時間拿來面對面交流，這才是真實的生活。
dialogue.py: wǒ zhī chí nǐ! bǎ duō chū lái de shí jiān ná lái miàn duì miàn jiāo liú, zhè cái shì zhēn shí de shēng huó.
dialogue.en: I support you! Take the extra time for face-to-face communication; that is real life.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 對，放下手機，立地成佛！開玩笑的，我們走吧。
dialogue.py: duì, fàng xià shǒu jī, lì dì chéng fó! kāi wán xiào de, wǒ men zǒu ba.
dialogue.en: Right, put down the phone, immediately become a Buddha! Just kidding, let's go.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 走吧！
dialogue.py: zǒu ba!
dialogue.en: Let's go!

speaking.part_b: 角色扮演：你的朋友每天花五個小時滑 Instagram，感到很焦慮。你建議他嘗試『數位排毒』，並分享你週末去爬山而不看手機的平靜感受。朋友決定也試試看。

grammar.explanation: 使用 '被...綁架' 表達受制於某物。'往往是...' 用於描述通常的情況或本質。'與其...不如...' (雖然未直接出現但隱含此邏輯) 引導更好的選擇。

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你看到那則網路霸凌的新聞了嗎？那個女孩太可憐了。
expansion_dialogue.py: nǐ kàn dào nà zé wǎng lù bà líng de xīn wén le ma? nà gè nǚ hái tài kě lián le.
expansion_dialogue.en: Did you see that news about cyberbullying? That girl is so pitiful.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B
expansion_dialogue.zh: 看到了。那些鍵盤俠說話真的一點都不負責。
expansion_dialogue.py: kàn dào le. nà xiē jiàn pán xiá shuō huà zhēn de yī diǎn dōu bù fù zé.
expansion_dialogue.en: I saw it. Those keyboard warriors are truly not responsible for what they say at all.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: A
expansion_dialogue.zh: 我們真的應該加強青少年的網路教育，讓他們知道尊重的重要性。
expansion_dialogue.py: wǒ men zhēn de yīng gāi jiā qiáng qīng shào nián de wǎng lù jiào yù, ràng tā men zhī dào zūn zhòng de zhòng yào xìng.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: B

title: Renting an Apartment
story_description: 馬克為了節省通勤時間，決定搬到離公司近一點的地方。他約了房東看房子，並學習如何用中文討論租金、押金、水電費以及簽訂房屋租賃契約的細節。
story_intro: 馬克在租屋網站上看到一間不錯的獨立套房。
地點離公司走路只要十分鐘。
他約了房東林太太週末看房。
他事前查了一些租屋相關的法律常識。
他希望能順利談成一個好價格。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 林太太您好，我是約好來看房子的馬克。這間套房採光真不錯。
dialogue.py: lín tài tai nín hǎo, wǒ shì yuē hǎo lái kàn fáng zi de mǎ kè. zhè jiān tào fáng cǎi guāng zhēn bú cuò.
dialogue.en: Mrs. Lin, hello, I'm Mark who made an appointment to see the apartment. The natural lighting in this studio is really not bad.

dialogue.speaker: Landlady
dialogue.zh: 馬克你好。是啊，這間坐北朝南，通風又好。家具都是去年才換新的。
dialogue.py: mǎ kè nǐ hǎo. shì a, zhè jiān zuò běi cháo nán, tōng fēng yòu hǎo. jiā jù dōu shì qù nián cái huàn xīn de.
dialogue.en: Hello Mark. Yes, this one faces south from the north, and the ventilation is good. The furniture was all replaced with new ones just last year.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 請問租金一個月是一萬五千元嗎？包含水電費和網路嗎？
dialogue.py: qǐng wèn zū jīn yī gè yuè shì yī wàn wǔ qiān yuán ma? bāo hán shuǐ diàn fèi hé wǎng lù ma?
dialogue.en: May I ask if the rent is 15,000 NT dollars a month? Does it include utilities and internet?

dialogue.speaker: Landlady
dialogue.zh: 租金一萬五包含網路和第四台。水電費要照『台水台電』的帳單自己繳喔。
dialogue.py: zū jīn yī wàn wǔ bāo hán wǎng lù hé dì sì tái. shuǐ diàn fèi yào zhào 'tái shuǐ tái diàn' de zhàng dān zì jǐ jiǎo ō.
dialogue.en: The rent of 15,000 includes internet and cable TV. You have to pay the water and electricity bills yourself according to the 'Taiwan Water and Taipower' bills.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 台水台電比較合理，這樣用多少算多少。那押金怎麼算呢？
dialogue.py: tái shuǐ tái diàn bǐ jiào hé lǐ, zhè yàng yòng duō shǎo suàn duō shǎo. nà yā jīn zěn me suàn ne?
dialogue.en: Taiwan Water and Taipower is more reasonable; this way it's calculated by how much is used. Then how is the deposit calculated?

dialogue.speaker: Landlady
dialogue.zh: 押金是兩個月，也就是三萬元。退租的時候，如果屋況沒問題就會全額退還。
dialogue.py: yā jīn shì liǎng gè yuè, yě jiù shì sān wàn yuán. tuì zū de shí hou, rú guǒ wū kuàng méi wèn tí jiù huì quán é tuì huán.
dialogue.en: The deposit is two months, which is 30,000 dollars. When terminating the lease, if the house condition is fine, it will be refunded in full.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 了解。我注意到合約上寫『禁止養寵物』，但我有一隻貓，能通融一下嗎？
dialogue.py: liǎo jiě. wǒ zhù yì dào hé yuē shàng xiě 'jìn zhǐ yǎng chǒng wù', dàn wǒ yǒu yī zhī māo, néng tōng róng yī xià ma?
dialogue.en: Got it. I noticed the contract says 'No pets allowed', but I have a cat; could you make an exception?

dialogue.speaker: Landlady
dialogue.zh: 這...因為之前有房客的貓把沙發抓壞了，所以我後來都規定不能養。如果一定要養，可能要多收一點『清潔費』。
dialogue.py: zhè... yīn wèi zhī qián yǒu fáng kè de māo bǎ shā fā zhuā huài le, suǒ yǐ wǒ hòu lái dōu guī dìng bù néng yǎng. rú guǒ yī dìng yào yǎng, kě néng yào duō shōu yī diǎn 'qīng jié fèi'.
dialogue.en: Well... because a previous tenant's cat scratched and ruined the sofa, so later I stipulated no pets. If you really must keep one, I might have to charge a bit more for a 'cleaning fee'.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我願意負擔額外的清潔費，我的貓很乖，不會亂抓。另外，租約是一年一簽嗎？
dialogue.py: wǒ yuàn yì fù dān é wài de qīng jié fèi, wǒ de māo hěn guāi, bú huì luàn zhuā. lì wài, zū yuē shì yī nián yī qiān ma?
dialogue.en: I'm willing to bear the extra cleaning fee; my cat is very well-behaved and won't scratch randomly. Additionally, is the lease signed year by year?

dialogue.speaker: Landlady
dialogue.zh: 對，最短租期是一年。如果你提早搬走，要扣一個月的違約金喔。
dialogue.py: duì, zuì duǎn zū qī shì yī nián. rú guǒ nǐ tí zǎo bān zǒu, yào kòu yī gè yuè de wéi yuē jīn ō.
dialogue.en: Yes, the minimum lease term is one year. If you move out early, one month's penalty fee will be deducted.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。我看這附近的環境很單純，治安應該不錯吧？
dialogue.py: méi wèn tí. wǒ kàn zhè fù jìn de huán jìng hěn dān chún, zhì ān yīng gāi bú cuò ba?
dialogue.en: No problem. I see the environment around here is very simple; public security should be good, right?

dialogue.speaker: Landlady
dialogue.zh: 這點你放心，樓下有保全，電梯也都有監視器，非常安全。
dialogue.py: zhè diǎn nǐ fàng xīn, lóu xià yǒu bǎo quán, diàn tī yě dōu yǒu jiān shì qì, fēi cháng ān quán.
dialogue.en: Rest assured about this; there are security guards downstairs, and elevators all have surveillance cameras; it's very safe.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 那太好了。如果家電壞了，像是冷氣不冷，修繕費用是誰負責？
dialogue.py: nà tài hǎo le. rú guǒ jiā diàn huài le, xiàng shì lěng qì bù lěng, xiū shàn fèi yòng shì shuí fù zé?
dialogue.en: That's great. If appliances break, like the AC not being cold, who is responsible for the repair costs?

dialogue.speaker: Landlady
dialogue.zh: 如果是自然損壞，當然是我負責修。但如果是你人為弄壞的，就要你賠償囉。
dialogue.py: rú guǒ shì zì rán sǔn huài, dāng rán shì wǒ fù zé xiū. dàn rú guǒ shì nǐ rén wéi nòng huài de, jiù yào nǐ péi cháng luo.
dialogue.en: If it's natural damage, of course I'm responsible for fixing it. But if it's damaged artificially by you, then you'll have to compensate.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 很公平。我很喜歡這裡。那我們什麼時候可以簽約？
dialogue.py: hěn gōng píng. wǒ hěn xǐ huan zhè lǐ. nà wǒ men shén me shí hou kě yǐ qiān yuē?
dialogue.en: Very fair. I like it here very much. So when can we sign the contract?

dialogue.speaker: Landlady
dialogue.zh: 如果你確定要，我們現在就可以簽。記得帶身分證影本。
dialogue.py: rú guǒ nǐ què dìng yào, wǒ men xiàn zài jiù kě yǐ qiān. jì de dài shēn fèn zhèng yǐng běn.
dialogue.en: If you are sure you want it, we can sign it right now. Remember to bring a copy of your ID card.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好的，我都準備好了。我等一下去領現金付押金。謝謝林太太。
dialogue.py: hǎo de, wǒ dōu zhǔn bèi hǎo le. wǒ děng yī xià qù lǐng xiàn jīn fù yā jīn. xiè xie lín tài tai.
dialogue.en: Okay, I've prepared everything. I'll go withdraw cash to pay the deposit in a moment. Thank you, Mrs. Lin.

dialogue.speaker: Landlady
dialogue.zh: 不客氣，希望你住得習慣！
dialogue.py: bú kè qi, xī wàng nǐ zhù de xí guàn!
dialogue.en: You're welcome; hope you get used to living here!

key_sentences.en: Pay according to Taiwan Water and Taipower bills.
Could you make an exception / be flexible?
Natural damage is repaired by the landlord.

speaking.part_b: 角色扮演：你正在看房子，發現冷氣有點舊。你向房東詢問如果冷氣在夏天壞了，修繕費用由誰負擔。房東說如果是『自然損壞』他會負責，但如果是『人為』的要你賠償。你同意這個條件並決定簽約。

passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫 120 到 150 個字。描述一次你租房子的經驗（或想像一次）。你遇到了什麼困難？合約中有哪些讓你印象深刻的規定？你對想要租房子的外國朋友有什麼建議？請結合本課學到的詞彙（如：押金、修繕、通融）。

grammar.explanation: 使用 '照...算' 表示依據某種標準計算。'也就是...' 用於進一步解釋或換算。'通融' 是一個非常有禮貌的請求打破規則的用詞。
