title: Investment and Stock Market
story_description: 馬克存了一筆錢，想開始投資理財。他向有豐富投資經驗的同事阿明請教股票市場的基礎知識。他們討論了風險分散、長期投資以及如何對抗通貨膨脹。
story_intro: 馬克看著銀行裡的存款，覺得利息太低了。
他聽說最近股市很熱絡。
但他對『股票』和『基金』一竅不通。
趁著午休時間，他向阿明討教。
他學習到投資的第一課是『控制風險』。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 阿明，我最近想把一筆存款拿去投資，銀行的定存利率真的太低了，根本趕不上通貨膨脹。
dialogue.py: ā míng, wǒ zuì jìn xiǎng bǎ yī bǐ cún kuǎn ná qù tōu zī, yín háng de dìng cún lì lǜ zhēn de tài dī le, gēn běn gǎn bú shàng tōng huò péng zhàng.
dialogue.en: A-ming, I recently want to take a deposit to invest; the bank's fixed deposit interest rate is really too low, it can't catch up with inflation at all.

dialogue.speaker: A-ming
dialogue.zh: 你這個觀念很正確。錢放在銀行實質上是在『貶值』。你想買股票還是買基金？
dialogue.py: nǐ zhè ge guān niàn hěn zhèng què. qián fàng zài yín háng shí zhí shàng shì zài 'biǎn zhí'. nǐ xiǎng mǎi gǔ piào hái shì mǎi jī jīn?
dialogue.en: Your concept is very correct. Money kept in the bank is essentially 'depreciating'. Do you want to buy stocks or funds?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 其實我不太懂這兩者的差別。股票是不是風險很高？我看新聞常有人『被套牢』。
dialogue.py: qí shí wǒ bú tài dǒng zhè liǎng zhě de chā bié. gǔ piào shì bú shì fēng xiǎn hěn gāo? wǒ kàn xīn wén cháng yǒu rén 'bèi tào láo'.
dialogue.en: Actually, I don't quite understand the difference between the two. Are stocks very high-risk? I often see news about people being 'stuck/trapped' in the market.

dialogue.speaker: A-ming
dialogue.zh: 買單一公司的股票風險確實較高。如果你是新手，我建議你從 ETF（指數股票型基金）開始。
dialogue.py: mǎi dān yī gōng sī de gǔ piào fēng xiǎn què shí jiào gāo. rú guǒ nǐ shì xīn shǒu, wǒ jiàn yì nǐ cóng ETF (zhǐ shù gǔ piào xíng jī jīn) kāi shǐ.
dialogue.en: Buying stocks of a single company does have higher risk. If you are a novice, I suggest you start with ETFs (Exchange Traded Funds).

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: ETF？那是什麼？
dialogue.py: ETF? nà shì shén me?
dialogue.en: ETF? What is that?

dialogue.speaker: A-ming
dialogue.zh: 簡單來說，就是買下一籃子表現優良的公司股票。這樣可以『分散風險』。就算其中一家公司倒了，影響也不會太大。
dialogue.py: jiǎn dān lái shuō, jiù shì mǎi xià yī lán zi biǎo xiàn yōu liáng de gōng sī gǔ piào. zhè yàng kě yǐ 'fēn sàn fēng xiǎn'. jiù suàn qí zhōng yī jiā gōng sī dǎo le, yǐng xiǎng yě bú huì tài dà.
dialogue.en: Simply put, it's buying a basket of well-performing company stocks. This can 'diversify risk'. Even if one company goes bankrupt, the impact won't be too big.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 聽起來很適合我！那我應該什麼時候進場買？要每天看『盤』嗎？
dialogue.py: tīng qǐ lái hěn shì hé wǒ! nà wǒ yīng gāi shén me shí hou jìn chǎng mǎi? yào měi tiān kàn 'pán' ma?
dialogue.en: Sounds very suitable for me! Then when should I enter the market to buy? Do I need to watch the 'market board' every day?

dialogue.speaker: A-ming
dialogue.zh: 千萬不要每天盯盤，那會影響心情。你可以設定『定期定額』投資，每個月固定扣款買入。
dialogue.py: qiān wàn bú yào měi tiān dīng pán, nà huì yǐng xiǎng xīn qíng. nǐ kě yǐ shè dìng 'dìng qī dìng é' tōu zī, měi gè yuè gù dìng kòu kuǎn mǎi rù.
dialogue.en: Absolutely do not stare at the market board every day; that will affect your mood. You can set up 'regular fixed-amount' investment, deducting a fixed amount to buy every month.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 定期定額？如果股票跌了，我不就虧錢了嗎？
dialogue.py: dìng qī dìng é? rú guǒ gǔ piào diē le, wǒ bú jiù kuī qián le ma?
dialogue.en: Regular fixed-amount? If the stock falls, won't I lose money?

dialogue.speaker: A-ming
dialogue.zh: 股價跌的時候，你反而可以用同樣的錢買到更多的『股數』。長期下來，成本會被攤平。
dialogue.py: gǔ jià diē de shí hou, nǐ fǎn ér kě yǐ yòng tóng yàng de qián mǎi dào gèng duō de 'gǔ shù'. cháng qī xià lái, chéng běn huì bèi tān píng.
dialogue.en: When the stock price falls, you can actually buy more 'shares' with the same amount of money. Over the long term, the cost will be averaged out.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 原來如此。這就是所謂的『長期投資』和享受複利的威力吧。
dialogue.py: yuán lái rú cǐ. zhè jiù shì suǒ wèi de 'cháng qī tōu zī' hé xiǎng shòu fù lì de wēi lì ba.
dialogue.en: I see. This is what's called 'long-term investing' and enjoying the power of compound interest, right?

dialogue.speaker: A-ming
dialogue.zh: 沒錯！投資最忌諱的就是『追高殺低』。看到別人賺錢就跟著買，跌了又恐慌賣出。
dialogue.py: méi cuò! tōu zī zuì jì huì de jiù shì 'zhuī gāo shā dī'. kàn dào bié rén zhuàn qián jiù gēn zhe mǎi, diē le yòu kǒng huāng mài chū.
dialogue.en: Exactly! The biggest taboo in investing is 'chasing highs and selling lows'. Seeing others make money and following to buy, then panicking and selling when it drops.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 懂了。我不能貪心，要保持理智。不過，投資股票的『手續費』高嗎？
dialogue.py: dǒng le. wǒ bù néng tān xīn, yào bǎo chí lǐ zhì. bù guò, tōu zī gǔ piào de 'shǒu xù fèi' gāo ma?
dialogue.en: Got it. I can't be greedy; I must stay rational. However, is the 'handling fee' for investing in stocks high?

dialogue.speaker: A-ming
dialogue.zh: 現在很多證券商都有提供手續費折扣。你可以多比較幾家開戶。但我還是要提醒你，投資一定有風險。
dialogue.py: xiàn zài hěn duō zhèng quàn shāng dōu yǒu tí gōng shǒu xù fèi zhé kòu. nǐ kě yǐ duō bǐ jiào jǐ jiā kāi hù. dàn wǒ hái shì yào tí xǐng nǐ, tōu zī yī dìng yǒu fēng xiǎn.
dialogue.en: Nowadays many securities firms offer handling fee discounts. You can compare a few to open an account. But I still must remind you, investments definitely have risks.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 『投資理財有賺有賠』，這句警語我聽過很多次了。我只會用閒錢投資。
dialogue.py: 'tōu zī lǐ cái yǒu zhuàn yǒu péi', zhè jù jǐng yǔ wǒ tīng guò hěn duō cì le. wǒ zhǐ huì yòng xián qián tōu zī.
dialogue.en: 'Investments have gains and losses'; I've heard this warning many times. I will only invest with spare money.

dialogue.speaker: A-ming
dialogue.zh: 那就好。今晚下班後，我可以教你怎麼看懂基本的財報。
dialogue.py: nà jiù hǎo. jīn wǎn xià bān hòu, wǒ kě yǐ jiāo nǐ zěn me kàn dǒng jī běn de cái bào.
dialogue.en: That's good. After work tonight, I can teach you how to read basic financial reports.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 太棒了！謝謝阿明大師！今晚晚餐我請客！
dialogue.py: tài bàng le! xiè xie ā míng dà shī! jīn wǎn wǎn cān wǒ qǐng kè!
dialogue.en: Awesome! Thank you Master A-ming! Dinner is on me tonight!

passage.title: Investment and Stock Market Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克看著銀行裡的存款，覺得利息太低了。他聽說最近股市很熱絡。但他對『股票』和『基金』一竅不通。趁著午休時間，他向阿明討教。他學習到投資的第一課是『控制風險』。
passage.en: A-ming, I recently want to take a deposit to invest; the bank's fixed deposit interest rate is really too low, it can't catch up with inflation at all. Your concept is very correct. Money kept in the bank is essentially 'depreciating'. Do you want to buy stocks or funds? Actually, I don't quite understand the difference between the two. Are stocks very high-risk? I often see news about people being 'stuck/trapped' in the market. Buying stocks of a single company does have higher risk. If you are a novice, I suggest you start with ETFs (Exchange Traded Funds). ETF? What is that? Simply put, it's buying a basket of well-performing company stocks. This can 'diversify risk'. Even if one company goes bankrupt, the impact won't be too big. Sounds very suitable for me! Then when should I enter the market to buy? Do I need to watch the 'market board' every day? Absolutely do not stare at the market board every day; that will affect your mood. You can set up 'regular fixed-amount' investment, deducting a fixed amount to buy every month.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫 120 到 150 個字。討論你的理財觀念。你平常會儲蓄嗎？你對『股票』或『基金』有什麼看法？如果你有一筆閒錢，你會選擇放在銀行還是拿去投資？請使用本課學到的詞彙（如：通膨、分散風險、定期定額）。

grammar.explanation: 使用 '趕不上' 表示速度或增長幅度落後於某事物。'把...拿去...' 用於描述對資源的處置。'反而' 表示與預期相反的結果。

title: Traditional Festivals
story_description: 中秋節快到了，莉莉邀請馬克參加家族的烤肉聚會。透過這個機會，馬克了解了中秋節的傳說故事、月餅的象徵意義，以及台灣獨特的節慶文化。
story_intro: 街上的餅店開始大排長龍。
到處都可以聞到烤肉的香味。
莉莉告訴馬克中秋節是農曆八月十五日。
馬克買了一盒柚子準備當作伴手禮。
他對『嫦娥奔月』的故事感到非常好奇。

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 馬克，這週五是中秋節，我家人要在院子裡烤肉，你想一起來嗎？
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, zhè zhōu wǔ shì zhōng qiū jié, wǒ jiā rén yào zài yuàn zi lǐ kǎo ròu, nǐ xiǎng yī qǐ lái ma?
dialogue.en: Mark, this Friday is the Mid-Autumn Festival. My family is going to have a barbecue in the yard. Do you want to come along?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？太棒了！我很樂意。不過中秋節不是吃月餅賞月嗎？為什麼台灣人要烤肉？
dialogue.py: zhēn de ma? tài bàng le! wǒ hěn lè yì. bù guò zhōng qiū jié bú shì chī yuè bǐng shǎng yuè ma? wèi shén me tái wān rén yào kǎo ròu?
dialogue.en: Really? That's great! I'd love to. But isn't Mid-Autumn Festival for eating mooncakes and admiring the moon? Why do Taiwanese people barbecue?

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，這算是一個『約定俗成』的習慣。聽說三十幾年前，醬油廣告打太兇，結果『一家烤肉萬家香』，大家就都開始烤肉了。
dialogue.py: hā hā, zhè suàn shì yī gè 'yuē dìng sú chéng' de xí guàn. tīng shuō sān shí jǐ nián qián, jiàng yóu guǎng gào dǎ tài xiōng, jié guǒ 'yī jiā kǎo ròu wàn jiā xiāng', dà jiā jiù dōu kāi shǐ kǎo ròu le.
dialogue.en: Haha, this is considered an 'established by popular usage' habit. I heard that over 30 years ago, soy sauce commercials were promoted so aggressively, resulting in 'one family barbecues, ten thousand families smell the fragrance', so everyone started barbecuing.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 原來是商業行銷造就的傳統！真有趣。我買了這盒『柚子』，希望你們家人會喜歡。
dialogue.py: yuán lái shì shāng yè xíng xiāo zào jiù de chuán tǒng! zhēn yǒu qù. wǒ mǎi le zhè hé 'yòu zi', xī wàng nǐ men jiā rén huì xǐ huan.
dialogue.en: So it's a tradition created by commercial marketing! Really interesting. I bought this box of 'pomelos'; I hope your family will like it.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 謝謝！柚子的發音跟『佑子』很像，有保佑子孫的意思，非常吉利。
dialogue.py: xiè xie! yòu zi de fā yīn gēn 'yòu zi' hěn xiàng, yǒu bǎo yòu zǐ sūn de yì si, fēi cháng jí lì.
dialogue.en: Thank you! The pronunciation of pomelo (yòuzi) is very similar to 'bless the son' (yòuzǐ); it has the meaning of blessing descendants, which is very auspicious.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 中文的諧音文化真的很豐富。對了，月餅為什麼要做成圓形的？
dialogue.py: zhōng wén de xié yīn wén huà zhēn de hěn fēng fù. duì le, yuè bǐng wèi shén me yào zuò chéng yuán xíng de?
dialogue.en: Chinese homophonic culture is really rich. By the way, why must mooncakes be made in a round shape?

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 圓形象徵『團圓』。中秋節是一年之中月亮最圓最亮的時候，遊子都會盡量趕回家跟家人團聚。
dialogue.py: yuán xíng xiàng zhēng 'tuán yuán'. zhōng qiū jié shì yī nián zhī zhōng yuè liàng zuì yuán zuì liàng de shí hou, yóu zǐ dōu huì jìn liàng gǎn huí jiā gēn jiā rén tuán jù.
dialogue.en: The round shape symbolizes 'reunion'. Mid-Autumn Festival is when the moon is the roundest and brightest of the year; travelers living away from home will try their best to hurry back to reunite with their families.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 難怪最近高鐵票這麼難買。我之前聽過『嫦娥奔月』的故事，那是中秋節的由來嗎？
dialogue.py: nán guài zuì jìn gāo tiě piào zhè me nán mǎi. wǒ zhī qián tīng guò 'cháng é bēn yuè' de gù shi, nà shì zhōng qiū jié de yóu lái ma?
dialogue.en: No wonder high-speed rail tickets have been so hard to buy recently. I heard the story of 'Chang'e flying to the moon' before; is that the origin of the Mid-Autumn Festival?

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 對，那是最著名的神話。嫦娥吃了長生不老藥，飛到了月亮上。大家為了紀念她，就在這天拜月亮。
dialogue.py: duì, nà shì zuì zhù míng de shén huà. cháng é chī le cháng shēng bù lǎo yào, fēi dào le yuè liàng shàng. dà jiā wèi le jì niàn tā, jiù zài zhè tiān bài yuè liàng.
dialogue.en: Yes, that's the most famous myth. Chang'e took the elixir of immortality and flew to the moon. To commemorate her, everyone worships the moon on this day.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 這故事帶點淡淡的哀傷。那吳剛伐桂呢？
dialogue.py: zhè gù shi dài diǎn dàn dàn de āi shāng. nà wú gāng fá guì ne?
dialogue.en: This story carries a touch of faint sorrow. What about Wu Gang chopping the cassia tree?

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 你連吳剛都知道！對，傳說月亮上有個砍不斷的桂樹。這些神話讓中秋節充滿了浪漫的色彩。
dialogue.py: nǐ lián wú gāng dōu zhī dào! duì, chuán shuō yuè liàng shàng yǒu gè kǎn bù duàn de guì shù. zhè xiē shén huà ràng zhōng qiū jié chōng mǎn le làng màn de sè cǎi.
dialogue.en: You even know Wu Gang! Yes, legend says there is an uncuttable cassia tree on the moon. These myths make the Mid-Autumn Festival full of romantic colors.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 除了中秋節，台灣還有哪些重要的傳統節日？
dialogue.py: chú le zhōng qiū jié, tái wān hái yǒu nǎ xiē zhòng yào de chuán tǒng jié rì?
dialogue.en: Besides Mid-Autumn Festival, what other important traditional festivals are there in Taiwan?

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 最重要的當然是『農曆新年』，然後是吃粽子的『端午節』。這三大節日是台灣人最看重的。
dialogue.py: zuì zhòng yào de dāng rán shì 'nóng lì xīn nián', rán hòu shì chī zòng zi de 'duān wǔ jié'. zhè sān dà jié rì shì tái wān rén zuì kàn zhòng de.
dialogue.en: The most important of course is the 'Lunar New Year', and then the 'Dragon Boat Festival' where we eat zongzi. These three major festivals are what Taiwanese people value the most.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 端午節的龍舟比賽我很想看。每個節日都有專屬的食物，真的很有意思。
dialogue.py: duān wǔ jié de lóng zhōu bǐ sài wǒ hěn xiǎng kàn. měi gè jié rì dōu yǒu zhuān shǔ de shí wù, zhēn de hěn yǒu yì si.
dialogue.en: I really want to watch the dragon boat races during the Dragon Boat Festival. Every festival has its exclusive food; it's really interesting.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 這就是文化傳承啊。週五晚上見囉，記得空著肚子來，我爸爸烤的香腸可是一絕！
dialogue.py: zhè jiù shì wén huà chuán chéng a. zhōu wǔ wǎn shàng jiàn luo, jì de kōng zhe dǔ zi lái, wǒ bà ba kǎo de xiāng cháng kě shì yī jué!
dialogue.en: This is cultural inheritance. See you Friday night; remember to come with an empty stomach; the sausages my dad grills are absolutely superb!

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，我迫不及待了！
dialogue.py: méi wèn tí, wǒ pò bù jí dài le!
dialogue.en: No problem, I can't wait!

title: Volunteer Work and Society
story_description: 馬克週末參加了一個為偏鄉兒童輔導英文的志工活動。透過這次活動，他深刻體會到城鄉差距與教育資源分配不均的問題，也感受到了『施比受更有福』的喜悅。
story_intro: 馬克在學校的佈告欄看到志工招募的海報。
他決定利用週末時間去偏鄉小學幫忙。
他負責教低年級的小朋友簡單的英文對話。
這裡的設備比城市裡的學校簡陋許多。
孩子們純真的笑容讓他深受感動。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 陳校長，今天真的很開心能來這裡當志工。小朋友們都非常熱情。
dialogue.py: chén xiào zhǎng, jīn tiān zhēn de hěn kāi xīn néng lái zhè lǐ dāng zhì gōng. xiǎo péng yǒu men dōu fēi cháng rè qíng.
dialogue.en: Principal Chen, I'm really happy to come here as a volunteer today. The children are all very enthusiastic.

dialogue.speaker: Principal
dialogue.zh: 馬克，謝謝你大老遠跑來。偏鄉學校最缺乏的就是『外語師資』，你的到來對孩子們幫助很大。
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, xiè xie nǐ dà lǎo yuǎn pǎo lái. piān xiāng xué xiào zuì quē fá de jiù shì 'wài yǔ shī zī', nǐ de dào lái duì hái zi men bāng zhù hěn dà.
dialogue.en: Mark, thank you for coming from so far away. What rural schools lack most is 'foreign language teaching staff'; your arrival is a great help to the kids.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我發現雖然這裡的硬體設備不如市區的學校，但孩子們學習的『渴望』非常強烈。
dialogue.py: wǒ fā xiàn suī rán zhè lǐ de yìng tǐ shè bèi bù rú shì qū de xué xiào, dàn hái zi men xué xí de 'kě wàng' fēi cháng qiáng liè.
dialogue.en: I found that although the hardware equipment here is not as good as schools in the city, the kids' 'thirst/desire' to learn is very strong.

dialogue.speaker: Principal
dialogue.zh: 是啊，這就是我們常說的『城鄉差距』。教育資源分配不均，是我們一直努力想改善的難題。
dialogue.py: shì a, zhè jiù shì wǒ men cháng shuō de 'chéng xiāng chā jù'. jiào yù zī yuán fēn pèi bù jūn, shì wǒ men yī zhí nǔ lì xiǎng gǎi shàn de nán tí.
dialogue.en: Yes, this is what we often call the 'urban-rural gap'. Unequal distribution of educational resources is a difficult problem we've always been striving to improve.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我在教他們英文唱歌的時候，有個小男孩說他長大想當機長，飛到世界各地看看。
dialogue.py: wǒ zài jiāo tā men yīng wén chàng gē de shí hou, yǒu gè xiǎo nán hái shuō tā zhǎng dà xiǎng dāng jī zhǎng, fēi dào shì jiè gè dì kàn kan.
dialogue.en: When I was teaching them English songs, a little boy said he wants to be a pilot when he grows up and fly all over the world to see it.

dialogue.speaker: Principal
dialogue.zh: 那是小明。很多這裡的孩子，父母都在外地打工，他們是所謂的『隔代教養』家庭，平時是由爺爺奶奶照顧的。
dialogue.py: nà shì xiǎo míng. hěn duō zhè lǐ de hái zi, fù mǔ dōu zài wài dì dǎ gōng, tā men shì suǒ wèi de 'gé dài jiào yǎng' jiā tíng, píng shí shì yóu yé ye nǎi nai zhào gù de.
dialogue.en: That's Xiao Ming. Many children here have parents working out of town; they are from so-called 'skipped-generation parenting' families, usually taken care of by grandparents.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 隔代教養？那一定很不容易。爺爺奶奶可能沒有精力輔導他們的功課。
dialogue.py: gé dài jiào yǎng? nà yī dìng hěn bù róng yì. yé ye nǎi nai kě néng méi yǒu jīng lì fǔ dǎo tā men de gōng kè.
dialogue.en: Skipped-generation parenting? That must be very difficult. Grandparents might not have the energy to tutor their homework.

dialogue.speaker: Principal
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，所以我們學校在放學後會安排『課後輔導』，盡量彌補家庭教育的不足。
dialogue.py: méi cuò, suǒ yǐ wǒ men xué xiào zài fàng xué hòu huì ān pái 'kè hòu fǔ dǎo', jìn liàng mí bǔ jiā tíng jiào yù de bù zú.
dialogue.en: Exactly, so our school arranges 'after-school tutoring' after classes are dismissed, trying to make up for the deficiency in family education.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 校長，你們真的太偉大了。這讓我意識到我平時擁有的資源是多麼『理所當然』。
dialogue.py: xiào zhǎng, nǐ men zhēn de tài wěi dà le. zhè ràng wǒ yì shí dào wǒ píng shí yǒng yǒu de zī yuán shì duō me 'lǐ suǒ dāng rán'.
dialogue.en: Principal, you are truly too great. This makes me realize how I took the resources I usually have so much 'for granted'.

dialogue.speaker: Principal
dialogue.zh: 社會需要更多像你這樣願意付出的年輕人。『施比受更有福』，你今天有體會到這句話的意思嗎？
dialogue.py: shè huì xū yào gèng duō xiàng nǐ zhè yàng yuàn yì fù chū de nián qīng rén. 'shī bǐ shòu gèng yǒu fú', nǐ jīn tiān yǒu tǐ huì dào zhè jù huà de yì si ma?
dialogue.en: Society needs more young people willing to give like you. 'It is more blessed to give than to receive'; did you experience the meaning of this phrase today?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 非常有感觸。看到他們因為學會一個新單字而眼睛發亮的樣子，我心裡的滿足感是無法形容的。
dialogue.py: fēi cháng yǒu gǎn chù. kàn dào tā men yīn wèi xué huì yī gè xīn dān zì ér yǎn jing fā liàng de yàng zi, wǒ xīn lǐ de mǎn zú gǎn shì wú fǎ xíng róng de.
dialogue.en: I feel it very deeply. Seeing their eyes light up because they learned a new word, the sense of satisfaction in my heart is indescribable.

dialogue.speaker: Principal
dialogue.zh: 這就是志工服務的魔力。你付出了一點時間，卻收穫了滿滿的感動。
dialogue.py: zhè jiù shì zhì gōng fú wù de mó lì. nǐ fù chū le yī diǎn shí jiān, què shōu huò le mǎn mǎn de gǎn dòng.
dialogue.en: This is the magic of volunteer service. You gave a little time but harvested a lot of moving feelings.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 如果可以的話，我下個月想帶幾個外國朋友一起來辦一個『英語夏令營』，您覺得合適嗎？
dialogue.py: rú guǒ kě yǐ de huà, wǒ xià gè yuè xiǎng dài jǐ gè wài guó péng you yī qǐ lái bàn yī gè 'yīng yǔ xià lìng yíng', nín jué de hé shì ma?
dialogue.en: If possible, next month I want to bring a few foreign friends together to hold an 'English summer camp'; do you think it's suitable?

dialogue.speaker: Principal
dialogue.zh: 那真是求之不得！孩子們一定會高興壞了。我代表全校師生先謝謝你們。
dialogue.py: nà zhēn shì qiú zhī bù dé! hái zi men yī dìng huì gāo xìng huài le. wǒ dài biǎo quán xiào shī shēng xiān xiè xie nǐ men.
dialogue.en: That's exactly what we wish for! The kids will definitely be overjoyed. On behalf of all the teachers and students, I thank you in advance.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 這是我應該做的。我們下個月見！
dialogue.py: zhè shì wǒ yīng gāi zuò de. wǒ men xià gè yuè jiàn!
dialogue.en: It's what I should do. See you next month!

key_sentences.en: What's most lacking is teaching staff.
Make up for the deficiency in family education.

key_sentences.example: 不要把別人的幫忙視為理所當然。

key_sentences.example: 這份工作對我來說真是求之不得。

speaking.part_b: 角色扮演：你在面試一個非營利組織（NGO）的實習職位。面試官問你為什麼想來這裡工作？你回答說你曾經在偏鄉做過志工，看到『教育資源分配不均』的問題，希望能『盡一份心力』，因為你相信『施比受更有福』。面試官對你的回答很滿意。
part_c: 你曾經參加過什麼志工活動嗎？請分享你的經驗。
你認為政府應該如何解決『城鄉差距』的問題？

passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫 120 到 150 個字。討論志工服務的意義。你覺得參與志工活動除了幫助別人，對志工本人有什麼好處？請舉出一個你想參與的公益計畫，並說明原因。請使用本課學到的詞彙（如：彌補、理所當然、施比受更有福）。

grammar.explanation: 使用 '大老遠' 形容路途遙遠且辛苦。'不如' 用於比較，表示前者比不上後者。'理所當然' 是一個常用的成語，表示事情本該如此。
examples: 他大老遠跑來送我禮物。 (He came from far away just to give me a gift.)
這家餐廳的味道不如以前了。 (This restaurant's taste is not as good as before.)
父母的愛不是理所當然的，我們要懂得感恩。 (Parents' love is not something to be taken for granted; we must know how to be grateful.)

求之不得 (Couldn't ask for more)

title: Literature and History Basics
story_description: 馬克為了更深入了解華人思想，選修了一門『中國文學與歷史』的通識課。在課堂上，教授介紹了儒家思想、唐詩宋詞，並討論了歷史故事如何影響現代人的價值觀。
story_intro: 馬克對古裝劇裡的文言文感到很好奇。
他決定從基礎的文學常識開始學起。
今天的課堂主題是『儒家思想與唐詩』。
教授用生動的方式講解古代文人的生活。
馬克發現歷史不只是過去，更是現在的鏡子。

dialogue.speaker: Professor
dialogue.zh: 各位，說到華人的價值觀，就不能不提『儒家思想』。孔子提倡的『仁』和『禮』，至今仍深深影響著我們的社會。
dialogue.py: gè wèi, shuō dào huá rén de jià zhí guān, jiù bù néng bù tí 'rú jiā sī xiǎng'. kǒng zǐ tí chàng de 'rén' hé 'lǐ', zhì jīn réng shēn shēn yǐng xiǎng zhe wǒ men de shè huì.
dialogue.en: Everyone, speaking of Chinese values, we cannot fail to mention 'Confucianism'. The concepts of 'Benevolence' and 'Propriety' advocated by Confucius still deeply influence our society today.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 教授，『仁』是不是就是對別人好、有同理心的意思？
dialogue.py: jiào shòu, 'rén' shì bú shì jiù shì duì bié rén hǎo, yǒu tóng lǐ xīn de yì si?
dialogue.en: Professor, does 'Benevolence' just mean being good to others and having empathy?

dialogue.speaker: Professor
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，馬克理解得很精準。『己所不欲，勿施於人』，這句話就是仁的核心。你自己不喜歡的事，就不要加在別人身上。
dialogue.py: méi cuò, mǎ kè lǐ jiě de hěn jīng zhǔn. 'jǐ suǒ bù yù, wù shī yú rén', zhè jù huà jiù shì rén de hé xīn. nǐ zì jǐ bù xǐ huan de shì, jiù bú yào jiā zài bié rén shēn shàng.
dialogue.en: Exactly, Mark's understanding is very precise. 'Do not do to others what you do not want done to yourself'; this phrase is the core of benevolence. Things you don't like yourself, don't impose on others.

dialogue.speaker: Student B
dialogue.zh: 可是我覺得現代社會競爭這麼激烈，儒家思想會不會太過於『理想化』了？
dialogue.py: kě shì wǒ jué de xiàn dài shè huì jìng zhēng zhè me jī liè, rú jiā sī xiǎng huì bú huì tài guò yú 'lǐ xiǎng huà' le?
dialogue.en: But I feel modern society is so fiercely competitive; isn't Confucianism a bit too 'idealized'?

dialogue.speaker: Professor
dialogue.zh: 這是個好問題。文學和哲學提供的是一種精神的『避風港』。就像我們接下來要談的『唐詩』。
dialogue.py: zhè shì gè hǎo wèn tí. wén xué hé zhé xué tí gōng de shì yī zhǒng jīng shén de 'bì fēng gǎng'. jiù xiàng wǒ men jiē xià lái yào tán de 'táng shī'.
dialogue.en: That's a good question. Literature and philosophy provide a spiritual 'safe haven'. Just like the 'Tang poetry' we are going to discuss next.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我聽過李白！他是『詩仙』對吧？他好像很喜歡喝酒。
dialogue.py: wǒ tīng guò lǐ bái! tā shì 'shī xiān' duì ba? tā hǎo xiàng hěn xǐ huan hē jiǔ.
dialogue.en: I've heard of Li Bai! He is the 'Poet Immortal', right? He seemed to really like drinking wine.

dialogue.speaker: Professor
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，是的。李白的詩充滿了『豪邁』和浪漫的氣息。相對的，另一位詩人杜甫，被稱為『詩聖』，他的作品就比較『寫實』，反映了民間的疾苦。
dialogue.py: hā hā, shì de. lǐ bái de shī chōng mǎn le 'háo mài' hé làng màn de qì xī. xiāng duì de, lìng yī wèi shī rén dù fǔ, bèi chēng wéi 'shī shèng', tā de zuò pǐn jiù bǐ jiào 'xiě shí', fǎn yìng le mín jiān de jí kǔ.
dialogue.en: Haha, yes. Li Bai's poetry is full of 'heroic/bold' and romantic atmosphere. In contrast, another poet Du Fu, known as the 'Poet Sage', his works are more 'realistic', reflecting the sufferings of the common people.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 所以透過讀詩，我們可以看出當時的社會背景和歷史變遷？
dialogue.py: suǒ yǐ tòu guò dú shī, wǒ men kě yǐ kàn chū dāng shí de shè huì bèi jǐng hé lì shǐ biàn qiān?
dialogue.en: So through reading poetry, we can see the social background and historical changes of that time?

dialogue.speaker: Professor
dialogue.zh: 一點也沒錯。所謂『以史為鏡』，歷史故事總是在不斷重演。了解過去，才能看清未來。
dialogue.py: yī diǎn yě méi cuò. suǒ wèi 'yǐ shǐ wéi jìng', lì shǐ gù shi zǒng shì zài bú duàn chóng yǎn. liǎo jiě guò qù, cái néng kàn qīng wèi lái.
dialogue.en: Absolutely correct. The so-called 'using history as a mirror', historical stories are always constantly repeating. Only by understanding the past can we see the future clearly.

dialogue.speaker: Student B
dialogue.zh: 教授，那『宋詞』跟唐詩有什麼不一樣？
dialogue.py: jiào shòu, nà 'sòng cí' gēn táng shī yǒu shén me bù yī yàng?
dialogue.en: Professor, then what's the difference between 'Song lyrics (Ci)' and Tang poetry?

dialogue.speaker: Professor
dialogue.zh: 宋詞原本是配合音樂唱的歌詞，句子的長短不一，所以又叫『長短句』。情感表達比唐詩更『細膩』婉約。
dialogue.py: sòng cí yuán běn shì pèi hé yīn yuè chàng de gē cí, jù zi de cháng duǎn bù yī, suǒ yǐ yòu jiào 'cháng duǎn jù'. qíng gǎn biǎo dá bǐ táng shī gèng 'xì nì' wǎn yuē.
dialogue.en: Song Ci were originally lyrics sung with music; the sentences vary in length, so it's also called 'long and short sentences'. The emotional expression is more 'delicate' and graceful than Tang poetry.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 中文真的很奧妙。同樣是文字，卻能傳達這麼多層次的情感。但那些『文言文』真的好難懂。
dialogue.py: zhōng wén zhēn de hěn ào miào. tóng yàng shì wén zì, què néng chuán dá zhè me duō céng cì de qíng gǎn. dàn nà xiē 'wén yán wén' zhēn de hǎo nán dǒng.
dialogue.en: Chinese is truly profound/mysterious. It's the same characters, yet they can convey so many layers of emotion. But those 'Classical Chinese' texts are really hard to understand.

dialogue.speaker: Professor
dialogue.zh: 文言文就像濃縮的精華。不要死記硬背，要試著去體會作者寫作時的『心境』。這需要時間慢慢『沉澱』。
dialogue.py: wén yán wén jiù xiàng nóng suō de jīng huá. bú yào sǐ jì yìng bèi, yào shì zhe qù tǐ huì zuò zhě xiě zuò shí de 'xīn jìng'. zhè xū yào shí jiān màn màn 'chén diàn'.
dialogue.en: Classical Chinese is like concentrated essence. Don't memorize it mechanically; try to experience the author's 'state of mind' when writing. This needs time to slowly 'settle/accumulate'.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我想我會去買一本唐詩三百首，每天讀一首試試看。
dialogue.py: wǒ xiǎng wǒ huì qù mǎi yī běn táng shī sān bǎi shǒu, měi tiān dú yī shǒu shì shì kàn.
dialogue.en: I think I will go buy a copy of 'Three Hundred Tang Poems' and try reading one every day.

dialogue.speaker: Professor
dialogue.zh: 很好的開始！『腹有詩書氣自華』，讀書能改變一個人的氣質。今天的課就上到這裡。
dialogue.py: hěn hǎo de kāi shǐ! 'fù yǒu shī shū qì zì huá', dú shū néng gǎi biàn yī gè rén de qì zhí. jīn tiān de kè jiù shàng dào zhè lǐ.
dialogue.en: A very good start! 'One who is filled with poetry and books naturally has an elegant aura'; reading can change a person's temperament. Today's class ends here.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝教授，這堂課太精彩了！
dialogue.py: xiè xie jiào shòu, zhè táng kè tài jīng cǎi le!
dialogue.en: Thank you Professor, this class was wonderful!

key_sentences.en: Do not do to others what you do not want done to yourself.
key_sentences.example: 要懂得己所不欲，勿施於人。

key_sentences.en: Reflect the sufferings of the common people.
One filled with poetry naturally has an elegant aura.

speaking.part_b: 角色扮演：你在博物館參觀書法展。你向導覽員詢問一幅作品背後的故事。導覽員告訴你，這是詩人在經歷『歷史變遷』後寫下的，表達了對『民間疾苦』的同情。你表示這幅作品非常有『氣質』和『細膩』的情感。
part_c: 你覺得學習一個國家的歷史和文學，對於學習它的語言有幫助嗎？為什麼？
『己所不欲，勿施於人』，你在生活中有實踐過這句話嗎？請舉例。

comprehension.q: 儒家思想中『仁』的核心概念是什麼？
options: B. 己所不欲，勿施於人

comprehension.q: 李白的詩和杜甫的詩有什麼不同的風格？
options: A. 李白寫實，杜甫豪邁
B. 李白豪邁浪漫，杜甫寫實反映疾苦
C. 兩人都只寫愛情詩

comprehension.q: 『以史為鏡』的意思是什麼？
options: B. 從歷史中學習教訓，看清未來

comprehension.q: 為什麼宋詞又被稱為『長短句』？
options: A. 因為句子長短不一
B. 因為只能唱很短的時間
C. 因為寫在長短不一的紙上

comprehension.q: 教授建議讀文言文時應該怎麼做？

true_false.q: 儒家思想對現代華人社會已經沒有影響了。
文學和哲學可以作為人們精神的避風港。
杜甫被稱為『詩仙』，喜歡喝酒。
宋詞的情感表達通常比唐詩更細膩。
讀書可以改變一個人的氣質。

fill_blank.q: 這部電影反映了民間的疾____。
這句話的情感表達非常細____。

passage.title: Literature and History Basics Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克對古裝劇裡的文言文感到很好奇。他決定從基礎的文學常識開始學起。今天的課堂主題是『儒家思想與唐詩』。教授用生動的方式講解古代文人的生活。馬克發現歷史不只是過去，更是現在的鏡子。
passage.en: Everyone, speaking of Chinese values, we cannot fail to mention 'Confucianism'. The concepts of 'Benevolence' and 'Propriety' advocated by Confucius still deeply influence our society today. Professor, does 'Benevolence' just mean being good to others and having empathy? Exactly, Mark's understanding is very precise. 'Do not do to others what you do not want done to yourself'; this phrase is the core of benevolence. Things you don't like yourself, don't impose on others. But I feel modern society is so fiercely competitive; isn't Confucianism a bit too 'idealized'? That's a good question. Literature and philosophy provide a spiritual 'safe haven'. Just like the 'Tang poetry' we are going to discuss next. I've heard of Li Bai! He is the 'Poet Immortal', right? He seemed to really like drinking wine. Haha, yes. Li Bai's poetry is full of 'heroic/bold' and romantic atmosphere. In contrast, another poet Du Fu, known as the 'Poet Sage', his works are more 'realistic', reflecting the sufferings of the common people. So through reading poetry, we can see the social background and historical changes of that time?
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫 120 到 150 個字。介紹一位你喜歡的作家、詩人或歷史人物（不限國家）。他/她的作品或事蹟有什麼特色？為什麼這個人物會吸引你？他/她對你的價值觀有什麼影響？請盡量使用本課詞彙（如：豪邁、寫實、氣質）。

grammar.explanation: 使用 '不能不' 雙重否定表示強烈肯定（必須）。'相對的' 用於引出對比。'死記硬背' 是一個成語，指不求甚解地記憶。
examples: 這部電影太好看了，你不能不看。 (This movie is so good, you absolutely must watch it.)
北部的冬天很冷，相對的，南部就溫暖多了。 (The winter in the north is very cold; relatively, the south is much warmer.)
學習語言不能靠死記硬背，要多開口說。 (Learning a language cannot rely on rote memorization; you must speak more.)
避風港 (Safe haven)
歷史變遷 (Historical changes)

title: Starting a Business
story_description: 馬克的大學同學大衛最近辭職『創業』了。馬克去大衛的新辦公室拜訪，聽他分享創業初期的甘苦談，包括找資金、招募團隊，以及如何面對市場的激烈競爭。
story_intro: 大衛一直夢想著擁有自己的公司。
上個月，他終於下定決心辭去穩定的工作。
他創立了一家專做綠能科技的新創公司。
馬克帶著盆栽去祝賀他公司『開幕』。
大衛看起來有點憔悴，但眼神充滿熱情。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 大衛，恭喜你公司開幕！這盆『發財樹』祝你生意興隆。
dialogue.py: dà wèi, gōng xǐ nǐ gōng sī kāi mù! zhè pén 'fā cái shù' zhù nǐ shēng yì xīng lóng.
dialogue.en: David, congratulations on the opening of your company! This 'money tree' wishes you a prosperous business.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你，馬克。快請坐。我這陣子忙著裝潢和面試員工，每天都睡不到五個小時。
dialogue.py: xiè xie nǐ, mǎ kè. kuài qǐng zuò. wǒ zhè zhèn zi máng zhe zhuāng huáng hé miàn shì yuán gōng, měi tiān dōu shuì bú dào wǔ gè xiǎo shí.
dialogue.en: Thank you, Mark. Please have a seat quickly. I've been busy with decoration and interviewing employees recently, sleeping less than five hours every day.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 創業維艱啊。你怎麼會突然決定放棄外商公司的高薪，自己出來『創業』呢？
dialogue.py: chuàng yè wéi jiān a. nǐ zěn me huì tū rán jué dìng fàng qì wài shāng gōng sī de gāo xīn, zì jǐ chū lái 'chuàng yè' ne?
dialogue.en: Starting a business is hard. Why did you suddenly decide to give up the high salary at the foreign company and come out to 'start a business' yourself?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 因為我不想一輩子只當個『螺絲釘』。我看到綠能市場的『潛力』，覺得這是一個不能錯過的機會。
dialogue.py: yīn wèi wǒ bù xiǎng yí bèi zi zhǐ dāng gè 'luó sī dīng'. wǒ kàn dào lǜ néng shì chǎng de 'qián lì', jué de zhè shì yī gè bù néng cuò guò de jī huì.
dialogue.en: Because I don't want to just be a 'screw (cog in the machine)' for my whole life. I saw the 'potential' of the green energy market and felt this was an opportunity not to be missed.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 很有勇氣！不過，開公司需要一大筆『資金』吧？你的啟動資金是怎麼來的？
dialogue.py: hěn yǒu yǒng qì! bù guò, kāi gōng sī xū yào yī dà bǐ 'zī jīn' ba? nǐ de qǐ dòng zī jīn shì zěn me lái de?
dialogue.en: Very courageous! However, opening a company requires a large sum of 'capital', right? How did your startup capital come about?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 除了我自己的存款，我還找了幾個天使『投資人』。我們寫了一份很詳細的商業企劃書，才好不容易說服他們。
dialogue.py: chú le wǒ zì jǐ de cún kuǎn, wǒ hái zhǎo le jǐ gè tiān shǐ 'tōu zī rén'. wǒ men xiě le yī fèn hěn xiáng xì de shāng yè qǐ huà shū, cái hǎo bù róng yì shuō fú tā men.
dialogue.en: Besides my own savings, I also found a few angel 'investors'. We wrote a very detailed business plan before finally managing to persuade them.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 萬事起頭難。現在團隊建立得怎麼樣了？
dialogue.py: wàn shì qǐ tóu nán. xiàn zài tuán duì jiàn lì de zěn me yàng le?
dialogue.en: Everything is hard at the beginning. How is the team building going now?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 目前只有五個人，大家都是身兼多職。新創公司最怕的就是『燒錢』太快，所以我們必須『開源節流』。
dialogue.py: mù qián zhǐ yǒu wǔ gè rén, dà jiā dōu shì shēn jiān duō zhí. xīn chuàng gōng sī zuì pà de jiù shì 'shāo qián' tài kuài, suǒ yǐ wǒ men bì xū 'kāi yuán jié liú'.
dialogue.en: Currently there are only five people; everyone is wearing multiple hats. What startups fear most is 'burning money' too fast, so we must 'increase revenue and reduce expenditure'.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 你們的產品什麼時候會正式上市？市場上的競爭對手多嗎？
dialogue.py: nǐ men de chǎn pǐn shén me shí hou huì zhèng shì shàng shì? shì chǎng shàng de jìng zhēng duì shǒu duō ma?
dialogue.en: When will your product officially launch on the market? Are there many competitors in the market?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 預計下個月初『發表』。競爭當然激烈，但我們的技術有『專利』保護，這是我們的核心競爭力。
dialogue.py: yù jì xià gè yuè chū 'fā biǎo'. jìng zhēng dāng rán jī liè, dàn wǒ men de jì shù yǒu 'zhuān lì' bǎo hù, zhè shì wǒ men de hé xīn jìng zhēng lì.
dialogue.en: Estimated to be 'announced/published' early next month. Competition is of course fierce, but our technology has 'patent' protection; this is our core competitiveness.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 有專利就安心多了。不過，身為老闆，你現在的壓力一定很大吧？
dialogue.py: yǒu zhuān lì jiù ān xīn duō le. bù guò, shēn wéi lǎo bǎn, nǐ xiàn zài de yā lì yī dìng hěn dà ba?
dialogue.en: Having a patent makes it much more reassuring. However, as the boss, your pressure must be huge now, right?

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 是啊，每天一睜開眼就是在想公司要怎麼活下去。不僅要對投資人負責，還要為員工的生計打算。
dialogue.py: shì a, měi tiān yī zhēng kāi yǎn jiù shì zài xiǎng gōng sī yào zěn me huó xià qù. bù jǐn yào duì tōu zī rén fù zé, hái yào wèi yuán gōng de shēng jì dǎ suàn.
dialogue.en: Yes, every day as soon as I open my eyes, I'm thinking about how the company can survive. I not only have to be responsible to investors, but also plan for the employees' livelihoods.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 這就是所謂的『甜蜜的負擔』吧。自己當老闆，雖然辛苦，但成就感也是無與倫比的。
dialogue.py: zhè jiù shì suǒ wèi de 'tián mì de fù dān' ba. zì jǐ dāng lǎo bǎn, suī rán xīn kǔ, dàn chéng jiù gǎn yě shì wú yǔ lún bǐ de.
dialogue.en: This is the so-called 'sweet burden', right? Being your own boss, although hard, the sense of achievement is also unparalleled.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 你說到點子上了。看著自己的想法一步步『實現』，那種感覺真的無法用金錢衡量。
dialogue.py: nǐ shuō dào diǎn zi shàng le. kàn zhe zì jǐ de xiǎng fǎ yī bù bù 'shí xiàn', nà zhǒng gǎn jué zhēn de wú fǎ yòng jīn qián héng liáng.
dialogue.en: You hit the nail on the head. Watching your own ideas be 'realized' step by step, that feeling truly cannot be measured with money.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 如果有什麼我能幫忙的，儘管說。我的行銷經驗或許能派上用場。
dialogue.py: rú guǒ yǒu shén me wǒ néng bāng máng de, jǐn guǎn shuō. wǒ de xíng xiāo jīng yàn huò xǔ néng pài shàng yòng chǎng.
dialogue.en: If there's anything I can help with, don't hesitate to say. My marketing experience might come in handy.

dialogue.speaker: David
dialogue.zh: 太好了！等我們產品上市後，我一定請你來當我們的行銷顧問。
dialogue.py: tài hǎo le! děng wǒ men chǎn pǐn shàng shì hòu, wǒ yī dìng qǐng nǐ lái dāng wǒ men de xíng xiāo gù wèn.
dialogue.en: Great! After our product is launched, I will definitely invite you to be our marketing consultant.

key_sentences.en: Don't want to just be a cog in the machine.

key_sentences.zh: 這是一個不能錯過的機會。
key_sentences.en: This is an opportunity that cannot be missed.
Everyone is wearing multiple hats / doing multiple jobs.
key_sentences.example: 在新創公司常要身兼多職。

key_sentences.en: Must increase revenue and reduce expenditure.
key_sentences.example: 經濟不景氣，我們要開源節流。

key_sentences.zh: 這是我們的核心競爭力。

key_sentences.en: You hit the nail on the head.
My experience can come in handy.

vocabulary.meaning: to come in handy / be put to use

part_a: 新創公司要懂得開源節流。
speaking.part_b: 角色扮演：你的朋友最近打算『創業』開一家咖啡廳。你問他的『資金』哪裡來，並提醒他餐飲業競爭激烈，一定要有自己的『核心競爭力』，否則很容易『燒錢』。朋友感謝你的建議。
part_c: 你曾經想過要自己『創業』當老闆嗎？為什麼？
你覺得一個成功的新創公司，最重要的是『資金』、『技術』還是『團隊』？

comprehension.q: 大衛為什麼決定辭職創業？
options: B. 他不想一輩子當螺絲釘，且看好綠能市場

comprehension.q: 大衛的創業『資金』是怎麼來的？

comprehension.q: 為什麼大衛公司的員工必須『身兼多職』？

B. 因為目前只有五個人，要避免燒錢太快
C. 因為老闆不付薪水

comprehension.q: 大衛公司的『核心競爭力』是什麼？
options: A. 辦公室裝潢得很漂亮

comprehension.q: 馬克表示他哪方面的經驗或許能幫上大衛的忙？

true_false.q: 馬克送了一盆『發財樹』祝賀大衛公司開幕。
大衛說找投資人非常容易，不用寫企劃書。

title: Social Diversity and Inclusion
story_description: 十月是台灣的同志驕傲月（Pride Month）。莉莉邀請馬克一起參加同志大遊行。他們在遊行中討論了性別平權、多元成家，以及台灣在亞洲推動人權的進步與挑戰。
story_intro: 台北的街頭掛滿了彩虹旗。
這個週末即將舉行亞洲最大的同志遊行。
莉莉和馬克約好一起去現場感受氣氛。
馬克對台灣開放的社會風氣感到驚訝。
他們在遊行隊伍中看到了形形色色的人。

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 馬克，快看！那個花車好華麗，上面的人打扮得好有創意。
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, kuài kàn! nà gè huā chē hǎo huá lì, shàng miàn de rén dǎ bàn de hǎo yǒu chuàng yì.
dialogue.en: Mark, look! That float is so gorgeous, and the people on it are dressed up so creatively.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 現場的氣氛真的太棒了，充滿了歡樂和愛。我注意到很多大企業也組了隊伍來參加。
dialogue.py: xiàn chǎng de qì fēn zhēn de tài bàng le, chōng mǎn le huān lè hé ài. wǒ zhù yì dào hěn duō dà qǐ yè yě zǔ le duì wǔ lái cān jiā.
dialogue.en: The atmosphere here is really awesome, full of joy and love. I noticed many large corporations also formed contingents to participate.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，現在越來越多的企業強調『多元共融（DEI）』。支持性別平權已經是全球的趨勢。
dialogue.py: méi cuò, xiàn zài yuè lái yuè duō de qǐ yè qiáng diào 'duō yuán gòng róng (DEI)'. zhī chí xìng bié píng quán yǐ jīng shì quán qiú de qū shì.
dialogue.en: Exactly, now more and more companies emphasize 'Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI)'. Supporting gender equality is already a global trend.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我記得台灣是亞洲第一個同性婚姻合法化的國家，對吧？這真的很了不起。
dialogue.py: wǒ jì de tái wān shì yà zhōu dì yī gè tóng xìng hūn yīn hé fǎ huà de guó jiā, duì ba? zhè zhēn de hěn liǎo bu qǐ.
dialogue.en: I remember Taiwan is the first country in Asia to legalize same-sex marriage, right? This is really amazing.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 是的，二零一九年通過的法案。不過，這條路走得很艱辛，社會上也曾經有過激烈的『對立』和爭論。
dialogue.py: shì de, èr líng yī jiǔ nián tōng guò de fǎ àn. bù guò, zhè tiáo lù zǒu de hěn jiān xīn, shè huì shàng yě céng jīng yǒu guò jī liè de 'duì lì' hé zhēng lùn.
dialogue.en: Yes, the bill passed in 2019. However, this road was very difficult; there used to be fierce 'opposition/conflict' and debate in society.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 改革總是伴隨著陣痛。那些反對的人，他們的顧慮是什麼呢？
dialogue.py: gǎi gé zǒng shì bàn suí zhe zhèn tòng. nà xiē fǎn duì de rén, tā men de gù lǜ shì shén me ne?
dialogue.en: Reform is always accompanied by growing pains. Those who opposed, what were their concerns?

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 主要是一些傳統宗教團體和較『保守』的長輩。他們認為這會破壞傳統的家庭結構和『倫理』觀念。
dialogue.py: zhǔ yào shì yī xiē chuán tǒng zōng jiào tuán tǐ hé jiào 'bǎo shǒu' de zhǎng bèi. tā men rèn wéi zhè huì pò huài chuán tǒng de jiā tíng jié gòu hé 'lún lǐ' guān niàn.
dialogue.en: Mainly some traditional religious groups and more 'conservative' elders. They believed this would destroy the traditional family structure and 'ethical' concepts.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 可以理解。不同的世代本來就會有不同的價值觀。那現在法案通過幾年了，社會氣氛有改變嗎？
dialogue.py: kě yǐ lǐ jiě. bù tóng de shì dài běn lái jiù huì yǒu bù tóng de jià zhí guān. nà xiàn zài fǎ àn tōng guò jǐ nián le, shè huì qì fēn yǒu gǎi biàn ma?
dialogue.en: Understandable. Different generations will naturally have different values. So now that the bill has been passed for a few years, has the social atmosphere changed?

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 改變很多！大家發現，天並沒有塌下來。同志伴侶一樣能建立幸福的『多元家庭』，甚至還能合法收養小孩了。
dialogue.py: gǎi biàn hěn duō! dà jiā fā xiàn, tiān bìng méi yǒu tā xià lái. tóng zhì bàn lǚ yí yàng néng jiàn lì xìng fú de 'duō yuán jiā tíng', shèn zhì hái néng hé fǎ shōu yǎng xiǎo hái le.
dialogue.en: Changed a lot! Everyone realized the sky didn't fall. Same-sex couples can equally build happy 'diverse families', and can even legally adopt children now.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 這就是包容的力量。我們應該尊重每個人的『性傾向』和自我認同，而不是給他們貼上『標籤』。
dialogue.py: zhè jiù shì bāo róng de lì liàng. wǒ men yīng gāi zūn zhòng měi gè rén de 'xìng qīng xiàng' hé zì wǒ rèn tóng, ér bú shì gěi tā men tiē shàng 'biāo qiān'.
dialogue.en: This is the power of inclusion. We should respect everyone's 'sexual orientation' and self-identity, rather than putting 'labels' on them.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 你說得很對。真正的平權，不只是法律上的保障，更是日常生活中的『消除歧視』。
dialogue.py: nǐ shuō de hěn duì. zhēn zhèng de píng quán, bù zhǐ shì fǎ lǜ shàng de bǎo zhàng, gèng shì rì cháng shēng huó zhōng de 'xiāo chú qí shì'.
dialogue.en: You are very right. True equality is not just legal protection, but more so 'eliminating discrimination' in daily life.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 除了性別平權，台灣在『無障礙設施』方面也做得不錯。我看到很多坐輪椅的朋友也能輕鬆參與遊行。
dialogue.py: chú le xìng bié píng quán, tái wān zài 'wú zhàng ài shè shī' fāng miàn yě zuò de bú cuò. wǒ kàn dào hěn duō zuò lún yǐ de péng you yě néng qīng sōng cān yǔ yóu xíng.
dialogue.en: Besides gender equality, Taiwan is also doing quite well in terms of 'barrier-free (accessible) facilities'. I see many friends in wheelchairs can also easily participate in the parade.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 這都是慢慢爭取來的。社會的進步需要大家一起發聲。快看，前面在發免費的彩虹貼紙，我們去拿！
dialogue.py: zhè dōu shì màn màn zhēng qǔ lái de. shè huì de jìn bù xū yào dà jiā yī qǐ fā shēng. kuài kàn, qián miàn zài fā miǎn fèi de cǎi hóng tiē zhǐ, wǒ men qù ná!
dialogue.en: These were all slowly fought for. The progress of society requires everyone to speak up together. Look quickly, they are handing out free rainbow stickers ahead, let's go get them!

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好啊！我也要買一件『Love is Love』的 T 恤當作紀念。
dialogue.py: hǎo a! wǒ yě yào mǎi yī jiàn 'Love is Love' de T xù dāng zuò jì niàn.
dialogue.en: Okay! I also want to buy a 'Love is Love' T-shirt as a souvenir.

passage.title: Social Diversity and Inclusion Listening Passage
passage.zh: 台北的街頭掛滿了彩虹旗。這個週末即將舉行亞洲最大的同志遊行。莉莉和馬克約好一起去現場感受氣氛。馬克對台灣開放的社會風氣感到驚訝。他們在遊行隊伍中看到了形形色色的人。
passage.en: Mark, look! That float is so gorgeous, and the people on it are dressed up so creatively. The atmosphere here is really awesome, full of joy and love. I noticed many large corporations also formed contingents to participate. Exactly, now more and more companies emphasize 'Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI)'. Supporting gender equality is already a global trend. I remember Taiwan is the first country in Asia to legalize same-sex marriage, right? This is really amazing. Yes, the bill passed in 2019. However, this road was very difficult; there used to be fierce 'opposition/conflict' and debate in society. Reform is always accompanied by growing pains. Those who opposed, what were their concerns? Mainly some traditional religious groups and more 'conservative' elders. They believed this would destroy the traditional family structure and 'ethical' concepts. Understandable. Different generations will naturally have different values. So now that the bill has been passed for a few years, has the social atmosphere changed?
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫 120 到 150 個字。探討『多元與包容』的重要性。在你的成長環境中，是否有遇過因為性別、種族或性傾向而產生的『歧視』或『刻板標籤』？你認為社會應該如何進步，才能達到真正的『平權』？請使用本課學到的詞彙。

grammar.explanation: 使用 '不只是...更是...' 表示遞進關係，強調後者。'伴隨著' 表示事物同時發生。'貼標籤' 是一個比喻用法，指對人有刻板印象。
examples: 這不只是一份工作，更是我的夢想。 (This is not just a job, but more so my dream.)
經濟的高速發展往往伴隨著環境污染。 (Rapid economic development is often accompanied by environmental pollution.)
請不要因為他的穿著就給他貼標籤。 (Please don't put a label on him just because of his attire.)
多元共融 (Diversity and Inclusion)
消除歧視 (Eliminate discrimination)

title: Resolving Conflicts at Work
story_description: 馬克在工作上與跨部門的同事因為資源分配和專案進度產生了『摩擦』。他向主管求助，學習如何透過有效的溝通與談判技巧，化解衝突並達成『雙贏』的局面。
story_intro: 馬克負責的行銷專案進度嚴重落後。
主要原因是設計部門無法如期交出圖檔。
馬克和設計部的主管凱文在會議上發生了爭執。
雙方各執一詞，氣氛非常僵硬。
馬克決定尋求他的主管陳經理的建議。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 陳經理，你有空嗎？我想跟您討論一下新產品專案的事情。我跟設計部的凱文發生了一些『摩擦』。
dialogue.py: chén jīng lǐ, nǐ yǒu kòng ma? wǒ xiǎng gēn nín tǎo lùn yī xià xīn chǎn pǐn zhuān àn de shì qing. wǒ gēn shè jì bù de kǎi wén fā shēng le yī xiē 'mó cā'.
dialogue.en: Manager Chen, do you have a moment? I'd like to discuss the new product project with you. I've had some 'friction' with Kevin from the design department.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 我聽說了，你們早上的會議氣氛不太好。具體是哪裡出了問題？
dialogue.py: wǒ tīng shuō le, nǐ men zǎo shàng de huì yì qì fēn bú tài hǎo. jù tǐ shì nǎ lǐ chū le wèn tí?
dialogue.en: I heard about it; the atmosphere at your morning meeting wasn't very good. Where exactly is the problem?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 設計部一直拖延交稿時間，導致我們後續的行銷活動全部卡住。我要求他們加班趕工，但凱文非常生氣地『拒絕』了。
dialogue.py: shè jì bù yī zhí tuō yán jiāo gǎo shí jiān, dǎo zhì wǒ men hòu xù de xíng xiāo huó dòng quán bù kǎ zhù. wǒ yào qiú tā men jiā bān gǎn gōng, dàn kǎi wén fēi cháng shēng qì de 'jù jué' le.
dialogue.en: The design department keeps delaying the delivery of the drafts, causing all our subsequent marketing activities to be stuck. I requested them to work overtime to rush the work, but Kevin 'refused' very angrily.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 馬克，處理跨部門合作時，『指責』對方通常於事無補。你有試著去了解他們為什麼會『延遲』嗎？
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, chǔ lǐ kuà bù mén hé zuò shí, 'zhǐ zé' duì fāng tōng cháng yú shì wú bǔ. nǐ yǒu shì zhe qù liǎo jiě tā men wèi shén me huì 'yán chí' ma?
dialogue.en: Mark, when handling cross-departmental collaboration, 'blaming' the other party usually doesn't help matters. Have you tried to understand why they are 'delayed'?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 凱文說最近公司接了太多急件，他們部門的『人力』嚴重吃緊。
dialogue.py: kǎi wén shuō zuì jìn gōng sī jiē le tài duō jí jiàn, tā men bù mén de 'rén lì' yán zhòng chī jǐn.
dialogue.en: Kevin said the company has taken on too many urgent cases recently, and their department's 'manpower' is severely strained.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 這就是了。當資源有限時，衝突就容易發生。我們需要的是『協商』，而不是對抗。
dialogue.py: zhè jiù shì le. dāng zī yuán yǒu xiàn shí, chōng tū jiù róng yì fā shēng. wǒ men xū yào de shì 'xié shāng', ér bú shì duì kàng.
dialogue.en: There it is. When resources are limited, conflicts easily arise. What we need is 'negotiation', not confrontation.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 那您建議我該怎麼做？專案的『死線（Deadline）』已經迫在眉睫了。
dialogue.py: nà nín jiàn yì wǒ gāi zěn me zuò? zhuān àn de 'sǐ xiàn (Deadline)' yǐ jīng pò zài méi jié le.
dialogue.en: Then what do you suggest I do? The project's 'deadline' is already imminent.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 首先，你要先放下情緒，主動去找凱文『破冰』。你可以向他表達你理解他們部門的困難。
dialogue.py: shǒu xiān, nǐ yào xiān fàng xià qíng xù, zhǔ dòng qù zhǎo kǎi wén 'pò bīng'. nǐ kě yǐ xiàng tā biǎo dá nǐ lǐ jiě tā men bù mén de kùn nán.
dialogue.en: First, you need to put down your emotions and proactively go to Kevin to 'break the ice'. You can express to him that you understand his department's difficulties.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 展現『同理心』，對吧？
dialogue.py: zhǎn xiàn 'tóng lǐ xīn', duì ba?
dialogue.en: Show 'empathy', right?

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 沒錯。接下來，試著『妥協』。看看我們這邊能不能精簡一些不必要的設計需求，或者允許他們分批交稿。
dialogue.py: méi cuò. jiē xià lái, shì zhe 'tuǒ xié'. kàn kan wǒ men zhè biān néng bù néng jīng jiǎn yī xiē bú bì yào de shè jì xū qiú, huò zhě yǔn xǔ tā men fēn pī jiāo gǎo.
dialogue.en: Exactly. Next, try to 'compromise'. See if our side can streamline some unnecessary design requirements, or allow them to submit the drafts in batches.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我懂了。如果我稍微退讓一步，減輕他們的負擔，他們可能就願意配合我們趕出核心的圖檔。
dialogue.py: wǒ dǒng le. rú guǒ wǒ shāo wēi tuì ràng yī bù, jiǎn qīng tā men de fù dān, tā men kě néng jiù yuàn yì pèi hé wǒ men gǎn chū hé xīn de tú dǎng.
dialogue.en: I understand. If I concede a step slightly to lighten their burden, they might be willing to cooperate with us to rush out the core graphics.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 這就叫做創造『雙贏』的局面。職場上沒有永遠的敵人，大家都是為了把事情做好。
dialogue.py: zhè jiù jiào zuò chuàng zào 'shuāng yíng' de jú miàn. zhí chǎng shàng méi yǒu yǒng yuǎn de dí rén, dà jiā dōu shì wèi le bǎ shì qing zuò hǎo.
dialogue.en: This is called creating a 'win-win' situation. In the workplace, there are no permanent enemies; everyone is just trying to get things done well.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝經理的指點。我之前太強勢了，『溝通方式』確實有問題。我等一下買杯咖啡去找凱文道歉。
dialogue.py: xiè xie jīng lǐ de zhǐ diǎn. wǒ zhī qián tài qiáng shì le, 'gōu tōng fāng shì' què shí yǒu wèn tí. wǒ děng yī xià mǎi bēi kā fēi qù zhǎo kǎi wén dào qiàn.
dialogue.en: Thank you for the guidance, Manager. I was too domineering before; my 'communication style' indeed had problems. I'll go buy a cup of coffee and apologize to Kevin later.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.zh: 很好，這才是成熟的職場態度。有進展隨時讓我知道。
dialogue.py: hěn hǎo, zhè cái shì chéng shú de zhí chǎng tài duù. yǒu jìn zhǎn suí shí ràng wǒ zhī dào.
dialogue.en: Very good, this is the mature workplace attitude. Let me know anytime there is progress.

key_sentences.en: Blaming the other party doesn't help matters.
The deadline is imminent / extremely close.

key_sentences.zh: 雙方各退讓一步來妥協。
key_sentences.en: Both sides concede a step to compromise.

part_a: 我們部門最近人力吃緊。
專案的進度已經迫在眉睫。
我們應該妥協，創造雙贏。
speaking.part_b: 角色扮演：你和同事在決定行銷預算時發生了『爭執』。你的態度太『強勢』了。主管建議你去『破冰』。你買了點心去找同事，展現同理心，並提出一個雙方各『退讓』一步的『協商』方案。
part_c: 在職場或學校中，當你與別人意見不同時，你通常會怎麼處理？
你覺得『妥協』代表認輸嗎？為什麼？

comprehension.q: 馬克為什麼跟凱文發生爭執？
options: A. 因為凱文偷吃他的午餐
B. 因為設計部拖延交稿，影響專案進度
C. 因為他們在搶同一個職位

comprehension.q: 陳經理說『指責』對方會怎麼樣？
options: A. 會讓對方工作變快
C. 於事無補（沒有幫助）

comprehension.q: 設計部無法如期交稿的真正原因是什麼？
options: A. 他們部門人力嚴重吃緊
B. 凱文忘記了這件事

passage.title: Resolving Conflicts at Work Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克負責的行銷專案進度嚴重落後。主要原因是設計部門無法如期交出圖檔。馬克和設計部的主管凱文在會議上發生了爭執。雙方各執一詞，氣氛非常僵硬。馬克決定尋求他的主管陳經理的建議。
passage.en: Manager Chen, do you have a moment? I'd like to discuss the new product project with you. I've had some 'friction' with Kevin from the design department. I heard about it; the atmosphere at your morning meeting wasn't very good. Where exactly is the problem? The design department keeps delaying the delivery of the drafts, causing all our subsequent marketing activities to be stuck. I requested them to work overtime to rush the work, but Kevin 'refused' very angrily. Mark, when handling cross-departmental collaboration, 'blaming' the other party usually doesn't help matters. Have you tried to understand why they are 'delayed'? Kevin said the company has taken on too many urgent cases recently, and their department's 'manpower' is severely strained. There it is. When resources are limited, conflicts easily arise. What we need is 'negotiation', not confrontation. Then what do you suggest I do? The project's 'deadline' is already imminent. First, you need to put down your emotions and proactively go to Kevin to 'break the ice'. You can express to him that you understand his department's difficulties.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫 120 到 150 個字。描述一次你與他人（同事、同學或朋友）發生『衝突』或『摩擦』的經驗。衝突的原因是什麼？你們最後是如何解決的？是有人『妥協』，還是達成了『雙贏』？請使用本課詞彙。

grammar.explanation: 使用 '導致' 表示引起某種不好的結果。'於事無補' 是成語，指對事情沒有任何幫助。'迫在眉睫' 形容事情非常急迫，就像逼近在眉毛和睫毛之間。
examples: 溝通不良導致了專案失敗。 (Poor communication led to the project's failure.)
你現在後悔也於事無補了。 (Your regretting now won't help matters at all.)
氣候變遷的危機已經迫在眉睫。 (The crisis of climate change is already imminent.)
人力吃緊 (Manpower is tight)
雙贏局面 (Win-win situation)

title: Exploring Deep Culture
story_description: 馬克跟著莉莉去了一趟著名的『龍山寺』。他體驗了台灣傳統的民間信仰，包括拿香拜拜、擲筊（Bwa Bwei）求籤，並了解了這些儀式背後安定人心的文化力量。
story_intro: 今天是週末，莉莉帶馬克到台北的舊城區體驗文化。
他們來到了香火鼎盛的龍山寺。
廟裡擠滿了來祈求平安和考試順利的信徒。
馬克對煙霧繚繞的廟宇和精美的雕刻感到震撼。
莉莉決定教馬克如何『跟神明溝通』。

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 馬克，這裡就是龍山寺了。你看，這裡的『香火』多麼『鼎盛』，代表這間廟非常靈驗。
dialogue.py: mǎ kè, zhè lǐ jiù shì lóng shān sì le. nǐ kàn, zhè lǐ de 'xiāng huǒ' duō me 'dǐng shèng', dài biǎo zhè jiān miào fēi cháng líng yàn.
dialogue.en: Mark, this is Longshan Temple. Look, the 'incense smoke' here is so 'flourishing/prosperous', meaning this temple is very efficacious (answers prayers).

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 建築的屋頂上有很多華麗的龍的雕刻，真的很壯觀。我們現在要進去拜拜嗎？
dialogue.py: jiàn zhù de wū dǐng shàng yǒu hěn duō huá lì de lóng de diāo kè, zhēn de hěn zhuàng guān. wǒ men xiàn zài yào jìn qù bài bài ma?
dialogue.en: There are many gorgeous dragon carvings on the roof of the building; it's really spectacular. Are we going in to worship now?

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 對，進廟有規矩的。要『右進左出』，也就是從龍門進去，虎門出來，這象徵著平安吉祥。
dialogue.py: duì, jìn miào yǒu guī ju de. yào 'yòu jìn zuǒ chū', yě jiù shì cóng lóng mén jìn qù, hǔ mén chū lái, zhè xiàng zhēng zhe píng ān jí xiáng.
dialogue.en: Yes, entering a temple has rules. You must 'enter right, exit left', which means entering through the Dragon Gate and exiting through the Tiger Gate; this symbolizes peace and auspiciousness.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 原來如此。我看到很多人拿著兩個紅色的木塊在地上丟，那是在做什麼？
dialogue.py: yuán lái rú cǐ. wǒ kàn dào hěn duō rén ná zhe liǎng gè hóng sè de mù kuài zài dì shàng diū, nà shì zài zuò shén me?
dialogue.en: I see. I see many people holding two red wooden blocks and throwing them on the ground; what is that doing?

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 那叫做『擲筊』，是我們和神明溝通的方式。如果一平一凸，就叫做『聖筊』，表示神明答應或同意你的請求。
dialogue.py: nà jiào zuò 'zhí jiǎo', shì wǒ men hé shén míng gōu tōng de fāng shì. rú guǒ yī píng yī tū, jiù jiào zuò 'shèng jiǎo', biǎo shì shén míng dá yìng huò tóng yì nǐ de qǐng qiú.
dialogue.en: That's called 'casting moon blocks (Bwa Bwei)', it's our way of communicating with the deities. If one is flat and one is convex, it's called a 'Holy Block (Divine Answer)', meaning the deity agrees or consents to your request.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 哇，這就像是神聖的『機率遊戲』。我也想試試看！我想求一支『籤』，問問我未來的事業發展。
dialogue.py: wa, zhè jiù xiàng shì shén shèng de 'jī lǜ yóu xì'. wǒ yě xiǎng shì shì kàn! wǒ xiǎng qiú yī zhī 'qiān', wèn wèn wǒ wèi lái de shì yè fā zhǎn.
dialogue.en: Wow, this is like a sacred 'probability game'. I want to try it too! I want to draw a 'fortune stick' to ask about my future career development.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 好啊。求籤之前，你要先在心裡默念你的名字、出生年月日和住址，然後清楚地問神明一個問題。
dialogue.py: hǎo a. qiú qiān zhī qián, nǐ yào xiān zài xīn lǐ mò niàn nǐ de míng zi, chū shēng nián yuè rì hé zhù zhǐ, rán hòu qīng chǔ dì wèn shén míng yī gè wèn tí.
dialogue.en: Okay. Before drawing a stick, you must first silently recite your name, birth date, and address in your heart, and then clearly ask the deity a question.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: （閉上眼睛默念，然後抽出一支籤）我抽到第六十籤。接下來呢？
dialogue.py: (bì shàng yǎn jing mò niàn, rán hòu chōu chū yī zhī qiān) wǒ chōu dào dì liù shí qiān. jiē xià lái ne?
dialogue.en: (Closes eyes and silently recites, then draws a stick) I drew stick number sixty. What's next?

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 接下來你要『擲筊』，連續擲出三次『聖筊』，才能確定這支籤真的是神明要給你的。如果不是，就要重抽。
dialogue.py: jiē xià lái nǐ yào 'zhí jiǎo', lián xù zhí chū sān cì 'shèng jiǎo', cái néng què dìng zhè zhī qiān zhēn de shì shén míng yào gěi nǐ de. rú guǒ bú shì, jiù yào chóng chōu.
dialogue.en: Next you have to 'cast blocks', and consecutively throw three 'Holy Blocks' to confirm this stick is really what the deity wants to give you. If not, you have to draw again.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: （丟了三次木塊）哇！三次都是一平一凸！我拿到神明的確認了！我們去拿『籤詩』吧。
dialogue.py: (diū le sān cì mù kuài) wa! sān cì dōu shì yī píng yī tū! wǒ ná dào shén míng de què rèn le! wǒ men qù ná 'qiān shī' ba.
dialogue.en: (Throws the wooden blocks three times) Wow! All three times are one flat one convex! I got the deity's confirmation! Let's go get the 'fortune poem'.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: （看著籤詩）這是一支『上上籤』喔！籤詩上說，只要你腳踏實地，未來的事業一定會大放異彩。
dialogue.py: (kàn zhe qiān shī) zhè shì yī zhī 'shàng shàng qiān' ō! qiān shī shàng shuō, zhǐ yào nǐ jiǎo tà shí dì, wèi lái de shì yè yī dìng huì dà fàng yì cǎi.
dialogue.en: (Looking at the fortune poem) This is an 'Excellent (top-top)' fortune! The poem says, as long as you have your feet firmly on the ground (are practical), your future career will definitely shine brilliantly.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 太令人振奮了！我覺得這些儀式不僅是『迷信』，更有一種『安定人心』的力量。
dialogue.py: tài lìng rén zhèn fèn le! wǒ jué de zhè xiē yí shì bù jǐn shì 'mí xìn', gèng yǒu yī zhǒng 'ān dìng rén xīn' de lì liàng.
dialogue.en: So inspiring! I feel these rituals are not just 'superstition', but have a power to 'calm people's minds'.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 你說得對。在面對未知的『徬徨』時，宗教信仰能給人方向感和心靈的寄託。對了，離開前我們去買個『護身符』吧。
dialogue.py: nǐ shuō de duì. zài miàn duì wèi zhī de 'páng huáng' shí, zōng jiào xìn yǎng néng gěi rén fāng xiàng gǎn hé xīn líng de jì tuō. duì le, lí kāi qián wǒ men qù mǎi gè 'hù shēn fú' ba.
dialogue.en: You're right. When facing the 'hesitation/uncertainty' of the unknown, religious belief can give people a sense of direction and spiritual sustenance. By the way, before leaving let's go buy an 'amulet/charm'.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 好啊。買完護身符，還要把它拿到香爐上面繞三圈，對嗎？我剛剛看到別人這樣做。
dialogue.py: hǎo a. mǎi wán hù shēn fú, hái yào bǎ tā ná dào xiāng lú shàng miàn rào sān quān, duì ma? wǒ gāng gāng kàn dào bié rén zhè yàng zuò.
dialogue.en: Okay. After buying the amulet, we still need to take it over the incense burner and circle it three times, right? I just saw others doing that.

dialogue.speaker: Lily
dialogue.zh: 你觀察得很仔細！那叫做『過香爐』，可以吸收神明的靈氣。走吧！
dialogue.py: nǐ guān chá de hěn zǐ xì! nà jiào zuò 'guò xiāng lú', kě yǐ xī shōu shén míng de líng qì. zǒu ba!
dialogue.en: You observed very carefully! That's called 'passing over the incense burner'; it can absorb the deity's spiritual energy. Let's go!

key_sentences.en: This temple's incense smoke is flourishing (has many worshippers).
This temple is very efficacious (answers prayers effectively).

key_sentences.zh: 擲筊是跟神明溝通的方式。
key_sentences.en: Casting moon blocks is a way to communicate with deities.
Silently recite your name in your heart.
As long as you are down-to-earth / practical.

key_sentences.zh: 有一種安定人心的力量。
key_sentences.en: Has a power to calm people's minds.
Take the amulet to pass over the incense burner.

vocabulary.example: 他是一個腳踏實地的人。

title: Personal Finance and Debt
story_description: 馬克收到信用卡的帳單，發現自己不小心『超支』了，只能繳『最低應繳金額』。他向阿明請教如何處理信用卡債務（循環利息），並學習了貸款和房貸的基本概念。
story_intro: 馬克看著桌上的信用卡帳單，眉頭深鎖。
上個月搬家買家具，不小心刷了太多錢。
帳單上的數字超過了他這個月的薪水。
他考慮只繳交『最低應繳金額』。
阿明看到馬克苦惱的樣子，決定給他一些理財建議。

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 阿明，我完蛋了。這個月的信用卡帳單『爆表』了，我根本繳不出『全額』。
dialogue.py: ā míng, wǒ wán dàn le. zhè gè yuè de xìn yòng kǎ zhàng dān 'bào biǎo' le, wǒ gēn běn jiǎo bù chū 'quán é'.
dialogue.en: A-ming, I'm doomed. This month's credit card bill has 'gone off the charts', I simply can't pay the 'full amount'.

dialogue.speaker: A-ming
dialogue.zh: 怎麼會這樣？你上個月買了什麼大件物品嗎？
dialogue.py: zěn me huì zhè yàng? nǐ shàng gè yuè mǎi le shén me dà jiàn wù pǐn ma?
dialogue.en: How did this happen? Did you buy any large items last month?

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 因為剛搬家，買了新床墊和電視。我打算這個月先繳『最低應繳金額』，剩下的下個月再還。
dialogue.py: yīn wèi gāng bān jiā, mǎi le xīn chuáng diàn hé diàn shì. wǒ dǎ suàn zhè gè yuè xiān jiǎo 'zuì dī yīng jiǎo jīn é', shèng xià de xià gè yuè zài huán.
dialogue.en: Because I just moved, I bought a new mattress and TV. I plan to just pay the 'minimum amount due' this month, and return the rest next month.

dialogue.speaker: A-ming
dialogue.zh: 千萬不要！你如果只繳最低金額，剩下的未繳款項會開始計算『循環利息』。那個利率非常高，通常高達 15%！
dialogue.py: qiān wàn bú yào! nǐ rú guǒ zhǐ jiǎo zuì dī jīn é, shèng xià de wèi jiǎo kuǎn xiàng huì kāi shǐ jì suàn 'xún huán lì xí'. nà gè lì lǜ fēi cháng gāo, tōng cháng gāo dá shí wǔ bǎi fēn zhì!
dialogue.en: Absolutely do not! If you only pay the minimum amount, the remaining unpaid balance will start accumulating 'revolving interest'. That interest rate is extremely high, usually up to 15%!

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 15%！？這麼誇張？那利息滾利息，我不就變成『卡奴』了嗎？
dialogue.py: shí wǔ bǎi fēn zhì!? zhè me kuā zhāng? nà lì xí gǔn lì xí, wǒ bú jiù biàn chéng 'kǎ nú' le ma?
dialogue.en: 15%!? That exaggerated? Then with interest rolling on interest, won't I become a 'card slave'?

dialogue.speaker: A-ming
dialogue.zh: 沒錯！銀行最喜歡你只繳最低金額了。這樣他們才能賺取高額利息。這是理財的大忌。
dialogue.py: méi cuò! yín háng zuì xǐ huan nǐ zhǐ jiǎo zuì dī jīn é le. zhè yàng tā men cái néng zhuàn qǔ gāo é lì xí. zhè shì lǐ cái de dà jì.
dialogue.en: Exactly! Banks like it best when you only pay the minimum amount. That way they can earn high interest. This is a big taboo in personal finance.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 那我該怎麼辦？我戶頭裡的現金真的不夠付全額。
dialogue.py: nà wǒ gāi zěn me bàn? wǒ hù tóu lǐ de xiàn jīn zhēn de bú gòu fù quán é.
dialogue.en: Then what should I do? The cash in my account is really not enough to pay in full.

dialogue.speaker: A-ming
dialogue.zh: 你可以打電話給信用卡公司，申請『帳單分期』。雖然分期也會收一點手續費或利息，但絕對比循環利息低很多。
dialogue.py: nǐ kě yǐ dǎ diàn huà gěi xìn yòng kǎ gōng sī, shēn qǐng 'zhàng dān fēn qī'. suī rán fēn qī yě huì shōu yī diǎn shǒu xù fèi huò lì xí, dàn jué duì bǐ xún huán lì xí dī hěn duō.
dialogue.en: You can call the credit card company and apply for 'bill installments'. Although installments also charge a small handling fee or interest, it is absolutely much lower than revolving interest.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 『帳單分期』？好主意。我等一下就打客服。原來『信用』的使用這麼危險，一不小心就負債了。
dialogue.py: 'zhàng dān fēn qī'? hǎo zhǔ yì. wǒ děng yī xià jiù dǎ kè fú. yuán lái 'xìn yòng' de shǐ yòng zhè me wēi xiǎn, yī bù xiǎo xīn jiù fù zhài le.
dialogue.en: 'Bill installments'? Good idea. I'll call customer service later. It turns out using 'credit' is so dangerous; one moment of carelessness and you are in debt.

dialogue.speaker: A-ming
dialogue.zh: 信用卡是一把雙面刃。用得好可以累積『信用評分』，以後買房子要申請『房貸』時，銀行才會給你好的利率。
dialogue.py: xìn yòng kǎ shì yī bǎ shuāng miàn rèn. yòng de hǎo kě yǐ lěi jī 'xìn yòng píng fēn', yǐ hòu mǎi fáng zi yào shēn qǐng 'fáng dài' shí, yín háng cái huì gěi nǐ hǎo de lì lǜ.
dialogue.en: A credit card is a double-edged sword. If used well, you can accumulate 'credit score'; later when you buy a house and need to apply for a 'mortgage', the bank will then give you a good interest rate.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 房貸的金額那麼大，利率差一點點就差很多吧？
dialogue.py: fáng dài de jīn é nà me dà, lì lǜ chā yī diǎn dian jiù chā hěn duō ba?
dialogue.en: The amount for a mortgage is so large, a slight difference in interest rate makes a big difference, right?

dialogue.speaker: A-ming
dialogue.zh: 對啊，所以平時就要『按時繳款』，培養良好的信用紀錄。任何貸款，包括信貸和車貸，銀行都會看你的聯徵紀錄。
dialogue.py: duì a, suǒ yǐ píng shí jiù yào 'àn shí jiǎo kuǎn', péi yǎng liáng hǎo de xìn yòng jì lù. rèn hé dài kuǎn, bāo guò xìn dài hé chē dài, yín háng dōu huì kàn nǐ de lián zhēng jì lù.
dialogue.en: Yes, so usually you must 'make payments on time' to cultivate a good credit record. For any loan, including personal loans and car loans, the bank will check your credit bureau record.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 我懂了。我以後買東西前一定要『量入為出』，不能再憑衝動消費了。
dialogue.py: wǒ dǒng le. wǒ yǐ hòu mǎi dōng xi qián yī dìng yào 'liàng rù wéi chū', bù néng zài píng chōng dòng xiāo fèi le.
dialogue.en: I understand. Before buying things in the future, I absolutely must 'live within my means'; I can no longer consume purely on impulse.

dialogue.speaker: A-ming
dialogue.zh: 這就對了。理財的第一步，就是學會『記帳』，掌握自己每個月的現金流。
dialogue.py: zhè jiù duì le. lǐ cái de dì yī bù, jiù shì xué huì 'jì zhàng', zhǎng wò zì jǐ měi gè yuè de xiàn jīn liú.
dialogue.en: That's right. The first step in personal finance is learning to 'keep accounts (track expenses)' and grasp your monthly cash flow.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你，阿明，你救了我的錢包！我去處理分期了。
dialogue.py: xiè xie nǐ, ā míng, nǐ jiù le wǒ de qián bāo! wǒ qù chǔ lǐ fēn qī le.
dialogue.en: Thank you, A-ming, you saved my wallet! I'm going to handle the installments now.

key_sentences.en: The bill went off the charts (exploded).

key_sentences.example: 不要只繳最低應繳金額。
被循環利息壓得喘不過氣。

key_sentences.en: A credit card is a double-edged sword.

key_sentences.example: 按時還款能提高信用評分。

key_sentences.en: Must live within one's means (measure expenditure by income).
key_sentences.example: 理財的根本是量入為出。

passage.title: Personal Finance and Debt Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克看著桌上的信用卡帳單，眉頭深鎖。上個月搬家買家具，不小心刷了太多錢。帳單上的數字超過了他這個月的薪水。他考慮只繳交『最低應繳金額』。阿明看到馬克苦惱的樣子，決定給他一些理財建議。
passage.en: A-ming, I'm doomed. This month's credit card bill has 'gone off the charts', I simply can't pay the 'full amount'. How did this happen? Did you buy any large items last month? Because I just moved, I bought a new mattress and TV. I plan to just pay the 'minimum amount due' this month, and return the rest next month. Absolutely do not! If you only pay the minimum amount, the remaining unpaid balance will start accumulating 'revolving interest'. That interest rate is extremely high, usually up to 15%! 15%!? That exaggerated? Then with interest rolling on interest, won't I become a 'card slave'? Exactly! Banks like it best when you only pay the minimum amount. That way they can earn high interest. This is a big taboo in personal finance. Then what should I do? The cash in my account is really not enough to pay in full. You can call the credit card company and apply for 'bill installments'. Although installments also charge a small handling fee or interest, it is absolutely much lower than revolving interest.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: 請寫 120 到 150 個字。分享你的『理財』或『記帳』習慣。你曾經有過『衝動購物』而後悔的經驗嗎？你認為年輕人應該如何避免成為負債累累的『卡奴』？請使用本課學到的詞彙（如：量入為出、分期、全額）。

grammar.explanation: 使用 '根本' 放於否定詞前，表示完全不、一點也不（強調語氣）。'量入為出' 是理財的基本成語。'雙面刃' 用來形容事物有利也有弊。
examples: 我根本不知道這件事。 (I completely didn't know about this.)
這筆錢我根本繳不出。 (I simply can't pay this amount at all.)
科技是一把雙面刃，帶來便利也帶來隱私問題。 (Technology is a double-edged sword; it brings convenience but also privacy issues.)
最低應繳金額 (Minimum amount due)
信用評分 (Credit score)

title: Discussing News
story_description: Mark and A-ming discuss a new local law that restricts single-use plastics and share their opinions.
story_intro: 馬克和阿明在咖啡廳喝咖啡。
阿明看到了一則新的新聞。
新聞說下個月開始，市區不能使用一次性塑膠杯。
馬克覺得這是一個很好的政策。
他們開始討論這個政策對生活的影響。

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 阿明，你看到今天的新聞了嗎？
dialogue.py: Ā-míng, nǐ kàn dào jīn tiān de xīn wén le ma?
dialogue.en: A-ming, did you see today's news?

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 沒有，發生了什麼事？
dialogue.py: Méi yǒu, fā shēng le shén me shì?
dialogue.en: No, what happened?

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 政府宣布了一個新的政策。
dialogue.py: Zhèng fǔ xuān bù le yí ge xīn de zhèng cè.
dialogue.en: The government announced a new policy.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 什麼政策？跟我們有關係嗎？
dialogue.py: Shén me zhèng cè? Gēn wǒ men yǒu guān xì ma?
dialogue.en: What policy? Does it have to do with us?

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 有啊。下個月開始，市區所有的飲料店都不能提供塑膠杯了。
dialogue.py: Yǒu a. Xià ge yuè kāi shǐ, shì qū suǒ yǒu de yǐn liào diàn dōu bù néng tí gōng sù jiāo bēi le.
dialogue.en: Yes. Starting next month, all beverage shops in the city area cannot provide plastic cups.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？那大家買飲料怎麼辦？
dialogue.py: Zhēn de ma? Nà dà jiā mǎi yǐn liào zěn me bàn?
dialogue.en: Really? Then what do people do when buying drinks?

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 我們必須自己帶環保杯，或者買紙杯。
dialogue.py: Wǒ men bì xū zì jǐ dài huán bǎo bēi, huò zhě mǎi zhǐ bēi.
dialogue.en: We must bring our own reusable cups, or buy paper cups.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 我覺得這個政策滿好的，可以減少垃圾。
dialogue.py: Wǒ jué de zhè ge zhèng cè mǎn hǎo de, kě yǐ jiǎn shǎo lè sè.
dialogue.en: I think this policy is pretty good, it can reduce garbage.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 我也贊成，雖然剛開始可能有點不方便。
dialogue.py: Wǒ yě zàn chéng, suī rán gāng kāi shǐ kě néng yǒu diǎn bù fāng biàn.
dialogue.en: I also agree, although it might be a bit inconvenient at the beginning.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 對，習慣了就好。環保本來就需要大家的努力。
dialogue.py: Duì, xí guàn le jiù hǎo. Huán bǎo běn lái jiù xū yào dà jiā de nǔ lì.
dialogue.en: Right, it will be fine once we get used to it. Environmental protection inherently requires everyone's effort.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 新聞報導還說，如果店家違規，會被罰款。
dialogue.py: Xīn wén bào dǎo hái shuō, rú guǒ diàn jiā wéi guī, huì bèi fá kuǎn.
dialogue.en: The news report also said that if stores violate the rule, they will be fined.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 罰多少錢？
dialogue.py: Fá duō shǎo qián?
dialogue.en: How much is the fine?

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 聽說大約是五千塊。
dialogue.py: Tīng shuō dà yuē shì wǔ qiān kuài.
dialogue.en: I heard it's about five thousand dollars.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 哇，那真的會對店家有很大的影響。
dialogue.py: Wa, nà zhēn de huì duì diàn jiā yǒu hěn dà de yǐng xiǎng.
dialogue.en: Wow, then that will really have a big impact on the stores.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 對啊，所以我打算明天去買一個好一點的環保杯。
dialogue.py: Duì a, suǒ yǐ wǒ dǎ suàn míng tiān qù mǎi yí ge hǎo yì diǎn de huán bǎo bēi.
dialogue.en: Yeah, so I plan to go buy a better reusable cup tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 好主意，我也要買一個。我們一起去吧！
dialogue.py: Hǎo zhǔ yì, wǒ yě yào mǎi yí ge. Wǒ men yì qǐ qù ba!
dialogue.en: Good idea, I want to buy one too. Let's go together!

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。其實最近這類的新聞很多。
dialogue.py: Méi wèn tí. Qí shí zuì jìn zhè lèi de xīn wén hěn duō.
dialogue.en: No problem. Actually, there's a lot of this kind of news lately.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 對，氣候變遷的問題越來越嚴重了。
dialogue.py: Duì, qì hòu biàn qiān de wèn tí yuè lái yuè yán zhòng le.
dialogue.en: Yes, the problem of climate change is getting more and more serious.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 每個人都應該做一點改變。
dialogue.py: Měi ge rén dōu yīng gāi zuò yì diǎn gǎi biàn.
dialogue.en: Everyone should make a little change.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 同意。我回家後要把這個新聞告訴我的家人。
dialogue.py: Tóng yì. Wǒ huí jiā hòu yào bǎ zhè ge xīn wén gào sù wǒ de jiā rén.
dialogue.en: Agreed. After I go home, I will tell my family about this news.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 他們應該也會贊成的。
dialogue.py: Tā men yīng gāi yě huì zàn chéng de.
dialogue.en: They will probably agree too.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 希望我們的城市能越來越乾淨。
dialogue.py: Xī wàng wǒ men de chéng shì néng yuè lái yuè gān jìng.
dialogue.en: I hope our city can get cleaner and cleaner.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 一定會的，只要大家一起合作。
dialogue.py: Yí dìng huì de, zhǐ yào dà jiā yì qǐ hé zuò.
dialogue.en: It certainly will, as long as everyone cooperates together.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 為我們的環保計畫乾杯！
dialogue.py: Wèi wǒ men de huán bǎo jì huà gān bēi!
dialogue.en: Cheers to our environmental protection plan!

key_sentences.zh: 你看到今天的新聞了嗎？
key_sentences.example: 你看到今天的新聞了嗎？關於那場比賽。

passage.title: Discussing News Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克和阿明在咖啡廳喝咖啡。阿明看到了一則新的新聞。新聞說下個月開始，市區不能使用一次性塑膠杯。馬克覺得這是一個很好的政策。他們開始討論這個政策對生活的影響。
passage.en: A-ming, did you see today's news? No, what happened? The government announced a new policy. What policy? Does it have to do with us? Yes. Starting next month, all beverage shops in the city area cannot provide plastic cups. Really? Then what do people do when buying drinks? We must bring our own reusable cups, or buy paper cups. I think this policy is pretty good, it can reduce garbage.

grammar.explanation: '對...有影響' (duì... yǒu yǐng xiǎng) means 'to have an impact/influence on...'. It is a common pattern for expressing how one thing affects another.
examples: 這個政策對大家有很大的影響。
天氣對我的心情有影響。
他不吃早餐，這對他的健康有影響。
網路對年輕人的生活有很大的影響。
這件事對我沒有影響。

title: Talking About the Environment
story_description: Mark and A-ming discuss the environmental problems in their area and ways to protect the earth.
story_intro: 馬克和阿明在公園散步。
他們看到草地上有很多垃圾。
這讓他們開始討論環境問題。
阿明覺得大家應該多做資源回收。
馬克分享了他節能減碳的習慣。

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 你看，那邊的草地上有好多塑膠袋和瓶子。
dialogue.py: Nǐ kàn, nà biān de cǎo dì shàng yǒu hǎo duō sù jiāo dài hé píng zi.
dialogue.en: Look, there are so many plastic bags and bottles on the grass over there.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 真的耶。大家為什麼亂丟垃圾呢？
dialogue.py: Zhēn de ye. Dà jiā wèi shén me luàn diū lè sè ne?
dialogue.en: Really. Why do people litter?

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 環境污染的問題真的越來越嚴重了。
dialogue.py: Huán jìng wū rǎn de wèn tí zhēn de yuè lái yuè yán zhòng le.
dialogue.en: The problem of environmental pollution is really getting more and more serious.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 是啊，保護環境是每個人的責任。
dialogue.py: Shì a, bǎo hù huán jìng shì měi ge rén de zé rèn.
dialogue.en: Yes, protecting the environment is everyone's responsibility.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 你平常有做資源回收嗎？
dialogue.py: Nǐ píng cháng yǒu zuò zī yuán huí shōu ma?
dialogue.en: Do you usually do recycling?

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 有啊。我會把紙類和塑膠分開。
dialogue.py: Yǒu a. Wǒ huì bǎ zhǐ lèi hé sù jiāo fēn kāi.
dialogue.en: Yes. I separate paper and plastic.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 這樣很好。為了解決垃圾問題，回收很重要。
dialogue.py: Zhè yàng hěn hǎo. Wèi le jiě jué lè sè wèn tí, huí shōu hěn zhòng yào.
dialogue.en: That's very good. To solve the garbage problem, recycling is very important.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 那你呢？你有什麼好習慣？
dialogue.py: Nà nǐ ne? Nǐ yǒu shén me hǎo xí guàn?
dialogue.en: What about you? What good habits do you have?

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 我平常會注意節約能源，離開房間一定會關燈。
dialogue.py: Wǒ píng cháng huì zhù yì jié yuē néng yuán, lí kāi fáng jiān yí dìng huì guān dēng.
dialogue.en: I usually pay attention to saving energy, I always turn off the lights when leaving a room.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 那很不錯。我也盡量多搭公車，少自己開車。
dialogue.py: Nà hěn bú cuò. Wǒ yě jìn liàng duō dā gōng chē, shǎo zì jǐ kāi chē.
dialogue.en: That's not bad. I also try to take the bus more and drive less by myself.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 這樣不但可以減少塞車，也能減少空氣污染。
dialogue.py: Zhè yàng bù dàn kě yǐ jiǎn shǎo sāi chē, yě néng jiǎn shǎo kōng qì wū rǎn.
dialogue.en: This not only reduces traffic jams, but also reduces air pollution.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 對。其實很多小事都能幫助地球。
dialogue.py: Duì. Qí shí hěn duō xiǎo shì dōu néng bāng zhù dì qiú.
dialogue.en: Yes. Actually, many small things can help the Earth.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，我們去把那些垃圾撿起來吧。
dialogue.py: Méi cuò, wǒ men qù bǎ nà xiē lè sè jiǎn qǐ lái ba.
dialogue.en: That's right, let's go pick up that garbage.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 好啊！公園變乾淨了，大家看著也舒服。
dialogue.py: Hǎo a! Gōng yuán biàn gān jìng le, dà jiā kàn zhe yě shū fú.
dialogue.en: Okay! When the park is clean, it's pleasant for everyone to look at.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 你說得對，從我們自己做起。
dialogue.py: Nǐ shuō de duì, cóng wǒ men zì jǐ zuò qǐ.
dialogue.en: You're right, starting from ourselves.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 希望以後有更多人重視這個問題。
dialogue.py: Xī wàng yǐ hòu yǒu gèng duō rén zhòng shì zhè ge wèn tí.
dialogue.en: I hope more people will value this problem in the future.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 一定會的，現在學校也有教環保觀念。
dialogue.py: Yí dìng huì de, xiàn zài xué xiào yě yǒu jiāo huán bǎo guān niàn.
dialogue.en: They definitely will, schools are teaching environmental concepts now too.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我們撿完垃圾去洗手吧。
dialogue.py: Tài hǎo le. Wǒ men jiǎn wán lè sè qù xǐ shǒu ba.
dialogue.en: Great. Let's go wash our hands after picking up the garbage.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 走吧。
dialogue.py: Zǒu ba.
dialogue.en: Let's go.

passage.title: Talking About the Environment Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克和阿明在公園散步。他們看到草地上有很多垃圾。這讓他們開始討論環境問題。阿明覺得大家應該多做資源回收。馬克分享了他節能減碳的習慣。
passage.en: Look, there are so many plastic bags and bottles on the grass over there. Really. Why do people litter? The problem of environmental pollution is really getting more and more serious. Yes, protecting the environment is everyone's responsibility. Do you usually do recycling? Yes. I separate paper and plastic. That's very good. To solve the garbage problem, recycling is very important. What about you? What good habits do you have?
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Write a short paragraph (100-140 words) describing the environmental issues in your city and suggesting one solution.

grammar.explanation: '為了...' (wèi le...) means 'in order to...' or 'for the purpose of...'. It is placed at the beginning of a clause to state the purpose of the action that follows.
examples: 為了保護環境，我每天帶環保杯。
為了考試，他每天都在圖書館讀書。
為了健康，媽媽讓我多吃蔬菜。
為了早點完成工作，我們加班了。
為了解決問題，大家開了一個會。

practice.q: Translate: In order to buy a house, he is saving money.
practice.a: 為了買房子，他正在存錢。

practice.q: Translate: In order to learn Chinese well, I practice every day.
practice.a: 為了學好中文，我每天練習。

practice.q: Translate: In order to protect the earth, we do recycling.
practice.a: 為了保護地球，我們做資源回收。

expansion_dialogue.speaker: 馬克
expansion_dialogue.zh: 我覺得外送的包裝太多了。
expansion_dialogue.py: Wǒ jué de wài sòng de bāo zhuāng tài duō le.
expansion_dialogue.en: I feel like food delivery has too much packaging.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: 阿明
expansion_dialogue.zh: 對啊，每次吃完都有好幾個塑膠盒。
expansion_dialogue.py: Duì a, měi cì chī wán dōu yǒu hǎo jǐ ge sù jiāo hé.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: 馬克

expansion_dialogue.py: Suǒ yǐ rú guǒ kě yǐ, wǒ hái shì xǐ huān qù cān tīng chī.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: 阿明
expansion_dialogue.zh: 或者我們自己煮，也比較健康。
expansion_dialogue.py: Huò zhě wǒ men zì jǐ zhǔ, yě bǐ jiào jiàn kāng.
expansion_dialogue.en: Or we cook ourselves, which is also healthier.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: 馬克
expansion_dialogue.zh: 沒錯，下次我們一起去市場買菜吧！
expansion_dialogue.py: Méi cuò, xià cì wǒ men yì qǐ qù shì chǎng mǎi cài ba!
expansion_dialogue.en: Right, next time let's go to the market to buy groceries together!

expansion_dialogue.speaker: 阿明

expansion_dialogue.py: Hǎo a, wǒ dài wǒ de huán bǎo gòu wù dài qù.
expansion_dialogue.en: Okay, I'll bring my reusable shopping bag.
