title: Technology in Daily Life
story_description: Mark and A-ming talk about how technology, like smartphones and AI, makes life convenient but also creates new challenges.
story_intro: 馬克的舊手機壞了，他剛買了一支新的智慧型手機。
阿明覺得現在的手機功能真的很多。
他們討論手機和應用程式帶來的方便。
同時，他們也發現人們越來越依賴科技。
馬克決定以後每天要少用一點手機。

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 阿明，你看我的新手機，功能超級多！
dialogue.py: Ā-míng, nǐ kàn wǒ de xīn shǒu jī, gōng néng chāo jí duō!
dialogue.en: A-ming, look at my new phone, it has super many functions!

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 哇，這支手機的螢幕很大，拍照也很清楚吧？
dialogue.py: Wa, zhè zhī shǒu jī de yíng mù hěn dà, pāi zhào yě hěn qīng chǔ ba?
dialogue.en: Wow, the screen of this phone is big, and taking photos is very clear, right?

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 對啊，而且裡面還有最新的人工智慧系統。
dialogue.py: Duì a, ér qiě lǐ miàn hái yǒu zuì xīn de rén gōng zhì huì xì tǒng.
dialogue.en: Yes, and it also has the newest artificial intelligence system inside.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 現在的科技真的越來越進步了。
dialogue.py: Xiàn zài de kē jì zhēn de yuè lái yuè jìn bù le.
dialogue.en: Technology nowadays is really getting more and more advanced.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 沒錯。不管是買東西、看地圖還是聯絡朋友，都非常方便。
dialogue.py: Méi cuò. Bù guǎn shì mǎi dōng xi, kàn dì tú hái shì lián luò péng yǒu, dōu fēi cháng fāng biàn.
dialogue.en: Exactly. Whether it's buying things, checking maps, or contacting friends, it's very convenient.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 可是我覺得，我們好像太依賴手機了。
dialogue.py: Kě shì wǒ jué de, wǒ men hǎo xiàng tài yī lài shǒu jī le.
dialogue.en: But I feel like we rely on our phones too much.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 你說得對。如果一天沒有手機，我可能會覺得很焦慮。
dialogue.py: Nǐ shuō de duì. Rú guǒ yì tiān méi yǒu shǒu jī, wǒ kě néng huì jué de hěn jiāo lǜ.
dialogue.en: You're right. If I didn't have my phone for a day, I might feel very anxious.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 對啊，我有時候吃飯也在看手機，都沒有跟家人聊天。
dialogue.py: Duì a, wǒ yǒu shí hòu chī fàn yě zài kàn shǒu jī, dōu méi yǒu gēn jiā rén liáo tiān.
dialogue.en: Yeah, sometimes I look at my phone even while eating, and don't chat with my family.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 這真的是個問題。科技改變了我們的溝通方式。
dialogue.py: Zhè zhēn de shì ge wèn tí. Kē jì gǎi biàn le wǒ men de gōu tōng fāng shì.
dialogue.en: This is really a problem. Technology has changed our way of communication.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 而且有時候網路上的資訊太多，也讓人覺得很累。
dialogue.py: Ér qiě yǒu shí hòu wǎng lù shàng de zī xùn tài duō, yě ràng rén jué de hěn lèi.
dialogue.en: Also, sometimes there is too much information on the internet, making people feel tired.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 同意。所以雖然手機是很好的工具，但我們也要控制時間。
dialogue.py: Tóng yì. Suǒ yǐ suī rán shǒu jī shì hěn hǎo de gōng jù, dàn wǒ men yě yào kòng zhì shí jiān.
dialogue.en: Agreed. So although phones are good tools, we also need to control our time.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，我現在睡前一小時都不用手機了。
dialogue.py: Méi cuò, wǒ xiàn zài shuì qián yì xiǎo shí dōu bú yòng shǒu jī le.
dialogue.en: Right, I now don't use my phone for an hour before sleeping.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？你的睡眠品質有變好嗎？
dialogue.py: Zhēn de ma? Nǐ de shuì mián pǐn zhí yǒu biàn hǎo ma?
dialogue.en: Really? Has your sleep quality gotten better?

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 有啊，我現在睡得很好。你也應該試試看。
dialogue.py: Yǒu a, wǒ xiàn zài shuì de hěn hǎo. Nǐ yě yīng gāi shì shì kàn.
dialogue.en: Yes, I sleep very well now. You should try it too.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 好，我從今天晚上開始試試。
dialogue.py: Hǎo, wǒ cóng jīn tiān wǎn shàng kāi shǐ shì shì.
dialogue.en: Okay, I'll start trying from tonight.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 不過你的新手機借我玩一下好嗎？
dialogue.py: Bú guò nǐ de xīn shǒu jī jiè wǒ wán yí xià hǎo ma?
dialogue.en: But can you let me play with your new phone for a bit?

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，好啊，但不要玩太久喔！
dialogue.py: Hā hā, hǎo a, dàn bú yào wán tài jiǔ o!
dialogue.en: Haha, sure, but don't play for too long!

key_sentences.zh: 現在的科技越來越進步了。
key_sentences.en: Technology is getting more and more advanced.
key_sentences.example: 醫學科技越來越進步了。

key_sentences.zh: 不管是買東西還是看地圖，都很方便。
key_sentences.en: Whether it's buying things or checking maps, it's very convenient.
key_sentences.example: 不管是晴天還是雨天，他都去跑步。

passage.title: Technology in Daily Life Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克的舊手機壞了，他剛買了一支新的智慧型手機。阿明覺得現在的手機功能真的很多。他們討論手機和應用程式帶來的方便。同時，他們也發現人們越來越依賴科技。馬克決定以後每天要少用一點手機。
passage.en: A-ming, look at my new phone, it has super many functions! Wow, the screen of this phone is big, and taking photos is very clear, right? Yes, and it also has the newest artificial intelligence system inside. Technology nowadays is really getting more and more advanced. Exactly. Whether it's buying things, checking maps, or contacting friends, it's very convenient. But I feel like we rely on our phones too much. You're right. If I didn't have my phone for a day, I might feel very anxious. Yeah, sometimes I look at my phone even while eating, and don't chat with my family.

examples: 不管是大人還是小孩，都喜歡這個遊戲。
不管是買東西還是看地圖，都很方便。
不管是晴天還是雨天，他都去跑步。
不管是中文還是英文，他都說得很好。
不管是誰，都不可以進去。

title: Online Safety
story_description: A-ming receives a suspicious text message and asks Mark for advice. They discuss how to stay safe online.
story_intro: 阿明的手機收到了一封奇怪的簡訊。
簡訊說他中了一百萬，要他點擊連結。
阿明覺得很高興，但他有點懷疑。
他決定問問馬克的意見。
馬克告訴他那是騙人的，提醒他注意網路安全。

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 馬克，你看這封簡訊，我好像中大獎了！
dialogue.py: Ā-míng, nǐ kàn zhè fēng jiǎn xùn, wǒ hǎo xiàng zhòng dà jiǎng le!
dialogue.en: Mark, look at this text message, it seems I won a big prize!

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 什麼大獎？我看一下。上面寫你中了一百萬？
dialogue.py: Shén me dà jiǎng? Wǒ kàn yí xià. Shàng miàn xiě nǐ zhòng le yì bǎi wàn?
dialogue.en: What big prize? Let me see. It says you won one million?

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 對啊，他要我點這個連結去領錢。
dialogue.py: Duì a, tā yào wǒ diǎn zhè ge lián jié qù lǐng qián.
dialogue.en: Yeah, it wants me to click this link to claim the money.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 阿明，你千萬別點！這一定是騙人的。
dialogue.py: Ā-míng, nǐ qiān wàn bié diǎn! Zhè yí dìng shì piàn rén de.
dialogue.en: A-ming, definitely don't click it! This must be a scam.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？可是它看起來很像銀行的訊息。
dialogue.py: Zhēn de ma? Kě shì tā kàn qǐ lái hěn xiàng yín háng de xùn xí.
dialogue.en: Really? But it looks a lot like a bank message.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 現在的詐騙手法越來越聰明了，他們會假裝是銀行或郵局。
dialogue.py: Xiàn zài de zhà piàn shǒu fǎ yuè lái yuè cōng míng le, tā men huì jiǎ zhuāng shì yín háng huò yóu jú.
dialogue.en: Scam methods nowadays are getting smarter, they will pretend to be a bank or post office.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 那如果我點了連結會怎麼樣？
dialogue.py: Nà rú guǒ wǒ diǎn le lián jié huì zěn me yàng?
dialogue.en: Then what happens if I click the link?

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 他們可能會偷走你的密碼和個人資料，甚至登入你的帳號。
dialogue.py: Tā men kě néng huì tōu zǒu nǐ de mì mǎ hé gè rén zī liào, shèn zhì dēng rù nǐ de zhàng hào.
dialogue.en: They might steal your password and personal data, or even log into your account.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 哇，好危險！還好我先問了你。
dialogue.py: Wa, hǎo wéi xiǎn! Hái hǎo wǒ xiān wèn le nǐ.
dialogue.en: Wow, so dangerous! Good thing I asked you first.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 這叫釣魚簡訊。你最好把它刪除，然後封鎖這個號碼。
dialogue.py: Zhè jiào diào yú jiǎn xùn. Nǐ zuì hǎo bǎ tā shān chú, rán hòu fēng suǒ zhè ge hào mǎ.
dialogue.en: This is called a phishing message. You'd better delete it and block this number.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 好，我現在就刪。網路安全真的很重要。
dialogue.py: Hǎo, wǒ xiàn zài jiù shān. Wǎng lù ān quán zhēn de hěn zhòng yào.
dialogue.en: Okay, I'll delete it right now. Online safety is really important.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 沒錯。除了不點奇怪的連結，密碼也要經常換。
dialogue.py: Méi cuò. Chú le bù diǎn qí guài de lián jié, mì mǎ yě yào jīng cháng huàn.
dialogue.en: Right. Besides not clicking strange links, you should also change your passwords often.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 而且不要所有網站都用同一個密碼，對吧？
dialogue.py: Ér qiě bú yào suǒ yǒu wǎng zhàn dōu yòng tóng yí ge mì mǎ, duì ba?
dialogue.en: And don't use the same password for all websites, right?

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 完全正確。如果有什麼懷疑，可以直接打電話給官方確認。
dialogue.py: Wán quán zhèng què. Rú guǒ yǒu shén me huái yí, kě yǐ zhí jiē dǎ diàn huà gěi guān fāng què rèn.
dialogue.en: Exactly correct. If you have any doubts, you can directly call the official to confirm.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你的建議，學到了一課。
dialogue.py: Xiè xie nǐ de jiàn yì, xué dào le yí kè.
dialogue.en: Thanks for your advice, I learned a lesson.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 不客氣。我們一定要小心保護自己。
dialogue.py: Bú kè qì. Wǒ men yí dìng yào xiǎo xīn bǎo hù zì jǐ.
dialogue.en: You're welcome. We must be careful to protect ourselves.

grammar.explanation: '最好' (zuì hǎo) usually means 'best', but when placed before a verb, it acts as an adverb meaning 'had better' or 'it would be best to'. It is used to give strong advice.
examples: 你最好把它刪除。
外面很冷，你最好多穿一點。
你生病了，最好去看看醫生。
我們最好早點出發，才不會塞車。
這件事你最好不要告訴他。

title: Travel Problem Abroad
story_description: While traveling abroad, Mark loses his passport and asks a local police officer for help.
story_intro: 馬克在國外旅行時，遇到了一個大麻煩。
他發現自己的護照不見了。
他非常著急，到處尋找。
最後他決定去警察局尋求幫忙。
警察告訴他應該怎麼做才能補辦護照。

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 警察先生，不好意思，我需要幫忙。
dialogue.py: Jǐng chá xiān shēng, bù hǎo yì si, wǒ xū yào bāng máng.
dialogue.en: Mr. Police Officer, excuse me, I need help.

dialogue.speaker: 警察
dialogue.zh: 先生，別著急，發生了什麼事？
dialogue.py: Xiān shēng, bié zhāo jí, fā shēng le shén me chì?
dialogue.en: Sir, don't worry, what happened?

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 我的護照弄丟了，我找了很久都找不到。
dialogue.py: Wǒ de hù zhào nòng diū le, wǒ zhǎo le hěn jiǔ dōu zhǎo bú dào.
dialogue.en: I lost my passport, I searched for a long time but couldn't find it.

dialogue.speaker: 警察
dialogue.zh: 你最後一次看到護照是在哪裡？
dialogue.py: Nǐ zuì hòu yí cì kàn dào hù zhào shì zài nǎ lǐ?
dialogue.en: Where was the last time you saw your passport?

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 我記得在火車站買票的時候還在包包裡。
dialogue.py: Wǒ jì de zài huǒ chē zhàn mǎi piào de shí hòu hái zài bāo bāo lǐ.
dialogue.en: I remember when I bought a ticket at the train station it was still in my bag.

dialogue.speaker: 警察
dialogue.zh: 可能是在車站不小心掉的。你有其他證件嗎？
dialogue.py: Kě néng shì zài chē zhàn bù xiǎo xīn diào de. Nǐ yǒu qí tā zhèng jiàn ma?
dialogue.en: Maybe you accidentally dropped it at the station. Do you have other ID documents?

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 我有帶身分證和駕照，還有護照的影本。
dialogue.py: Wǒ yǒu dài shēn fèn zhèng hé jià zhào, hái yǒu hù zhào de yǐng běn.
dialogue.en: I brought my ID card and driver's license, and also a photocopy of my passport.

dialogue.speaker: 警察
dialogue.zh: 有影本的話會比較好處理。我們需要先幫你報案。
dialogue.py: Yǒu yǐng běn de huà huì bǐ jiào hǎo chǔ lǐ. Wǒ men xū yào xiān bāng nǐ bào àn.
dialogue.en: Having a photocopy makes it easier to process. We need to help you file a report first.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 好的，謝謝。那報案之後我該怎麼辦？
dialogue.py: Hǎo de, xiè xie. Nà bào àn zhī hòu wǒ gāi zěn me bàn?
dialogue.en: Okay, thank you. Then what should I do after filing the report?

dialogue.speaker: 警察
dialogue.zh: 拿到報案證明後，你必須去你們國家的大使館補辦護照。
dialogue.py: Ná dào bào àn zhèng míng hòu, nǐ bì xū qù nǐ men guó jiā de dà shǐ guǎn bǔ bàn hù zhào.
dialogue.en: After getting the police report, you must go to your country's embassy to reapply for a passport.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 請問大使館離這裡遠嗎？
dialogue.py: Qǐng wèn dà shǐ guǎn lí zhè lǐ yuǎn ma?
dialogue.en: Excuse me, is the embassy far from here?

dialogue.speaker: 警察
dialogue.zh: 不遠，搭地鐵大約二十分鐘。我給你地址。
dialogue.py: Bù yuǎn, dā dì tiě dà yuē èr shí fēn zhōng. Wǒ gěi nǐ dì zhǐ.
dialogue.en: Not far, about 20 minutes by subway. I'll give you the address.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 太感謝你了。我明天的飛機，來得及嗎？
dialogue.py: Tài gǎn xiè nǐ le. Wǒ míng tiān de fēi jī, lái de jí ma?
dialogue.en: Thank you so much. My flight is tomorrow, will I make it in time?

dialogue.speaker: 警察
dialogue.zh: 如果是緊急情況的話，大使館通常可以幫你辦臨時護照。
dialogue.py: Rú guǒ shì jǐn jí qíng kuàng de huà, dà shǐ guǎn tōng cháng kě yǐ bāng nǐ bàn lín shí hù zhào.
dialogue.en: If it's an emergency, the embassy usually can help you make a temporary passport.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 這讓我放心多了。那請幫我做報案紀錄吧。
dialogue.py: Zhè ràng wǒ fàng xīn duō le. Nà qǐng bāng wǒ zuò bào àn jì lù ba.
dialogue.en: That makes me feel much more relieved. Then please help me make the police report.

dialogue.speaker: 警察
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，請把你的身分證給我。
dialogue.py: Méi wèn tí, qǐng bǎ nǐ de shēn fèn zhèng gěi wǒ.
dialogue.en: No problem, please give me your ID card.

key_sentences.zh: 我的護照弄丟了，我需要幫忙。
key_sentences.en: I lost my passport, I need help.
key_sentences.example: 我的錢包弄丟了，我需要幫忙。

key_sentences.en: I brought a photocopy of my passport.

passage.title: Travel Problem Abroad Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克在國外旅行時，遇到了一個大麻煩。他發現自己的護照不見了。他非常著急，到處尋找。最後他決定去警察局尋求幫忙。警察告訴他應該怎麼做才能補辦護照。
passage.en: Mr. Police Officer, excuse me, I need help. Sir, don't worry, what happened? I lost my passport, I searched for a long time but couldn't find it. Where was the last time you saw your passport? I remember when I bought a ticket at the train station it was still in my bag. Maybe you accidentally dropped it at the station. Do you have other ID documents? I brought my ID card and driver's license, and also a photocopy of my passport. Having a photocopy makes it easier to process. We need to help you file a report first.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Write a short dialogue (4-6 lines) between you and a hotel receptionist, reporting that you lost your room key.

grammar.explanation: '...的話' (...de huà) means 'if...' It is often used together with '如果' (rú guǒ), but '如果' can be omitted. '...的話' is placed at the end of the conditional clause.
examples: 有影本的話，會比較好處理。
如果明天下雨的話，我們就不去爬山了。
有問題的話，請打電話給我。
太貴的話，我就不買了。
如果你不喜歡的話，我們換別的餐廳。

expansion_dialogue.speaker: 馬克

expansion_dialogue.py: Zāo gāo, wǒ men hǎo xiàng cuò guò huǒ chē le.
expansion_dialogue.en: Oh no, it seems we missed the train.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: 阿明
expansion_dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？現在幾點？
expansion_dialogue.py: Zhēn de ma? Xiàn zài jǐ diǎn?
expansion_dialogue.en: Really? What time is it now?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: 馬克
expansion_dialogue.zh: 十點十分，火車十點就開了。
expansion_dialogue.py: Shí diǎn shí fēn, huǒ chē shí diǎn jiù kāi le.
expansion_dialogue.en: 10:10, the train left at 10:00.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: 阿明
expansion_dialogue.zh: 那我們去櫃檯問問看能不能換票吧。
expansion_dialogue.py: Nà wǒ men qù guì tái wèn wèn kàn néng bù néng huàn piào ba.
expansion_dialogue.en: Then let's go to the counter and ask if we can exchange the tickets.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: 馬克
expansion_dialogue.zh: 好，請問下一班去台北的火車是幾點？
expansion_dialogue.py: Hǎo, qǐng wèn xià yì bān qù Tái běi de huǒ chē shì jǐ diǎn?
expansion_dialogue.en: Okay, excuse me, what time is the next train to Taipei?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: 站務員
expansion_dialogue.zh: 下一班是十一點半，但是你們必須補票。
expansion_dialogue.py: Xià yì bān shì shí yī diǎn bàn, dàn shì nǐ men bì xū bǔ piào.
expansion_dialogue.en: The next one is at 11:30, but you must pay the fare difference.

title: At Immigration or Airport
story_description: Mark arrives at the airport in Taiwan and answers questions from the immigration officer.
story_intro: 馬克搭飛機到了台灣。
他排隊準備過海關。
海關人員看了他的護照，問了他幾個問題。
馬克回答了他來台灣的目的和停留的時間。
最後他順利入境了。

dialogue.speaker: 海關
dialogue.zh: 您好，請給我您的護照和入境卡。
dialogue.py: Nín hǎo, qǐng gěi wǒ nín de hù zhào hé rù jìng kǎ.
dialogue.en: Hello, please give me your passport and arrival card.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 好的，這是我的護照和入境卡。
dialogue.py: Hǎo de, zhè shì wǒ de hù zhào hé rù jìng kǎ.
dialogue.en: Okay, here is my passport and arrival card.

dialogue.speaker: 海關
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。請問您這次來台灣的目的是什麼？
dialogue.py: Xiè xie. Qǐng wèn nín zhè cì lái Tái wān de mù dì shì shén me?
dialogue.en: Thank you. What is the purpose of your visit to Taiwan this time?

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 我是來旅遊的。
dialogue.py: Wǒ chì lái lǚ yóu de.
dialogue.en: I am here for traveling.

dialogue.speaker: 海關
dialogue.zh: 您打算在台灣停留多久？
dialogue.py: Nín dǎ suàn zài Tái wān tíng liú duō jiǔ?
dialogue.en: How long do you plan to stay in Taiwan?

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 我打算停留兩個星期。
dialogue.py: Wǒ dǎ suàn tíng liú liǎng ge xīng qī.
dialogue.en: I plan to stay for two weeks.

dialogue.speaker: 海關
dialogue.zh: 請問您這段時間要住在哪裡？
dialogue.py: Qǐng wèn nín zhè duàn shí jiān yào zhù zài nǎ lǐ?
dialogue.en: Where will you be staying during this time?

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 我會住在台北車站附近的一家旅館。
dialogue.py: Wǒ huì zhù zài Tái běi chē zhàn fù jìn de yì jiā lǚ guǎn.
dialogue.en: I will stay at a hotel near Taipei Main Station.

dialogue.speaker: 海關
dialogue.zh: 好的，麻煩您看一下鏡頭，我們要拍張照。還有請把雙手食指放在機器上。
dialogue.py: Hǎo de, má fán nín kàn yí xià jìng tóu, wǒ men yào pāi zhāng zhào. Hái yǒu qǐng bǎ shuāng shǒu shí zhǐ fàng zài jī qì shàng.
dialogue.en: Okay, please look at the camera, we need to take a photo. And please put your two index fingers on the machine.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 好的，這樣可以嗎？
dialogue.py: Hǎo de, zhè yàng kě yǐ ma?
dialogue.en: Okay, is this fine?

dialogue.speaker: 海關
dialogue.zh: 可以了。請問您有沒有帶需要申報的物品？
dialogue.py: Kě yǐ le. Qǐng wèn nín yǒu méi yǒu dài xū yào shēn bào de wù pǐn?
dialogue.en: That's fine. Do you have any items that need to be declared?

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 沒有，我只有一些個人衣物和一台相機。
dialogue.py: Méi yǒu, wǒ zhǐ yǒu yì xiē gè rén yī wù hé yì tái xiàng jī.
dialogue.en: No, I only have some personal clothing and a camera.

dialogue.speaker: 海關
dialogue.zh: 有帶肉類食品或新鮮水果嗎？
dialogue.py: Yǒu dài ròu lèi shí pǐn huò xīn xiān shuǐ guǒ ma?
dialogue.en: Did you bring any meat products or fresh fruits?

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 沒有，我都沒有帶。
dialogue.py: Méi yǒu, wǒ dōu méi yǒu dài.
dialogue.en: No, I didn't bring any of those.

dialogue.speaker: 海關
dialogue.zh: 好的，這是您的護照。歡迎來到台灣，祝您旅途愉快！
dialogue.py: Hǎo de, zhè shì nín de hù zhào. Huān yíng lái dào Tái wān, zhù nín lǚ tú yú kuài!
dialogue.en: Okay, here is your passport. Welcome to Taiwan, wish you a pleasant trip!

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 謝謝！請問領行李的地方在哪裡？
dialogue.py: Xiè xie! Qǐng wèn lǐng xíng lǐ de dì fāng zài nǎ lǐ?
dialogue.en: Thank you! Excuse me, where is the baggage claim area?

dialogue.speaker: 海關
dialogue.zh: 一直往前走，然後下樓梯就到了。
dialogue.py: Yì zhí wǎng qián zǒu, rán hòu xià lóu tī jiù dào le.
dialogue.en: Walk straight ahead, then go downstairs and you'll be there.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 非常感謝。
dialogue.py: Fēi cháng gǎn xiè.
dialogue.en: Thank you very much.

key_sentences.zh: 請給我您的護照和入境卡。
key_sentences.en: Please give me your passport and arrival card.

key_sentences.example: 你要住在朋友家還是旅館？

passage.title: At Immigration or Airport Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克搭飛機到了台灣。他排隊準備過海關。海關人員看了他的護照，問了他幾個問題。馬克回答了他來台灣的目的和停留的時間。最後他順利入境了。

expansion_dialogue.speaker: 馬克
expansion_dialogue.zh: 請問換錢的地方在哪裡？
expansion_dialogue.py: Qǐng wèn huàn qián de dì fāng zài nǎ lǐ?
expansion_dialogue.en: Excuse me, where is the place to exchange money?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: 服務員
expansion_dialogue.zh: 往前走，在左邊有一家銀行。
expansion_dialogue.py: Wǎng qián zǒu, zài zuǒ biān yǒu yì jiā yín háng.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: 馬克

expansion_dialogue.py: Xiè xie. Wǒ hái xiǎng mǎi yì zhāng shàng wǎng de diàn huà kǎ.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: 服務員

title: Describing a Memorable Experience
story_description: Mark tells A-ming about a memorable experience from his past that changed his perspective.
story_intro: 馬克和阿明在聊天，聊到了過去的經驗。
阿明問馬克有沒有什麼難忘的事情。
馬克想起了他第一次自己出國的經驗。
那時候他很緊張，但也學到了很多。
那個經驗讓他變得更獨立。

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 馬克，你人生中最難忘的經驗是什麼？
dialogue.py: Ā-míng, nǐ rén shēng zhōng zuì nán wàng de jīng yàn shì shén me?
dialogue.en: Mark, what is the most unforgettable experience in your life?

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 嗯...我想應該是我十八歲那年第一次自己出國。
dialogue.py: Èn... wǒ xiǎng yīng gāi shì wǒ shí bā suì nà nián dì yí cì zì jǐ chū guó.
dialogue.en: Hmm... I think it was when I went abroad by myself for the first time at 18.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 哇，十八歲自己出國，去哪裡？
dialogue.py: Wa, shí bā suì zì jǐ chū guó, qù nǎ lǐ?
dialogue.en: Wow, going abroad alone at 18, where did you go?

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 我去澳洲做了一個月的志工。
dialogue.py: Wǒ qù Ào zhōu zuò le yí ge yuè de zhì gōng.
dialogue.en: I went to Australia to be a volunteer for a month.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 那時候一定很緊張吧？
dialogue.py: Nà shí hòu yí dìng hěn jǐn zhāng ba?
dialogue.en: You must have been very nervous at that time, right?

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 對，非常緊張。因為我的英文還不夠好。
dialogue.py: Duì, fēi cháng jǐn zhāng. Yīn wèi wǒ de yīng wén hái bú gòu hǎo.
dialogue.en: Yes, very nervous. Because my English wasn't good enough yet.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 那後來發生了什麼事？
dialogue.py: Nà hòu lái fā shēng le shén me shì?
dialogue.en: Then what happened later?

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 剛到的第一天，我就在機場迷路了，而且還找不到我的行李。
dialogue.py: Gāng dào de dì yì tiān, wǒ jiù zài jī chǎng mí lù le, ér qiě hái zhǎo bú dào wǒ de xíng lǐ.
dialogue.en: On the very first day, I got lost at the airport, and also couldn't find my luggage.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 天啊，那怎麼辦？
dialogue.py: Tiān a, nà zěn me bàn?
dialogue.en: Oh my god, what did you do?

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 我差點哭了。但我鼓起勇氣，用很破的英文去問機場人員。
dialogue.py: Wǒ chā diǎn kū le. Dàn wǒ gǔ qǐ yǒng qì, yòng hěn pò de yīng wén qù wèn jī chǎng rén yuán.
dialogue.en: I almost cried. But I gathered my courage and used very broken English to ask the airport staff.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 他們有幫你嗎？
dialogue.py: Tā men yǒu bāng nǐ ma?
dialogue.en: Did they help you?

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 有，他們非常熱心，帶我去找到了行李，還教我怎麼搭公車。
dialogue.py: Yǒu, tā men fēi cháng rè xīn, dài wǒ qù zhǎo dào le xíng lǐ, hái jiāo wǒ zěn me dā gōng chē.
dialogue.en: Yes, they were very enthusiastic, took me to find my luggage, and taught me how to take the bus.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 真幸運！那個月你覺得怎麼樣？
dialogue.py: Zhēn xìng yùn! Nà ge yuè nǐ jué de zěn me yàng?
dialogue.en: So lucky! How did you feel about that month?

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 雖然一開始很辛苦，但我認識了世界各地的朋友。
dialogue.py: Suī rán yì kāi shǐ hěn xīn kǔ, dàn wǒ rèn shì le shì jiè gè dì de péng yǒu.
dialogue.en: Although it was hard at first, I met friends from all over the world.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 聽起來是很棒的回憶。
dialogue.py: Tīng qǐ lái shì hěn bàng de huí yì.
dialogue.en: It sounds like a wonderful memory.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 對，從那個時候起，我變得比較有自信，也敢跟外國人說話了。
dialogue.py: Duì, cóng nà ge shí hòu qǐ, wǒ biàn de bǐ jiào yǒu zì xìn, yě gǎn gēn wài guó rén shuō huà le.
dialogue.en: Yes, from that time on, I became more confident and dared to speak with foreigners.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 難怪你現在這麼喜歡旅行。
dialogue.py: Nán guài nǐ xiàn zài zhè me xǐ huān lǚ xíng.
dialogue.en: No wonder you like traveling so much now.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 是啊，那次經驗真的改變了我的人生。
dialogue.py: Shì a, nà cì jīng yàn zhēn de gǎi biàn le wǒ de rén shēng.
dialogue.en: Yes, that experience really changed my life.

passage.title: Describing a Memorable Experience Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克和阿明在聊天，聊到了過去的經驗。阿明問馬克有沒有什麼難忘的事情。馬克想起了他第一次自己出國的經驗。那時候他很緊張，但也學到了很多。那個經驗讓他變得更獨立。
passage.en: Mark, what is the most unforgettable experience in your life? Hmm... I think it was when I went abroad by myself for the first time at 18. Wow, going abroad alone at 18, where did you go? I went to Australia to be a volunteer for a month. You must have been very nervous at that time, right? Yes, very nervous. Because my English wasn't good enough yet. Then what happened later? On the very first day, I got lost at the airport, and also couldn't find my luggage.

grammar.explanation: '從那個時候起' (cóng nà ge shí hòu qǐ) means 'from that time on' or 'ever since then'. It indicates the starting point of an ongoing change or situation.
examples: 從那個時候起，我就愛上了喝茶。
他搬家了，從那個時候起我們就沒見面。
從那個時候起，她決定每天跑步。
從那個時候起，我變得比較有自信。
這家店換老闆了，從那個時候起生意變差了。

expansion_dialogue.speaker: 阿明

expansion_dialogue.py: Nà nǐ zuì shī bài de jīng yàn shì shén me?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: 馬克

expansion_dialogue.py: Hā hā, dà gài shì dì yí cì zuò fàn gěi péng yǒu chī de shí hòu ba.
expansion_dialogue.en: Haha, probably when I cooked for friends for the first time.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: 阿明
expansion_dialogue.zh: 怎麼了？很難吃嗎？
expansion_dialogue.py: Zěn me le? Hěn nán chī ma?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: 馬克
expansion_dialogue.zh: 我把糖當成鹽巴，整道菜都是甜的。
expansion_dialogue.py: Wǒ bǎ táng dāng chéng yán bā, zhěng dào cài dōu shì tián de.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: 阿明
expansion_dialogue.zh: 哈哈哈，那朋友有吃嗎？

expansion_dialogue.speaker: 馬克

title: Giving a Short Speech
story_description: Mark is preparing a short speech for his Chinese class and asks A-ming for feedback on the structure.
story_intro: 馬克的中文課有一個演講任務。
他寫好了草稿，正在練習。
他請阿明聽他的演講，給他一些建議。
馬克的演講主題是「我的興趣」。
他學習如何開始、說明重點和結束演講。

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 阿明，你現在有空嗎？能不能聽我練習演講？
dialogue.py: Ā-míng, nǐ xiàn zài yǒu kòng ma? Néng bù néng tīng wǒ liàn xí yǎn jiǎng?
dialogue.en: A-ming, are you free now? Can you listen to me practice my speech?

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 當然可以，你的主題是什麼？
dialogue.py: Dāng rán kě yǐ, nǐ de zhǔ tí shì shén me?
dialogue.en: Of course, what is your topic?

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 主題是「我的興趣」。我有點緊張。
dialogue.py: Zhǔ tí shì “wǒ de xìng qù”. Wǒ yǒu diǎn jǐn zhāng.
dialogue.en: The topic is 'My Hobbies'. I am a bit nervous.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 別緊張，你先說一次給我聽聽看。
dialogue.py: Bié jǐn zhāng, nǐ xiān shuō yí cì gěi wǒ tīng tīng kàn.
dialogue.en: Don't be nervous, say it once for me to listen.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 大家好，今天我想跟大家分享我的興趣。我的興趣是攝影。
dialogue.py: Dà jiā hǎo, jīn tiān wǒ xiǎng gēn dà jiā fēn xiǎng wǒ de xìng qù. Wǒ de xìng qù shì shè yǐng.
dialogue.en: Hello everyone, today I want to share my hobby with you all. My hobby is photography.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 開場白不錯，很清楚。接下來呢？
dialogue.py: Kāi chǎng bái bú cuò, hěn qīng chǔ. Jiē xià lái ne?
dialogue.en: The opening is not bad, very clear. What's next?

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 首先，我喜歡攝影是因為它可以記錄生活。其次，攝影讓我可以去很多不同的地方。
dialogue.py: Shǒu xiān, wǒ xǐ huān shè yǐng shì yīn wèi tā kě yǐ jì lù shēng huó. Qí cì, shè yǐng ràng wǒ kě yǐ qù hěn duō bù tóng de dì fāng.
dialogue.en: First, I like photography because it can record life. Second, photography allows me to go to many different places.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 用「首先」和「其次」很好，非常有條理。然後呢？
dialogue.py: Yòng “shǒu xiān” hé “qí cì” hěn hǎo, fēi cháng yǒu tiáo lǐ. Rán hòu ne?
dialogue.en: Using 'First' and 'Second' is very good, very organized. And then?

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 最後，攝影讓我認識了很多有相同興趣的朋友。
dialogue.py: Zuì hòu, shè yǐng ràng wǒ rèn shì le hěn duō yǒu xiāng tóng xìng qù de péng yǒu.
dialogue.en: Finally, photography allowed me to meet many friends with the same interests.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 內容很棒，重點都說到了。那你要怎麼結束？
dialogue.py: Nèi róng hěn bàng, zhòng diǎn dōu shuō dào le. Nà nǐ yào zěn me jié shù?
dialogue.en: The content is great, hit all the main points. How will you end it?

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 總之，攝影豐富了我的生活。謝謝大家聽我的演講。
dialogue.py: Zǒng zhī, shè yǐng fēng fù le wǒ de shēng huó. Xiè xie dà jiā tīng wǒ de yǎn jiǎng.
dialogue.en: In short, photography enriched my life. Thank you all for listening to my speech.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 非常好！不過我覺得你講話的速度可以稍微慢一點。
dialogue.py: Fēi cháng hǎo! Bú guò wǒ jué de nǐ jiǎng huà de sù dù kě yǐ shāo wéi màn yì diǎn.
dialogue.en: Very good! But I think your speaking speed can be slightly slower.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？因為我一緊張就會講得很快。
dialogue.py: Zhēn de ma? Yīn wèi wǒ yì jǐn zhāng jiù huì jiǎng de hěn kuài.
dialogue.en: Really? Because once I get nervous I speak very fast.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，演講的時候記得深呼吸，看著觀眾。
dialogue.py: Méi guān xì, yǎn jiǎng de shí hòu jì de shēn hū xī, kàn zhe guān zhòng.
dialogue.en: It's okay, remember to take a deep breath and look at the audience during the speech.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 好，我會注意的。另外，我的發音有沒有問題？
dialogue.py: Hǎo, wǒ huì zhù yì de. Lìng wài, wǒ de fā yīn yǒu méi yǒu wèn tí?
dialogue.en: Okay, I will pay attention. Also, was there any problem with my pronunciation?

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 「攝影」的「影」是三聲，你剛才有點像二聲。
dialogue.py: “shè yǐng” de “yǐng” shì sān shēng, nǐ gāng cái yǒu diǎn xiàng èr shēng.
dialogue.en: The 'ying' in 'photography' is third tone, you sounded a bit like second tone just now.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 攝影...好，我多練習幾次。
dialogue.py: shè yǐng... hǎo, wǒ duō liàn xí jǐ cì.
dialogue.en: Photography... okay, I will practice a few more times.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 你準備得很充分，明天一定沒問題的，加油！
dialogue.py: Nǐ zhǔn bèi de hěn chōng fèn, míng tiān yí dìng méi wèn tí de, jiā yóu!
dialogue.en: You are well prepared, you'll definitely be fine tomorrow, good luck!

writing: Write an outline for a speech about your hometown (using 首先, 其次, 最後). Give 3 main points.

grammar.explanation: To structure an argument or a speech, we use logical connectors: '首先' (shǒu xiān, first/first of all), '其次' (qí cì, secondly), and '最後' (zuì hòu, finally). '總之' (zǒng zhī, in short/to sum up) is used to conclude.
examples: 首先，這個計畫太貴。其次，我們沒有時間。最後，老闆不會同意的。
要學好中文，首先要多聽。其次要多說。最後要多寫。
這家餐廳很好。首先，菜很好吃。其次，服務很好。
總之，我不喜歡這部電影。
首先要洗手，然後才能吃飯。

Translate: Second, we need to buy furniture.
Translate: Finally, we can move in.
Translate: In short, it takes a lot of time.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: 老師
expansion_dialogue.zh: 馬克，你的演講非常精彩。
expansion_dialogue.py: Mǎ kè, nǐ de yǎn jiǎng fēi cháng jīng cǎi.
expansion_dialogue.en: Mark, your speech was very wonderful.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: 馬克
expansion_dialogue.zh: 謝謝老師，其實我上台的時候很緊張。
expansion_dialogue.py: Xiè xie lǎo shī, qí shí wǒ shàng tái de shí hòu hěn jǐn zhāng.
expansion_dialogue.en: Thank you teacher, actually I was very nervous when I went on stage.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: 老師
expansion_dialogue.zh: 看不出來，你的台風很穩，而且發音也很清楚。
expansion_dialogue.py: Kàn bù chū lái, nǐ de tái fēng hěn wěn, ér qiě fā yīn yě hěn qīng chǔ.
expansion_dialogue.en: Couldn't tell, your stage presence was steady, and your pronunciation was clear.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: 馬克
expansion_dialogue.zh: 因為我昨天和朋友練習了好幾次。
expansion_dialogue.py: Yīn wèi wǒ zuó tiān hé péng yǒu liàn xí le hǎo jǐ cì.
expansion_dialogue.en: Because I practiced with a friend several times yesterday.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: 老師
expansion_dialogue.zh: 練習果然有用。下次如果有比賽，你要不要參加？
expansion_dialogue.py: Liàn xí guǒ rán yǒu yòng. Xià cì rú guǒ yǒu bǐ sài, nǐ yào bù yào cān jiā?
expansion_dialogue.en: Practice really works. If there is a competition next time, do you want to participate?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: 馬克
expansion_dialogue.zh: 好啊，我願意挑戰看看。
expansion_dialogue.py: Hǎo a, wǒ yuàn yì tiǎo zhàn kàn kàn.
expansion_dialogue.en: Sure, I am willing to challenge it.

title: Final Review Conversation
story_description: Mark and A-ming review their language learning progress, discuss past difficulties, and set future goals.
story_intro: 馬克學中文已經將近一年了。
今天他和阿明在喝茶聊天。
他們回顧了這一年來學習的進步。
馬克分享了他剛開始遇到的困難。
他們也討論了未來的學習目標。

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 馬克，時間過得真快，你學中文快一年了。
dialogue.py: Ā-míng, shí jiān guò de zhēn kuài, nǐ xué zhōng wén kuài yì nián le.
dialogue.en: Mark, time flies so fast, you've been learning Chinese for almost a year.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 對啊，我覺得我的進步滿大的。
dialogue.py: Duì a, wǒ jué de wǒ de jìn bù mǎn dà de.
dialogue.en: Yes, I feel my progress has been quite big.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 你剛開始學的時候，覺得什麼最困難？
dialogue.py: Nǐ gāng kāi shǐ xué de shí hòu, jué de shén me zuì kùn nán?
dialogue.en: When you just started learning, what did you find most difficult?

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 剛開始覺得聲調最難。我常常說錯聲調，大家聽不懂。
dialogue.py: Gāng kāi shǐ jué de shēng diào zuì nán. Wǒ cháng cháng shuō cuò shēng diào, dà jiā tīng bù dǒng.
dialogue.en: At the beginning I felt tones were the hardest. I often said the wrong tones and people couldn't understand.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 但是你現在發音很標準了。
dialogue.py: Dàn shì nǐ xiàn zài fā yīn hěn biāo zhǔn le.
dialogue.en: But your pronunciation is very standard now.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，因為我每天都聽錄音練習。雖然過程很辛苦，但是值得。
dialogue.py: Xiè xie, yīn wèi wǒ měi tiān dōu tīng lù yīn liàn xí. Suī rán guò chéng hěn xīn kǔ, dàn shì zhí de.
dialogue.en: Thank you, because I practice listening to recordings every day. Although the process was hard, it was worth it.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 那你現在覺得什麼比較難？
dialogue.py: Nà nǐ xiàn zài jué de shén me bǐ jiào nán?
dialogue.en: Then what do you find harder now?

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 現在覺得中文字比較難，有些字長得很像，很容易寫錯。
dialogue.py: Xiàn zài jué de zhōng wén zì bǐ jiào nán, yǒu xiē zì zhǎng de hěn xiàng, hěn róng yì xiě cuò.
dialogue.en: Now I feel Chinese characters are harder, some characters look very similar and are easy to write wrong.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 這很正常，我們台灣人有時候也會忘記怎麼寫。
dialogue.py: Zhè hěn zhèng cháng, wǒ men Tái wān rén yǒu shí hòu yě huì wàng jì zěn me xiě.
dialogue.en: That's very normal, we Taiwanese sometimes also forget how to write them.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？這讓我放心一點了。
dialogue.py: Zhēn de ma? Zhè ràng wǒ fàng xīn yì diǎn le.
dialogue.en: Really? That makes me feel a bit relieved.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 那你明年的目標是什麼？
dialogue.py: Nà nǐ míng nián de mù biāo chì shén me?
dialogue.en: So what is your goal for next year?

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 我希望能看懂中文新聞，還想挑戰去考B1的檢定考試。
dialogue.py: Wǒ xī wàng néng kàn dǒng zhōng wén xīn wén, hái xiǎng tiǎo zhàn qù kǎo B1 de jiǎn dìng kǎo shì.
dialogue.en: I hope to be able to read Chinese news, and also want to challenge taking the B1 proficiency test.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 很好的目標！我相信你一定做得到。
dialogue.py: Hěn hǎo de mù biāo! Wǒ xiāng xìn nǐ yí dìng zuò de dào.
dialogue.en: Great goal! I believe you definitely can do it.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你的鼓勵。其實我很感謝你。
dialogue.py: Xiè xie nǐ de gǔ lì. Qí shí wǒ hěn gǎn xiè nǐ.
dialogue.en: Thanks for your encouragement. Actually I am very grateful to you.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 感謝我？為什麼？
dialogue.py: Gǎn xiè wǒ? Wèi shén me?
dialogue.en: Grateful to me? Why?

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 因為你常常陪我聊天，幫我練習口語。有朋友的幫助，學習變得更有趣。
dialogue.py: Yīn wèi nǐ cháng cháng péi wǒ liáo tiān, bāng wǒ liàn xí kǒu yǔ. Yǒu péng yǒu de bāng zhù, xué xí biàn de gèng yǒu qù.
dialogue.en: Because you often chat with me and help me practice speaking. With a friend's help, learning becomes more interesting.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 別客氣，我們是好朋友嘛。以後我們繼續用中文聊天。
dialogue.py: Bié kè qì, wǒ men chì hǎo péng yǒu ma. Yǐ hòu wǒ men jì xù yòng zhōng wén liáo tiān.
dialogue.en: You're welcome, we are good friends. We will continue to chat in Chinese in the future.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 一言為定！
dialogue.py: Yì yán wéi dìng!
dialogue.en: It's a deal!

key_sentences.zh: 時間過得真快，快一年了。
key_sentences.en: Time flies so fast, it's been almost a year.

key_sentences.en: This is very normal, no need to worry too much.

key_sentences.example: 有了電腦，工作變得更方便。

passage.title: Final Review Conversation Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克學中文已經將近一年了。今天他和阿明在喝茶聊天。他們回顧了這一年來學習的進步。馬克分享了他剛開始遇到的困難。他們也討論了未來的學習目標。
passage.en: Mark, time flies so fast, you've been learning Chinese for almost a year. Yes, I feel my progress has been quite big. When you just started learning, what did you find most difficult? At the beginning I felt tones were the hardest. I often said the wrong tones and people couldn't understand. But your pronunciation is very standard now. Thank you, because I practice listening to recordings every day. Although the process was hard, it was worth it. Then what do you find harder now? Now I feel Chinese characters are harder, some characters look very similar and are easy to write wrong.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

writing: Write a paragraph (100-140 words) reviewing your own language learning progress. State one difficulty you overcame and one future goal.

grammar.explanation: '雖然...但是...' (suī rán... dàn shì...) means 'Although... but...'. In Chinese, both words are often used together in a sentence, unlike in English where 'although' and 'but' cannot appear in the same clause.
examples: 雖然過程很辛苦，但是值得。
雖然下雨了，但是我們還是出門了。
雖然他學中文不久，但是說得很好。
雖然這家餐廳很貴，但是很好吃。
雖然我很累，但是我還是把功課做完了。

practice.q: Translate: Although the exam was hard, I passed.
practice.a: 雖然考試很難，但是我通過了。

practice.q: Translate: Although he is busy, he exercises every day.
practice.a: 雖然他很忙，但是他每天運動。

practice.q: Translate: Although I don't have money, I am very happy.
practice.a: 雖然我沒有錢，但是我很開心。

practice.a: 雖然中文很難，但是很有趣。

practice.q: Translate: Although she is young, she is very smart.
practice.a: 雖然她很年輕，但是很聰明。

expansion_dialogue.speaker: 馬克
expansion_dialogue.zh: 除了學習，這一年我也去了台灣很多地方。
expansion_dialogue.py: Chú le xué xí, zhè yì nián wǒ yě qù le Tái wān hěn duō dì fāng.
expansion_dialogue.en: Besides studying, I also went to many places in Taiwan this year.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: 阿明
expansion_dialogue.zh: 你最喜歡哪個城市？
expansion_dialogue.py: Nǐ zuì xǐ huān nǎ ge chéng shì?
expansion_dialogue.en: Which city do you like the most?

expansion_dialogue.speaker: 馬克
expansion_dialogue.zh: 我最喜歡台南，那裡有很多歷史建築，食物也很好吃。
expansion_dialogue.py: Wǒ zuì xǐ huān Tái nán, nà lǐ yǒu hěn duō lì shǐ jiàn zhù, shí wù yě hěn hǎo chī.
expansion_dialogue.en: I like Tainan the most, there are many historical buildings, and the food is very good.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: 阿明
expansion_dialogue.zh: 下次有機會我帶你去花蓮看看東部的風景。
expansion_dialogue.py: Xià cì yǒu jī huì wǒ dài nǐ qù Huā lián kàn kàn dōng bù de fēng jǐng.
expansion_dialogue.en: Next time if there's a chance, I will take you to Hualien to see the scenery of the east.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: 馬克
expansion_dialogue.zh: 好啊，我很期待！
expansion_dialogue.py: Hǎo a, wǒ hěn qī dài!
expansion_dialogue.en: Great, I look forward to it!

title: Final Story: One Year of Learning
story_description: A comprehensive story reflecting on Mark's one year in Taiwan—studying, making friends, solving problems, and becoming confident.
story_intro: 馬克來台灣一年了，今天是他的告別派對。
他回想剛來的時候，一句中文都不會說。
這一年裡，他不僅學會了語言，還交了許多朋友。
他去餐廳打工，也自己出門旅行，解決了很多困難。
他感謝這段旅程，並期待未來能再回來。

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 馬克，恭喜你完成了一年的學習計畫。明天就要回國了，會捨不得嗎？
dialogue.py: Ā-míng, gōng xǐ nǐ wán chéng le yì nián de xué xí jì huà. Míng tiān jiù yào huí guó le, huì shě bù dé ma?
dialogue.en: Mark, congratulations on completing your one-year study plan. You are going back to your country tomorrow, will you be reluctant to leave?

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 非常捨不得。台灣已經變成我的第二個家了。
dialogue.py: Fēi cháng shě bù dé. Tái wān yǐ jīng biàn chéng wǒ de dì èr ge jiā le.
dialogue.en: Very reluctant. Taiwan has already become my second home.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 還記得你剛來的時候，連點杯珍珠奶茶都不會。
dialogue.py: Hái jì de nǐ gāng lái de shí hòu, lián diǎn bēi zhēn zhū nǎi chá dōu bú huì.
dialogue.en: I still remember when you just arrived, you couldn't even order a cup of pearl milk tea.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，對啊。那時候我只會說「你好」和「謝謝」。
dialogue.py: Hā hā, duì a. Nà shí hòu wǒ zhǐ huì shuō “nǐ hǎo” hé “xiè xie”.
dialogue.en: Haha, yeah. At that time I could only say 'Hello' and 'Thank you'.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 但你真的很努力。你不但上課認真，還去咖啡廳打工。
dialogue.py: Dàn nǐ zhēn de hěn nǔ lì. Nǐ bú dàn shàng kè rèn zhēn, hái qù kā fēi tīng dǎ gōng.
dialogue.en: But you were really hardworking. You not only studied seriously in class, but also worked part-time at a coffee shop.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 打工雖然累，但讓我的聽力和口語進步非常快。
dialogue.py: Dǎ gōng suī rán lèi, dàn ràng wǒ de tīng lì hé kǒu yǔ jìn bù fēi cháng kuài.
dialogue.en: Although working part-time was tiring, it made my listening and speaking improve very fast.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 你還自己環島旅行，連迷路都能自己解決。
dialogue.py: Nǐ hái zì jǐ huán dǎo lǚ xíng, lián mí lù dōu néng zì jǐ jiě jué.
dialogue.en: You even traveled around the island by yourself, and could even solve getting lost on your own.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 因為我知道，只要開口問，台灣人都會熱心幫忙。
dialogue.py: Yīn wèi wǒ zhī dào, zhǐ yào kāi kǒu wèn, Tái wān rén dōu huì rè xīn bāng máng.
dialogue.en: Because I know, as long as I open my mouth to ask, Taiwanese people will enthusiastically help.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 這一年對你來說最大的改變是什麼？
dialogue.py: Zhè yì nián duì nǐ lái shuō zuì dà de gǎi biàn shì shén me?
dialogue.en: What is the biggest change for you this year?

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 我變得更獨立、更有自信了。現在我不怕面對陌生的環境。
dialogue.py: Wǒ biàn de gèng dú lì, gèng yǒu zì xìn le. Xiàn zài wǒ bú pà miàn duì mò shēng de huán jìng.
dialogue.en: I became more independent and more confident. Now I am not afraid to face unfamiliar environments.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 身為你的朋友，我真的為你感到驕傲。
dialogue.py: Shēn wéi nǐ de péng yǒu, wǒ zhēn de wèi nǐ gǎn dào jiāo ào.
dialogue.en: As your friend, I am really proud of you.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 阿明，這一年最感謝的就是你。如果沒有你，我的生活會無聊很多。
dialogue.py: Ā-míng, zhè yì nián zuì gǎn xiè de jiù shì nǐ. Rú guǒ méi yǒu nǐ, wǒ de shēng huó huì wú liáo hěn duō.
dialogue.en: A-ming, what I am most grateful for this year is you. Without you, my life would be much more boring.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 別這麼說。我也從你身上學到了很多外國文化。
dialogue.py: Bié zhè me shuō. Wǒ yě cóng nǐ shēn shàng xué dào le hěn duō wài guó wén huà.
dialogue.en: Don't say that. I also learned a lot of foreign culture from you.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 我回國以後一定會繼續學中文，我們可以在網路上聊天。
dialogue.py: Wǒ huí guó yǐ hòu yí dìng huì jì xù xué zhōng wén, wǒ men kě yǐ zài wǎng lù shàng liáo tiān.
dialogue.en: After I go back, I will definitely continue learning Chinese, we can chat online.

dialogue.speaker: 阿明
dialogue.zh: 當然！下次換我去你的國家找你玩。
dialogue.py: Dāng rán! Xià cì huàn wǒ qù nǐ de guó jiā zhǎo nǐ wán.

passage.title: Final Story: One Year of Learning Listening Passage
passage.zh: 馬克來台灣一年了，今天是他的告別派對。他回想剛來的時候，一句中文都不會說。這一年裡，他不僅學會了語言，還交了許多朋友。他去餐廳打工，也自己出門旅行，解決了很多困難。他感謝這段旅程，並期待未來能再回來。
passage.en: Mark, congratulations on completing your one-year study plan. You are going back to your country tomorrow, will you be reluctant to leave? Very reluctant. Taiwan has already become my second home. I still remember when you just arrived, you couldn't even order a cup of pearl milk tea. Haha, yeah. At that time I could only say 'Hello' and 'Thank you'. But you were really hardworking. You not only studied seriously in class, but also worked part-time at a coffee shop. Although working part-time was tiring, it made my listening and speaking improve very fast. You even traveled around the island by yourself, and could even solve getting lost on your own. Because I know, as long as I open my mouth to ask, Taiwanese people will enthusiastically help.
passage.instruction: Listen to the short passage first. Then answer the comprehension, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions from memory.

grammar.explanation: '不但...而且/還...' (bú dàn... ér qiě/hái...) means 'Not only... but also...'. It is used to connect two clauses to show that both situations exist and the latter is a further step.
examples: 他不但聰明，而且很用功。
我不但上課認真，還去咖啡廳打工。
這家餐廳不但食物好吃，而且服務很好。
她不但會說英文，還會說日文。
這個手機不但便宜，而且功能很多。

expansion_dialogue.speaker: 馬克
expansion_dialogue.zh: 哇，是一本相簿，裡面都是我們的照片！

expansion_dialogue.speaker: 朋友B

expansion_dialogue.speaker: 馬克
expansion_dialogue.zh: 我一定會好好保存的。認識你們是我最大的收穫。

expansion_dialogue.en: I will definitely keep it well. Knowing you all is my biggest harvest.

expansion_dialogue.speaker: 大家
expansion_dialogue.zh: 馬克，祝你未來一切順利！
expansion_dialogue.py: Mǎ kè, zhù nǐ wèi lái yì qiè shùn lì!
expansion_dialogue.en: Mark, wish you all the best in the future!
